title: Director of Operations
description:
LightPath Technologies, Inc. is a leading global provider of precision optics and photonics solutions, serving defense, aerospace, medical, and industrial markets. With decades of expertise and a strong culture of innovation, LightPath designs and manufactures advanced optical components and systems that power some of the world’s most demanding applications. We offer a collaborative, technology-driven environment, opportunities to work on cutting-edge programs, and a comprehensive benefits package that supports our employees’ health, growth, and work-life balance.

We are currently looking for a Director of Operations to join our team onsite in our Plano, TX office. We offer a 9/80 work schedule and foster a professional, high-energy culture where employees are empowered to succeed.

Responsible for the daily operations of the company, including thin film production, camera and optics production, supply chain management, warehousing, facilities operations and quality, as they pertain to daily operation of the company. Develop and manage a plan to increase production capacities, and onboard new products as they become available from Engineering and oversee hiring to meet goals.

Responsibilities:

Operational Leadership

  • Provide strategic and tactical leadership across manufacturing, production, supply chain, and logistics functions
  • Drive operational performance to meet or exceed safety, quality, delivery, and cost (SQDC) objectives
  • Lead daily operations with a focus on throughput, yield improvement, and on-time delivery

Strategic Planning & Execution

  • Develop and execute operational strategies aligned with corporate goals and growth initiatives
  • Translate business objectives into actionable operational plans and measurable outcomes
  • Support capacity planning, capital investments, and facility expansion as needed

Continuous Improvement

  • Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement initiatives across all operational areas
  • Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, reduce waste, and optimize costs
  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational dashboards

Financial & Business Management

  • Develop and manage operating budgets, forecasts, and cost controls
  • Drive margin improvement through productivity gains, cost reduction, and process optimization
  • Partner with Finance to analyze performance and support strategic decision-making

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with all applicable regulations, including ITAR, EAR, and other U.S. government contracting requirements
  • Maintain adherence to industry standards such as ISO and applicable military specifications
  • Promote a culture of safety, compliance, and ethical business practices

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Build, lead, and develop high-performing teams across multiple operational disciplines
  • Establish succession planning, workforce development, and leadership training programs
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Engineering on new product introduction (NPI), process development, and design for manufacturability (DFM)
  • Collaborate with Sales and Program Management to ensure customer requirements and delivery commitments are achieved
  • Work closely with Quality to ensure compliance with customer and regulatory standards

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred
  • Minimum 10–15 years of progressive operations leadership experience, including senior-level management
  • Experience in optics, photonics, precision manufacturing, or similar high-tech environments strongly preferred
  • Experience supporting defense, aerospace, or government contracts required

Technical & Regulatory Expertise

  • Strong knowledge of ITAR/EAR compliance, government contracting requirements, and export controls
  • Familiarity with ISO standards, MIL specifications, and regulated manufacturing environments
  • Experience with ERP/MRP systems and data-driven decision-making

Leadership Competencies

  • Proven ability to lead large, cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities
  • Excellent communication and executive presence

title: Warehouse Technican
location: Ethos Biosciences NJ - Logan Township, NJ 08085
description:
Who We Are

Ott Scientific

The Ott Scientific family of companies comprises Polysciences, Bangs Laboratories, and Ethos Biosciences. Together, we bring the whole of our experience with best-in-class facilities and scientific, technical, analytical, and manufacturing capabilities to serve customers around the globe. We deliver highly specialized products and services that support scientific discovery and innovations.

Ethos Biosciences

At Ethos Biosciences, we are a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) that offers private label manufacturing to many of the biggest life science and diagnostic companies around the world. Our laboratories, manufacturing suites, and warehouse areas are purpose built to accommodate these specialty manufacturing and development operations. We exist to drive healthcare innovation by providing diagnostic tools for scientists and practitioners. Every day we design, develop, and manufacturing diagnostic products that are accurate, repeatable, and easy to use. Our vision is to provide gold standard assays for novel biomarkers and critical reagents to institutions pioneering biomedical research and practice.

title: Begeleider vluchtelingen-dagopvang locatie in Ter Apel
description:
Wat draag je bij?
Op korte termijn zijn we voor de dagopvang locatie in Ter Apel, (waar vluchtelingen wachten tot er plek is bij het COA) op zoek naar enthousiaste en betrokken vrijwilligers die zich willen inzetten voor asielzoekers en vluchtelingen.

Op het “voorterrein” in Ter Apel komen mensen aan die vaak onzeker, vermoeid of gespannen zijn. Zij weten niet altijd wat er gaat gebeuren, waar ze terechtkunnen en welke stappen zij kunnen verwachten.

Als vrijwilliger van VluchtelingenWerk Nederland ben jij één van de eerste aanspreekpunten. Je biedt een luisterend oor, geeft begrijpelijke uitleg en houdt in de gaten of iemand extra ondersteuning nodig heeft.

Je bent aanwezig op een plek waar mensen vaak veel hebben meegemaakt en behoefte hebben aan een luisterend oor, praktische ondersteuning en duidelijke informatie.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Als vrijwilliger op het voorterrein

    • Luister je naar mensen en geef je ruimte aan hun vragen en zorgen.

    • Leg je uit wat er op dat moment gebeurt en welke vervolgstappen mensen kunnen verwachten.

    • Geef je praktische en begrijpelijke informatie over de procedure en de opvang, binnen de informatie die je als vrijwilliger kunt geven.

    • Signaleer je kwetsbaarheid, bijvoorbeeld wanneer iemand erg angstig, verward, ziek, alleenstaand of anderszins extra ondersteuning nodig lijkt te hebben.

    • Bespreek je signalen met de aanwezige medewerkers en zorg je dat iemand bij de juiste hulp of organisatie terechtkomt.

    • Stel je mensen gerust door duidelijkheid te geven en verwachtingen te verduidelijken.

    • Draag je bij aan een rustige, respectvolle en veilige sfeer op het voorterrein.

    Je hoeft niet overal een antwoord op te hebben. Het belangrijkste is dat je goed luistert, signalen herkent en weet wanneer je moet doorverwijzen.

  • Wij zoeken mensen die:

    • Een luisterend oor kunnen bieden, ook wanneer iemand emotioneel of gespannen is.

    • Duidelijk en rustig kunnen communiceren.

    • Goed kunnen omgaan met mensen met verschillende culturele achtergronden.

    • Oog hebben voor mensen die mogelijk extra kwetsbaar zijn.

    • Niet snel oordelen en respectvol omgaan met verschillende verhalen en situaties.

    • Hun eigen grenzen kennen en kunnen aangeven.

    • Goed kunnen samenwerken met medewerkers van VWN, het Rode Kruis en andere betrokken organisaties.

    • Beschikbaar zijn voor een aantal uur per week of op regelmatige basis.

    Ervaring met vluchtelingen of asielzoekers is mooi meegenomen, maar niet noodzakelijk. We vinden vooral jouw betrokkenheid, open houding en bereidheid om te leren belangrijk.

Wat vragen wij?

  • Beschikbaarheid van minimaal 6 uur per week

  • De mogelijkheid om op locatie Ter Apel te werken

  • Een betrokken en respectvolle houding naar vluchtelingen en collega’s.

  • Inlevingsvermogen en geduld.

  • Bereidheid om trainingen te volgen en je aan de richtlijnen en afspraken van VluchtelingenWerk te houden.

  • Goede beheersing van het Nederlands (liefst op minimaal B1 niveau).

  • Beheersing van een andere taal zoals Arabisch, Tigrinya, of Farsi/Dari is een pré.

  • Vermogen om creatief te communiceren, denk aan non-verbaal, vertaal apps, tekenen, simpel en langzaam spreken. Onze cliënten zijn bezig met het leren van het Nederlands. Soms spreken de cliënten Engels.

Wat bieden wij?

  • De kans om iets te kunnen betekenen voor anderen.

  • Fijne contacten en gezelligheid in een divers team, onder begeleiding van een beroepskracht.

  • Volop mogelijkheden om te leren over andere achtergronden en culturen.

  • Ruimte voor eigen ontwikkeling en initiatief.

  • Een gedegen inwerkprogramma.

  • Mogelijkheden om e-learnings, trainingen en cursussen te volgen bij de VluchtelingenWerk Academie. Dit zowel om (juridische) kennis op te doen als je sociale en professionele vaardigheden te ontwikkelen;

  • Onkostenvergoeding

Heb je interesse?

Laat dan hier je gegevens achter en wij nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op.

title: Tax Advisor
description:

To provide expert tax advice and services to clients, ensuring accurate and timely completion of individual and business tax returns. This role involves direct client communication, planning and advisory services and review of tax returns, and acting as an advocate for clients with tax authorities.


Key Responsibilities:

Tax Planning and Compliance:

  • Maintain knowledge of tax laws and tax planning strategies, especially strategies discussed in Anderon marketing and forums.
  • Provide consultation services for clients as requested, analyzing client's facts and circumstances to provide guidance and alternatives.
  • Fulfill on 2-year review, Tax Saver Pro, and other service offerings pertaining to tax planning and consultation.
  • Participate in and contribute to various advisory resource functions such as the Knowledge Room and respond to client-submitted queries such as Platinum Questions.
  • Participate in tax resolution and controversy matters as needed.
  • Contribute on an as-needed basis to assist with the review and signing of tax returns.

Client Communication:

  • Communicate with clients across the country via telephone, email and video calls regarding tax matters.
  • Act as an advocate on behalf of clients when communicating with the IRS and other tax authorities.

Team Support:

  • Contribute to team goals and objectives by providing support and guidance to junior staff.
  • Build positive relationships with team members and resolve minor conflicts within the team.

Process Improvement:

  • Identify opportunities for improving tax preparation and review processes.
  • Implement best practices to enhance accuracy and efficiency.

Administrative Tasks:

  • Ensure all client documentation is accurately recorded and maintained.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned by Company management to support the overall objectives of the organization.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.|
  • EA, CPA, or attorney with tax specialization required.
  • 2-3 years of experience in tax preparation or advisory services at a CPA firm.
  • 2 years of experience preparing individual (1040) federal and state tax returns.
  • 2 years of experience preparing business (1120, 1120S, 1065, 1041) tax returns.
  • Must be able to effectively organize, prioritize, and manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong Excel skills including pivot tables.
  • Experience with tax preparation and planning software including Forms 1120, 1065, 1120S, and 1040. Experience with BNA Tax Planner, Corvee, CCH Axcess or CCH ProSystem fx is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Additional certifications or coursework related to advanced tax strategies or financial management.

Performance Metrics:

  • Client Satisfaction: Measured by client feedback and satisfaction survey results.
  • Efficiency: Timely completion of tax planning and advisory tasks.
  • Communication: Responsiveness to client communication and effective team collaboration.
  • Accuracy: Ensuring accuracy in tax planning, advisory and review processes.

Forsyth County, NC | Paid Per Billable Contact

Help Strengthen Families Where They Need It Most

Youth Haven Services is seeking a compassionate and dedicated Qualified Professionals (QP) to provide Intensive In-Home (IIH) services to children, adolescents, and their families throughout Forsyth County, NC.

This position is ideal for professionals who enjoy working independently, building meaningful relationships with families, and helping youth remain safely in their homes and communities.   • Perform other duties as assigned in support of the Intensive In-Home program.

Education

Experience

  • Minimum of two (2) years of documented experience working with children, adolescents, and families receiving behavioral health or mental health services.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.

title: Technical Project Manager - Engine by Starling
description:
At Engine by Starling, we are on a mission to find and work with leading banks all around the world who have the ambition to build rapid growth businesses, on our technology.

Engine is Starling's software-as-a-service (SaaS) business, the technology that was built to power Starling Bank, and a year ago we split out as a separate business.

Starling Bank has seen exceptional growth and success, and a large part of that is down to the fact that we have built our own modern technology from the ground up. The Engine technology platform is now available to banks and financial institutions all around the world, enabling them to benefit from the innovative digital features, and efficient back-office processes that has helped achieve Starling's success.

Our people are at the very heart of Engine and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together!

The way to thrive and shine within Engine is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, and discovering to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness.

Hybrid Working

We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Engine - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of London so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person.

About Engineering at Engine by Starling -

We are hiring a Technical Program Manager to join our Technology team at Engine. You will be responsible for delivering a critical, strategic programmes within a technical and product domain.

This role will involve technical understanding with complex strategic coordination in a multi-client environment. You will support product consultants, engineering leads and our account managers with planning and commitment setting, as we scale internationally and continue to grow our client base with competing needs.

Working closely with Engine’s Engineering and Product teams and reporting directly into Engineering, along with external payment schemes and technology providers, you will oversee the end-to-end implementation of a diverse range of complex projects across different areas of the business. Reporting directly to Engineering and collaborating closely with Engine’s Engineering and Product teams, your role will be to manage the end-to-end implementation of various complex projects. This will involve working across different business areas and engaging with external payment schemes and technology providers.

We're looking for someone who thrives delivering in a flexible environment; previous experience working in Financial Services or Technology companies would be an advantage. This role has room to grow, with opportunities to take on wider programme management of challenging inter-woven engineering and product deliveries.

If you’re interested, our main backend stack is; Java microservices in Kubernetes (EKS), on AWS & GCP using TeamCity for CI / CD (with multiple production releases per day) backed by Terraform and Grafana.


What You'll Do: Key Responsibilities

  • Overall management and co-ordination of a technical programme, managing a portfolio of multiple complex, inter-dependent projects. You’ll serve as the key bridge between Engineering, Clients and our Delivery partners.
  • Work closely with Engineering Leads to support the Software Development Lifecycle, understanding work dependencies and complexities. Collaborate across multiple teams to coordinate work and effort. Support Product and Engineering to produce an achievable plan.
  • Working with Product Leads to maintain a clear, real-time understanding of all client competing needs against our internal capacity. Proactively identifying risks of over-commitment to ensure realistic delivery timelines.
  • Owning relationships with external parties such as vendors and payment schemes. Ensuring service is provided to a high standard and holding them accountable where they play a key role in project delivery.
  • Provide key reporting and metrics for delivery progress and tracking against plans.
  • Continually monitor processes and implement improvements.

Requirements

Ideally you will have:

  • End-to-end Project or Programme Management experience, ideally within a technology or financial services environment.
  • Proven experience working directly with Engineering and Product teams to deliver complex technical solutions and experience in the software-as-a-service sector.
  • A 'hands-on' and adaptable approach to programme delivery, with the ability to thrive in a flexible, fast-paced environment where priorities can shift.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience communicating complex technical topics.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and a creative problem-solving ability to navigate ambiguity and technical hurdles.
  • Technical skills and the ability to talk to Product and Engineering teams.
  • Strong experience working on cards projects is highly desirable

Our interview process:

Interviewing is a two way process and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you! Our interviews are conversational and we want to get the best from you, so come with questions and be curious. In general you can expect the below, following a chat with one of our Talent Team:

  1. First interview (60 mins) - with someone from the team to get to know you, discuss the role, your skills, and how we work at Engine.
  2. Final interview (45 mins) - with the Technical Programme Manager and Engineering Director

Benefits

  • 33 days holiday (including public holidays, which you can take when it works best for you)
  • An extra day’s holiday for your birthday
  • Annual leave is increased with length of service, and you can choose to buy or sell up to five extra days off
  • 16 hours paid volunteering time a year
  • Salary sacrifice, company enhanced pension scheme
  • Life insurance at 4x your salary & group income protection
  • Private Medical Insurance with VitalityHealth including mental health support and cancer care. Partner benefits include discounts with Waitrose, Mr&Mrs Smith and Peloton
  • Generous family-friendly policies
  • Incentives refer a friend scheme
  • Perkbox membership giving access to retail discounts, a wellness platform for physical and mental health, and weekly free and boosted perks
  • Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work, Salary Sacrificed Gym partnerships and Electric Vehicle (EV) leasing

About Us

You may be put off applying for a role because you don't tick every box. Forget that! While we can’t accommodate every flexible working request, we're always open to discussion. So, if you're excited about working with us, but aren’t sure if you're 100% there yet, get in touch anyway. We’re on a mission to radically reshape banking – and that starts with our brilliant team. Whatever came before, we’re proud to bring together people of all backgrounds and experiences who love working together to solve problems.

title: Resident Advocate 3p-11p M-F (52283)
description:
OUR MISSION

The Family Place empowers survivors of family violence by providing safe housing, counseling, and skills that create independence while building community engagement and advocating for social change to stop family violence.

Position Summary:

Are you passionate about making a difference? When you take on this role, you will play a vital part in creating a safe and supportive environment for survivors of family violence as they begin rebuilding their lives. By ensuring the shelter remains secure, welcoming, and well-maintained, you help restore a sense of stability and dignity for each resident. Through compassionate support, active listening, and collaboration with the program team, you will not only ensure client safety but also empower individuals to move forward with confidence and hope. Your presence helps transform the shelter from a temporary refuge into a place of healing, growth, and new beginnings.

As a Resident Advocate, you're often the first face our clients see when they walk through the door, and sometimes, it's the first time in a long time they feel safe. You play a vital role in creating a supportive, stable environment where survivors of domestic violence can begin to heal. Whether it’s offering comfort during a crisis, ensuring the shelter is safe and clean, or simply being a consistent, caring presence, the work you do helps individuals and families feel seen, respected, and empowered. Your compassion, attention, and advocacy directly impact their ability to rebuild their lives with dignity and hope.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provides emotional support to residential clients by demonstrating sensitivity and support to those in crisis through active listening and comforting words in a non-judgmental manner.
  • Collaborate with Case Managers, supervisor, and designated staff on service updates or needs for clients through documentation, email, and/or verbal communication.
  • Intervenes in crisis situations, is intentional in words and action, by using approved de-escalation and crisis intervention methods that promote the safety of all residents.
  • Provides timely communication to supervisor and designated staff regarding pertinent client situations and issues.
  • Assure that all intakes with new clients include reviewing shelter policies, tours of the facility, completing intake paperwork, access for immediate needs, and providing personal supplies within 24 hours.
  • Assists client with basic life skills activities, including healthy habits, clean living skills, organization, daily planning, time management, etc.
  • Conducts client exit interviews, safety planning when needed (for unplanned exits), exit surveys, and schedules transportation services.
  • Monitor inventory, document items taken from the adult/children closet, including inventory in overflow storage location, and report to operations and direct supervisor when inventory items need replenishing.
  • Monitor the resident advocate desk and assist clients with basic needs, such as distributing medication, toiletries, cleaning supplies, etc., and document appropriately in Clients First.
  • Monitors the facility for safety and cleanliness. Take appropriate action to maintain the cleanliness of the shelter, as needed. Provides light household tasks (i.e., spot cleaning rooms for in/out clients) and sanitizing common areas of the shelter.
  • Transport clients in the company vehicle to and from appointments and meetings, or hospital when necessary.
  • Interact with interns and volunteers and support and guide them when necessary.
  • Co-facilitate Resident meetings, assist with volunteer groups, and children’s activities during adult groups.
  • Assist with special events and other program activities scheduled during the shift.
  • Provides backup coverage for hotline phone calls, assesses the level of client risk, and, through active listening, comforting words, and positive problem-solving, provides mental and emotional support.


Other Duties: Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

title: Developer Experience Engineer
description:
Antwerpen – Zoek je een uitdagende, leerzame en innovatieve ervaring als Developer Experience Engineer? Dan is deze rol in een moderne, software-gedreven en snel veranderende omgeving precies wat je zoekt!

Bij DPG Media ontwikkelen we consumentenproducten die door miljoenen klanten worden gebruikt, evenals in-house producten waar dagelijks duizenden journalisten en andere collega’s mee werken. Dit doen we met behulp van geavanceerde cloud-, AI- en development-technologieën.

Wat is Developer Experience?

DevEx is een user-centric initiatief gericht op het empoweren van onze engineeringteams. We behandelen onze developers als klanten, met als doel wrijving te verminderen en ons technologielandschap te standaardiseren via drie strategische pijlers:

1. AI-Assisted Software Development (DevGenAI)

Dit is momenteel een zeer strategische pijler waarin fors wordt geïnvesteerd:

  • Experiment & Implement: Versterk en onderhoud de kennis van de DevGenAI-markt door experimenten. Claude Code en GitHub Copilot zijn momenteel onze primaire DevGenAI-technologieën.

  • Build the DevGenAI Ecosystem: Creëer herbruikbare bouwblokken zoals een DevGenAI metrics platform, skills catalog, MCP registry, agentic infrastructure, etc.

  • Foster Community: Leid hackathons en events om de kloof tussen AI-potentieel en de dagelijkse praktijk te overbruggen.

2. Internal Developer Platform (IDP)

We bouwen en onderhouden een op maat gemaakt developer platform om developers in de "flow" te houden:

  • Beheer en ontsluiting van een Internal Developer Platform (IDP) gebaseerd op Backstage.

  • Dit platform bevat hoofdzakelijk onze software catalog, documentation portal en herbruikbare code templates / scaffolders.

3. Application Delivery

We streven ernaar om de manier waarop we code shippen te vereenvoudigen en te consolideren. Je helpt ons delivery-landschap te verfijnen door gebruik te maken van:

  • Version Control & CI/CD: Het orkestreren van workflows via GitHub.

  • Artifact Management: Het stroomlijnen van onze supply chain met Cloudsmith.

Aangezien Developer Experience nieuw en innovatief is, maakt het omarmen van verandering integraal deel uit van de baan.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Build & Evolve: Je bent eigenaar van de technische implementatie van ons DevEx-ecosysteem. Vandaag betekent dit werken met Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Backstage, Microsoft Foundry, Grafana en Cloudsmith.

  • Engineer met moderne talen: Ontwikkel robuuste oplossingen met TypeScript, Terraform en AWS CDK binnen een AWS-heavy landschap.

  • Support & Troubleshoot: Fungeer als expert voor gebruikersvragen en incidenten, zodat onze developers productief blijven.

  • Advocate: Sla de brug tussen engineering en product door bij te dragen aan Developer Relations en interne community-initiatieven.

  • Collaborate: Werk in een Agile-team waar jouw stem de roadmap vormgeeft, samen met de Product Owner en collega-engineers.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je bent een ervaren IT-engineer die graag problemen oplost en anderen helpt succesvol te zijn. Je beschikt over een sterk analytisch vermogen en leerkracht.

  • Met je open mindset en toegankelijke houding onderhoud je positieve en effectieve relaties met de development community.

  • Je bent een natuurlijke communicator, benaderbaar en empathisch. Je bent vaardig in het uitleggen van technische onderwerpen aan mensen met verschillende expertiseniveaus.

  • Je bent resultaatgericht en streeft er dagelijks naar om jezelf, het proces en het product op een natuurlijke manier te verbeteren.

  • Kennis van een of meer van de volgende gebieden helpt zeker: frontend / backend development, system engineering, public cloud (AWS), developer tools, DevGenAI, etc.

  • Je krijgt energie van troubleshooting en hebt een proactieve aanpak in het vinden van oplossingen.

  • Ons kernteam is gevestigd in Antwerpen, maar we staan open voor talent uit heel Nederland en België.

    • Woon je in België? Dan verwachten we je gemiddeld 2 dagen per week op kantoor voor een optimale samenwerking.

    • Woon je in Nederland? In dat geval spreken we een flexibeler schema af, waarbij we je minstens één keer per week in België verwelkomen om de connectie met het team en de omgeving te behouden.

Pluspunten scoor je met:

  • Ervaring met de meeste van de hierboven beschreven technologieën.

  • Vloeiende beheersing van zowel het Nederlands als het Engels.

  • Minimaal een HBO/Bachelor diploma.

Wie zijn wij?

Bij DPG Media staan we open voor alle talent in de maatschappij. Ongeacht je achtergrond, nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren op deze functie. Juist door de verschillen tussen collega’s ontstaan verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen. En dat past dan weer heel erg goed bij ons als organisatie. We zijn benieuwd wie jij bent en welke kwaliteiten en ervaring jij meebrengt. Wil je meer weten over onze inclusieve werkomgeving, klik dan hier!
Wat zit er nog in je pakket?

🌟 Beloning die bij je past: Krijg een salaris dat net zo indrukwekkend is als je cv en talenten.

💻 Alles wat je nodig hebt: We zorgen dat je alles in huis hebt – laptop, telefoon en maaltijdcheques – zodat je helemaal los kunt gaan op je werk.

🛡️ Zorgeloos verzekerd: Met onze verzekering ben je helemaal gedekt, no worries!

📝 Flexibiliteit: Met mogelijkheden voor thuiswerkdagen kies je wat het beste voor jou werkt. Zin in een pyjamadag? Gewoon doen! Alles om werk en privé in balans te houden.

💰 Deel in ons succes: Als DPG Media scoort, scoor jij ook. Extra zakcentjes op basis van onze prestaties. Ka-ching!

🚴 Slimme mobiliteit: Of je nu fietst, met het OV komt of parkeert, jij kiest wat het beste werkt.

🎓 Blijf groeien: Ontdek continu nieuwe hoogtes via de DPG Media Academy. Wie zei dat leren saai moest zijn?

🌴 Tijd voor ontspanning: Met 32 vakantiedagen kun je je batterij weer helemaal opladen.

🏢 Kantoren vol creativiteit: Laat je inspireren in onze bruisende hubs in Antwerpen of Vilvoorde.

🔖 Media Kortingen: Scoor leuke deals op onze media en evenementen. Want wie houdt er niet van een goede deal?

🎉 Top sfeer: Van spontane feestjes tot teamuitjes, hier voel je je meteen thuis. En ons legendarische personeelsfeest? Daar wil je niets van missen!

Solliciteren, en dan?

Ben jij een topper in je vakgebied of heb je de ambitie om dat te worden? Fleur je helemaal op in een warme, creatieve en bruisende omgeving waar je constant uitgedaagd wordt? Solliciteer via de onderstaande button en laten we samen bekijken wat we voor elkaar kunnen betekenen. Want jouw talent is welkom bij DPG Media, ongeacht jouw achtergrond en voorkeuren.

Meer weten neem dan contact op met Toon Hertogs via toon.hertogs@persgroep.net.

title: Program Director (52652)
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Program Director ensures program services are delivered in accordance with grant requirements, applicable federal and state requirements, contractual obligations, WestCare policies and procedures, and established program goals and performance measures. This position provides supervision and leadership to program staff, develops and maintains collaborative relationships with Veteran-serving organizations and community partners, oversees grant performance and reporting, monitors service quality and program outcomes, and ensures appropriate stewardship of grant resources.

The Program Director promotes a Veteran-centered, trauma-informed, recovery-oriented, culturally responsive, and person-centered approach to suicide prevention

Essential functions include those listed below.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Provides overall leadership, direction, and day-to-day management of the program.
  • Ensures program services are implemented in accordance with the approved grant application, VA requirements, applicable regulations, contractual obligations, and WestCare policies and procedures.
  • Develops, implements, and monitors program procedures, workflows, service-delivery practices, and operational processes.
  • Ensures program activities remain consistent with the goals, objectives, scope of services, approved budget, and performance expectations established by the grant.
  • Monitors program operations and identifies opportunities to improve efficiency, service quality, participant engagement, and outcomes.
  • Ensures appropriate staffing and program coverage to meet service-delivery requirements.
  • Provides leadership and direction during programmatic, participant, or operational emergencies.
  • Participates in organizational leadership meetings, program meetings, grant meetings, community meetings, and other activities as assigned.
  • Maintains effective communication with WestCare leadership regarding program performance, staffing, compliance, challenges, and accomplishments.

Veteran Suicide Prevention Services

  • Provides leadership and oversight for community-based suicide prevention services for eligible Veterans, Service Members, and their families.
  • Ensures appropriate outreach and engagement strategies are implemented to identify and connect eligible individuals with available services.
  • Oversees implementation of required screening, assessment, referral, and follow-up processes within the scope of the program.
  • Ensures participants identified as potentially at risk receive timely and appropriate intervention, referral, safety planning, and connection to qualified clinical or emergency resources in accordance with established protocols.
  • Ensures staff understand and appropriately implement program procedures related to suicide risk identification, escalation, referral, and follow-up.
  • Promotes early intervention and efforts to address factors that may contribute to suicide risk, including behavioral health needs, social isolation, housing instability, financial hardship, employment concerns, access to benefits, and other social determinants of health.
  • Ensures program participants are appropriately connected with VA services, community behavioral health providers, social service organizations, and other resources based on individual needs.
  • Promotes participant engagement and continuity of services throughout program enrollment.

Staff Supervision and Development

  • Interviews, selects, trains, supervises, develops, and evaluates assigned program staff in collaboration with Human Resources and appropriate organizational leadership.
  • Provides ongoing supervision, coaching, feedback, and professional development to program staff.
  • Establishes clear expectations regarding program performance, documentation, participant services, outreach, productivity, and compliance.
  • Conducts regular individual and team meetings to review program operations, participant needs, performance measures, and emerging concerns.
  • Monitors staff performance and addresses performance concerns in accordance with WestCare policies and procedures.
  • Ensures staff receive appropriate training related to Veteran suicide prevention, trauma-informed care, suicide risk identification, cultural competency, community resources, documentation, confidentiality, and grant requirements.
  • Promotes a positive, collaborative, accountable, and professional working environment.
  • Supports employee engagement, retention, professional growth, and effective teamwork.
  • Ensures adequate staffing and appropriate distribution of program responsibilities.

Community Outreach and Partnerships

  • Develops and maintains collaborative relationships with VA facilities, Veteran-serving organizations, behavioral health providers, healthcare systems, community-based organizations, government agencies, social service providers, and other community partners.
  • Builds referral networks designed to identify and engage Veterans and other eligible individuals who may not currently be connected to VA or community services.
  • Represents WestCare and the SSG Fox SPGP at community meetings, coalitions, outreach events, Veteran events, and other appropriate activities.
  • Develops strategies to increase community awareness of available suicide prevention and supportive services.
  • Promotes coordination among community partners to reduce barriers to services and improve continuity of care.
  • Identifies opportunities for collaboration, cross-referrals, outreach, education, and community engagement.
  • Maintains professional and productive relationships with grant partners and stakeholders.

Grant Compliance and Performance Management

  • Maintains thorough knowledge of SSG Fox SPGP requirements and ensures ongoing compliance with applicable grant requirements.
  • Ensures services, expenditures, staffing, documentation, and program activities remain within the approved scope of the grant.
  • Monitors program goals, objectives, deliverables, performance measures, and participant outcomes.
  • Ensures required program data is collected accurately, completely, and within established timelines.
  • Reviews program records, participant files, reports, and other documentation for accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
  • Coordinates preparation and submission of required grant reports, performance reports, program narratives, data reports, and other requested information.
  • Maintains documentation necessary to demonstrate program performance and compliance during monitoring, audits, site visits, and grant reviews.
  • Participates in VA technical assistance, monitoring activities, site visits, conference calls, trainings, and other grant-related activities.
  • Develops and implements corrective action plans when programmatic or compliance deficiencies are identified.
  • Communicates significant grant compliance concerns promptly to appropriate organizational leadership.
  • Maintains awareness of changes to applicable SSG Fox SPGP guidance, regulations, reporting requirements, and program expectations.

Budget and Fiscal Oversight

  • Works collaboratively with organizational leadership and fiscal staff to develop, monitor, and manage the approved program budget.
  • Monitors program expenditures to ensure appropriate and allowable use of grant funds.
  • Reviews program spending and identifies budget variances or concerns requiring corrective action.
  • Ensures purchases, participant assistance, program expenses, and other expenditures comply with applicable grant and organizational requirements.
  • Assists with budget modifications, projections, and financial reporting as required.
  • Ensures appropriate stewardship and accountability for federal grant resources.
  • Maintains sufficient documentation to support program expenditures and grant-funded activities.

Quality Improvement and Documentation

  • Participates in and promotes ongoing Quality Improvement activities.
  • Conducts or coordinates regular reviews of participant records and program documentation.
  • Ensures documentation is timely, accurate, complete, professional, and consistent with applicable program requirements.
  • Uses program data, participant outcomes, performance measures, and quality findings to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Develops and implements improvement strategies when performance goals are not being achieved.
  • Ensures identified deficiencies are addressed promptly and appropriately.
  • Collaborates with Quality Assurance, Compliance, Human Resources, Finance, and organizational leadership as necessary.
  • Supports preparation for internal and external audits, reviews, monitoring visits, and program evaluations.

General Responsibilities

  • Maintains confidentiality of participant, employee, and organizational information in accordance with applicable requirements.
  • Demonstrates sound judgment and maintains professional and ethical standards in all interactions.
  • Maintains awareness of community resources available to Veterans and their families.
  • Assists other WestCare staff and programs as needed to promote organizational cooperation and effective service delivery.
  • Must Embrace and embody the mission, vision, guiding principles, clinical vision, and goals of WestCare Foundation; and
  • Perform all other duties as assigned.

title: RF Antenna Expert
description:
STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionizing the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop and manufacture high performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost effective. This provides our operators with a decisive edge in highly contested environments.

We’re focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems—not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe—today.

Support the development, selection, integration, testing, and continuous improvement of antenna solutions for STARK’s unmanned systems, Ground Control Stations, and field-ready communication setups. You will work hands-on with antennas, radios, masts, vehicles, boats, handheld configurations, test equipment, and operational GCS environments to ensure reliable RF performance across different mission profiles. A key part of the role is to identify suitable antenna concepts, build or adapt prototypes, conduct RF measurements and field tests, and translate findings into robust and repeatable antenna setups for deployment. This role is strongly practical and includes regular work in workshops, laboratories, outdoor test ranges, and real integration environments.

Antenna Selection & Design: Identify, evaluate, design, and adapt antenna solutions for drone platforms, Ground Control Stations, vehicle-based systems, handheld setups, boat-based configurations, and other mission-specific applications.

· RF Integration: Integrate antennas with radios, GCS hardware, networking equipment, masts, mounts, cables, connectors, and power systems to ensure stable and field-ready communication performance.

· Prototype Development: Build, modify, and iterate antenna prototypes, mounting concepts, cable routes, adapters, brackets, and practical integration solutions for different platforms and operational constraints.

· Measurement & Testing: Plan and conduct RF measurements, lab tests, range tests, and field trials to validate antenna performance, link quality, radiation behavior, installation effects, and operational suitability.

· Link Performance Optimization: Support the optimization of communication links by analyzing antenna gain, polarization, placement, cable losses, interference effects, line-of-sight constraints, and platform-specific installation impacts.

· Platform & GCS Adaptation: Support antenna integration for mobile GCS variants, vehicles, boats, handheld systems, portable masts, drone platforms, and other field configurations.

· Troubleshooting: Investigate RF performance issues, communication losses, degraded link behavior, installation problems, and integration conflicts together with radio, data link, GCS, and flight test teams.

· Documentation: Document antenna setups, measurement results, test configurations, installation constraints, cable dependencies, lessons learned, and recommended configurations in a clear and maintainable way.

· Production & Operational Readiness: Support repeatable antenna setups for production, supply chain, customer handover, and operational deployment.

Around 5 years of professional experience in RF engineering, antenna engineering, communications engineering, field testing, hardware integration, or a related technical environment.

· Antenna Expertise: Strong practical understanding of antenna types, antenna characteristics, gain, polarization, radiation patterns, impedance matching, cable losses, placement effects, and RF installation constraints.

· RF Measurement Skills: Experience using RF measurement and test equipment such as spectrum analyzers, VNAs, power meters, signal generators, test radios, field measurement tools, or comparable equipment.

· Hands-On Mentality: Strong practical mindset with the ability to build, adapt, install, test, and troubleshoot antenna setups directly on hardware, in workshops, on vehicles, on boats, or in field-testing environments.

· Communication Systems Understanding: Good understanding of radio communication links, link budgets, frequency bands, interference, line-of-sight behavior, data link performance, and operational RF constraints.

· Integration Mindset: Ability to work across antennas, radios, mechanical mounts, cabling, GCS hardware, unmanned platforms, and operational requirements to create robust system-level solutions.

· Adaptability: High level of adaptability and willingness to work in a dynamic, experimental, and continuously evolving engineering environment.

· Communication: Solid English skills are required. German skills for technical communication, suppliers, documentation, and test coordination are a plus.

· Clearance: Ability to obtain appropriate security clearance required for the position.

Experience with military, defence, aerospace, UAV, robotics, marine, automotive, or other mission-critical communication environments.

· Experience with Ground Control Stations, unmanned systems, tactical radios, MANET radios, SATCOM, or professional RF communication systems.

· Experience with S-Band, C-Band, directional antennas, omni antennas, horn antennas, mast systems, mobile antenna installations, or ruggedized field setups.

· Experience with antenna integration into vehicles, boats, portable masts, handheld systems, mobile cases, or drone platforms.

title: Summer Crew 2027
description:
Welkom bij Wajer Yachts – waar luxe en vakmanschap samenkomen

Bij Wajer Yachts bouwen we niet zomaar jachten; we creëren luxe ervaringen over de hele wereld. Van Heeg tot Miami, overal trekken ze bewonderende blikken. Dat is geen toeval – bij Wajer ligt de focus op innovatie, kwaliteit en ultiem comfort. En dat alles begint met een team van gepassioneerde vakspecialisten zoals jij.

Dit wordt jouw werk

Als onderdeel van de Wajer Summer Crew werk je in een van onze hubs in Spanje of Zuid-Frankrijk. Je vaart, maakt de jachten schoon en klaar voor vertrek, verwelkomt gasten en zorgt dat elk detail klopt – van gekoelde drankjes tot indrukwekkende vaarroutes langs de kust. De ene dag ben je op zee, de andere help je mee met andere werkzaamheden of evenementen zoals de Cannes en Monaco Boat Show.

Dit krijg je van ons

  • Een maandsalaris tussen €2.444 en €2.715, exclusief vakantiegeld en de uitbetaling van vakantiedagen.

  • Huisvesting in een van onze Wajer-crewaccommodaties (gedeelde kamers).

  • Vers bereide diners op doordeweekse dagen.

  • Een internationale ervaring op de nieuwste Wajer-jachten.

  • Deelname aan de Wajer Summer Crew Academy, waar je training krijgt over jachten, veiligheidsprocedures, technische systemen en gastvrijheid.

  • De kans om na het seizoen door te groeien binnen het Wajer Care Talent Program.

Dit ben jij

Je hebt een passie voor het water en een groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel. Je weet wat het betekent om op een luxe jacht te werken en streeft altijd naar perfectie.

Daarnaast heb je:

  • Bij voorkeur een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding.

  • Klein Vaarbewijs I en II + vaarervaring op (snelvarende) motorboten - indien je voor de sluitingsdatum van deze vacature niet beschikt over de vaarbewijzen, kunnen we je sollicitatie niet in behandeling nemen. Ook niet indien je examens nog gepland staan!

  • Een technisch inzicht – professionele of hobbymatige ervaring met techniek is een pluspunt.

  • Minimaal 8 opeenvolgende weken beschikbaar (bij voorkeur het volledige seizoen: april–oktober).

  • Goede beheersing van de Engelse en Nederlandse taal (Spaans, Frans of Duits is een pré).

  • Een geldig EU-paspoort en rijbewijs (B).

De sollicitatieprocedure

Na een succesvolle sollicitatieprocedure, starten we onze (verplichte) Wajer Summer Crew Academy. Hierin leiden we je verder op met een Powerboat Level 2 (incl. Commercial Endorsement), leren we je alles over onze jachten, de techniek, omgangsnormen en andere praktische zaken. De Wajer Summer Crew Academy vindt plaats op onderstaande data, deelname tijdens alle onderdelen is verplicht. Ben je één of meerdere van deze data niet beschikbaar? Dan kunnen we jouw sollicitatie helaas niet verder in behandeling nemen.

Hospitality & Communicatie - 6 februari óf 7 februari 2027.

Techniek 1 - 13 februari óf 14 februari 2027.

RYA Powerboat & Vaarassessment - 16, 17, 23 en 24 februari 2027.

Sea Survival, First Aid & Marifonie - 6 & 7 maart óf 13 & 14 maart 2027.

Techniek 2 & Veiligheid - 20 maart óf 21 maart 2027.

Solliciteren is mogelijk t/m zondag 26 oktober 2026. Daarna worden alle sollicitaties in behandeling genomen en nemen we contact met je op.

description:

We are seeking a School-Based Clinician who is passionate about helping children and families thrive. Schedule: This position follows a 10-month school year schedule, with compensation prorated and paid over 12 months.

Candidates must reside in Connecticut to be eligible for this position.

What You Will Do:

As a School-Based Clinician, you will provide assessment, treatment, crisis intervention, and ongoing therapeutic support to children and adolescents in a school setting. Key responsibilities include:

  • Conduct comprehensive assessments, psychosocial evaluations, and treatment planning for students referred through school-based services.

Your present skillset

Beneficial

  • Experience with Grafana, Prometheus or equivalent observability stacks, including building dashboards and alert rules
  • Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible, or similar)
  • Experience operating multi-region services and troubleshooting region-specific performance issues (e.g. APAC latency)
  • Experience acting as the operational interface to third-party vendors and cloud providers during degradations

description:
Teamleider Ontbijt & Lunch

(Start om 07:00 uur | Fulltime) Van der Valk Hotel Veenendaal

Ben jij een energieke en betrokken leider met een passie voor gastvrijheid? Sta jij graag midden in de operatie en weet jij een team te motiveren om iedere dag het beste uit zichzelf te halen? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wie zijn wij?

Van der Valk Hotel Veenendaal is een modern en gastvrij hotel waar kwaliteit, service en beleving centraal staan. Dagelijks ontvangen wij hotelgasten en bezoekers voor een uitgebreid ontbijt, een heerlijke à la carte lunch en een verzorgd lunchbuffet. Samen zorgen wij voor een warme sfeer waarin gasten zich welkom voelen en graag terugkomen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Teamleider Ontbijt & Lunch ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse leiding van het restaurant tijdens de ochtend- en middagdiensten. Je bent zichtbaar aanwezig op de werkvloer, werkt actief mee in de operatie en zorgt ervoor dat gasten kunnen rekenen op uitstekende service en een gastvrije ontvangst.

Je geeft leiding aan het ontbijt- en lunchteam, bewaakt de kwaliteit en bent het aanspreekpunt voor zowel medewerkers als gasten. Dankzij jouw enthousiasme en daadkracht verloopt iedere dienst soepel en efficiënt.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Aansturen, coachen en motiveren van het ontbijt- en lunchteam;

  • Actief meewerken op de werkvloer en leidinggeven vanuit de praktijk;

  • Opstellen van dagroosters en zorgen voor een efficiënte personeelsplanning;

  • Waarborgen van kwaliteit, service en gasttevredenheid;

  • Afstemmen met de keuken en andere afdelingen voor een optimale samenwerking;

  • Signaleren van verbeterpunten en aandragen van nieuwe ideeën;

  • Zorgdragen voor een gastvrije en representatieve uitstraling van het restaurant.

Wat verwachten wij van jou?

  • Aantoonbare ervaring in een leidinggevende functie binnen de horeca;

  • Een natuurlijke gastvrije uitstraling en voorbeeldfunctie op de werkvloer;

  • Sterke organisatorische vaardigheden en oog voor detail;

  • Een positieve, coachende en motiverende leiderschapsstijl;

  • Stressbestendigheid en het vermogen om het overzicht te bewaren tijdens drukke momenten;

  • Een hands-on mentaliteit waarbij je graag zelf meewerkt;

  • Beschikbaarheid voor diensten die starten om 07:00 uur, inclusief weekenden en feestdagen.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een verantwoordelijke en afwisselende functie binnen een professioneel, jong en hecht team;

  • Werken in dagdiensten met een goede werk-privébalans;

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen de Van der Valk-organisatie;

  • Personeelskorting bij Van der Valk Hotels;

  • Een marktconform salaris en aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Enthousiast geworden?

Zie jij jezelf als onze nieuwe Teamleider Ontbijt & Lunch? Dan maken wij graag kennis met je.

Solliciteer direct en word onderdeel van het team van Van der Valk Hotel Veenendaal. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat iedere gast de dag begint met een uitstekende ervaring en een warm welkom.

title: Manufacturing Start-up Project Manager (51268)
description:
Gradian is an engineering-led, full-line thermal solutions partner serving data center and other mission-critical, commercial, and industrial markets. Headquartered in Maple Grove, MN, with additional facilities across North America, we design and manufacture liquid cooling systems, air handling equipment, heat rejection units, and modular, factory-assembled thermal management solutions.

Gradian was founded through the unification of four complementary, established brands: MAS HVAC, Daedex, DeepCoolAI, and EcoChillers. Together, we act as a single-source provider, deploying cooling technologies as scalable systems optimized for efficiency, spatial constraints, and overall performance. With a vertically integrated engineering and manufacturing model, we pair rapid design turnaround with precision fabrication, so customers can move faster on complex projects where reliability, timeline, and quality all matter.

Why work here

At Gradian, you'll work alongside others who get genuinely fired up by complex problems, see your work go from first sketch to job site in weeks, not years, and know that while we're developing the technologies critical for AI infrastructure to scale, our culture remains people-first by design.

It is core to our identity that we operate as one team — driving to win together, energizing others, and building lasting relationships that make the work fun and rewarding.

Position Summary

The Project Manager, Manufacturing Startup will lead the planning, execution, and successful launch of a new manufacturing facility producing mission-critical Data Center HVAC equipment. This role is responsible for managing all aspects of factory startup, including capital equipment installation, industrial engineering and assembly process development, production staffing, first article builds, customer qualification requirements, and operational readiness.

The successful candidate will coordinate cross-functional teams across Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Facilities, and Customers to ensure a safe, efficient, and scalable manufacturing operation capable of meeting customer delivery, quality, and cost objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Factory Startup and Program Management

  • Lead manufacturing startup activities from facility readiness through production launch.
  • Develop and manage detailed project timelines, budgets, milestones, and risk mitigation plans.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to achieve startup objectives.
  • Monitor project performance and communicate status to executive leadership.
  • Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) for startup readiness and operational excellence.

Capital Equipment Management

  • Define manufacturing equipment requirements for Data Center HVAC product lines.
  • Manage capital expenditure projects including:
    • Assembly line equipment
    • Material handling systems
    • Production tooling
    • Test equipment
    • Automation systems
    • Facility infrastructure upgrades
  • Coordinate equipment specification, procurement, installation, commissioning, and acceptance testing.
  • Ensure equipment readiness aligns with production launch schedules.
  • Manage vendor relationships and equipment performance requirements.

Industrial Engineering and Assembly Process Development

  • Lead manufacturing process design and implementation.
  • Develop:
    • Assembly workflows
    • Manufacturing routing structures
    • Work instructions
    • Standard operating procedures (SOPs)
    • Line balancing and takt time analysis
  • Conduct time studies and labor planning activities.
  • Develop production layouts that optimize safety, quality, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Implement Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement methodologies.
  • Establish material flow, inventory control, and point-of-use systems.

Staffing and Workforce Planning

  • Develop comprehensive manufacturing staffing plans based on production forecasts.
  • Determine labor requirements by department including:
    • Assembly
    • Quality
    • Engineering
    • Material handling
    • Production supervision
    • Test operations
  • Partner with Human Resources to recruit, onboard, and train manufacturing personnel.
  • Support leadership development and operational readiness initiatives.
  • Develop workforce ramp-up plans to support customer demand growth.

First Article Build and Production Launch

  • Lead first article manufacturing builds and validation activities.
  • Ensure manufacturing processes are capable of meeting engineering and customer specifications.
  • Coordinate:
    • Prototype builds
    • Pilot production runs
    • Process validation
    • Capacity verification
  • Identify and resolve manufacturing readiness issues prior to production launch.
  • Drive corrective actions to support smooth transition into full-rate production.

Customer Quality and Compliance Requirements

  • Serve as primary manufacturing representative for customer qualification and audit activities.
  • Ensure compliance with customer-specific quality requirements and specifications.
  • Lead development of:
    • Quality Plans
    • Control Plans
    • Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA)
    • Inspection Procedures
    • First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR)
  • Support customer acceptance testing and production approval processes.
  • Drive root-cause analysis and corrective action implementation for quality issues.
  • Ensure adherence to industry standards and regulatory requirements.

Risk Management and Continuous Improvement

  • Identify project risks related to production readiness, quality, supply chain, staffing, and equipment installation.
  • Develop mitigation plans and contingency strategies.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on:
    • Safety
    • Productivity
    • Quality
    • Cost reduction
    • On-time delivery
  • Support future production capacity expansion initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.
  • 7+ years of manufacturing project management experience.
  • 5+ years supporting factory startup, greenfield manufacturing, or major production launch initiatives.
  • Experience with capital equipment implementation and manufacturing automation projects.
  • Strong understanding of industrial engineering principles and assembly process development.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Proven knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement methodologies.
  • Experience managing project schedules, budgets, and resource allocations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP (Project Management Professional) certification.
  • Experience manufacturing HVAC, cooling systems, mechanical equipment, or data center infrastructure products.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
  • Experience with ERP/MRP systems.
  • Knowledge of quality management systems including ISO 9001.
  • Experience supporting customer audits and qualification programs.
  • Familiarity with APQP, PFMEA, PPAP, and First Article Inspection processes.

Key Competencies

  • Manufacturing Startup Leadership
  • Program and Project Management
  • Capital Equipment Planning
  • Industrial Engineering
  • Assembly Process Development
  • Workforce Planning
  • Customer Quality Requirements
  • First Article Qualification
  • Lean Manufacturing
  • Risk Management
  • Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Executive Communication
  • Problem Solving and Decision Making

    Benefits

  • Medical, vision, and dental plans
  • Short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • Group term life insurance coverage
  • HSA, FSA, and Dependent Care plans available
  • 8 paid holidays, 4 floating holidays, and generous PTO policy
  • 401k matching
  • Annual safety shoe allowance
  • Education assistance program

We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, political affiliation, or any other legally protected status.

title: Sanitation Supervisor (Day) (4457)
description:
Perricone Juices has joined forces with the esteemed Natalie’s Orchid Island Juice Company, combining two leaders in the premium citrus juice industry. This strategic acquisition forms a dynamic and growth-oriented company, blending Perricone’s expertise in craft citrus juices with Natalie’s reputation for fresh, high-quality products. Acquisition enhances the company’s market presence and strengthens its position within the industry, opening doors to exciting opportunities for innovation and expansion.

Perricone Juices is currently seeking a Transportation Coordinator for our Fort Pierce facility, to help lead and advance our operations. This position offers long-term stability and a comprehensive benefits package, including health, vision, dental, life insurance, and a 401(k) plan.

Position Summary:

The Sanitation Supervisor leads the day-to-day activities of the sanitation and pasteurization team, ensuring plant equipment, processes, and work areas meet federal, state, and company sanitation standards. This role reports to Operations and owns the CIP process end-to-end, operator training on CIP and sanitation procedures, plant cleanliness and janitorial operations, and the master sanitation schedule/list, while driving continuous process improvement across the sanitation program. The Sanitation Supervisor is accountable for maintaining microbiological control in accordance with HACCP principles, cGMP, and SSOP requirements and works in close coordination with the QA department and the HACCP/Document Control Coordinator to ensure sanitation practices align with the food safety plan. This is an exempt, supervisory role whose primary duty is the management of the sanitation department and its employees.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities:

The following duties are representative of the position; other duties may be assigned as business needs require.

  • Supervise, schedule, and direct the daily work of the Sanitation Lead and sanitation/pasteurization technicians, ensuring adequate coverage across assigned shifts.
  • Interview, select, train, coach, and evaluate sanitation staff; recommend hiring, discipline, promotion, and termination decisions.
  • Inspect products, equipment, and premises for conformity to federal and state sanitation laws, plant standards, and pest-control procedures; direct food handlers and production personnel in sanitary practices.
  • Own the CIP (Clean-in-Place) process end-to-end, including system setup, chemical concentrations, cycle verification, and troubleshooting; ensure proper use of the CIP system across sanitation and pasteurization equipment.
  • Develop and deliver CIP and sanitation operator training; certify operators on CIP procedures and verify ongoing competency.
  • Direct cleaning of equipment and work areas; own all in-house swab testing to verify CIP and sanitation effectiveness.
  • Own and maintain the Master Sanitation Schedule/List, ensuring all cleaning frequencies, responsibilities, and verification steps are current, followed, and audit-ready.
  • Oversee overall plant cleanliness and janitorial operations, including common areas, offices, and non-production spaces, directly or through janitorial staff/contractors.
  • Drive continuous process improvement within the sanitation program, identifying opportunities to reduce chemical usage, downtime, water/energy consumption, and labor hours while maintaining sanitation effectiveness.
  • Manage and maintain microbiological levels within acceptable limits, following HACCP principles and practices consistent with FDA health standards, cGMP, and SSOP requirements.
  • Investigate and resolve quality issues related to SSOPs in partnership with QC, Extraction, and Bottling departments.
  • Coordinate daily with Production and Bottling on pasteurization production needs; audit pasteurization operations across all phases to assure quality performance.
  • Coordinate with QA to ensure sanitation and pasteurization monitoring, verification activities, and recordkeeping align with the facility's HACCP plan and document control system; escalate CCP-related deviations per the food safety plan.
  • Ensure all sanitation and pasteurization technicians are properly trained on their responsibilities; develop and deliver effective training programs.
  • Maintain free flow of information with Production, Bottling, and QC to identify and troubleshoot sanitation and pasteurization issues on a daily basis.
  • Examine incoming fruit shipments for foreign matter (insects, poisons, dirt) and gather ingredient samples for laboratory analysis.
  • Confer with management and production personnel on sanitation/pasteurization problems; recommend changes to equipment, plant layout, lighting, ventilation, or work practices to improve sanitation standards and product purity.
  • Compile and route required reports on regular inspections, sanitation violations, and corrective steps taken to resolve deficiencies.
  • Study production schedules and estimate labor-hour requirements for job assignments; establish or adjust work procedures to meet production schedules.
  • Interpret company policies to workers and enforce safety regulations; analyze and resolve work problems, or assist workers in solving them.
  • Maintain time and production records; confer with other supervisors to coordinate activities across departments.
  • Perform the activities of workers supervised as needed to maintain coverage or train staff.
  • Comply with all Plant, State, and Federal OSHA, EPA, FDA, HACCP, and SQF regulations; conduct verification activities to ensure finished product complies with food safety and quality specifications.
  • Participate in the annual review of the food safety system and assist in maintaining the Food Safety and Quality system.
  • Own responsibility for Non-GMO SGS Supply Chain Standards compliance within the sanitation program.
  • Manage department budgeting, planning, and vendor relationships for sanitation supplies and services.
  • Respond to and direct urgent sanitation or pasteurization issues, including off-hours and on-call support as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by Operations leadership.

Supervisory Responsibility:

This position has direct supervisory authority over the Sanitation Lead, sanitation/pasteurization technicians, and janitorial staff or contractors. The Sanitation Supervisor customarily and regularly directs the work of two or more full-time employees (or their equivalent) and has the authority to hire, fire, promote, and discipline, or whose recommendations on these actions are given particular weight, consistent with the FLSA executive exemption. This position reports into Operations rather than Quality Assurance; it coordinates closely with QA and the HACCP/Document Control Coordinator on food safety compliance, but neither QA nor the HACCP/Document Control Coordinator has a reporting relationship to or from this role.

title: Host/Hostess
description:
Position Overview
The Host/Hostess is responsible for creating a welcoming and positive first impression for all guests. This role manages reservations, coordinates seating, and ensures smooth guest flow while providing friendly, professional service. The Host/Hostess plays a key role in delivering an exceptional dining experience from arrival to departure.

Responsibilities

  • Greet guests promptly and warmly upon arrival
  • Manage reservations and waitlists using reservation systems or manual logs
  • Accurately quote wait times and monitor table turnover
  • Escort guests to tables and present menus
  • Communicate effectively with servers and management regarding table status and guest needs
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization of the host stand and entrance area
  • Understand and respond knowledgeably to questions about the restaurant and menu
  • Thank guests as they leave and invite them to return
  • Follow all company policies, health, and safety standards

The Environment

At Exmoor, we take pride in fostering a safe, close-knit, family-orientated work environment. We believe that a positive and supportive atmosphere not only enhances productivity but also creates a sense of camaraderie among our team members. We encourage collaboration, open communication, and mutual respect, ensuring that everyone feels valued and appreciated. Together, we strive to create lasting memories for everyone on the property and forge strong relationships, making our workplace an enjoyable and fulfilling place to be.

Our Simple Truth

Appreciation is the heart of Everything.

Our Mission Statement

We demonstrate Whole-Hearted Hospitality through effort, recognition, innovation, and service excellence; doing so creates great experiences for our members and each other.

Our Core Values

Support and improve the Club with everything we do.

Protect our family-oriented workplace environment.

Inspire each other and work together as a team.

Respect, appreciate, and empower one another.

Innovate- never stop learning, evolving, and growing.

Tradition- honor the past and help shape our future.

The History

Founded in 1896 as Illinois' third golf club, Exmoor is a private, full-service country club, located in Highland Park, Illinois, 28 miles north of Chicago. With a championship golf course designed by Donald J. Ross, Exmoor continues to fulfill its original mission as a family club devoted to the game of golf, while offering a growing range of sports and social opportunities. Sports at Exmoor include golf, curling, tennis, swimming, ice skating, platform tennis, cross-country skiing, and the fastest-growing sport in America, pickleball. Members of all ages enjoy a year-round schedule of exciting social activities.

The Club's mission is to provide the finest golf, sporting, and social experiences for its community of member families and their guests all year long.

title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
Scopely is looking for a smart, technically strong, and process-adaptive Senior QA Engineer to join our Royal Lounge Casino team in Bangalore on a hybrid basis.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

With 30M+ downloads, Grand Casino is home to slots, bingo, cards, and more! Team members are distributed across the globe with hubs in Bengaluru, Tel Aviv, Barcelona, among others

What You’ll Do

  • Write, maintain, and execute test cases for studio games across mobile and web platforms, covering a broad range of devices, operating systems, and browsers.
  • Perform functional and non-functional testing of mobile applications, including network traffic, API responses, and log analysis.
  • Collaborate closely with Scrum teams, Producers, Developers, and QA Leads/Managers to ensure releases meet high quality standards.
  • Communicate proactively with Developers and business stakeholders during defect triage to reduce defect ageing and drive timely resolution.
  • Conduct root cause analysis for defects and provide corrective and preventive action plans.
  • Work effectively in an Agile environment to support timely and high-quality product delivery.
  • Identify quality trade-offs, project risks, and appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Develop a detailed understanding of studio games, including gameplay flows, player journeys, edge cases, and game-specific scenarios.
  • Create and maintain QA documentation, including test cases, test plans, test reports, training material, and process documentation.
  • Mentor junior QA team members and support their technical and domain growth.
  • Partner with the QA Lead to continuously improve QA processes, test coverage, and release quality.
  • Support team coordination and delivery in the absence of the QA Lead.

What We Are Looking For

  • 4–7 years of experience in software testing, preferably across mobile, web, or gaming products.
  • Strong familiarity with mobile and web platforms from a QA perspective.
  • Good understanding of client-server architecture, APIs, application data flow, and network debugging.
  • Hands-on experience in test design, test execution, defect reporting, regression testing, and risk-based testing.
  • Strong exploratory testing skills, with the ability to select the right test approach based on feature complexity and risk.
  • Experience using QA tools such as Jira, TestRail, Charles Proxy, Fiddler, browser developer tools, or similar tools.
  • Ability to create clear and comprehensive QA documentation, including test cases, test plans, test reports, and training material.
  • Good understanding of software testing processes, SDLC/STLC, and Agile methodologies.
  • Basic knowledge of SQL and database concepts.
  • Strong communication, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience testing mobile games, web games, or live-service products.
  • Passion for gaming, with a genuine interest in playing and understanding casual games.
  • Strong gaming mindset, including an understanding of player behaviour, engagement mechanics, progression, rewards, and LiveOps.
  • Prior experience testing Slots, Casino, or other real-money/social casino-style games.
  • Exposure to test automation frameworks and AI-driven testing approaches.

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: .
