title: Produce Lead
location: Moscow Food Co-op Downtown - Moscow, ID 83843
description:
Join Our Produce Team!

The Moscow Food Co-op is looking for an energetic, organized, and customer-focused Produce Lead to help lead our Produce Department. This is a hands-on leadership position that combines customer service, purchasing, merchandising, inventory management, and team support.

The Produce Lead works closely with the Produce Manager to keep the department well-stocked, fresh, attractive, and running smoothly while supporting department goals for sales, margin, labor, product quality, and customer satisfaction.

What You’ll Do

  • Provide exceptional customer service and create a welcoming shopping experience.
  • Help lead daily department operations and support staff when the Produce Manager is unavailable.
  • Order produce from local, regional, and national vendors and maintain appropriate inventory levels.
  • Keep displays abundant, attractive, properly rotated, and fully stocked.
  • Monitor product quality, freshness, pricing, shrink, waste, and inventory.
  • Receive deliveries and maintain accurate purchasing, pricing, and inventory records.
  • Stock, rotate, trim, wash, bundle, and prepare produce alongside the team.
  • Help train, coach, and prioritize work for Produce staff.
  • Maintain clean, organized, and food-safe displays, coolers, prep areas, and backstock.
  • Support department promotions, seasonal changes, inventories, and store-wide initiatives.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who enjoys working alongside their team and can balance leadership responsibilities with the hands-on work needed to keep a busy Produce Department running.

Our ideal candidate is:

  • Friendly, outgoing, and committed to excellent customer service.
  • A positive and dependable leader who communicates well and supports their team.
  • Organized, self-directed, and able to prioritize in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive and willing to jump in wherever needed.
  • Detail-oriented with strong follow-through and problem-solving skills.
  • Knowledgeable about produce quality, freshness, handling, storage, and rotation.
  • Interested in local, seasonal, organic, and natural foods.
  • Comfortable with purchasing, inventory, merchandising, and basic computer systems.
  • Able to give and receive feedback professionally and contribute to a positive team environment.

Schedule & Availability

  • Full-time: 35–40 hours per week
  • Part-time: 20–29 hours per week
  • Flexible scheduling, including mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and university breaks
  • Must be able to stand for extended periods and lift up to 50 pounds

Why Work at the Co-op?

Position Summary

The Produce Lead is responsible for supporting the Produce Manager in the daily operations, purchasing, merchandising, inventory management, and leadership of the Produce Department. This position plays a key role in ensuring exceptional customer service, maintaining high-quality and abundant produce displays, managing product purchasing and inventory levels, and supporting department staff to achieve sales, margin, labor, and customer satisfaction goals.

The Produce Lead serves as a working leader, balancing hands-on department responsibilities with buying, merchandising, and operational oversight. This position helps create a welcoming shopping experience while ensuring department standards for quality, freshness, food safety, and profitability are consistently met.

Customer Service Expectations

Customer service is the top priority at the Co-op. Staff are expected to create friendly, welcoming, and helpful experiences for every customer. Employees should proactively greet customers (30 second rule), remain approachable and engaged on the sales floor, and respond to questions with professionalism and care.

Staff should demonstrate:

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • A positive and solutions-oriented attitude.
  • Patience, professionalism, and respect for diverse customer needs and perspectives.
  • A willingness to learn about products and continuously improve product knowledge.
  • Consistent attention to detail and follow-through.

Customer Service & Leadership

The Produce Lead is expected to create a welcoming, engaging, and helpful experience for every customer by:

  • Greeting customers promptly and proactively help.
  • Maintain a positive, approachable presence on the sales floor.
  • Provide accurate product information and recommendations.
  • Handle customer concerns professionally and respectfully.
  • Foster a culture of hospitality and service excellence within the department.
  • Resolve customer concerns professionally and take ownership of finding solutions.
  • Lead daily department operations in the absence of the Produce Manager.
  • Assign and prioritize tasks for Produce Department staff during shifts.
  • Assist with training, coaching, and supporting department staff.
  • Set and maintain expectations for productivity, quality, waste reduction, and customer service.
  • Assist with scheduling, finding shift coverage, and supporting staffing needs.
  • Facilitate department huddles and communicate important operational updates.
  • Make appropriate operational decisions when management is unavailable and communicate actions taken.

Purchasing & Inventory Management

  • Evaluate products, customer demand, seasonal trends, and market conditions to maintain a diverse and attractive product selection.
  • Place purchase orders with local, regional, and national vendors to maintain appropriate inventory levels.
  • Minimize out-of-stocks while avoiding excessive inventory and shrink.
  • Monitor inventory movement and maintain strong inventory turns.
  • Evaluate product performance and recommend additions, changes, deletions, and assortment.
  • Research and develop relationships with new vendors and local producers.
  • Receive product deliveries and verify quality, quantity, pricing, and accuracy.
  • Process invoices, credits, and purchase records accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Maintain accurate product costs and pricing information within store systems.
  • Ensure all department products are correctly priced and labeled.
  • Obtain credit for damaged or unsellable products when appropriate.
  • Participate in inventory counts, cycle counts, and inventory reconciliation.

Merchandising & Promotions

  • Plan, build, and maintain attractive, abundant, and fully stocked produce displays.
  • Ensure all displays are rotated properly to maintain freshness and reduce waste.
  • Monitor department presentation to ensure a clean, organized, and appealing shopping environment.
  • Participate in department resets, seasonal transitions, and promotional displays.
  • Collaborate with the Produce Manager on promotional planning, new product launches, and cross-merchandising opportunities.
  • Ensure shelf tags, signage, and pricing information are accurate and up to date.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, seasonal products, and customer preferences.
  • Share product knowledge with customers and staff.

Department Operations

  • Ensure produce displays, coolers, prep areas, storage areas, and back stock are maintained according to department standards.
  • Monitor product quality and remove damaged, spoiled, or out-of-date items promptly.
  • Maintain accurate waste and shrink records.
  • Ensure proper rotation, storage, handling, and food safety practices.
  • Maintain cleanliness through daily cleaning routines and scheduled deep-cleaning projects.
  • Monitor cooler temperatures and department equipment to ensure proper operation.
  • Communicate maintenance or repair needs to the Produce Manager.
  • Assist with freight, stocking, trimming, washing, bundling, and preparation of produce products.
  • Ensure department areas meet all health, safety, and sanitation standards.
  • Support department and store-wide initiatives and projects.
  • Complete all other duties as assigned by the Produce Manager.

Co-op-Wide Employee Standards

Customer Service & Communication

  • Provide excellent customer service by creating friendly, welcoming, and helpful experience for every customer.
  • Remain approachable, attentive, and professional while assisting customers, coworkers, and vendors.
  • Communicate effectively with supervisors and team members regarding customer concerns, product issues, and operational needs.
  • Offer product suggestions and respond to questions with professionalism, patience, and respect for diverse customer needs and perspectives.
  • Maintain a positive, solutions-oriented attitude and continuously build product and operational knowledge.

Teamwork & Professionalism

  • Work cooperatively with all departments to support a respectful, inclusive, and team-oriented workplace culture.
  • Demonstrate flexibility by assisting in other areas of the store, including cashier backup and cross-department support as needed.
  • Follow the direction of the Manager on Duty (MOD) and contribute to department and store-wide initiatives.
  • Assist with staff training and participate in Co-op meetings, inventories, and required training.

Operations & Accountability

  • Maintain excellent attendance, punctuality, and scheduling flexibility, including arriving on time and following break and time-off policies.
  • Follow established opening, closing, safety, and operational procedures.
  • Maintain accurate use of scheduling and timekeeping systems and assist with shift coverage when needed.
  • Ensure a safe, organized, and professional environment for customers and staff through attention to detail and follow-through.

title: Product Manager, Peer-to-Peer Events
description:
Highlights:

Location: Serbia

Language: Fluent in Russian and English (C1+)

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About Peer-to-Peer at Fundraise Up

Peer-to-Peer turns supporters into fundraisers. Instead of only donating, a supporter creates a fundraising page, invites others to give, joins a team, or participates in an event on behalf of a nonprofit.

We are building Peer-to-Peer as a new product line. The product starts with two connected directions:

  • P2P DIY: self-serve fundraising for birthdays, memorials, personal challenges, and other supporter-led campaigns.
  • P2P Events: structured, time-bound fundraising programs such as walks, runs, rides, climbs, workplace challenges, and recurring event series.

DIY creates the product foundation. Events extends it with registration, teams and captains, event operations, participant communication, attribution, reporting, and integrations. The two directions must work as one coherent product while serving different customer workflows and levels of complexity.

About the Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to own P2P Events within the broader Peer-to-Peer product line.

This is a hands-on software product role covering discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and iteration. You will turn an ambiguous product area into a focused solution grounded in customer, usage, and commercial evidence.

Events and DIY serve different sides of the same system: nonprofits need to run fundraising programs, while participants need effective tools to fundraise. You will work closely with the PM responsible for the broader P2P area so these experiences and their shared capabilities evolve together.

This is not an event-planning or project-coordination role.

What You’ll Own

Define the product direction

  • Turn customer research, market evidence, and business context into a clear product thesis and sequenced roadmap.
  • Choose a focused target segment and event scenario rather than trying to serve the entire category at once.
  • Decide which capabilities belong in the shared P2P foundation and which require an Events-specific model.
  • Keep assumptions, success metrics, scope, risks, and product decisions explicit.

Lead discovery and product definition

  • Work directly with nonprofit event teams, participants, design partners, and internal GTM teams.
  • Validate decisions through interviews, workflow mapping, prototypes, and live product usage.
  • Separate true adoption blockers from feature requests and incumbent-product expectations.
  • Shape problems such as registration, teams and captains, attribution and reporting, event operations, participant communication, and CRM integrations. These are examples—not a pre-committed feature checklist.

Shape and deliver the product

  • Own the product from problem definition through requirements, delivery, launch, and iteration.
  • Write clear requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and decision records.
  • Make day-to-day scope and trade-off decisions with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Research, and QA.
  • Ensure the product can evolve from simpler events to more advanced team structures, event series, and operational workflows without overbuilding the first release.
  • Keep delivery predictable by surfacing dependencies, risks, and unresolved decisions early.

Launch, learn, and drive outcomes

  • Launch and learn through EAPs with clear entry criteria, success measures, readiness requirements, and out-of-scope areas.
  • Understand whether organizations can run events successfully and whether participants activate, fundraise, and return.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, CSM, and Support on positioning, customer commitments, enablement, and competitive context.
  • Connect product evidence to adoption, expansion, pipeline, retention, and GPV.
  • Turn evidence into clear recommendations: iterate, expand, change direction, or stop.

Work AI-native

  • Use AI for research synthesis, prototyping, specification quality, data exploration, and operational automation.
  • Build testable artifacts quickly without outsourcing product judgment.

Requirements

  • 4–7 years of Product Management or Product Ownership experience in a software product company.
  • End-to-end ownership of a customer-facing product area with Engineering and Design.
  • Strong judgment in reducing a large problem space to a focused release and explaining the trade-offs.
  • Experience turning customer evidence and product data into decisions.
  • Clear written communication across requirements, edge cases, metrics, and decision records.
  • Ability to work with multi-actor workflows, permissions, states, and data relationships.
  • High ownership and independence, with fluent written and spoken English.

Strong plus

  • Experience with B2B SaaS, fundraising, payments, registration, events, community, or other multi-sided products.
  • Experience launching a new product area through beta or EAP.
  • Knowledge of CRM integrations, reporting, transaction attribution, analytics, or SQL.
  • Practical use of AI for research, prototyping, analysis, or product operations.

This Role May Not Be a Fit If

  • You are looking for an event-planning or internal project-management role rather than software product ownership.
  • You prefer to receive a fully defined roadmap and requirements instead of helping determine what should be built.
  • You want to work only on strategy and avoid specifications, QA, delivery details, or post-launch iteration.
  • You treat every customer request as a roadmap commitment.
  • You need stable scope and certainty before moving forward.
  • You measure progress mainly by features shipped rather than customer and business outcomes.

Why work with us

  • A strong, collaborative product team that owns what it builds
  • Clear product vision and access to real customer feedback from global nonprofit leaders
  • Flat structure: no politics, just great work with great people
  • Transparent company culture-we share how we’re growing, where revenue comes from, and what’s next
  • Long-term focus: we offer equity options and value sustained, meaningful contribution

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is DIN597,500 - DIN632,500 gross.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance for the employee and their family
  • 20 paid vacation days per year
  • 15 paid public holidays per year
  • 5 company-paid sick leave days
  • English learning courses
  • Relevant professional education
  • Gym or swimming pool
  • Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace
  • Co-working
  • Remote working

**Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. Exercise caution and ensure the authenticity of emails claiming to be from our company.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.

title: Klantmanager
description:
Klantmanager mkb

Bij aaff investeren we in jou, zodat jij jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen als klantmanager. Word jij een van onze 2000 co-eigenaren?


Wat ga je doen als klantmanager bij aaff?

Als klantmanager bij aaff bouw je actief aan duurzame klantrelaties. Dankzij jouw scherpe vragen, strategisch inzicht en warme aanpak vervul je de rol van sparringpartner, zowel zakelijk als privé.

Je zorgt ervoor dat de juiste mensen op het juiste moment aan tafel zitten, waardoor de samenwerking soepel verloopt. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines om de klanttevredenheid binnen jouw klantenportefeuille te waarborgen. Je voelt perfect aan wat er speelt in de regio en weet met jouw ondernemende aanpak precies waar onze dienstverlening het verschil kan maken. Daarnaast speel je een cruciale rol bij het aantrekken van klanten die passen bij onze waarden: het zijn van impactmakers, uitdagers, aanpakkers en bondgenoten

Je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

  • Je fungeert als trusted advisor om omvangrijke ondernemers te adviseren over kansen, uitdagingen en groeimogelijkheden.

  • Samenwerken met specialisten binnen aaff om klanten optimaal te helpen. Jij denkt breed mee en brengt klanten, collega’s en externe partijen bij elkaar

  • Nieuwe klanten uit de mkb-sectoren aantrekken en relaties opbouwen voor jouw eigen klantenportefeuille.

  • Als gezicht van de markt actief netwerken, kansen signaleren en onze dienstverlening onder de aandacht brengen.

  • Je sluit je aan bij een van onze topsectoren transport en logistiek, handel en e-commerce, hightech maakindustrie of bouw en infra.

Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Salaris: Tussen €4.195 tot €6.992

  • Keuzevrijheid in verlof: jij bepaalt hoeveel vrije dagen je opneemt, tot 38 per jaar. Kies uit regulier verlof, het aaff-budget of extra dagen via je salaris. Wat je van het aaff-budget niet gebruikt, keren we uit.

  • Thuiswerkbudget van € 550: om je werkplek thuis prettig en ergonomisch in te richten.

  • Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: € 2,45 per thuiswerkdag + € 40 netto internetvergoeding per maand.

  • Duurzaam onderweg: €0,30 per auto-km voor woon-werkritten, € 0,40 (€ 0,23 netto) per fiets-/wandelkilometer. Daarbovenop een volledige OV-vergoeding of – bij meer dan 7.500 zakelijke km/jaar – een elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsbudget. Bij elektrisch rijden ontvang je € 0,40 per kilometer.

  • Flexibel verlof sparen: voor een sabbatical, langere reis of tijd voor jezelf.

  • Laptop en telefoon: alles wat je nodig hebt om je werk goed te doen.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Senior Product Designer

Company

Orcrist builds the Orcrist Intelligence Platform (OIP), a Kubernetes-based data intelligence system delivered as SaaS or self-hosted/on-prem (including air-gapped deployments). We help defense, law-enforcement, and enterprise teams turn complex data into actionable intelligence, securely and responsibly.

Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer (f/m/d) to own end-to-end design across core surfaces of the Orcrist Intelligence Platform. As a generalist, you will span the full product design process: framing complex problems alongside product managers, collaborating directly with stakeholders, designing data-dense interaction patterns, and validating solutions with subject matter experts (SMEs).

You bring a strong product thinking mindset: balancing user needs, technical constraints, and business goals, and excel at turning data complexity into clear, actionable workflows that engineers can build with confidence.

What you'll do

  • Own the full design process: Drive initiatives end-to-end from problem framing and information architecture to UI design, validation, and implementation QA.
  • Product Thinking & Strategy: Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to evaluate trade-offs, define scope, and align design decisions with platform constraints and business goals.
  • Customer & Stakeholder Collaboration: Engage directly with end users, domain experts, and internal stakeholders to understand workflows, present design iterations, and align on decisions.
  • Multi-method Evaluation: Test and evaluate solutions using diverse validation methods (e.g. scenario walkthroughs, SME sessions, and usability testing).
  • Systemic Design & Handoffs: Define reusable interaction patterns, align with our Design System, and deliver adoption-grade handoff packages (annotated flows, edge cases, acceptance criteria, component specs).
  • Design for Complexity: Champion accessibility, performance, and data-dense usability across graph/network views, timelines, map/geospatial interfaces, and tabular record sets.

About You

  • 5+ years designing complex B2B/enterprise or analytical products (portfolio required showing end-to-end process and product impact).
  • Strong Product Thinking: You think in systems, trade-offs, and outcomes, not just screens or abstract workshop frameworks. You understand technical feasibility and business context.
  • End-to-End Product Ownership: Comfortable and willing to own the entire product lifecycle, from early framing and user research to visual polish and design QA, as well as the ability to contribute to the internal design system.
  • Data-Dense Product Experience: Demonstrated track record with high-complexity UX (e.g., dashboard and graph visualization, large structured/unstructured datasets, or time-series data).
  • Stakeholder & Customer Communication: Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate design decisions clearly to engineers, product leads, and non-design stakeholders.
  • Pragmatic Figma & System Habits: Strong Figma practice and ability to implement flexible design components with disciplined component structures and documentation that engineers can implement smoothly.
  • Autonomy & Technical Literacy: High self-direction in a remote setting, with a working understanding of web technologies and platform constraints (cloud vs. air-gapped).
  • AI-Assisted design and prototyping: Experience using AI tools to support different stages of the product design process, such as research synthesis, prototyping, or exploration. You understand how to use these tools thoughtfully and critically, while maintaining strong design judgement and quality standards.
  • EU/NATO citizenship and eligibility for security clearance.
  • Languages: Full professional fluency in English (C1+) required.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Analytical AI product experience: Experience designing data-intensive products that help users explore and interpret complex information through an agentic AI assistant, to facilitate analytical research, investigations, or decision making. Familiarity with products such as Palantir or similar platforms is a plus.
  • High-Stakes Domain Exposure: Experience designing for environments where accuracy, security, confidentiality, or auditability are critical, such as public safety, critical infrastructure, risk management, or regulated industries.
  • German language skills (B1+).

What We Offer

  • Remote‑first in Germany with regular workshops and occasional team events in Berlin.
  • Home office budget and great equipment.
  • 30 days vacation.
  • Direct impact on critical missions across private and public‑sector customers.
  • High autonomy and real scope: prototypes spanning ingest → processing → ML enrichment → search → UI.

title: Product Manager, Peer-to-Peer Events
description:
Highlights:

Location: Turkey

Language: Fluent in Russian and English (C1+)

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About Peer-to-Peer at Fundraise Up

Peer-to-Peer turns supporters into fundraisers. Instead of only donating, a supporter creates a fundraising page, invites others to give, joins a team, or participates in an event on behalf of a nonprofit.

We are building Peer-to-Peer as a new product line. The product starts with two connected directions:

  • P2P DIY: self-serve fundraising for birthdays, memorials, personal challenges, and other supporter-led campaigns.
  • P2P Events: structured, time-bound fundraising programs such as walks, runs, rides, climbs, workplace challenges, and recurring event series.

DIY creates the product foundation. Events extends it with registration, teams and captains, event operations, participant communication, attribution, reporting, and integrations. The two directions must work as one coherent product while serving different customer workflows and levels of complexity.

About the Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to own P2P Events within the broader Peer-to-Peer product line.

This is a hands-on software product role covering discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and iteration. You will turn an ambiguous product area into a focused solution grounded in customer, usage, and commercial evidence.

Events and DIY serve different sides of the same system: nonprofits need to run fundraising programs, while participants need effective tools to fundraise. You will work closely with the PM responsible for the broader P2P area so these experiences and their shared capabilities evolve together.

This is not an event-planning or project-coordination role.

What You’ll Own

Define the product direction

  • Turn customer research, market evidence, and business context into a clear product thesis and sequenced roadmap.
  • Choose a focused target segment and event scenario rather than trying to serve the entire category at once.
  • Decide which capabilities belong in the shared P2P foundation and which require an Events-specific model.
  • Keep assumptions, success metrics, scope, risks, and product decisions explicit.

Lead discovery and product definition

  • Work directly with nonprofit event teams, participants, design partners, and internal GTM teams.
  • Validate decisions through interviews, workflow mapping, prototypes, and live product usage.
  • Separate true adoption blockers from feature requests and incumbent-product expectations.
  • Shape problems such as registration, teams and captains, attribution and reporting, event operations, participant communication, and CRM integrations. These are examples—not a pre-committed feature checklist.

Shape and deliver the product

  • Own the product from problem definition through requirements, delivery, launch, and iteration.
  • Write clear requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and decision records.
  • Make day-to-day scope and trade-off decisions with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Research, and QA.
  • Ensure the product can evolve from simpler events to more advanced team structures, event series, and operational workflows without overbuilding the first release.
  • Keep delivery predictable by surfacing dependencies, risks, and unresolved decisions early.

Launch, learn, and drive outcomes

  • Launch and learn through EAPs with clear entry criteria, success measures, readiness requirements, and out-of-scope areas.
  • Understand whether organizations can run events successfully and whether participants activate, fundraise, and return.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, CSM, and Support on positioning, customer commitments, enablement, and competitive context.
  • Connect product evidence to adoption, expansion, pipeline, retention, and GPV.
  • Turn evidence into clear recommendations: iterate, expand, change direction, or stop.

Work AI-native

  • Use AI for research synthesis, prototyping, specification quality, data exploration, and operational automation.
  • Build testable artifacts quickly without outsourcing product judgment.

Requirements

  • 4–7 years of Product Management or Product Ownership experience in a software product company.
  • End-to-end ownership of a customer-facing product area with Engineering and Design.
  • Strong judgment in reducing a large problem space to a focused release and explaining the trade-offs.
  • Experience turning customer evidence and product data into decisions.
  • Clear written communication across requirements, edge cases, metrics, and decision records.
  • Ability to work with multi-actor workflows, permissions, states, and data relationships.
  • High ownership and independence, with fluent written and spoken English.

Strong plus

  • Experience with B2B SaaS, fundraising, payments, registration, events, community, or other multi-sided products.
  • Experience launching a new product area through beta or EAP.
  • Knowledge of CRM integrations, reporting, transaction attribution, analytics, or SQL.
  • Practical use of AI for research, prototyping, analysis, or product operations.

This Role May Not Be a Fit If

  • You are looking for an event-planning or internal project-management role rather than software product ownership.
  • You prefer to receive a fully defined roadmap and requirements instead of helping determine what should be built.
  • You want to work only on strategy and avoid specifications, QA, delivery details, or post-launch iteration.
  • You treat every customer request as a roadmap commitment.
  • You need stable scope and certainty before moving forward.

title: Commercial Contracts Lead
description:
Commercial Contracts Lead

Dallas, TX | Uptown | Hybrid

CMC, part of Amoria Group, is looking for a commercially minded Commercial Contracts Lead to support the continued growth of our US business.

This is a hands-on contracts role working closely with Sales, Operations, Finance and senior leadership. You'll take ownership of the commercial contract process, reviewing and negotiating agreements, identifying commercial and contractual risks, and helping our teams reach agreements that support the business while protecting our interests.

Please note: We are not seeking a lawyer, attorney or paralegal. We are specifically looking for someone with hands-on experience managing and negotiating contracts from a commercial and operational perspective. The focus is on understanding business priorities, managing commercial risk and making contracts work in practice.

What You'll Do

Own the Contract Process

  • Manage the end-to-end contract process across the US business, from initial review through negotiation, approval and execution.
  • Review and negotiate a range of commercial agreements, including MSAs, SOWs, client terms, amendments, contractor agreements and other commercial documentation.
  • Act as the key point of contact for Sales and internal stakeholders on contractual matters.
  • Ensure contracts are accurately documented, approved and stored in line with company processes.

Support Sales & Commercial Negotiations

  • Work closely with Sales teams during contract negotiations, helping them navigate contractual requirements and reach commercially sensible outcomes.
  • Review proposed client terms and identify clauses that could create commercial, financial, operational or contractual risk.
  • Challenge terms where appropriate and work with stakeholders to determine practical solutions.
  • Help Sales understand the implications of contractual commitments before agreements are signed.
  • Support the business in negotiating terms that enable deals to progress while maintaining appropriate levels of risk.

Identify & Manage Risk

  • Identify areas of contractual exposure and highlight potential issues before they become problems.
  • Assess clauses relating to areas such as liability, indemnification, payment terms, termination, warranties, insurance, confidentiality, intellectual property and contractual obligations.
  • Escalate material or complex issues where specialist legal input is required.
  • Work with Finance, Operations and Compliance to ensure contractual commitments can be delivered effectively.

Improve How We Work

  • Continuously improve our contract review, negotiation and approval processes.
  • Help develop and maintain contract templates, playbooks, guidance and approval frameworks.
  • Identify opportunities to make contract management more efficient and scalable as the US business grows.
  • Maintain clear records of contracts, negotiations, approvals and key obligations.
  • Support the development of consistent commercial contracting practices across the business.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience reviewing, negotiating and managing commercial contracts within a US business environment.
  • Strong practical understanding of MSAs, SOWs, client terms, amendments and contractual risk.
  • Experience working directly with Sales, Account Management or Commercial teams on contract negotiations.
  • The ability to quickly identify clauses or terms that could create financial, commercial or operational risk.
  • Strong commercial judgement and the confidence to challenge contractual terms where appropriate.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, particularly when working with Sales and senior stakeholders.
  • A practical, solutions-focused approach rather than simply identifying problems.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple contracts and negotiations simultaneously.
  • The ability to work independently and take ownership of the contract process.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid working environment with flexibility and autonomy
  • Monthly lunch clubs and team social events
  • Personal development allowance to support your career growth
  • Opportunity to attend two international company conferences each year
  • Employee-led culture committees and initiatives
  • Access to professional development and leadership training programmes
  • Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) with wellbeing and mental health support for you and your family
  • Financial wellbeing and caregiver support services
  • Employee discounts on travel, fitness, retail and more
  • Medical, dental and vision coverage options for eligible employees

Why Join CMC?

CMC is part of a global consulting group with an established presence across Europe and Asia Pacific. Since launching our Dallas office in 2022, we've been rapidly expanding our footprint across North America.

You'll be joining a high-growth business where you'll have genuine ownership and visibility across the US operation. You'll work directly with Sales, Operations, Finance and senior leadership, giving you the opportunity to influence how the business contracts with clients and how we manage commercial risk as we scale.

Our work supports critical industries including renewable energy, infrastructure and advanced engineering, giving you the opportunity to work within sectors that are helping shape a more sustainable and connected future.

You'll also be part of a culture built around Positivity, Respect, Ownership, Fun, Excellence and Success (PROFES), where collaboration is valued and people are encouraged to make an impact.

If you're a commercially minded contracts professional who enjoys negotiation, problem-solving and working closely with Sales, we'd love to hear from you.

OTHER DUTIES AS ASSIGNED

  • Partner with Senior Major Gift Officer, Director of Development, and campaign leadership to shape and refine major-gift and legacy-giving strategies.
  • Provide input on prospect research, wealth-capacity assessments, donor segmentation, and pipeline development.

These job responsibilities represent only the essential and most significant duties of the position.

This job description does not exclude other work assignments, directives and responsibilities not mentioned herein.

title: Associate, Client Solutions (Wed-Sat Shift)
description:
Job Title – Associate, Client Solutions (Sat to Wed shift)

Business Unit – Client Solutions

Location – Mumbai

Job Summary

GLG is seeking Associates who are excited to learn and excel at best-in-class client service in a strong performance-driven, merit-based, and team-oriented environment.

Associates are the engine driving GLG's Insight Network – the world's largest and most varied source of first-hand expertise. The Associate role involves fast-paced communication, working directly as thought partners with leading professionals across industries for client deliverables.

Associates should have a natural curiosity, strong critical thinking skills, and a competitive spirit to win for clients. Armed with those qualities, you’ll go through our robust onboarding and training programs so that you can grow and hone the skills needed to succeed in your role. Over time, basis consistent performance, you will be owning the project lifecycle, speaking frequently with leading clients and experts – all while receiving continued coaching and mentoring from your team to help you develop top-tier project management and communication skills.

Key Associate Responsibilities Include (but are not limited to):

  • Recruiting new experts to join GLG’s insight network through targeted lead generation and timely outreach by phone, email, and other methods.
  • Scheduling and confirming critical calls and meetings between GLG’s clients and Network Members, including scheduling all calls with your new recruits.
  • Collaborating closely with client-facing team members to expand projects and rescope of recruiting populations to drive successful client outcomes.
  • Building your understanding of client strategies, various industry sectors, and value chains to identify and vet the best experts for client projects.
  • Learning and upholding our compliance policies and procedures to protect the integrity of client engagements.
  • Proactively engaging with GLG’s Network Members to understand their expertise and gauge their fitment for client projects.

As an Associate, You Will Learn To:

  • Excel in a phone based and highly challenging environment that demands attention to detail and prioritization of various workflows and execution on multiple projects at the same time.
  • Recruit and vet new relevant experts to the GLG Network, building your lead generation, outreach, screening and pitching skills.
  • Develop strong, transferable business skills, including communication, time management, negotiating, problem solving, project management, research and the ability to achieve monthly/quarterly targets.
  • Collaborate with colleagues on and across both regional and global teams to contribute to revenue and broader commercial success.
  • Mentor future GLG Associates as you become tenured and proficient in your role.

Ideal Candidates Have

  • Bachelor's degree or higher (required)
  • 0-2 years of work experience in internet/market research, outreach, partnership, client-facing, sales, or account management roles
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in written English
  • Confident and strong communication (oral and written), interpersonal & problem-solving skills and motivation to work on the phone daily with Network Members and potential recruits.
  • Eagerness to learn about new topics, industries, and companies.
  • Desire to work in a fast-paced, collaborative, team environment where we strive to provide an excellent experience for experts and clients.
  • Hustle and tenacity to work responsibly and manage multiple, simultaneous tasks and prioritize effectively, given that client priorities shift quickly at GLG.
  • High motivation to exceed personal weekly, monthly, and quarterly commercial targets.
  • Willingness to work flexible and extended hours (including evenings and some holidays) based on client needs and expectations​
  • Demonstrate the ability and initiative to handle increasing responsibility over time

About GLG / Gerson Lehrman Group

GLG is the world’s leading platform for trusted human expertise. We connect global decision-makers—from hedge fund managers and private equity partners to strategy leaders at Fortune 500s—with the specific, authoritative voices required to answer their most critical questions.

At GLG, you are an extension of our clients' core teams. You will work at the intersection of industries and global markets, navigating high-stakes challenges across the full spectrum of their strategic initiatives. Operating within the industry’s most trusted research environment, you’ll help our clients capture the nuanced perspectives that drive smarter, faster business outcomes.

We are a global team of pragmatic problem-solvers who mirror the intensity of the markets we serve. If you are driven by intellectual curiosity and a bias toward action, join us in reinventing the industry we invented.

Gerson Lehrman Group, Inc. (“GLG”) is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, race, religion, color, marital status, disability, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Senior, Technical Program Manager(CoupangEats Engineering)
description:
Korean text follows English

Company Introduction

We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we are collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar commerce industry from the ground up and establishing an unparalleled reputation for being leading and reliable force in South Korean commerce.

We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.

Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated Program Manager(PM) to support the execution of strategic initiatives across Coupang Eats. Eats Engineering PMO sets the direction for our core products and services and serves as the hub that aligns teams around shared goals. To safeguard business continuity, vendor management, SLA and performance, incident escalation, and stakeholder communications to ensure consistent service quality. as well as lead project/program end to end delivery and enable timely, high‑quality delivery through planning and execution to bring critical business impact to Eats.

What You Will Do

  • Program/Project Delivery Support: lead project/program end to end delivery and enable timely, high‑quality delivery through planning and execution.
  • Project/program Management framework:Define, implement, and continuously improve project/program framework , standards, and best practices.
  • SLA and Performance Management: Align SLAs to SLOs, run periodic reviews, and track corrective actions for breaches.
  • Incident & Stakeholder Communications: Operate severity‑based escalations and coordinate clear internal/external communications.
  • Process & Operations Management: Use collaboration, documentation, and visualization tools to drive continuous improvement.
  • Vendor Portfolio Operations: Maintain vendor inventory and tiering; keep standard artifacts current.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in Program Management, Project Management, PMO, or related roles within technology-driven organizations.
  • Strong understanding of project and program management methodologies, frameworks, and best practices.
  • Experience managing complex cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent Korean and business-level English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in e-commerce, game, tech, or hyper-growth environments, or hands-on third-party security/risk work
  • Experience using AI/automation tools (e.g., Windsurf, ChatGPT) to streamline reporting, documentation, and workflows
  • Certifications such as PMP, PgMP, or Agile-related (PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe)

Recruitment Process and Others

Recruitment Process

  • Application Review - 1st Interview - 2nd Interview - Offer
  • The exact nature of the recruitment process may vary according to the specific job and may be changed due to scheduling or other circumstances.
  • Interview schedules and the results will be informed to the applicant via the e-mail address submitted at the application stage.

Details to Consider

  • This job posting may be closed prior to the stated end date for application if all openings are filled.
  • Coupang has the right to rescind an offer of employment if a candidate is found to have submitted false information as part of the application process.
  • Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran’s benefits, the disabled, etc.) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws.
  • Job titles and responsibilities may be subject to change depending on the candidate’s overall experience, etc. This will be communicated to the candidate at the appropriate time before the offer.
  • Hiring may be restricted in case the legal qualifications required for hiring and work performance is not met.
  • This is a full-time regular position and includes 12 weeks of probation period; provided, however, the probationary period may be either skipped, shortened or extended if necessary for business purposes

Privacy Notice

  • Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below.

Document Return Policy

  1. This notification is given pursuant to Article 11 (6) of the Fair Hiring Procedure Act.
  2. A job applicant, who has applied but not been finally selected for a position at Coupang (the “Company”), may request the Company to return his/her hiring documents submitted pursuant to the Fair Hiring Procedure Act. However, this will not apply where the hiring documents were submitted via the website of the Company or e-mail, or where the job applicant submitted those documents voluntarily without a request from the Company. In addition, if the hiring documents were destroyed due to a natural disaster or any other reasons not attributable to the Company, such documents will be deemed to have been returned to the job applicant.
  3. A job applicant who wishes to request the return of his/her hiring documents pursuant to the main sentence of paragraph 2 above should fill out a “Request for Return of Hiring Documents” [Annex Form No. 3 in the Enforcement Rule of the Fair Hiring Procedure Act] and submit It by email (recruitingops@coupang.com). In such case, within fourteen (14) days from the date of identifying the receipt of the request, the Company will send the hiring documents to the job applicant’s designated address via registered mail. Please be informed that the job applicant is required to pay the postage on the registered mail.
  4. In preparation for a job applicant’s request for the return of hiring documents pursuant to the main sentence of paragraph 2 above, the Company shall retain the original hiring documents submitted by the job applicant for 180 days from the completion of the recruiting process. If no request is made until the end of this period, all his/her hiring documents will be destroyed immediately in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Act.
  5. The above paragraphs 1 - 4 shall only apply when the labor-related laws of Korea govern the application. They are otherwise not applicable.

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

쿠팡이츠 Engineering 조직의 전략적 이니셔티브를 성공적으로 추진할 Program Manager를 채용합니다. Eats Engineering PMO는 핵심 서비스와 프로젝트의 실행력을 높이고, 다양한 조직이 공통된 목표를 향해 정렬될 수 있도록 지원하는 허브 역할을 수행합니다. 본 포지션은 주요 프로젝트와 프로그램의 End-to-End 딜리버리를 주도하고, 체계적인 프로젝트 관리 프레임워크와 운영 프로세스를 구축하여 조직 전반의 실행력을 향상시키는 역할을 담당합니다. 빠르게 성장하는 환경에서 복잡한 이해관계자와 협업하며, 체계적인 프로세스와 운영 문화를 만들어갈 수 있는 분을 찾고 있습니다.

업무 내용

Program & Project Delivery

  • 전략적 프로젝트 및 프로그램의 계획, 실행, 완료까지 End-to-End 딜리버리 리드
  • 일정, 범위, 리스크, 의존성 및 이해관계자를 관리하여 높은 수준의 결과물 제공
  • Engineering, Product, Operations, Security, Legal, Finance 등 다양한 조직과 긴밀히 협업

Project & Program Governance

  • 프로젝트 및 프로그램 관리 프레임워크, 표준, Best Practice 정의 및 지속 개선
  • 효과적인 Governance 체계 및 운영 프로세스 구축
  • 프로젝트 포트폴리오 수준의 리스크, 의존성 및 진행 현황 관리

Stakeholder Communication & Alignment

  • 조직 간 의사결정 및 협업 촉진
  • 경영진 대상 리포트 및 프로젝트 현황 보고 체계 구축
  • 주요 이슈 및 리스크에 대한 Escalation 관리 및 해결 지원

Operational Excellence

  • 프로세스 개선 및 문서화를 통한 운영 효율성 향상
  • 협업 및 자동화 도구를 활용한 업무 생산성 개선
  • 데이터 기반 의사결정과 지속적인 개선 문화 확산

Incident & Service Operations Support

  • 중요 장애 발생 시 Escalation 프로세스 운영 및 커뮤니케이션 지원
  • 엔지니어링 조직과 협력하여 서비스 안정성 및 운영 체계 강화

자격 요건

  • Business, Computer Science, Engineering 또는 관련 분야의 학사 학위 이상을 보유 또는 이에 준하는 실무 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 기술 기반 조직에서 Program Management, Project Management, PMO 또는 유관 분야 경력 4년 이상을 보유하신 분
  • 프로젝트 및 프로그램 관리 방법론, 프레임워크 및 베스트 프랙티스에 대한 높은 이해도를 보유하신 분
  • 다양한 이해관계자가 참여하는 복잡한 Cross-functional 프로젝트를 성공적으로 관리한 경험을 보유하신 분
  • Jira, Confluence 등 프로젝트 관리 및 협업 도구 활용 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 우수한 커뮤니케이션 역량, 조직 운영 역량 및 이해관계자 관리 역량을 보유하신 분
  • 영어 커뮤니케이션 역량을 보유하신 분

우대 사항

  • 이커머스, 게임, 테크 기업 또는 빠르게 성장하는(Hyper-growth) 환경에서의 업무 경험을 보유하신 분
  • Third-party Security 또는 Risk Management 관련 실무 경험을 보유하신 분
  • Windsurf, ChatGPT 등 AI 및 자동화 도구를 활용하여 리포팅, 문서화 및 업무 프로세스 효율화를 수행한 경험을 보유하신 분
  • PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe 등 프로젝트 및 애자일 관련 자격증을 보유하신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 1차 면접 - 2차 면접 - 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Product Manager, Peer-to-Peer Events
description:
Highlights:

Location: Armenia

Language: Fluent in Russian and English (C1+)

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About Peer-to-Peer at Fundraise Up

Peer-to-Peer turns supporters into fundraisers. Instead of only donating, a supporter creates a fundraising page, invites others to give, joins a team, or participates in an event on behalf of a nonprofit.

We are building Peer-to-Peer as a new product line. The product starts with two connected directions:

  • P2P DIY: self-serve fundraising for birthdays, memorials, personal challenges, and other supporter-led campaigns.
  • P2P Events: structured, time-bound fundraising programs such as walks, runs, rides, climbs, workplace challenges, and recurring event series.

DIY creates the product foundation. Events extends it with registration, teams and captains, event operations, participant communication, attribution, reporting, and integrations. The two directions must work as one coherent product while serving different customer workflows and levels of complexity.

About the Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to own P2P Events within the broader Peer-to-Peer product line.

This is a hands-on software product role covering discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and iteration. You will turn an ambiguous product area into a focused solution grounded in customer, usage, and commercial evidence.

Events and DIY serve different sides of the same system: nonprofits need to run fundraising programs, while participants need effective tools to fundraise. You will work closely with the PM responsible for the broader P2P area so these experiences and their shared capabilities evolve together.

This is not an event-planning or project-coordination role.

What You’ll Own

Define the product direction

  • Turn customer research, market evidence, and business context into a clear product thesis and sequenced roadmap.
  • Choose a focused target segment and event scenario rather than trying to serve the entire category at once.
  • Decide which capabilities belong in the shared P2P foundation and which require an Events-specific model.
  • Keep assumptions, success metrics, scope, risks, and product decisions explicit.

Lead discovery and product definition

  • Work directly with nonprofit event teams, participants, design partners, and internal GTM teams.
  • Validate decisions through interviews, workflow mapping, prototypes, and live product usage.
  • Separate true adoption blockers from feature requests and incumbent-product expectations.
  • Shape problems such as registration, teams and captains, attribution and reporting, event operations, participant communication, and CRM integrations. These are examples—not a pre-committed feature checklist.

Shape and deliver the product

  • Own the product from problem definition through requirements, delivery, launch, and iteration.
  • Write clear requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and decision records.
  • Make day-to-day scope and trade-off decisions with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Research, and QA.
  • Ensure the product can evolve from simpler events to more advanced team structures, event series, and operational workflows without overbuilding the first release.
  • Keep delivery predictable by surfacing dependencies, risks, and unresolved decisions early.

Launch, learn, and drive outcomes

  • Launch and learn through EAPs with clear entry criteria, success measures, readiness requirements, and out-of-scope areas.
  • Understand whether organizations can run events successfully and whether participants activate, fundraise, and return.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, CSM, and Support on positioning, customer commitments, enablement, and competitive context.
  • Connect product evidence to adoption, expansion, pipeline, retention, and GPV.
  • Turn evidence into clear recommendations: iterate, expand, change direction, or stop.

Work AI-native

  • Use AI for research synthesis, prototyping, specification quality, data exploration, and operational automation.
  • Build testable artifacts quickly without outsourcing product judgment.

Requirements

  • 4–7 years of Product Management or Product Ownership experience in a software product company.
  • End-to-end ownership of a customer-facing product area with Engineering and Design.
  • Strong judgment in reducing a large problem space to a focused release and explaining the trade-offs.
  • Experience turning customer evidence and product data into decisions.
  • Clear written communication across requirements, edge cases, metrics, and decision records.
  • Ability to work with multi-actor workflows, permissions, states, and data relationships.
  • High ownership and independence, with fluent written and spoken English.

Strong plus

  • Experience with B2B SaaS, fundraising, payments, registration, events, community, or other multi-sided products.
  • Experience launching a new product area through beta or EAP.
  • Knowledge of CRM integrations, reporting, transaction attribution, analytics, or SQL.
  • Practical use of AI for research, prototyping, analysis, or product operations.

This Role May Not Be a Fit If

  • You are looking for an event-planning or internal project-management role rather than software product ownership.
  • You prefer to receive a fully defined roadmap and requirements instead of helping determine what should be built.
  • You want to work only on strategy and avoid specifications, QA, delivery details, or post-launch iteration.
  • You treat every customer request as a roadmap commitment.
  • You need stable scope and certainty before moving forward.
  • You measure progress mainly by features shipped rather than customer and business outcomes.

Why work with us

  • A strong, collaborative product team that owns what it builds
  • Clear product vision and access to real customer feedback from global nonprofit leaders
  • Flat structure: no politics, just great work with great people
  • Transparent company culture-we share how we’re growing, where revenue comes from, and what’s next
  • Long-term focus: we offer equity options and value sustained, meaningful contribution

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is $4,600 - $5,000 gross.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Benefits

  • 31 days off
  • 100% paid telemedicine plan
  • Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace.
  • English learning courses
  • Relevant professional education
  • Gym or swimming pool
  • Co-working
  • Remote working

**Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. Exercise caution and ensure the authenticity of emails claiming to be from our company.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.

title: Senior Systems Reliability Engineer (SRE), Edge
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: London, UK

About the Role

We are looking for talented Systems Reliability Engineers to build and operate our Edge platform running in more than 320 cities in over 120 countries. Our SREs come from diverse technical backgrounds and have built up their knowledge working in different environments, but common factors across all of our reliability-focused engineers include a passion for automation, scalability, and operational excellence. We support our services in a “follow the sun” model with offices in East Asia, Europe and North America.

This is a superb opportunity to join a high-performing team and scale our high-growth network as Cloudflare’s business grows. We live at the boundary between systems, network, and software, and love improving the glue that holds them together. Working with us, you will build tools to constantly improve service availability, performance, and operational velocity. You will nurture a passion for an “automate everything” approach that makes systems failure resistant and ready to scale.

SREs focus on the immediate state and functionality of the Cloudflare platform around the world, leveraging an array of monitoring, alerting and diagnostics tools while developing and enhancing the Cloudflare platform and its capabilities. We own a wide portfolio of applications and services, running a tight feedback loop of developer and operator patterns. The ideal SRE candidate has a passionate curiosity about how the Internet fundamentally works and has a strong knowledge of networking, Linux and TLS along with coding ability in Go or Python.

This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.

Requisite Skills

  • Aptitude for identifying problems, owning them and working with others to solve them
  • Linux systems experience
  • 3 years experience in an SRE role or a role with similar functions
  • Software development skills in some programming language such as Go or Python
  • Understanding of distributed software systems and large scale system design tradeoffs
  • Intermediate experience of common network protocols like DNS and HTTP
  • Understanding of routing protocols and concepts such as BGP and IP anycast

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

  • Experience with the Linux kernel and Linux software packaging
  • Performance analysis and debugging
  • Configuration management systems such as Saltstack, Chef, Puppet or Ansible
  • Load balancing and reverse proxies such as Nginx, Varnish, HAProxy, Squid or Apache
  • SQL databases
  • Time series databases such as OpenTSDB, Graphite, Prometheus or Grafana
  • Key/Value stores

Bonus Points

  • Experience with continuous / rapid release engineering
  • Strong tooling and automation development experience
  • Experience working in a 24/7/365 service environment
  • Experience working with large scale production distributed systems
  • A history of contributing to Open Source Software

Some tools that we use

  • Nginx
  • PostgreSQL
  • Docker
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • Consul
  • Nomad
  • Salt

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

: We released to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

title: Regiebegeleider Ouderen LVB - MVB - EVB
description:
Jij hebt een hart voor mensen met een beperking. Je bent klaar om te bouwen aan een nieuw team en jouw energie werkt aanstekelijk.

3 Redenen waarom dit jouw baan is

  1. Je bent een rots in de branding voor cliënten

    Tijdens jouw dienst bied je veiligheid, nabijheid en structuur.

  2. Je houdt van afwisseling en verantwoordelijkheid

    Van persoonlijke verzorging tot het schrijven van ondersteuningsplannen, jij draait jouw hand er niet voor om.

  3. Je werkt graag in een team dat samen leert en groeit

    Je neemt initiatief, ondersteunt collega’s en denkt mee over de beste zorg.

En ja, dat zorgdiploma op mbo-niveau 4 (bijvoorbeeld MZ, Social Work of iets vergelijkbaars) heb jij natuurlijk gewoon in de pocket.

Wat jij verdient

Jij zorgt goed voor anderen, wij zorgen goed voor jou. Zo vinden wij een goede balans in werk-privé heel belangrijk. Daarnaast verdien jij:

  • Direct een vast contract (met twee maanden proeftijd) voor 24-36 uur per week.

  • Een bruto salaris tussen € 2.893 en € 3.902 per maand voor regiebegeleiders (FWG 40) conform de cao Gehandicaptenzorg o.b.v. 36 uur per week.

  • 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering, 8% vakantiegeld en pensioenopbouw.

  • Flexibele arbeidsvoorwaarden. Je kunt een deel van je arbeidsvoorwaarden naar wens inzetten, bijvoorbeeld voor een laptop, sportabonnement, (lease)fiets of extra verlof (vraag naar de regelingen).

  • Alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen met scholing en coaching via onze eigen Reinaerde Academy.

We hebben nog veel meer interessante arbeidsvoorwaarden, maar die vertellen we graag persoonlijk.

Even voorstellen: jouw nieuwe team en werklocatie

Welkom op de Rietveldlaan! Hier wonen ouder wordende cliënten met een verstandelijke beperking, verdeeld over twee vleugels. In vleugel A wonen cliënten met een Ernstig Verstandelijke Beperking (EVB) en in vleugel B cliënten met een Matig tot Licht Verstandelijke Beperking. Iedere cliënt heeft een eigen verhaal, wensen en ondersteuningsvraag. Juist die afwisseling maakt jouw werk betekenisvol en uitdagend.

Je komt terecht in een team dat volop in ontwikkeling is. Samen bouwen we aan een warme, veilige en vertrouwde woonomgeving waarin cliënten zich gezien en thuis voelen. Daarbij kijken we niet alleen naar goede zorg, maar ook naar kwaliteit van leven, plezier en persoonlijke aandacht.

Wat deze locatie extra leuk maakt? Je krijgt de kans om écht mee te bouwen. Jouw ideeën, energie en initiatief worden gewaardeerd. Of het nu gaat om het verbeteren van de dagelijkse zorg, het organiseren van een activiteit of het versterken van de samenwerking binnen het team: jouw bijdrage maakt het verschil. Samen leren, ontwikkelen en successen vieren staat centraal. Zo creëren we niet alleen een fijne plek voor de cliënten, maar ook een werkplek waar collega's graag zijn en trots op zijn.

Zo ziet jouw werkdag als regiebegeleider eruit

Jij bent de steun en toeverlaat voor bewoners. Je biedt structuur, verzorging en bent er gewoon met aandacht en warmte. Afhankelijk van jouw ervaring krijg je meer verantwoordelijkheid in het team. Een kleine greep uit jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Ondersteunen bij persoonlijke verzorging.

  • Structuur en veiligheid bieden gedurende de dag.

  • Schrijven en uitvoeren van individuele ondersteuningsplannen.

  • Verantwoordelijkheid nemen in teamtaken en collega’s ondersteunen.

  • Samenwerken met collega’s en familie voor de beste zorg.

Jouw werkdagen zijn

  • Je werkt in een onregelmatig dienstrooster, inclusief weekenden en slaapdiensten.

Ben je er klaar voor?

Reageer dan direct. Liever telefonisch solliciteren of eerst nog een vraag over de functie regiebegeleider? Bel of whatsapp Linda van Emmerik (recruiter), T 06 – 575 18 780.

Ook belangrijk

Net als wij vind ook jij een veilige en vertrouwde omgeving voor cliënten en collega’s belangrijk. Daarom lever je vóór je eerste werkdag een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) aan.

Wij zoeken graag zelf onze nieuwe collega regiebegeleider, daarom hoeven bureaus écht niet mee te helpen zoeken.
