Our 425-bed medical center has been named the #1 hospital in Arkansas for five consecutive years by U.S. News & World Report. We employ 3,200+ team members and serve the region with over 45 clinic locations, the area’s only Level II trauma center, and five Centers of Excellence - the Washington Regional J.B. Hunt Transport Services Neuroscience Institute; Washington Regional Walker Heart Institute; Washington Regional Women and Infants Center; Washington Regional Total Joint Center; and Washington Regional Pat Walker Center for Seniors.

Position Summary

The EVS Tech I reports to the Environmental Services Manager and is responsible for the daily cleaning and disinfection of patient and non-patient areas to support a safe, sanitary healing environment. This position has frequent interaction with staff, visitors, and patients and is expected to demonstrate courteous, service-oriented communication.

Essential Position Responsibilities

  • Follow departmental policies and manufacturer instructions for the safe handling, dilution, and use of cleaning/disinfecting chemicals and equipment.
  • Stock and maintain the EVS supply cart/closet (e.g., liners, microfiber, paper products, disinfectants) at the beginning and end of each shift.
  • Clean and disinfect patient rooms, offices, restrooms, corridors, and other assigned areas according to established schedules and standards.
  • Perform discharge/terminal cleaning and enhanced cleaning for isolation rooms as assigned, following infection prevention precautions.
  • Collect, remove, and properly dispose of trash, linen, and waste, including regulated medical waste, in accordance with hospital policy.
  • Replenish disposable items such as soap, paper towels, toilet paper, gloves, and sanitizer dispensers as assigned.
  • Clean and disinfect equipment and furniture (e.g., beds, stretchers, wheelchairs, tables) per unit workflow and EVS procedures.
  • Respond promptly to calls for service including spills, bodily fluid cleanups, and room/equipment turnarounds; place appropriate wet-floor signage and follow safety protocols.
  • Dust and spot-clean high and low surfaces, vents, ledges, and other touchpoints; focus on high-touch areas to reduce infection risk.
  • Use required personal protective equipment (PPE) and follow Standard/Transmission-Based Precautions as applicable.
  • Use assigned tracking system and approved electronic devices to receive, document, and close tasks; communicate status updates as needed.
  • Provide positive customer service and maintain patient privacy and confidentiality while interacting with patients, visitors, and staff.

Qualifications

  • Education: High school diploma or GED, preferred.
  • Licensure and Certifications: N/A
  • Experience: Previous housekeeping experience in a hospital setting, preferred.

Work Environment: This position spends the majority of time standing and/or walking while pushing, pulling, lifting, and/or carrying up to 50 lbs. Occasional sitting may be required while performing work in a standard office environment (e.g., documentation, training). The employee must have the ability to read, write, and speak English. This position may be exposed to industrial-strength cleaning chemicals, body fluids, and communicable diseases and must follow all required safety and infection prevention practices.

The job description is not designed or intended to cover or set forth a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Washington Regional reserves the right in its absolute discretion to change duties, responsibilities or activities or assign new duties, responsibilities, or activities at any time with or without notice. Employees may be directed to perform job-related tasks other than those specifically presented in this description.

title: Optician
description:

The Optician is responsible for assisting patients with the selection, fitting, and adjustment of eyewear to meet their visual needs and lifestyle preferences. This role involves interpreting prescriptions from optometrists or ophthalmologists, recommending appropriate lenses and frames, and ensuring accurate measurements for optimal vision correction. The Optician provides excellent customer service, educates patients on eyewear care and options, and ensures compliance with quality and safety standards. Additional responsibilities may include managing inventory, processing insurance claims, and maintaining accurate patient records.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Interpret and verify optical prescriptions provided by optometrists or ophthalmologists
  • Assist patients in selecting eyeglass frames, lenses, and lens coatings based on prescription, lifestyle, and budget
  • Take precise facial and optical measurements (e.g., pupillary distance, segment height, bridge fit)
  • Fit, adjust, and repair eyeglasses to ensure comfort, function, and visual accuracy
  • Educate patients on proper eyewear use, care, and maintenance
  • Explain lens options, vision correction solutions, and insurance benefits clearly and accurately
  • Process optical orders and ensure prescriptions are filled correctly and in a timely manner
  • Perform quality control checks on finished eyewear to ensure compliance with prescription specifications
  • Maintain accurate patient records and documentation
  • Manage inventory of frames, lenses, and optical supplies
  • Handle billing, insurance claims, and payments when required
  • Ensure compliance with professional, safety, and regulatory standards
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and professional optical dispensary
  • Collaborate with optometrists, ophthalmologists, and other healthcare staff to ensure optimal patient care
  • Address patient concerns, troubleshoot vision or fit issues, and provide follow-up support.
  • Hold in strictest confidence all information pertaining to any and all patients and health center matters.
  • Work assigned shifts as determined by supervisor and/or administration.
  • Other duties as assigned.

description:

Our mission is to improve the health of people in the communities we serve through compassionate, high-quality care, prevention, and wellness education. Hunt Transport Services Neuroscience Institute; Washington Regional Walker Heart Institute; Washington Regional Women and Infants Center; Washington Regional Total Joint Center; and Washington Regional Pat Walker Center for Seniors.

Position Summary

The Non-Registered Polysomnographic Tech assists with sleep disorder evaluations and treatments under the Sleep Lab Manager. This role assists with in-center polysomnography and home sleep apnea testing, helps ensure accurate data acquisition and documentation, and provides direct patient education and high-quality, compassionate care in accordance with facility protocols and applicable standards.

Essential Position Responsibilities

  • Prepare, calibrate, and troubleshoot equipment to ensure accurate recordings and safe operation

Qualifications

  • Education: High school diploma or GED, required. Completion of A-STEP educational modules administered through the AASM.

Eligibility for, and progress toward, professional credentialing in sleep (e.g., RST, RPSGT, or CPSGT) is preferred and may be required within an established timeframe based on department policy.

Work Environment: This position will spend 60% of the time walking and/or standing while pushing, pulling, lifting, and/or carrying up to 50 lbs. This position will serve a culturally and linguistically diverse patient population.

title: Lifeguard
description:
Make a SPLASH at the SJCC!

Love the water? Thrive in an energetic, people-focused environment? Join our Aquatics Team and turn your passion into a job you’ll actually be excited to show up for!

As a Lifeguard, you’ll be the heartbeat of our pool—creating a safe, welcoming, and fun environment for everyone by enforcing pool protocols, supporting daily operations, and keeping our aquatic spaces running smoothly. As a Swim Instructor, you’ll help swimmers of all ages and abilities build confidence in the water through engaging, supportive, and fun lessons that make a real impact.


Why you’ll love it here:
• Pay from $18–$26/hour, based on experience
• A supportive, upbeat team culture
• Meaningful work where you keep people safe and smiling
• The chance to build skills, leadership, and community



Apply TODAY and dive into a role that makes waves—in the pool and in our community!


Position Summary


The Lifeguard is responsible for maintaining a safe, welcoming, and well-supervised aquatic environment for all participants. Lifeguards maintain active surveillance, enforce facility rules and safety protocols, respond to emergencies, support scheduled aquatic programs, assist members and guests, and contribute to the safe and efficient operation of the Aquatics Department.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Maintain active and continuous surveillance of assigned areas and remain alert and prepared to recognize and respond immediately to emergencies.
  • Enforce pool and facility rules, policies, and safety protocols consistently, professionally, and respectfully. Educate and redirect participants regarding safe and unsafe behaviors.
  • Recognize and respond appropriately to aquatic and facility emergencies, including performing water rescues and providing First Aid, CPR/AED, and other emergency care within the scope of current training and certification.
  • Follow all Emergency Action Plans (EAPs), emergency procedures, evacuation procedures, and established safety protocols. Know the location and appropriate use of emergency and rescue equipment.
  • Complete accident, incident, rescue, chemical reading, patron count, and other required documentation accurately and promptly.
  • Communicate clearly, respectfully, and effectively with members, guests, participants, coworkers, supervisors, other departments, and outside partners. Promptly communicate safety concerns, incidents, facility issues, schedule concerns, and other relevant information.
  • Provide professional and welcoming customer service by assisting members and guests with pool rules, schedules, programs, and facility procedures and referring concerns to a supervisor when appropriate.
  • Support scheduled use of the aquatic facility, including lap swimming, open swim, swim lessons, school and camp programming, and other aquatic activities.
  • Assist with safe and efficient transitions between programs and user groups, including preparing aquatic spaces, communicating with incoming and outgoing groups, and maintaining supervision and safety expectations.
  • Work collaboratively with Aquatics staff, other departments, school and camp programs, before- and after-school programs, and outside partners to support effective communication, coordinated facility use, and smooth program transitions.
  • Monitor the aquatic environment and promptly report hazards, damaged or missing equipment, water-quality concerns, or other unsafe conditions to the appropriate supervisor.
  • Complete required pool water-quality checks by testing, reading, documenting, and reporting chemical levels according to established procedures and training. Lifeguards are not responsible for handling, adding, mixing, or adjusting pool chemicals.
  • Complete assigned opening, closing, cleaning, equipment, facility upkeep, and other operational responsibilities according to established procedures.
  • Complete down duties when not actively assigned to surveillance, including cleaning and organizing aquatic areas, patron counts, pool readings, equipment checks, program preparation, and other assigned tasks. Remain in the designated Aquatics area and available to assist patrons, staff, or respond to an emergency unless otherwise directed by a supervisor.
  • Arrive on time, in required uniform, with required equipment, and prepared to assume assigned responsibilities at the scheduled start of the shift.
  • Attend and actively participate in required staff meetings, in-service trainings, emergency drills, skills assessments, and continuing education.
  • Maintain professional conduct, communication, appearance, and appropriate boundaries with participants, members, guests, coworkers, and partners.
  • Assist with shift coverage when available and approved according to department scheduling procedures.
  • Work evenings, weekends, holidays, and other shifts as required based on facility and program needs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned that are consistent with the responsibilities and operational needs of the position.

title: Billing Specialist - Payment Poster

title: AL Med-Tech
location: The Lodge at Carson City  - Carson City, NV 89706
description:
The Medication Technician is responsible for the safe administration of medications to residents as ordered by the attending physician, under the direction of the attending physician, and Health Services Director and in accordance with established nursing standards, the policies, procedures and practices of the property, and the requirements of the state. Responsible for maintaining a current accounting of all medications residents are taking and the documentation required for that process.

Responsible to report all change in status of residents as it relates to assisting with medications. Reports to: Health Services Director or Journey Program Director, as assigned.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS, DUTIES AND RESPONSIBLITIES

The essential duties and responsibilities described below are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the basic functions of the position. While every effort has been made to identify the essential functions of the position, it in no way states or implies that these are the only duties you will be required to perform. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related or is an essential function of the position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

  1. At the direction of the Health Services Director or Journey Program Director, coordinate medication services with resident, pharmacy and physician. Prior to resident’s arrival, inform the local pharmacy of the medication needs of new

residents, verify medications and proper dosages with physician. Medication is not to be dispensed until verification with physician is complete.

  1. Order additional medications as needed and directed by the Health Services Director or Journey Program Director.
  2. Track all orders for medication changes and/or refills.
  1. Report to the Health Services Director or Journey Program Director any changes in medication order for residents, residents requiring extra services on a continual basis, and any changes in resident physical or mental status.
  2. Assist the Resident Services Director in maintaining and providing accurate and inclusive records on all residents. This may include the completion of Medication Administration Record (MAR) duplicate sheets for any changes in a particular

resident’s medication, performing monthly audits/checks on all residents’ charts, assisting with the processing of a new resident’s paperwork, filing and maintaining resident files in a professional manner.

  1. As requested, maintain an inventory of all department supplies. Notify the Health Services Director or Journey Program Director timely and/or place supply orders, with a supervisor’s approval, when supply levels reach a pre-designated threshold.
  2. As directed, act as the main point of contact for physicians, family members and vendors in the absence of the Health Services Director or Journey Program Director.
  3. At the direction of the Health Services Director or Journey Program Director, assist with department scheduling including covering call-offs, vacations and the elimination of overtime.
  4. As required, update the Caregiver Monthly Assignment Journal, Medication Technician Med List and 24 Hour Communication Log.
  5. Assists residents with their daily medications, treatments and resident care as assigned and within the scope of practice, policy and procedures and Title 22 Regulations.
  6. Observe and verify that medication is ingested or applied as directed. Document any instance where prescribed medication is not administered, including reason(s) for refusal and notify supervisor and/or Executive Director.
  7. Maintain accurate, complete and confidential resident medication and care records according to established procedure and state law.
  8. Keep medicine carts and areas orderly, clean and appropriately stocked and locked. Maintain upkeep and cleanliness of medicine carts and medication rooms.
  9. Assist medication aides and caregivers in the performance of their job and assume caregiver activities when needed.

  12. Carry a radio and/or pager as directed by supervisor to ensure prompt response to resident issues.
  13. Be familiar with the meaning and usage of common medical abbreviations, symbols and terms relative to the administration of medications as used by the residence, pharmacists and physicians.
  14. Demonstrate knowledge of infection control, i.e., adequate hand-washing, blood borne pathogens procedures, universal precautions, etc.
  1. Maintain all required licenses/certifications as required by state law.
  2. Report occupational exposure to blood, body fluids, infectious materials, and hazardous chemicals in accordance with the property’s policies and procedures governing accidents and incidents.
  3. Provide support to community’s marketing efforts through positive/friendly interaction during all property tours and telephone contact with the public, and as directed by a supervisor.
  4. Maintain a safe and secure environment for all staff, residents and guests, following established safety standards.
  5. Encourage teamwork through cooperative interactions with co-workers and other departments.
  6. Support a positive and professional image through actions and dress.

title: Associate Director - Operations - Instawork Robotics Labs
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.

About IRL (Instawork Robotics Labs)

Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a “100,000-year data gap” - the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork’s answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments - kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, homes - to capture the high-fidelity task data that the world’s leading Robotics labs use to train their foundation models. Read more here.

Build. Scale. Operate.

We’re looking for a hardcore operations leader who thrives in the real world — someone who has built and scaled large, distributed operations from the ground up and knows what it takes to turn an idea into an operation that actually works.

This is not a role for someone who only manages dashboards, processes, or strategy decks.

We’re looking for a builder and operator, someone who can start with a blank sheet of paper, build the team, design the processes, solve problems on the ground, and scale the operation without losing speed or quality.

You’ll be operating in an environment where things change quickly, the problems are often ambiguous, and there is rarely a playbook to follow.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and scale operations from the ground up — define the operating model, build processes, hire teams, establish metrics, and create the systems needed to scale.
  • Own large, distributed, real-world operations across multiple locations, teams, and workflows.
  • Build high-performing teams — hire exceptional operators, develop leaders, set a high bar for execution, and create a culture of ownership and accountability.
  • Turn chaos into structure — identify operational bottlenecks, build repeatable processes, and continuously improve how the organization operates.
  • Be relentlessly execution-oriented — when something breaks, you don’t wait for someone else to solve it. You get to the ground, understand the problem, and figure it out.
  • Operate at speed — priorities will change, plans will move, and unexpected problems will come up. You’ll need to make decisions quickly and keep the team moving.
  • Build for scale — design processes and teams that can handle 10x growth, not just solve today’s problem.
  • Own outcomes, not just activities — set clear operational metrics and relentlessly drive performance, quality, productivity, and efficiency.

What We’re Looking For

You’ve built before.

  • Significant experience building and running large, distributed, real-world operations.
  • Experience in e-commerce, logistics, marketplaces, field operations, fast-scaling startups, hardware-adjacent businesses, or other operationally intensive environments.
  • A track record of building teams and operating models from scratch, not just inheriting established ones.
  • Strong people leadership experience, with the ability to build teams that are highly accountable, ambitious, and deeply committed to the mission.
  • Extremely high ownership — you naturally think, “I’ll figure it out.”
  • Extreme agility and resilience.
    • Plans change → you adapt, rather than freeze.
    • Pressure increases → you become clearer and more decisive.
    • Something breaks → you go after the root cause.
  • Strong operational judgment — you know when to build a process, when to break one, and when to simply get things done.
  • Comfortable working with incomplete information and making decisions without waiting for perfect data.
  • A strong bias toward action, with the ability to balance speed, quality, cost, and scale.

The Kind of Leader We Want

You’re the person who:

  • Can walk into a messy operation and figure out what needs to happen next.
  • Has built teams from a handful of people into large, high-performing organizations.
  • Can spend the morning looking at operational metrics and the afternoon solving a problem on the ground.
  • Doesn’t need a perfect org structure or playbook to get started.
  • Sets an extremely high bar — but earns trust by giving the team the support, context, and ownership to meet it.
  • Builds teams that want to run through walls for them.
  • Is calm when things are chaotic and gets more focused when the pressure goes up.
  • Gets excited by operational complexity rather than intimidated by it.
  • Has experience with robotics, AI data collection, or hardware operations

Bonus, Not Required

Experience or exposure to:

  • Supply chain or manufacturing operations
  • Field workforce operations
  • Marketplace operations
  • Multi-city / multi-location scaling
  • Building operations in an early-stage or rapidly scaling startup

Our Values

  • Empathy, Trust & Candor
    We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.

  • Bias for Action
    We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!

  • Always Be Learning
    We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.

  • Act Like an Owner
    We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.

About Instawork

Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!

Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.

Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face-to-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

Ready to make an impact? Learn more at .

title: Shipping Representative (34816)
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Shipping Representative to accurately package, verify, process, and ship domestic, international, and hazardous material orders while ensuring compliance with established shipping procedures.

This is a highly physical, fast-paced, and high-structure position. Candidates should be comfortable working on their feet for extended periods, lifting and moving packages, and working in a high-volume environment where priorities can change quickly.

Please note: The posted shift end time is a guideline, not a guaranteed departure time. The team does not leave until the final shipment has been processed and leaves the facility. Depending on business needs, this may occasionally require working as late as 8:00–9:00 PM, particularly when an airport shipment or other time-sensitive delivery is required. Candidates must be comfortable with this level of schedule flexibility.

The position also requires regular use of Microsoft Office, SAP, Salesforce, FedEx, UPS, and other specialized software, as well as the ability to operate or learn to operate a forklift and company cargo van.

This role is best suited for someone who is organized, detail-oriented, dependable, physically capable, comfortable working under pressure, and able to prioritize multiple shipping requirements while maintaining accuracy and safety.

Essential Functions, Duties & Responsibilities

  • Accurately package, verify, label, and prepare domestic, international, and hazardous material shipments.
  • Examine shipment contents and compare against manifests, invoices, packing slips, RGA/RMA documentation, and other records to verify accuracy.
  • Securely package boxes and materials to prevent damage during transit.
  • Route outgoing shipments to the appropriate destination and coordinate time-sensitive deliveries.
  • Utilize SAP and Salesforce to process shipments, print/reference product information, enter tracking numbers, and update shipment details.
  • Coordinate with shipping carriers including UPS, FedEx, and DHL to schedule pickups, provide shipping instructions, and resolve shipment-related issues.
  • Prepare international and customs-compliant shipments and ensure required documentation is accurate and complete.
  • Receive inbound deliveries and inspect contents to ensure consistency with RGA/RMA paperwork and other documentation.
  • Support various shipping functions, including daily, weekly, hazardous material (HAZMAT), and international shipments.
  • Operate or learn to operate a forklift and company cargo van as required.
  • Maintain accurate shipping records and documentation.
  • Monitor and replenish shipping supplies and maintain supplies in designated locations.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, organized, and compliant shipping environment.
  • Assist with process improvement initiatives and identify opportunities to improve shipping efficiency and accuracy.
  • Work collaboratively with internal departments, carriers, and other team members to ensure shipments are completed accurately and on time.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Physical & Work Environment Requirements

  • This is a physically demanding position requiring regular standing, walking, bending, reaching, lifting, and moving packages/materials.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure, highly structured environment.
  • Must be comfortable handling multiple priorities and meeting time-sensitive shipping deadlines.
  • Must be able to work beyond the scheduled shift end time when necessary to ensure all shipments have left the facility.
  • Occasional workdays may extend until 8:00–9:00 PM based on shipment and airport transportation requirements.
  • Ability to safely operate or learn to operate a forklift and company cargo van.
  • Must follow all safety, shipping, hazardous-material, and company procedures.

title: Quality Assurance Officer
description:
Quality Assurance Officer

Hittech Multin | Den Haag | 24-32 uur per week

Ben jij een kwaliteitsprofessional die energie krijgt van het verbeteren van processen, het bewaken van kwaliteitsnormen en het meenemen van collega's in continue verbetering? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Binnen onze afdeling Quality is een vacature ontstaan voor een Quality Assurance Officer.

In deze functie werk je nauw samen met de QA Manager en draag je bij aan het actueel, praktisch en effectief houden van ons kwaliteitsmanagementsysteem. Je zorgt ervoor dat processen voldoen aan geldende normen, wet- en regelgeving en ondersteunt de organisatie bij het realiseren van duurzame kwaliteitsverbeteringen.

Je vertaalt kwaliteitsvereisten naar werkbare processen, begeleidt collega's bij verbetertrajecten en bent een belangrijke sparringpartner op het gebied van kwaliteit.

Wat ga je doen?

Proces- en kwaliteitsmanagement:

  • Bewaken en verbeteren van processen zodat deze voldoen aan geldende kwaliteitsnormen.

  • Initiëren, adviseren en implementeren van procesverbeteringen.

  • Signaleren van veranderingen in processen en werkwijzen en hierover kennis delen binnen de organisatie.

  • Bijdragen aan het opstellen van het QA-jaarplan en verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor toegewezen onderdelen.

  • Plannen, organiseren en opvolgen van meetmiddelenkalibraties.

Audits en compliance:

  • Uitvoeren van interne audits.

  • Mede begeleiden van externe audits.

  • Ondersteunen bij leveranciersaudits.

  • Vastleggen van auditbevindingen en ondersteunen bij corrigerende en preventieve acties.

  • Monitoren van de opvolging van verbetermaatregelen.

Adviseren en samenwerken:

  • Begeleiden van medewerkers bij het oplossen van klachten, afwijkingen en auditbevindingen.

  • Uitleg geven over kwaliteitseisen en kwaliteitsprocessen.

  • Collega's ondersteunen en aanspreken wanneer processen niet volgens de afspraken verlopen.

  • Samenwerken met alle afdelingen binnen de organisatie om kwaliteitsdoelstellingen te realiseren.

  • Creëren van draagvlak voor verbeteringen en veranderingen.

  • Escaleren van kwaliteitsrisico's naar de QA Manager of Directie, indien nodig.

Wat breng jij mee?

  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau, met een pragmatische instelling.

  • 5 tot 7 jaar ervaring met kwaliteit- en compliance management in een technische en/of medische omgeving.

  • Kennis van ISO-normen en kwaliteitsmethodieken zoals Root Cause Analysis (8D), risicoanalyses, Lean en/of SPC.

  • Een stevige gesprekspartner die kwaliteit combineert met samenwerking.

  • Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden, met focus op continu verbeteren.

  • Resultaatgericht, proactief en klantgericht.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen verschillende belangen te verbinden.

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal en goede beheersing van het Engels.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een salaris tussen € 4.400 en € 5.200 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

  • In beginsel een arbeidscontract voor 1 jaar, met daaropvolgend een vast dienstverband.

title: Estimator
location: OH Canal Fulton - Canal Fulton, OH 44614
description:
Estimator

Position Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Estimator to prepare accurate, timely, and competitive cost estimates for customer projects. This position is responsible for reviewing project requirements, completing material and labor takeoffs, identifying scope and cost risks, and preparing professional bid proposals.

The Estimator works closely with Sales, Engineering, Production, Purchasing, and other internal teams to ensure each estimate reflects the complete project scope and the company’s operational capabilities. The ideal candidate is analytical, organized, and comfortable managing multiple estimates and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Estimating and Bid Preparation

  • Review project drawings, specifications, addenda, contracts, and other bid documents to determine the complete project scope.
  • Prepare detailed quantity takeoffs and cost estimates for materials, labor, equipment, freight, subcontracted services, and other project-related expenses.
  • Identify missing information, potential risks, and opportunities for cost savings.
  • Clearly document estimate assumptions, clarifications, exclusions, and qualifications.
  • Prepare accurate and professional bid proposals for customers and other stakeholders.
  • Manage multiple estimates simultaneously while meeting required bid deadlines.
  • Review bid addenda and incorporate all applicable changes into estimates and proposals.

Collaboration and Communication

  • Partner with Sales, Engineering, Production, Purchasing, and Project Management to confirm project requirements and develop accurate cost assumptions.
  • Request and evaluate pricing from suppliers and subcontractors.
  • Develop and maintain productive relationships with vendors and subcontractors to support competitive pricing and reliable service.
  • Communicate with customers, contractors, and internal stakeholders to clarify project scope and resolve estimating questions.
  • Support customer and vendor negotiations by providing accurate cost information and scope clarification.
  • Participate in project handoff meetings for awarded work to ensure Operations and Project Management understand the estimated scope, assumptions, and cost structure.

Cost Analysis and Process Improvement

  • Maintain organized estimating records, pricing information, supplier quotations, and historical cost data.
  • Compare estimated costs with actual project results to identify trends and improve future estimate accuracy.
  • Assist with pricing change orders, and other project modifications.
  • Monitor changes in material, labor, freight, and subcontractor costs that may affect project pricing.
  • Recommend improvements to estimating processes, templates, cost databases, and software.
  • Support value-engineering efforts by identifying practical alternatives that reduce cost or improve project execution without compromising quality.

title: Product Manager
description:
[ WHO WE ARE ]

Based out of South Korea, KRAFTON, Inc. is committed to discovering and globally publishing games that deliver a uniquely fun experience with global production studios known for distinctive creatives. KRAFTON India has established itself as a trailblazer in the gaming industry, driven by its unwavering commitment to delivering distinctive and enjoyable gaming experiences. At the heart of KRAFTON India's success lies a deep understanding of the Indian gaming community.

The company takes immense pride in its premier entertainment properties that include highly popular titles like BATTLEGROUNDS MOBILE INDIA (BGMI), Road To Valor: Empires, Defense Derby, New State Mobile. These games have not only captured the hearts of Indian players but have also played a pivotal role in fostering a thriving e-sports ecosystem in the country.

KIGI aims to support 6-10 teams annually with program durations ranging from six months to one year. Additionally, KRAFTON India has invested over $150 million in the Indian market in the past two years and has committed an additional $150 million to the Indian start-up ecosystem over the next three years.

[ ABOUT THE ROLE ]

We are looking for a Product Manager who also carries Producer responsibilities to drive feature strategy, execution, and live operations for BGMI (Battlegrounds Mobile India). You will play a central role in shaping India-facing features, collaboration mechanics, user growth initiatives, and seamless live-ops delivery.This is a hybrid role that requires strong product thinking and hands-on production ownership, working closely with cross-functional teams across design, engineering, publishing, data, QA, and external partners.

  • Act as feature producer: plan sprints, track progress, manage dependencies, and ensure timely delivery.
  • Lead live-ops execution, including events, content updates, reward systems, and real-time issue handling.
  • Drive user growth, onboarding, retention, and monetization improvements for the Indian market.
  • Collaborate with central teams, external partners, and marketing on feature launches and IP tie-ups.
  • Analyze player data and market trends to optimize features and event performance.

[Qualification]

  • 4–7 years in mobile gaming product management or production.
  • Strong understanding of F2P systems, live-ops, and mobile game KPIs.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with design, engineering, QA, and data.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and project management skills.
  • Available for International travel and work with cross-continent teams
  • Passion for shooter games & Indian mobile gaming trends.

What you get in return

  • Learn Best-in-class global product practices, and scope for fast growth
  • Ability to learn from teams across the globe
  • Open and transparent work culture with ownership
  • Work on India’s biggest game of the decade.

title: FMCG Functional SME - Revenue Growth Management
description:
This role is for one of Weekday’s clients


Min Experience: 8+ years
Location: India
JobType: full-time

We are looking for an experienced FMCG Functional SME – Revenue Growth Management (RGM) with 8–12 years of relevant industry experience to drive data-led commercial strategy, pricing, promotion, assortment, and revenue optimization initiatives. The ideal candidate will combine strong FMCG domain expertise with hands-on experience in NielsenIQ data and analytical capabilities, including Python-based Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA).

You will work closely with business, commercial, sales, marketing, category, and analytics teams to translate market and transactional data into actionable recommendations that improve revenue, profitability, market share, and promotional effectiveness.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a functional subject matter expert in FMCG Revenue Growth Management, providing strategic and analytical guidance across pricing, promotions, assortment, pack-price architecture, and trade investments.
  • Analyze FMCG market and consumer data using NielsenIQ datasets to identify trends, growth opportunities, category dynamics, and competitive movements.
  • Develop and evaluate RGM strategies covering price-pack architecture, price elasticity, promotional effectiveness, assortment optimization, and mix management.
  • Conduct detailed Python-based Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) to identify patterns, anomalies, correlations, trends, and commercial opportunities within large datasets.
  • Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable business recommendations for senior stakeholders.
  • Partner with sales, marketing, category management, finance, and commercial teams to identify revenue and margin improvement opportunities.
  • Assess pricing and promotion performance across products, brands, channels, regions, and customer segments.
  • Build analytical frameworks and dashboards to monitor key RGM metrics, including revenue growth, volume, value share, price realization, promotional ROI, and profitability.
  • Support scenario analysis and business planning by evaluating the potential impact of pricing, promotion, assortment, and portfolio decisions.
  • Identify market whitespace and growth opportunities through competitive benchmarking and category-level analysis.
  • Ensure analytical methodologies and RGM recommendations are aligned with FMCG commercial objectives and industry best practices.
  • Present insights and recommendations effectively to business leaders and non-technical stakeholders.

Must-Have Skills

  • 8–12 years of experience in FMCG, Consumer Goods, Revenue Growth Management, Commercial Analytics, Category Management, or a closely related domain.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Revenue Growth Management (RGM) principles and methodologies.
  • Proven experience working with NielsenIQ data, market measurement solutions, and FMCG syndicated datasets.
  • Strong understanding of FMCG pricing, promotions, assortment, product mix, channels, and market-share dynamics.
  • Hands-on proficiency in Python for Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to work with large and complex datasets.
  • Experience translating quantitative analysis into actionable commercial and business recommendations.
  • Strong understanding of FMCG KPIs, including sales value, volume, market share, price, distribution, promotional performance, and profitability.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with price elasticity, demand modeling, promotional ROI, and price-pack architecture.
  • Knowledge of other FMCG data sources and syndicated market research platforms.
  • Experience with SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or other analytics and visualization tools.
  • Exposure to advanced analytics, forecasting, machine learning, or statistical modeling.
  • Experience working with multinational FMCG organizations and cross-functional teams.

title: Security Officer, Full-time
location: Senator John Heinz History Center - Pittsburgh, PA 15222
description:
About the Senator John Heinz History Center

The Senator John Heinz History Center is a Smithsonian-affiliated Museum and a first-day Pittsburgh attraction that presents compelling stories from American history with a Western Pennsylvania connection, all in an interactive and engaging environment for visitors of all ages. The largest history museum in Pennsylvania, the AAM-accredited History Center attracts large and diverse audiences to its 370,000-square-foot facility in Pittsburgh’s historic Strip District that includes six floors of long-term and changing exhibition space along with spectacular spaces for unique events.

The History Center’s family of museums includes the Western Pennsylvania Sports Museum, a dynamic museum-within-a-museum; the Fort Pitt Museum in Point State Park; and Meadowcroft Rockshelter & Historic Village, a National Historic Landmark located in Avella, Washington County, Pa. The History Center also leads a partnership of more than 125 regional historical societies, museums, and organizations dedicated to preserving local history – the History Center Affiliates Program.

A popular destination for families and visitors to our region, the History Center attracts more than 250,000 visitors annually and reaches millions through virtual programs and digital outreach. The History Center was recently recognized as America’s #1 History Museum by USA TODAY and “Pittsburgh’s Best Museum” by Pittsburgh Magazine.

Job Posting

The Senator John Heinz History Center, the largest history museum in Pennsylvania dedicated to history and an affiliate of the Smithsonian Institution, is seeking a Full-time Security Officer.

Security Officers must be friendly yet firm and responsive to the needs of all customers. The Officer may be questioned by the public on a number of topics regarding the History Center – directions within, amenities, exhibit components, and facilities. The officer observes and operates security systems as well as assists with overall risk management – locating, correcting and/or reporting threats of all kinds to the organization. The position demands that the officer maintain a working knowledge of the History Center exhibits, programs, and emergency response protocols while providing extraordinary customer service /interactions. Since the Officer at times be the only person in the building, a high degree of attentiveness and pro-activity will be necessary.

This is a full-time, hourly position reporting to the Chief of Security.

Why Work at the History Center?

  • Rewarding, mission-driven work that makes an impact in the community
  • Smithsonian-affiliated Museum located in Pittsburgh’s vibrant and historic Strip District
  • Voted the #1 history museum in the nation by USA Today
  • Voted Best Museum in Pittsburgh by Pittsburgh Magazine
  • Highly professional, collegial staff and dedicated volunteers
  • Located in Pittsburgh, one of America’s “most livable” cities
  • Dynamic workplace in Pittsburgh’s historic Strip District
  • Full benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options
  • 403(B) retirement plans with employer match
  • Paid time off (vacation, personal, and sick days)
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Nine (9) paid holidays
  • Company paid life insurance / LTD
  • Wellness and Employee Assistance Program
  • Discounts in the Museum Shop and Café
  • Public transportation and parking options nearby

title: Skidsteer North
description:
The Skid Steer Loader Operator is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of skid steer equipment to support site development activities, including rough and fine grading of subgrades for sidewalks, landscaping, concrete pavement, and asphalt installations. This role requires precision, attention to grade control, and the ability to work in a fast-paced construction environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate skid steer equipment to perform site preparation, grading, and material handling activities.
  • Perform finish grading and shaping of subgrades for:
    • Sidewalks and pedestrian pathways
    • Concrete pavement placements
    • Asphalt paving surfaces
    • Landscaping areas and swales
  • Grade surfaces using grade stakes, and site plans to achieve proper elevations and slopes.
  • Load, move, spread, and level materials such as soil, rock, sand, and aggregate.
  • Assist paving and concrete crews with subgrade preparation, material distribution, and cleanup.
  • Perform routine equipment inspections, maintenance, and daily safety checks (fluids, tracks, attachments).
  • Identify and report mechanical issues promptly to supervision.
  • Work closely with foremen, surveyors, and crew members to coordinate grading operations and maintain production schedules.
  • Maintain a clean and organized job site, including final trimming, grading touch-ups, and debris removal.

Qualifications

  • 2–5+ years of experience operating skid steer equipment in civil/site development or road construction.
  • Strong experience with rough and finish grading techniques.
  • Ability to read and interpret plans, grade stakes, and survey controls.
  • Knowledge of South Florida site conditions (drainage, compaction, sandy soils) is a plus (recommended based on regional practices).

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proficient in safe operation of skid steer with various attachments (bucket, grading blade, forks, broom).
  • Strong understanding of grading, elevations, and drainage principles.
  • Ability to work in close proximity to personnel, utilities, and other equipment safely.
  • Good communication skills and ability to follow direction from supervisors.
  • Strong attention to detail with a focus on quality finish work.
  • Willingness to assist with general labor tasks as needed.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to work outdoors in heat, humidity, and varying weather conditions typical of South Florida.
  • Capable of lifting 40–50 lbs and performing physical tasks such as bending, stooping, and climbing.
  • Ability to sit and operate equipment for extended periods.

Safety Requirements

  • Adhere strictly to OSHA and company safety standards.
  • Conduct daily pre-operation inspections and hazard awareness checks.
  • Maintain a safety-first mindset in all operations and interactions on the jobsite.

Work Environment

  • Active construction sites include residential, commercial, and industrial projects.
  • Frequent interaction with grading crews, paving crews, and concrete teams.
  • May require overtime, weekends, or travel depending on project schedules

title: Account Director, Strategic Accounts
description:

We are seeking a highly experienced, credible, and relationship-driven individual to join this successful team in the role of Account Director, Strategic Accounts. This professional will focus on growing and expanding Cyclomedia’s existing business within the State Department of Transportation (DOT) market across the United States.

As a member of the Transportation team, you will work collaboratively with colleagues to deepen relationships within agencies where Cyclomedia already has data on the ground and a track record of delivery. You will use your experience to help customers understand where Cyclomedia Technology’s street level imagery, LiDAR, and asset extraction services add value to their workflows and business goals. Our work with State DOTs is built on long-term partnership and multi-year programs, and we can truly make an impact on a safer world.

This role can be based anywhere in the United States and requires frequent travel to customer sites and industry events.

Job Duties

  • Grow a portfolio of existing State DOT accounts as the senior point of contact and trusted advisor.

  • Build and deepen relationships at every level of the agency, from data, GIS, and asset management teams through to executive leadership.

  • Articulate and present the strength and value proposition of Cyclomedia’s LiDAR, imagery, software, and solutions.

  • Identify where data we have already captured can be applied to new challenges, safety, asset inventory, pavement, maintenance, and planning, and build the business case with the agency.

  • Develop account strategies that turn individual projects into long-term, multi-year statewide programs.

  • Demonstrate an understanding of industry trends, funding sources, budget and acquisition cycles and processes.

  • Work closely with Solution Engineering and technical colleagues to shape solutions that fit the agency’s workflows.

  • Plan, prepare and participate in industry organization events including exhibits, sponsorships, speaking engagements, webinars, and targeted customer group meetings.

  • Be resourceful and take initiative to create paths to revenue opportunities.

  • Ten or more years of experience working in or alongside State Departments of Transportation; approximately fifteen years is ideal.

  • Direct DOT experience, with established relationships you can name and draw on from day one.

  • Demonstrated experience growing existing accounts, expanding scope, adding programs, and extending long-term work.

  • A consultative, advisory approach, with the ability to hold strategic conversations with senior agency leadership.

  • Comfort with long acquisition cycles, which typically run eighteen months to two years and occasionally longer.

  • Willingness and enthusiasm to travel frequently. Our business is built on face-to-face trust.

  • A background as an engineer, planner, or data or asset management leader within a DOT is preferred.

  • Working knowledge of geospatial data, imagery, LiDAR, GIS, and asset extraction — and how agencies apply it is preferred.

  • Excellent presentation and negotiation skills, including research, good listening, and qualification abilities.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to manage and prioritize your activities and to operate independently within a small, senior team.

  • Highly motivated team player, with a positive attitude and passion to build a business.

Benefits

  • Working with Cyclomedia has benefits!

  • The benefits go beyond assisting others and helping make the world a greener place. Below are just a few of the additional benefits of joining our team.

  • Affordable medical, dental, and vision insurance with domestic partner coverage

  • 401(k) Plan with company match

  • Life and disability insurance

  • Paid time off, including your birthday and holidays

This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of offensive security, mobile engineering, and platform protection — you will work closely with development, operations, and compliance teams to ensure security is embedded at every layer of our mobile stack.

You bring deep expertise in mobile application security, offensive techniques, and secure coding practices. You are also fluent in AI-assisted development and bring the discipline to build, maintain, and continuously improve your own AI engineering workflows.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Identify and address security vulnerabilities in mobile code, systems, and networks through manual review, automated tooling, and threat modelling.
  • Manage and optimise application security tools, processes, and alerts to maintain a strong security posture.
  • Validate and respond to Bug Bounty submissions, triaging findings and coordinating remediation with engineering teams.
  • Produce detailed security findings reports and present them to both technical and management audiences, contributing to real-world attack prevention.
  • Collaborate with development teams to implement and champion secure coding practices across iOS and Android platforms.
  • Apply AI tools to accelerate security research, automate vulnerability detection workflows, and improve the efficiency of threat analysis.
  • Work alongside operations and compliance teams to ensure security is a consistent priority across the organisation.
  • Participate in incident response and management activities.
  • Stay current on the latest offensive security techniques, application security threats, and industry best practices.

What We Look For In You

  • 5+ years of experience in mobile application security or offensive security, with hands-on expertise in iOS and/or Android platforms.
  • In-depth understanding of security risks, vulnerabilities, and concepts in mobile and web applications.
  • Proficient in code review across Kotlin, Swift, TypeScript, or JavaScript, with a strong grasp of application security threats.
  • Able to create proof-of-concepts (PoCs) to demonstrate vulnerabilities, review patch code for adherence to standards, and collaborate with repository owners on remediation.
  • Actively uses AI tools in your security engineering workflow — including building AI-leveraged workflows and codifying repeatable agent skills so tools like Claude Code or Codex deliver reliably on real production work.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Nice-To-Haves

  • Prior experience developing mobile security SDKs at scale — products with a daily active user base of over ten million.
  • Experience in large-scale business risk control projects, or practical experience in threat intelligence, business risk prevention, and countermeasures against black and grey industries.
  • In-depth reverse engineering of major apps from first-tier vendors, or other projects that demonstrate strong reverse engineering capabilities.
  • Proficiency in ARM assembly, with the ability to implement deep-level countermeasures at the native and application layers.
  • Experience with device fingerprint recognition — including simulating new devices through methods such as flashing, modification, and application cloning.
  • Ability to work across multiple mobile platforms simultaneously.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

DINING SUPERVISOR

OAKS AT PLEASANT GAP

FULL TIME

COMPETITIVE SALARY PLUS OTHER GREAT BENEFITS

The Oaks at Pleasant Gap, a personal care and independent living community, is actively seeking candidates for a Dining Supervisor. This position will coordinate, plan, and organize operation of the Dietary Department and prepare food to ensure that quality nutritional services are provided daily to our residents and the department is maintained in a clean, safe, and sanitary manner. This position will be 90% cooking and meal preparation and 10% administrative tasks to support the department.

Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate dietary services and activities with other related departments.
  • Develop and maintain written dietary policies and procedures.
  • Interpret the department’s policies and procedures to team members, residents, visitors, government agencies, etc., as necessary.
  • Perform administrative duties such as completing necessary forms, reports, evaluations, studies, etc.
  • Review the department’s policies, procedure manuals, job descriptions, etc., at least annually for revisions, and make recommendations to the Administrator.
  • Develop and maintain a file of tested standard recipes.
  • Make written and oral reports/recommendations to the Administrator as necessary/required concerning the operation of the dietary department.
  • Inspect food storage rooms, utility/janitorial closets, etc., to assure they meet all required regulatory guidelines and supply control.
  • Review and assist in developing a plan of correction for dietary service deficiencies noted during survey inspections and provide a written copy of such to the Administrator.
  • Process diet changes and new diets as received from nursing services.
  • Develop, implement and maintain ongoing continuous quality improvement program for the dietary department.
  • Participate in surveys (inspections) made by authorized government agencies.
  • Interview residents or family members, as necessary, to obtain diet history, maintaining an adequate liaison with families and residents as necessary.
  • Assure that dietary progress notes charted are informative and descriptive of the services provided and of the resident’s response to the service.
  • Assure that menus are maintained and filed in accordance with established policies and procedures.
  • Visit residents periodically to evaluate the quality of meals served, likes and dislikes, etc., and maintain records of resident’s food likes and dislikes.
  • Assist in planning normal and special diet menus as prescribed by the attending physician as well as diet plans for individual residents.
  • Review therapeutic and regular diet plans/menus to assure they are in compliance with physician’s orders.
  • Assist in establishing a food service production line, etc., to assure that meals are prepared on time.
  • Serve on, participate in, and attend various committees of the facility.
  • Provide written and/or oral reports of the dietary service programs and activities as required or as may be directed by such committee(s) and evaluate and implement recommendations from established committees as they may pertain to dietary services.
  • Meet with dietary personnel, on a regularly scheduled basis, solicit advice from interdepartmental supervisors concerning the operation of the dietary department, assist in identifying and correcting problem areas, and/or the methods of improvement of services.
  • Insofar as practical, encourage residents to participate in the development and review of his/her plan of care.
  • Ensure that all dietary personnel are aware of the care plan and use them in planning daily dietary services for the resident.
  • Review nurses’ notes to determine if the care plan is being followed.
  • Develop and maintain a good rapport with all services involved with the care plan to ensure that a team effort is achieved in developing a comprehensive plan of care.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of an Associate’s degree preferred; will consider applicable work experience.
  • Certified Dietary Manager in PA, a graduate of an accredited course in dietetic training approved by the American Dietetic Association or eligible for certification by the Dietary Managers Association.

title: AI Lead Developer i Stockholm
description:
{"lang": "en","role": ["AI"],"country": ["Sweden"], "image": "https://www.solita.fi/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Open-positions-24-6.jpg","intro": "Som Lead AI Developer kommer du in i ett skede där vi satsar på att skala upp vårt område inom AI, Cloud och modern systemutveckling. Vi tror på och vill förverkliga en AI- och datadriven framtid. Lead AI Developer till Solita

Du blir en del av ett växande område med runt 25 lättsamma och engagerade konsulter inom Cloud, AI och systemutveckling. Samtidigt får du kollegor från hela Solita med expertis inom allt från data och strategi till design och förändringsledning – människor att dela kunskap, perspektiv och idéer med!

En dag på Solita

En dag på Solita kan börja med ett standup-möte tillsammans med teamet i ditt kunduppdrag, ibland även med fler Solita-kollegor. På fredagar kanske du jobbar från vårt kontor i Stockholm och inleder dagen med gemensam frukost. Andra dagar sitter du hos kund eller arbetar hemifrån.

Under arbetsdagen växlar du mellan fokusarbete, samarbete och kunskapsutbyte. När du stöter på en utmaning kanske du hittar värdefulla insikter i en Slack-tråd där kollegor redan har diskuterat något liknande. Andra gånger får du nya perspektiv i ett spontant samtal med en kollega. Du har också möjlighet att delta i interna kompetensdelningar där vi pratar om allt från nya tekniker och arbetssätt till välmående. Ibland rundas dagen av med AW, filmkväll, brädspel eller någon annan aktivitet tillsammans med kollegor.

Din roll som Lead AI Developer

I rollen som Lead AI Developer utformar och leder du utvecklingen av robusta, skalbara och säkra AI-lösningar hos organisationer i olika branscher. Det gör du genom tekniskt utvecklings- och designarbete, coachning av utvecklare och nära dialog med verksamheten. Samtidigt identifierar och driver du förbättringar i hur AI-lösningar designas, utvärderas, produktionssätts och förvaltas.

Du arbetar ofta genom hela utvecklingscykeln – från tidiga dialoger, förstudier och pre-sales till implementation, produktionssättning och vidareutveckling. Du hjälper kunder att förstå vad som är rätt AI-lösning för deras behov, och vägleder team i hur lösningarna byggs på ett sätt som är hållbart över tid.

Du kan exempelvis arbeta med att:

  • Utforma och leda implementation av RAG-arkitektur och agentbaserade lösningar
  • Utveckla AI-agenter, MCP-servrar, API:er och backendlösningar
  • Integrera befintliga system med LLM-tjänster
  • Driva tekniska vägval kring promptdesign, utvärdering, säkerhet och skalbarhet
  • Produktionssätta AI-lösningar med stöd av DevSecOps och IaC
  • Stötta kunder i workshops, förstudier och tidiga initiativ
  • Bidra i pre-sales och i utvecklingen av vårt AI-erbjudande

För oss är teknikagnostiska och moderna lösningar normen. Problemet styr teknikvalen, inte tvärtom. Det innebär att du får stor frihet att forma arkitektur, teknikval och arbetssätt utifrån kundens behov och kontext.

Utöver moderna systemutvecklingstekniker arbetar du med olika AI-verktyg och ramverk, till exempel Semantic Kernel, LangChain, TensorFlow, AI Foundry eller liknande. Vi ser AI som en självklar del av modern utveckling, och vi tror att du vill vara med och driva den utvecklingen tillsammans med oss.

Känner du igen dig i följande?

Du kan kommunicera på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Det är ett plus om du har arbetat som konsult tidigare, men det viktigaste är att du snabbt kan sätta dig in i nya sammanhang, förstå vad som behövs och omsätta det i hållbara tekniska lösningar.

Tack vare flera års erfarenhet av att bygga moderna lösningar genom hela utvecklingscykeln – gärna i C#/.NET, Python eller Java/Spring Boot – känner du dig trygg i rollen. Vi tror också att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:

  • RAG-arkitektur eller AI-agentarkitektur
  • Clean Code, TDD och DDD
  • Att bygga AI-drivna applikationer med moderna ramverk som Semantic Kernel, LangChain eller liknande
  • Att implementera molnbaserade AI-tjänster
  • Att produktionssätta lösningar med hjälp av DevSecOps, CI/CD och Infrastructure as Code
  • Att göra tekniska vägval och skapa riktning i utvecklingsteam
  • Att arbeta nära kund och verksamhet i komplexa sammanhang

Vi letar inte bara efter tekniska skills. Vi vill jobba med dig som tar ansvar för att bygga rätt lösningar på rätt sätt genom att utmana med omtanke. Du ser kod som ett hantverk, inte bara ett medel till funktion: du bryr dig om kvalitet, läsbarhet och hållbarhet. Du kommer trivas hos oss om du tycker om att dela med dig av din kunskap lika mycket som du är nyfiken på och lyfter andras.

Vad vi erbjuder

Vår företagskultur är väldigt viktig för oss. Vi värdesätter låg hierarki, självständighet och ansvar, värdeskapande arbete och trevliga kollegor.

  • Meningsfulla projekt: Arbeta i en agil miljö där du kan påverka teknikval och arbetssätt för att skapa de bästa lösningarna
  • Flexibilitet och autonomi för att utforma ditt arbete med flextid
  • Ständig utveckling: Vi erbjuder kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling för att säkerställa att våra medarbetare ligger längst fram i teknikutvecklingen
  • Innovativ kultur: Arbeta tillsammans med några av de främsta experterna inom data, analys och utveckling

Utöver detta får du även ta del av följande förmåner:

💰 Fast lön oberoende av beläggningsgrad med möjlighet till löneväxling till ditt pensionssparande
🏦 Pensionsavsättning i linje med ITP1 samt möjlighet till löneväxling till ditt pensionssparande vid inkomst över 8,07 inkomstbasbelopp
🏖️ 30 semesterdagar
😃 Sjukvårdsförsäkring för både din mentala och fysiska hälsa som täcker dig även utanför tjänstetid
🏋️‍♀️ Friskvårdsbidrag på 5000 kr via Benifex
💻 Ett brett nätverk av erfarna specialister från olika områden inom tech att samarbeta med
🔗 Intern coach för att stödja ditt välbefinnande
🪩 After Work och hobbyaktiviteter
🥐 Fredagsfrukost

Vilka är vi?

Solita är ett värderingsstyrt konsultbolag med över 2000 medarbetare i 9 länder, varav cirka 240 i Sverige. Vår storlek gör oss tillräckligt stora för att vara en stabil och innovativ arbetsgivare, men samtidigt tillräckligt små för att värna om våra medarbetare och kunder. Med bred kompetens inom digital transformation erbjuder vi en dynamisk arbetsmiljö. Hos oss får du friheten att utvecklas, både professionellt och personligt.

Intresserad av att höra mer?

Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av vårt team som ligger i framkant inom AI-utveckling.

Om du har några frågor, skriv gärna till Jacob Beck på LinkedIn eller mailadressen jacob.beck@solita.se.

Hur ser processen ut?

I rekryteringsprocessen tror vi på en snabb och effektiv process. Du ansöker med CV eller LinkedIn och svarar på några korta frågor. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande. Om vi ser en potentiell matchning bjuder vi in dig till ett första möte för att lära känna dig och berätta mer om vår kultur och våra värderingar på Solita. I andra intervjun fokuserar vi på din tekniska kompetens och din erfarenhet. Om allt går bra tar vi oss vidare till sista steget där vi presenterar ett erbjudande och välkomnar dig som ny Solitan!

title: Behavior Specialist of First Five
description:
Salary: $33.73/hr

Do you envision working for a dynamic, mission-driven organization which supports the community while fostering an employee culture of appreciation and fun? If your answer is yes, then an employment opportunity at Directions for Living may be a great fit for you! We offer an excellent salary and benefits package for all full-time employees, PTO and paid company holidays, 403b retirement, EAP, and year-round employee wellness and appreciation initiatives.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The First Five program will provide trauma-informed care to support children and families by strengthening and enhancing services in early learning centers. First Five has an overarching goal of helping early learning center teachers create a trauma-informed culture in their classrooms. Through classroom observation, First Five identifies children needing behavioral support. There are two pathways of service depending on the level of complexity and risk of expulsion that a child is experiencing.

This is a professional position providing intensive Behavior management. This position works in a team approach to decrease the number of children entering into a higher level of care due to their behaviors or to reduce the number of children that are unsuccessful in a classroom setting creating an educational set back whether that be as a result of an out of home placement or family instability concern related to the child experiencing an educational delays due to a lack of resources or support by utilizing a solution-focused, family centered approach and evidenced based practices to assist families in meeting needs and goals while preventing further incidents of abuse, neglect and abandonment. The Behavior Specialist will work with the other members of the team to provide a supportive, empowering and respectful relationship with families to facilitate change and emphasize the need to take action by providing both concrete services and family interventions. Requirements of this position include assessing, linking, coordinating and monitoring services from mental health, social and educational aspects, and providing those services within the home or in the community. The intensive Behavior Specialist will be an active participant at the Integrated Decision Team process and will provide face to face visits with the family according the frequency required in order to mitigate risk. This position is required to complete entries into the agency electronic health record. DFL prides itself on the fact that it is a trauma informed care services provider. This position requires a Behavioral Health Certification through the Florida Certification Board (FCB) within 6 months of hire. Hours are flexible, evening and weekend work is required. This position will work closely with members of the First Five team such as: Counselor, IDT facilitator, and Supervisor in collaboration with other community service providers externally to provide complete comprehensive services. Responsible to meet productivity requirements of 112 billable hours monthly. This is a field-based position.

Directions for Living is an essential services provider. All Directions for Living Team Members must be willing and able to provide vital support and essential services to the people that we serve in the event of an emergency, pandemic or other disaster situation.

Job Title: Quality Improvement Coordinator (Aledade Specialization)

Department: Medical

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Reports To: Quality Improvement Manager

Hours: Monday-Friday 8:00am to 5:00pm

Location: Redding

POSITION SUMMARY


The Quality Improvement Coordinator supports organization-wide efforts to improve patient outcomes, reduce avoidable costs, strengthen patient and care-team experience, and meet clinical, operational, grant, and value-based care requirements. The coordinator uses data analysis, structured improvement methods, workflow development, staff education, patient outreach, and cross-department collaboration to move improvement priorities from planning through sustained implementation.

This is a general Quality Improvement position with a primary specialization in the Aledade program. The coordinator serves as the day-to-day resource for assigned Aledade dashboards, quality measures, worklists, outreach workflows, data validation, performance monitoring, meetings, and issue escalation. Other projects may be assigned based on the Quality Improvement Plan and organizational priorities.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Quality Improvement and Project Coordination

  • Coordinate improvement initiatives aligned with the Quality Improvement Plan, strategic priorities, financially incentivized measures, grant requirements, and other assigned projects.
  • Develop workplans, track milestones and assigned actions, maintain organized project records, address barriers with project partners, and escalate significant risks or delays.
  • Collaborate with clinical, operational, and administrative teams to define problems, conduct root-cause analysis, test solutions, improve workflows, and monitor results.
  • Develop and maintain procedures, workflows, job aids, training materials, and staff communications that support consistent implementation and sustained improvement.

Data, Reporting, and Performance Improvement

  • Collect, validate, analyze, and interpret clinical and operational data to identify trends, care gaps, outliers, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare accurate and timely reports, presentations, summaries, and action lists for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Validate information across the electronic health record, Aledade, and other approved systems; document known data limitations or timing differences and escalate unresolved discrepancies.

Aledade and Value-Based Care

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day coordinator and internal resource for assigned Aledade tools, workflows, measures, training, meetings, and support needs.
  • Review Aledade dashboards, HEDIS and other quality-measure specifications, care-gap reports, prioritized worklists, and high-risk or high-acuity patient lists. Monitor performance against established targets and identify areas requiring focused intervention.
  • Maintain the Aledade program calendar, measure and report dictionary, workflow documentation, contact list, issue log, and current action plan. Ensure critical processes have documented primary and backup owners.
  • Coordinate care-gap and patient-outreach activities by identifying patients for follow-up, distributing work, monitoring completion, and confirming required documentation is entered in the appropriate system.
  • Within approved protocols, contact patients to obtain non-diagnostic information, provide basic education or self-management support, respond professionally to concerns, and connect patients with appropriate clinical or supportive services.

  • Participate in meetings and ongoing education, travel between clinic locations as needed, maintain accurate and confidential documentation, and perform other related duties as assigned.


QUALIFICATIONS


Education and Experience

  • Three or more years of quality improvement or healthcare-related experience preferred.
  • Associate or bachelor’s degree in healthcare, public health, health administration, or a related field preferred. A relevant combination of education and experience may be considered.
  • Familiarity with HEDIS/UDS measures, specifications, and reporting requirements.
  • Experience with Aledade or similar value-based care, accountable care, population health, or quality platform preferred.
  • Experience using an electronic health record or comparable clinical information system.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proficiency in data analysis, Microsoft Excel, and quality improvement methodologies.
  • Knowledge of Medicare, Blue Shield, Anthem payer requirements, and quality improvement metrics.
  • Ability to prepare clear reports, charts, presentations, procedures, workflows, and training materials.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, interpersonal, and patient-centered service skills.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, follow-through, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines while working independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, internet browsers, and virtual meeting tools, with the ability to learn new systems and complete required program training.
  • Ability to travel between Hill Country Community Clinic locations as required.


PERFORMANCE AND COMPLIANCE EXPECTATIONS

  • Produce accurate, timely, and reproducible reports, worklists, documentation, meeting materials, and follow-up actions.
  • Maintain clear owners, workflows, milestones, risks, and current action plans for assigned measures and projects.
  • Investigate, document, and escalate data discrepancies, barriers, delays, or errors through the appropriate path without avoidable delay.
  • Follow approved patient-outreach workflows, privacy requirements, documentation standards, clinical escalation boundaries, and applicable laws and organizational policies.
  • Protect the confidentiality of patient, employee, and organizational information.
  • Demonstrate professionalism, flexibility, respect, accountability, responsible use of organizational resources, and reliable follow-through.


WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS


Work is primarily performed in indoor office and health clinic settings near normal office activity, medical equipment, computers, telephones, and printers. Noise levels are generally moderate.

The employee regularly communicates and listens, frequently uses hands to operate a computer and handle objects, and may sit, stand, walk, reach, bend, kneel, crouch, climb, or balance. The employee regularly lifts or moves up to 10 pounds and occasionally up to 25 pounds. The position requires close and distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.
