About the Organization:

Children of Promise, NYC’s (CPNYC) reimagines a just society that values the purpose of every child impacted by mass incarceration and removes barriers to create opportunities for children to thrive and achieve their full potential. CPNYC’s mission is to support and advocate for the children of incarcerated parents while speaking out against root causes that affect the communities we serve, including systemic racism, poverty. and bias in our nation’s criminal justice system.

CPNYC has successfully developed an innovative model, the only one of its kind in New York City, which co-locates a licensed mental health clinic and children's centers in Bedford Stuyvesant, Brooklyn, and the South Bronx. Under the supervision of the Director of Programs the Educational Specialist will work as the liaison between Children of Promise, NYC, and the network of schools. The Education Specialist will also identify suitable curricula to help program staff create activity plans which incorporate lesson plans that strengthen basic literacy, numeracy skills and stimulate interest in Science, Technology, Engineering and Math (STEM) subjects.

Source, develop, implement, and adjust curriculum and educational systems appropriate to current climate; ensure that structured lesson plans are aligned with NYS and NYC learning standards
  • Manage and conduct staff meetings/trainings that reinforce classroom management expectations and CPNYC policies with the goal of developing each counselor we have on staff

title: Behavior Specialist - Tuolumne
description:
We want YOU to join the TUCCi team!

  • Do you have a passion to make a difference in children and/or adults with special needs?
  • Are you in psychology, healthcare, education, child development or a related field?
  • Do you want to build a rewarding career helping others?
  • Are you looking for a fun and fulfilling job with a strong support system and competitive pay?

Who we are!

Tucci Learning Solutions is a vibrant and growing ABA organization with deep roots in the Central Coast of California and branches in several California counties. TUCCi was founded by Vicci Tucci, a pioneering BCBA, who witnessed the maltreatment of patients when growing up across the street from a state hospital in the 1970s. This formed her life goal to create a non-coercive model of Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) called the Competent Learner Model (CLM), which has been developed over the past 40 years.

This evidence-based, peer-reviewed curriculum is designed to be easily accessible to parents, educators, and clinicians. The CLM provides a framework for Behavior Analysts to develop successful skill acquisition and behavior replacement programs to improve quality of life for our learners and for them to gain increased access to their community, school, and home lives. TUCCi team members benefit from the richness of our history and our commitment to be on the cutting edge of Applied Behavior Analysis implementation.

About the position:

As a Behavior Technician, you will work directly with a supervisor and Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA). You will deliver behavioral therapy to individuals with Autism and related developmental needs working in both home and/or school settings. Skills worked on will include: communication, social skills, academics, play development, behavior management and self help skills. TUCCi sets themselves apart from other companies by maximizing supervision to ensure teams are getting the support they need and so that clients can make rapid progress.

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive pay based on experience and qualifications
  • Paid travel time and mileage
  • Health Benefits for full time employees
  • Cell-phone stipend
  • Retirement - Employee Stock Ownership Plan/401K opportunity

  • No-Cost supervision for Behavior Technicians/RBT enrolled in a BCBA or BCaBA school program
  • No-Cost Employee Assistance Program (EAP) - financial, personal, legal and family support
  • Training and advancement opportunities to RBT, CLM Coach, Lead Behavior Technician, Behavior Analyst in Training, and Behavior Analyst.
  • Raise opportunities based on completion of CLM Course of Study, performance, furthered education, and promotions.
  • Opportunities to participate in conferences and research.



What is your role?

  • Work with learners implementing behavioral and instructional ABA based programs as designed by the BCBA in a school, home or community setting.
  • Collect data as directed by your team's BCBA.
  • Follow behavior and skill acquisition plans in a playful yet professional manner as directed by your team’s BCBA.
  • Promote client dignity and safety at all times.
  • Communicate effectively with team members in an acceptable time frame.
  • Attend regular team meetings and CLM coaching sessions.
  • Drive self to multiple work sites during the work day.
  • Exemplifies the desired culture and philosophies of the organization.
  • Commitment to following company policies, maintain client confidentiality, and adhere to HIPPA laws as well as the Ethics Code for Behavior Analysts/RBTs.

What’s needed from you?

  • Must have a desire to work with individuals with Autism or other developmental needs.
  • Positive attitude and kindness towards team members and clients.
  • [Preferred] Experience working with children and /or adults in the school, home and/or community settings.
  • [Minimum] High School diploma and background check
  • [Preferred] Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Education, or related field
  • [Preferred] Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) in good standing or willing to complete RBT certification within one year of employment.

  • Demonstrates initiative, creativity and flexibility with individuals and how the learning environments are arranged and rearranged.

title: Robotic Arc Welding Technician
description:
EWI is a world leader in developing and deploying new technologies that enable companies to bridge the gap between R&D and manufacturing implementation. EWI associates are passionate about identifying options to technical problems that provide a long-term competitive advantage for our clients. Our clients tell us we are a valuable extension and complement to their innovation, engineering, and manufacturing teams. If you enjoy working with customers, solving difficult technical problems, and developing and applying advanced technology; EWI is the place for you.

EWI has provided high end research and development services to commercial and government clients for over 35 years as a not-for-profit contract research laboratory with a focus on joining and related technologies. EWI’s Arc Welding and Directed Energy Deposition (DED) Processes Group is a world leader in arc welding processes and is building a range of new capabilities to advance robotic arc welding and robotic DED additive manufacturing and repair.

The Robotic Arc Welding Technician supports research and development projects that focus on arc welding processes. They work with EWI’s state-of-the-art industrial arc welding / DED robots and world class engineers to execute project work and tasks for customers that relate to advanced arc welding and arc DED additive manufacturing (AM). They also provide manual welding expertise where needed and cross-train in other lab-related areas where possible.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Apply knowledge and demonstrated expertise in the execution of tasks/duties related to robotic arc welding equipment, programming of mechanized equipment, and manual welding processes
  • Prepare, program, and operate industrial robots and setup equipment and/or components to the exact specifications of project requirements and/or customer’s needs
  • Perform tasks in support of application development and research projects
  • Support engineers and project managers in project planning processes by identifying and estimating level-of-effort required for proposed projects
  • Occasionally interact directly with customer through demonstrations, presentations, or clarifying reports as they relate to assigned projects. May also travel to client locations when appropriate
  • Utilize and effectively program CAD tools (or other skills) to create prototype tools required for project completion
  • Assemble or otherwise produce designed tools, fixtures, and enhancements
  • Continuously develop and apply depth of knowledge in automated arc welding processes
  • Maintain accurate and legible records of project work and test results
  • Support equipment preventative maintenance schedule and calibration efforts as needed
  • Achieve and strive for highest quality standards in work
  • Continuously meet and occasionally exceed (where necessary) production schedules and customer expectations and needs
  • Achieve established work-area cleanliness standards and maintain a high-degree of organization in work area(s); follow and support 5S program efforts
  • Perform work in a safe manner and adhere to safety programs, processes, and procedures set forth for the specific process and for company safety programs

title: Mid-level Motion Designer
location: Cape Town, WC, South Africa; Johannesburg, South Africa
description:
Ogilvy Social Lab, part of WPP, is setting global benchmarks in digital marketing and is driven by offering our expertise to both local and international clients through a multi-market footprint.

We have enabled 'borderless ways of working', operating as connected teams and providing Creative, Content, Media and Intelligence capabilities to Ogilvy agencies and clients in more than 20 countries.

Join our globally connected team and work on challenging projects that transcend borders. Embrace a career that takes you to new horizons and make a global impact!

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit .

Hey there, superstar! We're on the hunt for a Mid-level Motion Designer/Editor extraordinaire who's ready to jump into the action-packed world of marketing and advertising with our rockstar clients. Join our Social Labs team, where you'll be the creative maestro behind engaging content for iconic global brands. Get ready to rock with our amazing Creative Leads and make some serious waves in high-profile campaigns that'll leave everyone talking!

About you

You're not just a Motion Designer/Editor – you're a creative dynamo! Your job? Crafting mind-blowing motion design content that's as unforgettable as your favourite song's chorus. You'll be a key player in our team of 6 to 7 boundary-pushers, bringing top-notch skills and an infectious energy to every project.

Your mission? Creating tailor-made video content for epic paid media campaigns across digital playgrounds.

Already a wizard with Celtra? Awesome. If not, bring your passion to learn and your mastery of After Effects and Premier to the table. Got an analytical mind that sparks during visual prototyping? High-five! If you're a motion design aficionado, detail-obsessed, and ready to rock in a fun, collaborative vibe, then let's chat. Join us and make motion design history with a team that thrives on big ideas and even bigger enthusiasm! 🚀

Responsibilities

  • Work closely with the team to create captivating motion design content for our global brands.
  • Use standard software (Adobe After Effects and Premier) to make top-quality motion design videos.
  • Edit TV campaigns for seamless transitions and brand consistency.
  • Create video content for paid media campaigns, adapting to digital formats.
  • Play a role in major campaigns
  • Adopt modular creative strategies to tailor content for different audiences.
  • Integrate diverse content sources to ensure a cohesive end product.
  • Learn and utilize the Celtra platform for content development if needed.
  • Infuse energy and creativity into projects, pushing boundaries for exceptional work.
  • Analyse visual prototypes, providing valuable insights to enhance motion design.
  • Collaborate with creative leads to bring their ideas to life.
  • Meet deadlines with meticulous attention to detail, sticking to brand guidelines.
  • Stay updated on motion design trends to deliver cutting-edge work.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders to ensure project clarity.
  • Contribute to the agency's success and the brand, exceeding client expectations globally.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Demonstrated track record in motion design and editing at creative agencies or similar settings, with a robust portfolio of visually captivating projects.
  • Proficiency in industry-standard software like Adobe After Effects and Premier, understanding motion design principles, animation techniques, and visual storytelling.
  • Skilled in editing video content, ensuring smooth transitions, pacing, and overall cohesion. Strong knowledge of video editing software is essential.
  • Past work with prominent brands, preferably in consumer goods. Familiarity with brands in the beauty industry is a plus.
  • Proficient in crafting content optimized for digital and social media platforms, knowing platform-specific requirements and best practices.
  • Keen eye for detail, strong artistic sensibility, infusing projects with energy, creativity, and a unique visual style.
  • Effective team player, working closely with Creative Leads, designers, and stakeholders to bring ideas to life and deliver outstanding work.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, prioritizing tasks to meet project timelines while maintaining keen attention to detail.
  • Willingness to adjust to changing project needs, handling multiple tasks simultaneously, thriving in a fast-paced environment.
  • Skilled in additional relevant software like Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, enhancing workflow and delivering high-quality results.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, effectively expressing ideas, providing feedback, and collaborating with team members and clients.
  • Proactive and resourceful problem-solving approach, finding innovative solutions and overcoming challenges during the creative process.
  • Solid understanding of brand guidelines, working within established brand identities for consistency across motion design deliverables.
  • Stay up to date with latest trends, techniques, and emerging technologies in motion design and video editing, continuously seeking growth opportunities.
  • Ability to analyse visual prototypes, provide valuable insights, and make data-driven decisions for optimized impact and effectiveness.
  • Growth mindset and eagerness to learn new tools, techniques, and software as required by the role.

Offer

  • Full-time job within a growing and trendsetting agency
  • Global client portfolio
  • Attractive package and benefits
  • Continuous trainings. Career conversation and growing opportunities
  • Flexible homeworking policy

If you're passionate about motion design, and someone who possess an impeccable eye for detail, and thrive in a collaborative and fast-paced environment, we can't wait to hear from you. Together, let's bring exceptional motion design to life and surpass expectations every step of the way!

title: 2027 Hiring Pool - Operational Excellence & Automation - Project Management, Customer Experience Group (Based in Bangkok, Thailand | Relocation Provided)
description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:
The Customer Experience Group (CEG) of Agoda effectively serves our customers and partners to ensure satisfying results. This great task is accomplished with the support of our Global Service Verticals (GSV) team. We serve as the backbone for CEG’s global operations. Our team is comprised of project managers, process owners, analysts, and talent management. Together we work nonstop to improve the quality and efficiency of our customer and partner support processes.

We are a very data-driven environment, eager to move fast and learn through experimentation. A clear focus on supporting our customers and partners is bolstered by a strong, entrepreneurial culture that enriches us and Agoda’s business performance.

This role is within the Operational Excellence and Automation team, which is a part of CEG’s Global Service Verticals. The team focuses on driving end‑to‑end customer experience and process improvements, and scaling impact through automation, AI, and tooling across both customer-facing and agent-facing journeys.

Think your experience could be a great fit for Agoda?
If you're passionate about project or program management and excited by the possibility of building your career with Agoda, we'd love to hear from you—even if your experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement listed for this role.

Please note that this application will be considered for our 2027 hiring cycle.

By sharing your profile, you may be considered for future opportunities that better match your skills and aspirations. We'll keep your application in our talent pool and reach out if a relevant role becomes available.

Your next opportunity could be closer than you think—stay connected with Agoda!

The Opportunity:
This role is responsible for leading a portfolio of global operational excellence and automation initiatives in the Customer Experience Group (CEG), with a focus on:

(i) automation, AI, and tooling to enhance customer and agent experience, and

(ii) process optimization and CX improvements across the post‑booking customer journey.

You will lead a high‑performing team of project managers/experts to drive measurable impact on customer satisfaction, efficiency, quality, and cost. The role combines strategic problem solving, hands‑on data-driven execution, and strong stakeholder management with both technical (Product/Tech/Data) and non‑technical (Operations/Support/Commercial) teams.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

Lead and Own a Portfolio of Transformational Initiatives

  • Own from end‑to‑end a collection of projects and/or areas of business in CEG (global coverage), spanning automation/AI and process excellence initiatives.
  • Prioritize, plan, and drive initiatives that improve mission‑critical metrics: customer satisfaction (e.g., CSAT), service levels, automation quality, productivity, cost efficiency, and employee/agent engagement.
  • Ensure CEG readiness to support Agoda’s new business and product initiatives by working closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing, Strategic Partnerships, Partner Services, Finance, Legal, and other CEG teams.

Drive Automation & AI driven solutions

  • Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and tooling across customer and agent journeys (e.g., self‑service, workflow automation, AI quality testing).
  • Partner with Product Management / Technology / CEG teams to design, prioritize, and implement solutions, from experimentation and configuration through to global rollout and impact measurement.
  • Oversee the configuration and governance of operational flows and low‑code/automation tools, ensuring solutions are robust, scalable, and aligned with business goals and CX standards.

Shape End‑to‑End Customer & Process Improvements

  • Continuously improve CEG end‑to‑end processes across the post‑booking journey to remove pain points, and improve operational performance through targeted initiatives and data driven insights.
  • Own and evolve frameworks and roadmaps for how we continuously improve our internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and related processes; balancing CX/PX outcomes vs. efficiency/cost.
  • Drive strategic initiatives across CEG such as improving Localization support in key growth markets, regulatory initiatives and partner closely with our commercial teams in order to improve partner/supplier pain points.
  • Define clear problem statements and build business cases to define and prioritize customer/partner pain points and success metrics.

Lead and Develop a High‑Performing Team

  • Set long‑term vision, strategy, and annual/quarterly OKRs for your team, aligning with CEG and Agoda-wide priorities.
  • Manage and coach a team of project managers (and potentially people managers), building talent, capability, and succession within the Operational Excellence and Automation team.
  • Provide structured feedback, mentoring, and support to enable your team’s growth and to consistently raise the bar for quality and impact.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior leaders and stakeholders across CEG and other functions, effectively influencing priorities and decisions.
  • Monitor project milestones, identify risks and dependencies, troubleshoot issues, and implement mitigation plans—acting at all times as the ultimate owner of the portfolio’s outcomes.

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

Experience & Background

  • Freshers until 8+ years of experience in project/program management, operations, customer experience, process improvement, strategy, management consulting, or similar fields.
  • Significant people leadership experience, including building and managing high‑performing teams (ideally including people managers and individual contributors).
  • Proven track record of leading complex, cross‑functional initiatives from idea to implementation, with clear, measurable business impact.
  • Experience working closely with Product/Technology/Data teams on technical or automation/AI-focused projects is highly advantageous.

Technical & Analytical Skills

  • Strong analytical mindset; comfortable with numbers and quantitative problem solving. Able to define analysis structures, interpret data, challenge existing metrics, and make recommendations.
  • Familiarity with data and analytics tools (e.g., SQL, Tableau, Metabase, VBA, or similar) and experience leveraging them to drive decisions.
  • Comfort working with or overseeing workflow / automation / agent guidance tools, and the ability to engage in technical discussions with Product/Engineering/Data teams. Coding ability is a plus (you have to be willing to learn)
  • Exposure to AI/ML‑driven solutions in an operational or CX context (e.g., chatbots, recommendation engines, routing, classification, or decision support tools) is a strong plus.

CX, Process, and Delivery Skills

  • Demonstrated experience in process improvement and CX transformation, ideally in operations or customer support environments.
  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives in parallel, structure complex problems, and orchestrate cross‑functional teams.
  • Experience defining and driving improvements in KPIs such as CSAT, NPS, SLAs, handle time, productivity, or cost‑to‑serve.

Leadership, Communication & Ways of Working

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, dynamic, multicultural environment, comfortable with ambiguity and experimentation in a high‑velocity setting.
  • A growth mindset and positive attitude: proactive, hands‑on, detail‑oriented, and with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Eagerness to pitch new ideas, take initiative, and seek out opportunities for improvement; comfortable giving and receiving feedback.
  • Professional experience with Microsoft Office tools (e.g., Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Experience with collaboration and project tracking tools is a plus.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation package (relocation support and visa support provided for successful overseas candidates)
  • Exciting, high‑impact career opportunity with a major global OTA, including potential moves between teams and global locations. You will interact with departmental senior leadership regularly.
  • Dynamic, multinational tech environment with colleagues from diverse educational and professional backgrounds.
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities through corporate learning programs.
  • Modern office space and convenient location at the heart of Bangkok Metropolitan, Hub of Asia.

Please note that we may not be able to provide an immediate response or follow up on every application.

Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click here to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.

Discover more about working at Agoda

  • Facebook
  • LinkedIn
  • YouTube

At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. title: Drivers
description:
Job Title: Driver
Location: (01) Kabarole / (01) Mbale / (01) Kabale
Reports to: Logistics Officer

Application Deadline: 10th September 2026

Project Background

The Sustaining Gains & Continuing Services for Smallholder Farmers (SGCF) Project is designed as a 12-month consolidation initiative that brings together selected results, relationships and delivery structures established under CG and BRIGHT into one focused project implemented by GOAL Uganda in partnership with Agriterra. The project will ensure continuity of support to smallholder farmers, FOs, cooperatives and other local actors across the 14 districts of Elgon, Rwenzori and Kigezi, while working closely with district local governments, private sector partners, financial service providers and implementing partners up to August 2027. The project will build on good practices, networks, community and household / farmer-led planning processes developed by CG and BRIGHT. The SGCF Project will focus on preserving gains already made, sustaining critical services, consolidating relationships with farmers and institutions, and generating practical learning for the next EKN programme design.

Job summary

The Driver supports the project with all transport-related duties including transporting staff to specified project destinations, collecting and delivering various organization packages, maintaining the vehicle in a clean and good mechanical condition.

Job Functions

  • Drive the GOAL vehicle and authorized passengers to specified destinations as approved by the supervisor, and in line with GOAL transport management policy
  • Assist with loading and offloading of staff luggage, organization items and materials
  • Keep the assigned vehicle in a clean condition at all times by regular washing and cleaning
  • Maintain an updated logbook for all journey to record travel-time, locations, and fuel top-ups, etc.
  • Maintain the vehicle in a proper working condition to ensure safety and comfort of passengers by; performing routine physical inspections to monitor its safety and security, ensuring planned service, repair, and maintenance schedules are adhered to, reporting any accidents, injuries, and vehicle damage to the supervisor.
  • Promptly inform the supervisor if/when road misuse tickets are issued by the Uganda Police/ road traffic other authorities
  • Ensure the assigned vehicle is always parked in permissible parking spaces to avoid risks of towing
  • Fulfill other duties such as running office related errands as instructed by supervisor

Job Level Specifications

Essential Criteria

  • Minimum UCE qualification with basic knowledge of English (spoken and written) and other relevant local languages
  • 3 years relevant work experience with NGO or CSO
  • A valid driver’s license and clean driving record
  • Working knowledge of local roads and routes

Desirable Criteria

  • High integrity
  • Hospitable
  • Accountability
  • Confidentiality
  • Good communication skills
  • Good interpersonal skills
  • Sound knowledge of road safety regulations
  • Ability to utilize maps, GPS systems, and car manuals
  • Punctual and reliable

General Terms and Conditions

At GOAL we welcome people of all abilities and want to ensure that our hiring and interview process meets the needs of all applicants. If you require a reasonable accommodation to make your application or interview experience a great one, please just contact our Recruitment Team at recruitment@ug.goal.ie

GOAL Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion:
GOAL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees. We foster an inclusive culture where all voices are heard and valued. We know that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.

All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling GOAL’s commitment to equal employment opportunity and equal treatment. GOAL does not discriminate against any employee on the basis of sex, race, color, ethnic background, tribe, birth, creed or religion or social or economic standing, political opinion, disability.

Code of Conduct and Accountability within GOAL

GOAL is an equal opportunities employer and has values and behaviours framework which defines our code of conduct. Any candidate offered a job with GOAL will be expected to adhere to the following key areas of accountability.

  • Comply with GOAL’s policies and procedures with respect to safeguarding, Code of Conduct, health and safety, data protection and confidentiality, do no harm principles and unacceptable behaviour protocols.
  • Report any concerns about the welfare of a child or vulnerable adult or any wrongdoings within our programming area.
  • Report any concerns about inappropriate behaviour of a GOAL staff or partner.

Safeguarding

Children and vulnerable adults a must be safeguarded to the maximum extent from deliberate or inadvertent actions and failings that place them at risk of abuse, sexual exploitation, injury, and any other harm. One of the ways that GOAL shows this on-going commitment to safeguarding is to include rigorous background and reference checks in the selection process for all candidates.

GOAL

Established in 1977, GOAL is an international humanitarian agency and works with the most vulnerable communities to help them respond to and overcome humanitarian crises, and to assist those facing poverty and exclusion achieve greater resilience and well-being. GOAL envisions a world beyond humanitarian crises where poverty no longer exists, where vulnerable communities exposed to shocks and stresses are resilient, where barriers to well-being are removed and where everyone has equal rights and opportunities.

General Description of the Country Programme

First operational in Uganda in 1979, the current GOAL Uganda country programme focuses on Health, (including WASH, Health Accountability and Nutrition); and a market-based systems approach to improving agricultural livelihoods and WASH. GOAL Uganda mainstreams gender, child protection, social behavior changes and resilience strategies across all programming. GOAL uses a mixture of direct implementation and partnerships with national and international civil society organizations, local government, the private sector and communities to give effect to our mission.

title: Facilities Technician 1
description:
Mustang Special Utility District (Mustang SUD) is Texas' most extensive Special Utility District, providing water and wastewater services across more than 220 square miles. With over 43,000 active connections in one of the fastest-growing regions in the U.S., Mustang SUD is committed to excellence in public service, living up to our motto: “Second to None—Providing Life’s Precious Resource.”

Position Summary

As a Facilities Technician I at Mustang Special Utility District, you will be responsible for performing various maintenance and repair tasks to ensure the optimal functionality and safety of the District’s facilities and equipment. This role involves conducting routine inspections, addressing repair needs, and supporting facility improvement projects. The Facilities Technician I plays a crucial part in maintaining a safe, clean, and efficient work environment, directly contributing to the district's overall operational effectiveness.

Essential Functions:

  • General Maintenance: Perform routine maintenance tasks, including plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and carpentry work, to ensure facilities are safe and operational.

  • Inspection and Troubleshooting: Regularly inspect facilities and equipment to identify issues and promptly perform necessary repairs. Utilize diagnostic tools to troubleshoot problems.

  • Preventative Maintenance: Implement preventative maintenance schedules for all building systems and equipment to minimize downtime and extend the lifespan of assets.

  • Ground Maintenance: Perform ground maintenance such as mowing, weed-eating, edging, blowing, pruning, planting, trimming, and sodding as needed.

  • Debris Removal: Clean, clear, and dispose of debris and refuse in trash bins and in the landscape from all properties.

  • Equipment Handling: Move cabinets, boxes, furniture, crates, and equipment either manually or by using hand trucks or forklifts.

  • Painting: Paint the interior and exterior of buildings as needed.

  • Facility Improvements: Assist in facility improvement projects, such as remodeling, upgrades, and new installations.

  • Coordination with Contractors: Work with and escort qualified contractors on or within the facilities. Ensure all work complies with safety and quality standards.

  • Safety and Compliance: Adhere to safety protocols and maintain a safe work environment. Participate in traffic control and set up traffic cones, barricades, and other devices as necessary.

title: Tactical Data Link Expert
description:
STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionizing the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop and manufacture high performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost effective. This provides our operators with a decisive edge in highly contested environments.
We’re focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems—not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe—today.

Support the development, integration, testing, and operational use of tactical data link capabilities for STARK’s unmanned systems, Ground Control Stations, and wider command-and-control environments. You will help ensure that our systems can communicate reliably and securely with military networks, command posts, allied platforms, and mission systems. A key part of the role is to evaluate, understand, and integrate tactical communication standards and technologies such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, and other military data link solutions. You will translate operational communication requirements into practical integration concepts, test setups, and deployable system configurations.

Tactical Data Link Integration: Support the integration of tactical data link capabilities such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, and other military communication systems into STARK platforms and Ground Control Station environments.

Interoperability Concepts: Define and support communication concepts that enable reliable data exchange between unmanned systems, GCS setups, command centers, allied platforms, and external mission systems.

Requirements Translation: Translate operational and military communication requirements into technical integration requirements, interface definitions, test needs, and subsystem-level implementation concepts.

System Interface Support: Work with engineering, software, network, RF, modem, antenna, and GCS teams to align interfaces, protocols, data flows, configuration requirements, and integration constraints.

SATCOM & Beyond-Line-of-Sight Support: Support concepts and integration activities for SATCOM, long-range communication paths, and other beyond-line-of-sight connectivity options.

Testing & Validation: Plan and support lab tests, field tests, interoperability checks, and validation activities for tactical data link and communication setups.

Security & Reliability: Contribute to secure, robust, and mission-ready communication architectures, considering availability, latency, data integrity, authentication, and operational constraints.

Supplier & Partner Coordination: Work with external suppliers, partners, military stakeholders, and internal teams to assess data link options, integration dependencies, and technical feasibility.

Documentation: Document data link concepts, interface assumptions, configuration settings, integration dependencies, test results, and recommended operational setups in a clear and maintainable way.

Experience: Around 5 years of professional experience in tactical communications, military data links, SATCOM, RF systems, communication engineering, systems engineering, or a related technical field.

Tactical Data Link Knowledge: Practical understanding of military data link technologies such as Link 16, Link 22, SATCOM, or comparable tactical communication systems.

Systems Understanding: Ability to understand complex communication architectures involving platforms, radios, antennas, modems, networks, command systems, software interfaces, and operational workflows.

Interoperability Mindset: Strong understanding of how different systems exchange data, how interfaces are defined, and how interoperability is tested and validated.

Technical Communication: Ability to translate between operational users, engineering teams, software developers, RF specialists, suppliers, and program stakeholders.

Testing & Documentation: Experience supporting technical tests, integration trials, validation activities, or operational demonstrations, including structured documentation of results and findings.

Problem-Solving Ability: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify communication issues, integration gaps, configuration problems, and practical solutions.

Communication: Solid English skills are required. German skills for technical communication, stakeholder alignment, and documentation are a plus.

Team Fit: Ability to work collaboratively in a small, cross-functional team and communicate clearly and reliably in fast-moving engineering environments.

Clearance: Ability to obtain appropriate security clearance required for the position.

Experience in defence, military communications, command-and-control systems, aerospace, naval systems, UAVs, or other mission-critical operational environments.

· Prior exposure to NATO communication standards, tactical networks, joint fires, air defence, command posts, or battlefield management systems.

· Experience with SATCOM terminals, tactical radios, MANET, IP-based tactical networks, or professional communication equipment.

· Experience integrating unmanned systems into wider military communication architectures.

· Understanding of network security, encryption concepts, authentication, routing, IP networking, and secure data exchange.

title: Mechanical Technician, Riverside EfW
description:
Cory is one of the UK’s leading waste management and recycling companies.

We operate the Riverside Energy from Waste facility, which comprises of Riverside 1 and 2 with five process lines and two steam turbine generators. Combined, they are one of the largest and most efficient EfW facilities in the UK, processing around 1.5 million tonnes of non-recyclable waste each year. Our future decarbonisation strategy is centred around creating a decarbonisation hub at Riverside using carbon capture solutions to decarbonise waste from local communities, reusing the energy extracted to power heat networks and provide baseload electricity.

We are currently recruiting for a Mechanical Technician based at our Riverside Energy from Waste facility.

Key Elements of the Role

The holder of this role will provide an important function that directly contributes to the daily working and smooth running of the Riverside EfW facility through various operational duties and responsibilities.

Als IJzerwerker / Monteur Tankcontainers werk je dagelijks aan het repareren, onderhouden en aanpassen van tankcontainers.   • Demonteren, monteren, opbouwen en aanpassen van tankcontainers;

  • Controleren van je werkzaamheden en zorgen voor een veilige, nette en kwalitatieve oplevering.

Wie zoeken wij?

  • Je hebt ervaring als ijzerwerker, constructiebankwerker, metaalbewerker, carrosseriebouwer of in een vergelijkbare technische functie;

  • Je hebt technisch inzicht en kunt goed werken met handgereedschap en machines voor metaalbewerking;

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, praktisch en hebt oog voor kwaliteit en veiligheid;

  • Je bent collegiaal, zelfstandig en denkt oplossingsgericht;

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal; basiskennis Engels is een pré en je wilt jezelf verder ontwikkelen binnen tankcontaineronderhoud.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Goed gereedschap is belangrijk. Goede voorwaarden minstens zo. Bij Den Hartogh krijg je de ruimte om je vakmanschap verder te ontwikkelen en écht specialist te worden. Daar zetten we natuurlijk goede arbeidsvoorwaarden tegenover:

  • Veel afwisseling en verantwoordelijkheid – geen dag is hetzelfde en je werkt aan verschillende reparaties, constructies en tankcontainers;

  • Ruimte om door te groeien – ontwikkel jezelf verder binnen het vak en bouw aan een toekomst binnen Den Hartogh;

  • Een compleet arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket volgens de TLN CAO Beroepsgoederenvervoer, inclusief pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding.

• Maintain detailed logs of equipment issues, corrective actions, and resolutions for future reference and analysis

• Utilize diagnostic and test equipment to evaluate system performance and identify maintenance needs
• Communicate equipment concerns and maintenance recommendations to team members and leadership for follow-up actions

Why Join Us?

You'll play a critical role in supporting the equipment and systems that keep our manufacturing operations running. This position offers opportunities to expand your technical skills, participate in improvement initiatives, and work alongside a team committed to operational excellence, safety, and quality.

If you're a hands-on technician with strong troubleshooting abilities and a passion for keeping equipment performing at its best, we'd like to connect.

Documentation and Revision Control

Als contractmanager ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het opstarten, beheren en succesvol afronden van onze contracten. Je zorgt voor duidelijke afspraken, correcte naleving en het tijdig aanpakken van wijzigingen of risico’s. Met jouw kennis van UAV en UAV-GC en jouw juridische expertise zorg je voor een soepele samenwerking met opdrachtgevers.

In complexe tenders adviseer je de tendermanager en leg je het fundament voor een goede contractuele invulling van projecten. Tijdens alle projectfases zorg je voor een heldere interpretatie, toepassing en naleving van contractvoorwaarden. Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan verder uit:

  • Analyseren en mitigeren van contractuele risico’s en kansen in samenwerking met het projectteam

  • Optreden als aanspreekpunt voor het projectteam bij contractuele vraagstukken op juridisch, technisch en commercieel gebied

  • Onderhandelen over complexe geschillen en onderwerpen, waarbij je balanceert tussen het organisatiebelang en het belang van de opdrachtgever

  • Bewaken van de financiële afwikkeling van contracten, inclusief het opstellen en beheren van claims, meerwerken en wijzigingen

  • Bijdragen aan de periodieke interne evaluatie van projecten en de verdere professionalisering van contractmanagement binnen Hollandia Services

Wat biedt Hollandia?

Je krijgt veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid om jouw werk succesvol te maken. Ook heb je veel vrijheid om je werk op je eigen manier in te richten. Je werkt binnen een familiebedrijf waar we naar elkaar omkijken. Er is ruimte voor sociale activiteiten en je werkt aan spraakmakende projecten van bijzondere kunstwerken. Daarnaast bieden wij:

  • Een salaris tussen de € 4.796,00 en € 9.058,00 per maand

  • Dagje vrij? Geen probleem, wij bieden 40 vrije dagen per jaar

  • Een elektrische leaseauto voor bezoeken aan opdrachtgevers, de werf en projectlocaties

  • Ruimte voor opleidingen die passen bij jouw vakgebied en de ontwikkeling van onze projecten

  • Een pensioenregeling via PME, waarbij Hollandia meer dan de helft van de premie betaalt

Wat zoeken wij in jou?

Jij bent ambitieus, commercieel ingesteld en neemt eigenaarschap over jouw onderdeel van het project. Je hebt affiniteit met bouwprojecten en communiceert helder met verschillende stakeholders. Daarnaast heb je ervaring in bouwteams en/of tweefasenprojecten. Verder vragen wij:

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in een juridische of technische richting

  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met contractmanagement in de bouw of infra

  • Kennis van UAV- en UAV-GC-contracten

Wie zijn wij?

Al 98 jaar werken wij met staal in de wereld van bruggen, sluizen, hoogbouw, stadions en raffinaderijen. In binnen- en buitenland staan wij bekend om spraakmakende projecten zoals het Wembley stadion, de Hollandsche IJsselkering en de nieuwe zelfsluitende waterkering in Steyl-Maashoek. We zetten in op verduurzaming en innovatie om Nederland droog en in beweging te houden. Zo dragen we bij aan een veilige en betrouwbare infrastructuur voor miljoenen mensen.

Hollandia Services speelt een belangrijke rol in het onderhouden en renoveren van de Nederlandse infrastructuur. Met 200 technische experts onderhouden we bruggen, sluizen en keringen. We werken in teams die groot genoeg zijn om van elkaar te leren en klein genoeg om persoonlijk contact centraal te houden. Dit doen we vanuit onze locaties in Capelle aan den IJssel, Krimpen aan den IJssel en Sint Nicolaasga. We bieden volledige service op het gebied van mechanisch, elektrotechnisch en hydraulisch onderhoud. De projecten waaraan we werken verschillen in omvang en complexiteit. Zo is er altijd een project dat past bij jouw kennis en ambitie. Van een compact onderhoudsproject zoals het vervangen van aandrijvingen of het uitvoeren van inspecties en totale renovaties van technische iconen zoals de Oosterscheldekering, de Maeslantkering en de IJsselbruggen.

Nog meer weten? Bekijk onze bedrijfsvideo: Hollandia Services – YouTube

Kennismaken?

Bouw jij samen met ons mee aan deze nieuwe wereld? Wij komen graag met je in contact. Reageer via de sollicitatiebutton of neem telefonisch contact op met Sharon de Jong (corporate recruiter) via 0180-540 540.

description:
Public Strategies Overview

Public Strategies is a dynamic professional services firm with more than 35 years of experience delivering innovative communications, consulting, technology, events, and project management solutions. Serving private sector, government, and nonprofit clients nationwide, Public Strategies delivers award winning products and experiences. Position Summary

Program Delivery Specialists play a key role in delivering Public Strategies’ curriculum based programs. They lead engaging learning experiences that help individuals and families build knowledge, strengthen skills, and achieve meaningful personal goals. Program Delivery Specialists implement evidence informed curricula with fidelity, create inclusive learning environments, and support participants throughout their learning journey.

This occasional part time position is part of the Knowledge Development and Deployment Team within the Knowledge and Practice Division and reports to the Manager of Facilitation Practice and Quality. Program Delivery Specialists select their preferred availability, and assignments are scheduled based on program needs and individual availability. Required training, preparation, and periodic professional development are scheduled as needed to support successful program delivery.

Essential Job Functions

Program Delivery & Facilitation

  • Deliver assigned community based programs using established curricula, materials, and delivery standards.
  • Facilitate interactive learning experiences that encourage discussion, reflection, and practical skill building.
  • Adapt facilitation techniques to meet participant needs while maintaining fidelity to program content.
  • Coordinate with co facilitators and program staff to ensure consistent, high quality program delivery.

Participant Engagement & Support

  • Build positive and trusting relationships with participants to support engagement and continued participation.
  • Reinforce program concepts and help participants apply new knowledge and skills.
  • Assist participants in goal setting, activities, identifying resources, and navigating barriers.

Program Operations & Participant Experience

  • Assist with preparing program materials, technology, supplies, and learning spaces before each session as needed.
  • Welcome participants, support check in processes, and help create an inclusive environment.
  • Monitor participant needs during sessions and address routine on site issues.
  • Assist with restoring and organizing the learning environment after program activities.
  • Represent Public Strategies professionally with participants, partners, host sites, and community stakeholders.

Program Quality & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate and timely attendance records, participant documentation, and required program forms.
  • Provide feedback on participant engagement, curriculum implementation, and operational needs.
  • Participate in quality assurance activities to support consistent program standards.
  • Other duties as assigned and accepted.

Professional Expectations

  • Program Delivery Specialists must complete all required onboarding, program specific training, certification activities (when applicable), and ongoing professional development to maintain proficiency and delivery quality.

Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role

As enterprises accelerate Kubernetes adoption through container-based application modernization and modern virtualization, Kasten is positioned to be the data resilience standard for cloud-native infrastructure.

Reporting to the leader of Worldwide Kasten Solution Sales, you will partner with regional Kasten and field sales leadership to build territory strategy, raise technical win rates, and scale Kasten expertise across the broader Veeam field organization. You will also own the field-to-product feedback loop, working directly with Kasten Product Management and engineering to represent customer requirements. While Kasten is the primary focus, this leader will also support Veeam Data Platform opportunities where Kubernetes and virtualization workloads converge.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will inherit an established team of senior specialists, and your mandate is to make them better: sharper technical execution, deeper coverage across both regions, and a higher bar for how Kasten is positioned and proven. You will stay credible in front of enterprise architects and technical executives.

title: Dealership Relationship Specialist
description:
Who We Are

We have the fundamental belief that we, as an organization, can and will improve lives. Rooted in the centuries-old credit union philosophy of people helping people, we maintain a simple premise. Those we interact with will receive equal and just treatment, devoid of intolerance, false judgment, racism, or discrimination of any kind. We must not accept less if we are to fulfill our mission, "We Improve Lives." This mission empowers us to serve the greater good and to make a difference in our world. Our cooperative structure creates a cycle of mutual assistance towards the common goal of the financial well-being of members.

At Black Hills Federal Credit Union (BHFCU), we’re committed to improving the lives of our members every day, and we look for people who share that passion. Don’t have a ton of financial industry experience? No problem. Our onboarding includes an orientation program with ongoing training to help staff further their career at BHFCU by building on their existing strengths.

General Purpose:

The Dealership Relationship Specialist serves as the primary liaison between the Credit Union and its indirect lending dealer network. This position is responsible for developing and maintaining strong dealer relationships, supporting loan production growth, providing training and ongoing communication, and promoting the Credit Union's indirect lending programs in support of organizational objectives.

The Dealership Relationship Specialist manages and develops relationships with dealer partners throughout a multi-state market area through a combination of in-person visits, virtual meetings, telephone outreach, and business development activities. This position is responsible for increasing indirect loan production, strengthening dealer engagement, monitoring dealership and portfolio performance, and ensuring compliance with Credit Union policies, procedures, and applicable regulations.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and strengthen professional relationships with dealership partners throughout the Credit Union's indirect lending network.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for dealer inquiries, operational support, training, and issue resolution.
  • Promote the Credit Union's indirect lending programs and identify opportunities to increase loan production, dealer engagement, and market penetration.
  • Identify, recruit, onboard, and develop new dealership relationships that align with the Credit Union's strategic growth objectives.
  • Conduct dealer outreach through in-person visits, virtual meetings, telephone calls, email communication, and other relationship management activities. Dealer visitation schedules will be based on production levels, strategic value, and business needs.
  • Deliver training and education to dealership personnel regarding lending programs, operational procedures, funding requirements, compliance expectations, and system utilization.
  • Monitor dealership production, approval ratios, portfolio performance, submission quality, and relationship profitability, providing recommendations to improve performance and strengthen partnerships.
  • Proactively engage inactive or underperforming dealer partners to identify opportunities for growth and increased participation.
  • Collaborate with underwriting management, lending, funding, and operational teams to enhance the dealer experience while maintaining sound lending practices and credit quality.
  • Serve as a liaison between dealership personnel and Credit Union staff to resolve operational issues, contract discrepancies, titling concerns, reserve adjustments, chargebacks, and other dealer-related matters.
  • Support dealer compliance with Credit Union policies, procedures, and applicable federal and state regulations by identifying and escalating operational, fraud, or compliance concerns as appropriate.
  • Conduct periodic dealer relationship reviews, establish performance expectations, and recommend action plans to enhance production and profitability.
  • Remain informed regarding competitor programs, pricing changes, market conditions, and industry trends and communicate relevant information to management.
  • Assist with the processing and funding of indirect loan packages as necessary to support operational needs.
  • Prepare reports, analyze production and portfolio data, and provide recommendations regarding dealer performance, growth opportunities, and risk management.
  • Keep management informed of significant dealer issues, market conditions, and emerging opportunities.

Other Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Assists in Indirect processing as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Knowledge:

title: Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst
description:
Ferryhopper is an equal opportunity employer that welcomes diversity and is committed to inclusion in the workplace. We do not accept discrimination and harassment of any kind. This policy applies to all employment practices within our company.

The Company

Ferryhopper is revolutionising online ferry booking, aiming to change the way people travel by ferry. We are collaborating with more than 180 ferry companies across 35 countries, bringing a fresh and seamless ferry booking experience. We always strive to cater to the needs of all travellers and keep improving our services.

If you want to know more about the team, read about Ferryhopper in a nutshell.

The role

As a BI Analyst your primary role is to enable data-informed decision-making for various stakeholders across Ferryhopper. You dive into large datasets to analyze customer behavior and travel patterns, uncovering insights that drive strategic actions.

Your day-to-day tasks involve a combination of ad-hoc analyses, systematic reporting, and developing scalable data models using dbt to support the company’s growth. In this role, you own the full lifecycle: you build and maintain the core logic and transformations, but you also act as the end-user, analyzing and visualizing the very models you create. The focus is on extracting meaningful insights and translating them into actionable recommendations. You need a business mindset, strong attention to detail, curiosity, and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team. Proficiency in SQL, data modeling and data visualization tools, alongside strong business acumen, is essential.

We are actively looking to fill 2 positions and welcome candidates across the spectrum - whether your core strength lies in analyzing business context and performance metrics, owning core logic and transformations in dbt, or a mix of both.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and communicate systematic reports to support both strategic and day-to-day decision-making.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across departments to define and monitor KPIs and trends.
  • Develop and maintain data models and datasets for reporting and analytical purposes.
  • Foster a data-driven culture by working closely with stakeholders to drive insights, automation, and process improvements through data.
  • Enable stakeholders to understand and use available data products to promote data-driven decision making and assist in problem solving.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, data-driven solutions aligned with business goals.
  • Analyze large, complex datasets to generate insights and suggest actionable recommendations.
  • Identify bottlenecks and uncover opportunities where data can add value, collaborating with data analysts and engineers to scale the data team effectively.

Requirements

    • 3-5 Years of experience in a similar role.
    • Proficiency in SQL and hands-on experience with dbt and Git version control.
    • Expertise in using Power BI, Looker Studio (or similar tools) for designing and creating data visualizations, custom reports and dashboards.
    • Experience with BigQuery or other data warehousing technologies for managing large-scale datasets and performing ETL.
    • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
    • Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
    • Strong analytical skills to perform statistical analyses, interpret complex datasets, identify trends, and communicate findings effectively.
    • Ability to translate stakeholder needs into technical requirements.
    • A strong interest in continuous learning and development, with a collaborative mindset.
    • Adaptability to changing environments, with a willingness to approach problems from new angles.
    • Commitment to ensuring data quality and integrity, with a high sense of ownership and accuracy.

Nice to have:

    • Python knowledge is a plus.
    • Familiarity with jinja is a plus
    • Experience with marketing performance analytics, conversion funnels, or attribution metrics.

Current Tech stack:

    • Google Cloud (BigQuery), Power BI, Looker Studio, dbt-core, git, GSuite

Benefits

The health of our company and the success of our products are directly related to the health of our team and the work environment we create for ourselves. With this in mind, we strive to provide an inclusive and positive working environment. In this respect, we offer:

  • Competitive compensation package

  • Work from Anywhere: Six weeks per year to work from any location of your choice

title: Head of Proactive Security
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius is looking for a Head of Proactive Security to establish and lead the Proactive Security pillar. Reporting directly to the CISO, this leader will manage the Red Team, Penetration Testing, Threat Hunting, and Threat Intelligence teams.

The role is responsible for anticipating relevant threats, challenging Nebius's defenses, identifying exploitable weaknesses, hunting for adversary activity that may evade existing controls, and converting findings into measurable security improvements.

This is a hands-on leadership position for someone who combines offensive-security depth, threat-led thinking, strong operational judgment, and the ability to influence product, engineering, infrastructure, and security stakeholders.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Pillar strategy and leadership

    • Define the Proactive Security strategy, operating model, roadmap, priorities, budget, and success measures in alignment with Nebius's business objectives and threat profile.
    • Build, lead, and develop high-performing Red Team, Penetration Testing, Threat Hunting, and Threat Intelligence teams.
    • Create a unified intelligence-led program in which threat intelligence informs testing and hunting, and findings continuously improve defensive controls.
    • Prioritize work based on crown jewels, material attack paths, emerging threats, major technology changes, incidents, and business risk.
    • Establish clear team charters, engagement models, escalation paths, quality standards, and career-development frameworks.
    • Provide the CISO and senior leadership with clear visibility into adversary exposure, validated weaknesses, emerging threats, and remediation progress.

    Red Team and adversary emulation

    • Lead realistic, intelligence-led adversary simulations across cloud, identity, applications, infrastructure, endpoints, networks, and operational processes.
    • Design campaigns that evaluate prevention, detection, response, escalation, and recovery capabilities against relevant threat scenarios.
    • Develop and maintain adversary-emulation plans mapped to relevant threat actors, tactics, techniques, and procedures.
    • Ensure every engagement operates under documented authorization, rules of engagement, safety controls, deconfliction procedures, and evidence-handling requirements.
    • Deliver concise technical and executive reporting that explains demonstrated impact, attack paths, root causes, and prioritized improvements.

    Penetration testing and continuous security validation

    • Own the risk-based penetration-testing program for Nebius products, applications, APIs, cloud environments, infrastructure, and critical internal systems.
    • Define testing standards, scoping criteria, methodologies, quality assurance, retesting, and reporting requirements.
    • Coordinate internal testing and specialized external providers while maintaining consistent quality and risk prioritization.
    • Partner with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and Security teams to integrate testing into major launches, architectural changes, and high-risk initiatives.
    • Track findings through validation, remediation, exception, and closure, and identify systemic or recurring weakness patterns.
    • Expand automation and continuous validation where it improves coverage without replacing expert-led testing and judgment.

    Threat hunting

    • Establish a hypothesis-driven threat-hunting program across endpoint, identity, cloud, network, workload, application, and SaaS telemetry.
    • Prioritize hunts using threat intelligence, incidents, environmental changes, control gaps, and emerging adversary techniques.
    • Search for active, historical, or previously undetected malicious behavior that may not trigger existing alerts.
    • Turn validated hunt findings into new detections, telemetry requirements, response playbooks, hardening actions, and future hunt hypotheses.
    • Define repeatable hunt methodology, documentation standards, evidence handling, and measurement of hunt effectiveness.
    • Partner closely with Detection and Response, Incident Response, Security Engineering, and infrastructure teams during investigations and remediation.

    Threat intelligence

    • Own Nebius's threat-intelligence strategy, collection priorities, analysis standards, dissemination model, and intelligence lifecycle.
    • Maintain a current view of threat actors, campaigns, vulnerabilities, geopolitical developments, and techniques relevant to Nebius, its customers, and its technology stack.
    • Produce strategic intelligence for leadership, operational intelligence for defenders, and tactical intelligence that supports detections, investigations, hunting, and testing.
    • Translate intelligence into clear changes to security priorities, control coverage, red-team scenarios, hunt hypotheses, and incident readiness.
    • Establish reliable processes for source evaluation, confidence assessment, intelligence sharing, and secure handling of sensitive information.
    • Build trusted relationships with industry peers, relevant communities, vendors, and information-sharing organizations.

    Defensive improvement and governance

    • Create a closed-loop process that converts proactive-security findings into owned, prioritized, and measurable remediation actions.
    • Partner with Security Engineering, Detection and Response, Product Security, Cloud Security, IT, and Engineering to improve controls and reduce repeat findings.
    • Ensure material findings are communicated promptly, tracked transparently, and escalated according to risk.
    • Define reporting that distinguishes activity from outcomes and demonstrates improvements in resilience, coverage, and adversary readiness.
    • Support major incidents with threat context, attack-path analysis, hunting, and specialist offensive expertise when required.
    • Maintain strong legal, ethical, privacy, and operational-safety standards across all proactive-security activities.

We expect you to have:

  • Extensive cybersecurity experience, including leadership responsibility in offensive security, penetration testing, threat hunting, threat intelligence, detection engineering, or incident response.
  • Proven experience building or scaling multidisciplinary security teams and programs, including budgets, vendors, and external testing providers.
  • Strong technical understanding of modern cloud environments, identity systems, applications, APIs, networks, endpoints, containers, and production infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated experience planning and delivering red-team operations, penetration tests, or adversary-emulation exercises.
  • Practical knowledge of threat-hunting methodology, telemetry, detection logic, and investigation workflows.
  • Experience producing and operationalizing strategic, operational, and tactical threat intelligence.
  • Strong understanding of adversary behavior and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Excellent communication and executive-presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex technical findings into clear business risks, decisions, and remediation actions.
  • Sound judgment regarding authorization, operational safety, confidentiality, evidence handling, and responsible disclosure.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience in cloud, hyperscale, AI, or other highly distributed technology environments.
  • Deep domain expertise, relevant certifications or equivalent practical experience, and a track record of responsible research or industry collaboration.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Internal and External Events, Meetings & Trainings:

  • Provide operational support for onsite and offsite events, including vendor coordination, set-up and break-down support, transportation and organization of materials, equipment, and supplies, and collaboration with Advancement, Conference, Education, Facilities, and other teams to ensure events align with agency standards.

Operational Supply Management:

  • Manage day-to-day office supply ordering and support monitoring of the office supplies budget line for breakrooms, workrooms, offices, and general business functionality.
  • Maintain office supply request forms and communicate timelines.
  • Create and maintain a process to track office supply inventory in each workroom and ensure appropriate restocking procedures are in place.

Program Enhancement Efforts:

  • Support cross-functional efforts to streamline workflows, reduce redundancies, and implement standardized processes that improve program effectiveness.
  • Assist with program enhancement strategies, monitor performance metrics, and recommend continuous improvement actions aligned with organizational goals.

Other Duties:

title: 1136 | Senior Enterprise/Solution Architect (2-month project)
description:
Intetics Inc., a leading American technology company specializing in custom software application development, distributed professional teams creation, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is on the lookout for a Senior Enterprise/Solution Architect to join our team and provide exceptional customer support.

  • Act as the overall technical lead for the architecture audit
  • Establish architecture assessment principles, scope, and evaluation approach
  • Coordinate findings across architecture, infrastructure, security, data, and integration streams
  • Assess service boundaries, domain-driven design, bounded contexts, and architectural dependencies
  • Identify systemic architectural issues rather than isolated technical defects
  • Review and resolve conflicting technical findings across different streams
  • Lead architecture recommendations and prioritization
  • Ensure consistency and quality of the final audit conclusions
  • Support client-facing architecture workshops and technical discussions
  • Contribute to the final target-state architecture roadmap

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in software architecture, solution architecture, or enterprise architecture
  • Strong background in distributed systems and microservices architecture
  • Experience with large enterprise platforms and complex technical landscapes
  • Strong understanding of DDD, bounded contexts, service boundaries, and architectural dependencies
  • Experience with large-scale integration platforms
  • Experience with modernization or transformation programs
  • Experience with architecture governance and assessment frameworks
  • Ability to analyze dependencies across multiple technical domains, including application, integration, infrastructure, security, and data
  • Ability to consolidate findings from multiple architects into a coherent target-state assessment
  • Ability to challenge technical decisions and identify systemic architectural risks
  • Strong stakeholder management and client-facing communication skills
  • Experience producing architecture assessments, recommendations, and roadmaps
  • Banking / FinTech domain experience
  • Experience with environments containing 500+ microservices

title: Allied Therapist - Music
description:
The Allied Music Therapist will independently plan and facilitate music therapy groups, document client progress, and attend treatment team meetings.

  • Draw from research in the field and previous experience to independently design therapeutic musical tasks that meet a variety of needs, interests, and abilities.
  • Facilitate music therapy groups using a variety of methods.
  • Assess client needs and interests as well as musical and non-musical behaviors at outset of treatment and establish individual therapeutic goals.
  • Plan, review, and assess therapy sessions to monitor effectiveness as well as aid planning for future sessions.
  • Observe, evaluate and document both client behavior and content of musical contributions in group progress notes, offering insight into psychological implications of music-making and verbal processing when applicable.
  • Teach clients basic technical music skills, as needed to facilitate clients’ therapeutic progress.
  • Expand clients’ music vocabulary, providing clients with a wider range of communication skills.
  • Provide clients with exposure to various genres of music and a context for viewing and interpreting it through music analysis.
  • Maintain functional guitar, keyboard, and vocal skills and use them in sessions as needed.
  • Attend treatment team meetings as time allows in order to communicate clients’ progress in music therapy to the team, and to remain informed in regard to clients’ progress in other spheres.
  • Schedule one-to-one sessions with individuals who may especially benefit from music therapy.
  • Coordinate music therapy program with other therapy treatment programs.
  • Order and maintain music supplies and equipment.
  • Support clients by attending Agency functions (graduations, school dances, holiday events, etc.) as time allows.
