title: Hoofd PSV Soccer School, Camps & Clinics
description:
⚽ Werken bij PSV betekent werken in het hart van de topsport

PSV is een van de meest toonaangevende voetbalclubs van Nederland, met een rijke historie én de ambitie om elke dag beter te worden. Die drang naar vooruitgang voel je niet alleen op het veld, maar ook daarbuiten.

Bij een club die altijd in beweging is, ziet geen dag er hetzelfde uit. Een wedstrijd staat vast, maar wat eromheen gebeurt niet. Plannen kunnen veranderen, prioriteiten verschuiven en er kan altijd iets gebeuren dat om directe actie vraagt. Dat maakt het werk soms hectisch, maar vooral uitdagen.

Je voelt je thuis in een omgeving waar veel gebeurt, je pakt verantwoordelijkheid en werkt graag samen. Wat je rol ook is – op PSV Campus De Herdgang of in het Philips Stadion – jouw bijdrage helpt de club elke dag vooruit. Als tempo, ambitie en teamwork bij je passen, dan pas jij bij PSV.

⚽ Wie ben jij?

Als Hoofd PSV Soccer School, Camps & Clinics geef je richting aan een afdeling die jaarlijks duizenden jonge voetballers, trainers en partners laat kennismaken met de PSV Academy-methodologie. Je bent ondernemend, commercieel sterk en hebt een grote passie voor voetbal en talentontwikkeling

Je bent een natuurlijke verbinder die kansen weet om te zetten in succesvolle samenwerkingen en projecten. Daarnaast beschik je over coachend leiderschap en weet je medewerkers te motiveren en ontwikkelen. Vanuit PSV Academy werk je nauw samen met nationale en internationale partners en draag je bij aan de verdere groei van PSV Soccer School, Camps & Clinics.

⚽ Wat ga je doen?

Als Hoofd PSV Soccer School, Camps & Clinics ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor de commerciële, operationele en organisatorische resultaten van de afdeling. Je zorgt voor verdere groei van de activiteiten in binnen- en buitenland, onderhoudt strategische partnerships en draagt de visie en methodologie van PSV Academy uit naar deelnemers, trainers en partners.

Het betreft een fulltime functie waarin regelmatig reizen en aanwezigheid buiten reguliere kantooruren onderdeel zijn van de werkzaamheden.

⚽ De (hoofd)taken voor jouw positie als Hoofd PSV Soccer School, Camps & Clinics

  • Eindverantwoordelijk voor budget, resultaten en exploitatie van PSV Soccer School, Camps & Clinics;

  • Onderhouden en versterken van relaties met bestaande partners in binnen- en buitenland;

  • Acquireren van nieuwe commerciële partners en samenwerkingen;

  • Fungeren als verbindende schakel tussen externe partners en PSV Academy;

  • Presenteren en uitdragen van de PSV Academy-methodologie aan nationale en internationale partners;

  • Aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van het team PSV Soccer School, Camps & Clinics;

  • Coördineren van marketing- en promotieactiviteiten;

  • Werven, trainen en begeleiden van een kwalitatieve trainerspool volgens de PSV Academy-visie;

  • Afstemmen van trainingsprogramma's met PSV Academy;

  • Ontwikkelen van nieuwe commerciële voetbalconcepten, producten en activiteiten;

  • Coördineren en plannen van camps, clinics en Soccer School-activiteiten in binnen- en buitenland;

  • Verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van materialen, kleding, ballen en overige benodigdheden;

  • Opstellen en beheren van trainer-, activiteiten- en veldplanningen;

  • Bewaken van kwaliteit, continuïteit en een optimale beleving voor deelnemers en partners.

⚽ De ideale match voor ons team:

  • Werk- en denkniveau op hbo-niveau;

  • Aantoonbare ervaring binnen een commerciële, sportieve of evenementenorganisatie;

  • Ervaring met relatiebeheer, accountmanagement en business development;

  • Ervaring in een leidinggevende rol;

  • Affiniteit met jeugdvoetbal, talentontwikkeling en voetbalopleidingen;

  • In het bezit van een VC3-trainersdiploma;

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal;

  • Bereid om regelmatig te reizen en aanwezig te zijn bij activiteiten buiten kantooruren;

  • Passie voor sport en voetbal.

Je neemt de volgende competenties mee:

  • Ondernemend en resultaatgericht;

  • Sterke communicatieve en presentatievaardighede;

  • Verbindend en relatiegericht;

  • Organisatiesensitief;

  • Flexibel en stressbestendig;

  • Plannen en organiseren;

  • Coachend leiderschap;

  • Proactief en initiatiefrijk.

Daarnaast vinden we het belangrijk dat je jezelf herkent in de kernwaarden die bij PSV horen. Dat zijn:

prestatiegericht, gastvrij, betrouwbaar, sociaal betrokken en innovatief.

⚽ Werken bij PSV

Werken bij PSV betekent werken in een omgeving waar topsport, innovatie en passie voor voetbal samenkomen. Als toonaangevende betaald voetbalorganisatie met internationale uitstraling bieden we je een verantwoordelijke en uitdagende functie met veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Je krijgt de kans om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de verdere groei en wereldwijde verspreiding van de PSV Academy-methodologie. Daarnaast kun je rekenen op diverse secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden en maak je deel uit van een bevlogen organisatie waarin collega's, trainers en partners dagelijks samenwerken aan het ontwikkelen van talent en het creëren van unieke voetbalbelevingen.

⚽ Dit bieden wij jou

  • 25 vakantiedagen per jaar (op fulltimebasis);

  • Reiskostenvergoeding met gratis parkeerabonnement óf een NS‑Business Card;

  • Elke werkdag een betaalbare en lekkere lunch samen met collega’s;

  • Leuke activiteiten via onze activiteitencommissie PSV Together;

  • Gezondheidsvoordelen, waaronder het fietsplan en PSV Vitality;

  • Bedrijfskortingen: personeelskorting in de PSV FANstore, bij PUMA online en bij andere sponsors en partners;

  • Toegang tot trainingen en ontwikkelingsprogramma’s;

  • Een solide pensioenregeling;

  • En nog meer extra’s die werken bij PSV aantrekkelijk maken.

⚽ Maak jij de transfer naar PSV?

Ben je enthousiast over deze functie en herken je jezelf in het profiel? Solliciteer dan via onze website.
De sollicitatieprocedure omvat onder andere een arbeidsverledenonderzoek en het aanvragen van een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG).

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze advertentie wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: QA Engineer
description:
Waracle are looking for a mid level QA Engineer for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

We champion modern, balanced working and offer a hybrid setup, asking you to collaborate in person 2 days a week from our Sofia office.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

As a QA Engineer at Waracle, you will play a vital role in ensuring the quality and care behind the digital products we build. Operating at an independent, impactful level, you will design and run thoughtful test journeys based on project requirements. If you enjoy collaborating across teams, building out automated testing frameworks, and helping welcome and support new team members, you will thrive in this role.

  • Test Design: Designing and running tests independently, assessing the risk of code and configuration changes using product personas to guide user journeys.

  • Automation Engineering: Building and maintaining regression automation packs and configuring them to run within CI pipelines for timely feedback.

  • Observability: Using logs and dashboards to investigate issues and validate system health during the testing lifecycle.

  • NFR Execution: Executing scripted and manual tests across non-functional areas (Security, Performance, Accessibility) using standard tools.

  • Stakeholder Communication: Providing concise status updates in stand-ups and explaining complex QA issues in accessible language for non-technical audiences.

  • Process Improvement: Implementing local process enhancements and evaluating new tools or techniques to improve team efficiency.

  • Collaboration: Managing QA tasks independently and supporting the onboarding of new team members into the squad’s QA workflows.

What You’ll Bring

We know that excellent QA professionals come from all backgrounds, and no one matches a job description 100%. If you meet the core requirements below and are excited about the role, please apply - we value potential, adaptability, and diverse perspectives just as much as checkboxes!

  • Proven experience as a QA Engineer, preferably within a fast-paced digital consultancy or client-facing environment.

  • Automation skills, with the ability to write clean code, maintain existing testing frameworks, and write new automated test scripts.

  • Solid understanding and practical application of QA best practices, standards, and Agile/SDLC methodologies.

  • Solid technical competence in functional and non-functional testing, with an awareness of white-box testing and security testing fundamentals.

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively with peers and contributing positively to team technical discussions.

  • Experience in analysing requirements, defining test cases, ensuring comprehensive test coverage, and executing test plans.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, including proactive defect identification, logging, tracking, and assisting in triage.

  • Clear and effective communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to team members and participate confidently in team meetings.

  • Ability to efficiently learn and adapt to new project domains, technologies, and client sectors.

What to expect from our hiring process

  • 1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model.

  • 2. Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise. Depending on the role, this will be a focused take-home task (capped at 2–3 hours to respect your time) or a practical presentation.

  • 3. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one.

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

Healthcare and insurance:

  • Additional health insurance with dental treatment included

  • Wellbeing support

Entertainment and discounts:

  • Team parties and teambuildings

  • Multisport card

  • CoolFit card

Professional development:

  • Certification Courses

  • Learning Pathways and Transparent career paths

  • Udemy Business

  • Networking Opportunities

  • Public Speaking Opportunities

Others:

  • MacBook, peripherals, and other gadgets that are needed

  • Charity Committee

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
The Project Coordinator supports the successful execution of HVAC installation, controls, and electrical projects, while also coordinating related service activities, including preventive maintenance. This role provides administrative, scheduling, documentation, invoicing, and permitting support to the HVAC Install Manager and the Controls & Electrical Manager, helping ensure projects and service obligations are properly planned, compliant, billed, and closed out. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable supporting both project-based work and recurring service activity in a commercial mechanical environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Support commercial HVAC installation, controls, and electrical projects from kickoff through closeout
  • Assist the HVAC Install Manager and Controls & Electrical Manager with project setup, coordination, and administrative support
  • Create, maintain, and organize project documentation, schedules, and records within project management and accounting systems
  • Coordinate communication between project managers, service teams, field supervisors, technicians, subcontractors, vendors, customers, and accounting
  • Track project schedules, milestones, and deliverables, proactively identifying and escalating conflicts, delays, or risks
  • Assist with material ordering, tracking, and delivery coordination to ensure site readiness
  • Maintain accurate records for submittals, RFIs, change orders, purchase orders, and approvals
  • Log and track approved scope changes and pricing requests as directed by project leadership
  • Prepare meeting agendas, capture meeting minutes, and follow up on action items
  • Coordinate permit applications for HVAC, controls, and electrical work in accordance with project scope and local requirements
  • Prepare and submit permit documentation including drawings, specifications, insurance certificates, and contractor credentials
  • Track permit status, approvals, inspections, fees, and expiration dates
  • Coordinate required inspections with inspectors, field supervisors, and customers
  • Maintain organized, audit-ready permit and inspection records
  • Register equipment warranties, including Mitsubishi and JB warranties, to ensure client protection and manufacturer compliance.
  • Support scheduling and coordination of service-related activity associated with projects, controls work, and installed systems
  • Assist with scheduling preventive maintenance visits, seasonal service work, and warranty-related service activity
  • Coordinate service schedules with customers, technicians, service coordinators, and project teams to avoid work conflicts
  • Track completion of service and PM activities to ensure contractual obligations are met and documented
  • Enter, review, and validate installer and technician timesheets for payroll processing, ensuring time is coded accurately to the correct job, phase, cost code, and pay type
  • Verify time entries for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with company policies, and payroll deadlines
  • Follow up with installers, technicians, and supervisors to resolve missing, incorrect, or late time entries
  • Coordinate with payroll teams to support timely and accurate payroll processing
  • Maintain organized, audit-ready labor and timekeeping records
  • Support project invoicing, including monthly progress billing and percent-complete billing
  • Prepare and assemble billing documentation in AIA formats (G702/G703 or equivalent)
  • Track contract values, approved change orders, retainage, and prior billings to ensure accurate applications for payment
  • Coordinate with project managers and accounting to confirm billed progress aligns with field completion
  • Assist with service-related invoicing tied to preventive maintenance, warranty work, or project-associated service activity
  • Respond to customer billing documentation requests and support timely invoice submission
  • Assist with basic project cost tracking, labor reporting, and production data entry
  • Support project and service closeout activities including as-builts, O&M manuals, warranties, testing documentation, and customer handoff packages
  • Maintain organized, audit-ready project, service, billing, permit, and payroll documentation
  • Perform general administrative duties to support Install, Controls, and Electrical leadership
  • Adhere to all company safety, quality, and compliance standards

Job Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience in project coordination, service coordination, or project administration within HVAC, mechanical, controls, or electrical contracting
  • Familiarity with commercial HVAC installation, controls, electrical projects, permitting processes, preventive maintenance, and progress billing
  • Experience with AIA-style billing and percentage-of-completion invoicing preferred
  • Experience with ERP, service, or project management systems (ServiceTitan preferred)
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook, and Teams
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills

Physical Demands:

  • This is largely a sedentary role; with a large amount of computer work being required.
  • Answer phone, and use computer, scanner, printer, etc.
  • Stooping, walking, standing, bending, reaching, pulling and pushing
  • Clarity of vision at both over 20 feet and under 20 inches
  • Able to judge depth, have a good field of vision, and identify and distinguish colors
  • Climbing stairs
  • Dusty Environment

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work:

This is a full-time 40-hour position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Health care benefits through United HealthCare
  • Delta Dental and Vision Service Plan
  • Paid time off and holidays

title: AI Agent Engineer (Skills & Prompts)
description:
AI Agent Engineer (Skills & Prompts)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Location: Remote, Pakistan

The Role

Pixalate runs AI agents in production against real customer problems: agents that investigate invalid traffic (IVT) for clients, and analytics agents that let customers ask questions of our data directly. These agents are only as good as the instructions and skills behind them.

As an AI Agent Engineer you own that layer. You will write and maintain the system prompts and the agent skills that decide how our agents behave: what they know, which tools they reach for, when they push back, and, critically, when they stop and ask the user a clarifying question instead of guessing. This is engineering work, not prompt tinkering. You will version your changes, measure them against evaluations, and be accountable for agent behaviour in front of real customers. You will work directly with the team building the IQ Agent and Analytics MCP, the client IVT investigator agents, and the MRT MCP.

What You'll Do

Build and Own Agent Skills
  • Author and maintain Claude skills and plugins that define agent capabilities and behaviour
  • Design agents that ask clarifying questions and gather requirements interactively, rather than answering one-shot from incomplete information
  • Decide what belongs in a skill, what belongs in a system prompt, and what belongs in a tool
  • Maintain the skill library as products evolve, treating it as a living surface rather than a one-time build
System Prompts for Production Agents
  • Own the system prompts behind Pixalate's client-facing agents: IVT investigator agents, IQ Agent / Analytics MCP, and MRT MCP
  • Version prompts and skills deliberately, with a clear record of what changed and why
  • Debug real agent failures: wrong tool selection, hallucinated findings, missed clarifying questions, context exhaustion
Evaluation and Measurement
  • Define what "correct" means for each agent and build evaluation suites that test it
  • Build ground-truth datasets from real customer scenarios and measure changes against them
  • Catch regressions before customers do
Context and Tool Design
  • Engineer context strategies: what the agent sees, in what order, within what budget
  • Work with engineering on MCP tool surfaces: which tools exist, how they are described, and how those descriptions drive correct selection
  • Tune for cost and latency as well as accuracy
Safety and Trust
  • Guard against prompt injection, data leakage, and unsafe tool use in customer-facing agents
  • Ensure agents represent Pixalate's findings accurately and do not overstate confidence
What We're Looking For
  • Demonstrable experience building LLM agents that shipped to real users, not prototypes or demos
  • Hands-on work with agent skills, plugins, system prompts, or equivalent agent-behaviour tooling
  • Evidence of evaluation discipline: you can describe an eval suite you built, the ground truth behind it, and a regression it caught. This is the single most important qualification.
  • Strong written English. This role is writing, and the writing is the product.
  • Working proficiency in Python or TypeScript, and comfort reading the codebase your agents run in
  • Understanding of tool-calling / function-calling and how agents select tools
  • Awareness of prompt injection, PII handling, and the failure modes of customer-facing AI
  • Comfortable with some U.S. timezone overlap for team meetings
  • Ad-tech, digital advertising, or fraud-detection exposure is strongly preferred: programmatic, DSPs, SSPs, CTV, or IVT and ad fraud concepts. If you do not have it, you must be prepared to learn the domain deeply in your first 90 days, because agent quality depends on it.
  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers or similar tool-integration standards is a plus
  • Experience with observability and tracing for LLM systems is a plus
  • Experience with retrieval systems and their failure modes is a plus
  • Data analysis background, including SQL and working with large datasets, is a plus

About us

Pixalate is an online trust and safety platform that protects businesses, consumers and children from deceptive, fraudulent and non-compliant mobile, CTV apps and websites.

We're seeking an AI Agent Engineer to help build and maintain the production agent systems that directly impact millions of users worldwide. Our software and data have been used to unearth multiple high profile criminal and illegal surveillance cases including:
  • UNICEF: Pixalate was recently recognized by UNICEF as a Key Innovator for protecting children’s online privacy. & UNICEF Global Compliance Tech case study
  • Gizmodo: An iCloud Feature Is Enabling a $65 Million Scam, New Research Says
  • Adweek: A 7-Figure Ad Fraud Scheme Running on Roku Underlines Murkiness of CTV
  • Washington Post: Your kids’ apps are spying on them
  • Pro Publica: Porn, Piracy, Fraud: What Lurks Inside Google’s Black Box Ad Empire
  • ABC7 News: The State of Children's Privacy Online
  • NBC News: How many apps are tracking your children
Our team of lawyers, data scientists, engineers, economists and researchers span globally with presence in California, New York, Washington DC, London and Singapore.Pixalate is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse team.

Our Culture

We believe in small teams that produce high output. Slack is a way of life and short emails are encouraged. We value a fearless attitude and bold ideas. Chess players do well here. Titles don't mean much - you attain respect by producing results. Everyone's a data addict and analytical thinker who thrives on collaboration.

What We Offer

At Pixalate, you will have the opportunity to work on pioneering technologies alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry. If you're passionate about building products that protect millions of users and thrive in a fast-paced, challenging environment, you'll fit right in.
  • A Competitive Compensation Package

  • Casual, Remote Work Environment
  • Flexible Hours
  • Opportunity for Advancement and Professional Development
  • Fun Annual Team Events
  • Being part of a high-performing global team that wants to win and have fun doing it

With greater autonomy and multi-site accountability, the RSC II troubleshoots service delivery challenges, identifies resource gaps across properties, and contributes directly to partnership coordination and continuous improvement efforts.

Impact: The ability to deliver consistent, high-quality services across multiple properties and mentor emerging practitioners directly impacts EHRSI's mission by ensuring service fidelity at scale, strengthening partnership effectiveness, and building organizational capacity for sustainable growth.

Role Parameters

  • Caseload Ratio: Approximately 60-80 active resident relationships across 2-3 properties (aligned to 1:150 family, 1:125 senior, 1:100 PSH ratios)
  • Deployment: Multi-site coverage; assigned to a cluster of properties with diverse populations (family, senior, or mixed)
  • Transition Note: In 2026, RSC II roles stabilize multi-site delivery within existing staffing, focusing on partnership coordination and equity-driven service refinement. From 2027 onward, RSC II becomes formally integrated into regional hub structures, supported by Partner-Delivered Specialists (Youth, Health, Financial Coaching) and central functions (Training & QA, Outcomes & Analytics, Resident Voice, Partnership Development).

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Service Delivery and First Level Support (Across Domains)

Deliver Tier 1 Universal Programs independently across multiple sites:

  • Design and facilitate site-appropriate community-building activities adapted to resident demographics
  • Coordinate afterschool programs, youth leadership activities, and parent engagement workshops across properties
  • Deliver financial literacy series, employment readiness workshops, and digital inclusion programming
  • Organize health fairs, wellness initiatives, and preventive health education adapted to population needs
  • Ensure program consistency across sites while maintaining cultural responsiveness

Provide coaching-based first level support independently across all service domains:

  • Housing Stability: Lead lease compliance conversations, mediate complex property management concerns, coordinate emergency rental assistance across sites
  • Economic Stability: Facilitate in-depth budgeting coaching, support job search processes, navigate complex benefits enrolment
  • Health and Wellness: Provide health insurance enrolment support for complex cases, coordinate appointment scheduling, support medication adherence
  • Digital Inclusion: Troubleshoot technology issues across devices and platforms, teach intermediate digital skills
  • Youth and Family: Deliver after-school programming across age groups, facilitate parent workshops, connect families to specialized services

Execute warm handoffs to partner specialists independently for intensive or specialized services. When other service organizations are not available, may deliver direct services within scope of practice and under supervision.

2. Crisis Response, Safeguarding & Complex Case Management

  • Handle crisis intervention independently, applying advanced de-escalation and trauma-informed techniques
  • Report child, dependent adult, and elder abuse and neglect according to California State law as a mandated reporter
  • Work with property staff, families, and community agencies to identify and address resident problems before they reach crisis proportions
  • Manage multi-barrier cases requiring coordination across multiple service providers
  • Escalate complex or high-acuity situations to Supervisor with clear documentation and recommended next steps
  • Document crisis incidents accurately in CRM within 48 hours
  • Provide informal coaching to RSC I staff on crisis response protocols

3. Partnership Coordination & Referral Management

  • Build and manage relationships with partner organizations across multiple service domains
  • Obtain appropriate releases to interact with others on behalf of residents; maintain confidentiality appropriately
  • Execute warm handoff protocols independently: assess needs, make quality referrals, facilitate smooth transitions
  • Monitor referral outcomes in CRM: track appointment attendance, service completion, resident satisfaction
  • Conduct needs assessments across assigned sites to identify service gaps
  • Train RSC I staff in resource navigation and partnership relationship-building
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive lists of available community resources
  • Participate actively in partnership coordination meetings

4. Trauma-Informed Practice & Resident Relationship Building

  • Model trauma-informed, strengths-based engagement across diverse populations
  • Build trust-based relationships with residents across multiple properties
  • Use motivational interviewing and coaching-based approaches to support residents
  • Recognize and respond to resident stress indicators, mental health concerns, trauma symptoms
  • Coach RSC I peers on supportive communication, boundary-setting, and self-care practices
  • Maintain confidentiality and professional boundaries at all times
  • Integrate resident voice into program design and service adjustments

5. Data, Outcomes & Equity

  • Ensure high-quality data entry across all assigned sites in EHRSI's CRM (Salesforce) within 48 hours
  • Track and analyze outcome trends across properties: housing stability, economic mobility, health & wellness
  • Submit reports in an accurate and timely manner
  • Maintain all reporting requirements set by funding and/or governmental agencies
  • Use outcome data to refine outreach strategies and identify populations experiencing inequitable outcomes
  • Disaggregate outcomes by demographics to support equity analysis
  • Serve as a local data champion, supporting RSC I staff with CRM protocols
  • Maintain program files and records with required completeness (equal to or greater than 95%)

6. Property Management Collaboration & Site Team Integration

  • Serve as an active member of site teams across multiple properties, working collaboratively with property managers and site staff to meet property needs and resolve resident problems
  • Facilitate information flow across sites and between departments
  • Work with residents to resolve conflicts with neighbors
  • Coordinate recreational, cultural, and social activities in coordination with property operations staff

7. Team Collaboration, Mentorship & Organizational Learning

  • Provide informal mentorship to RSC I staff: share lessons learned, model best practices, support skill development
  • Participate actively in team meetings, supervision sessions, and reflective practice forums
  • Flag operational challenges to Supervisor: caseload imbalances, partnership performance issues, resource gaps
  • Represent assigned sites in planning discussions and partnership meetings
  • Attend all staff meetings, training sessions, and other appropriate meetings and conferences as required
  • Participate in relevant local, regional, state and/or national organizations as assigned
  • Actively participate in EHRSI's culture of inclusivity

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provides informal mentorship and coaching to RSC I staff
  • May coordinate volunteers, interns, or community partners for specific programs
  • No formal HR authority; escalates performance concerns to Supervisor

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

  • 2-4 years of experience in human services, community development, social services, or related fields
  • OR equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Demonstrated competency in multi-site coordination and complex case management

PREFERRED SKILLS and/or ABILITIES

Preferred:

  • Experience working with diverse populations across multiple property types
  • Crisis and mental health experience
  • Experience conducting community assessments and applying conflict management techniques
  • Training in trauma-informed care, housing first principles, harm reduction

Required Skills and Abilities

  • Advanced Domain Literacy: Strong working knowledge of housing, economic, health, digital, and youth and or family support domains
  • Independent Practice: Ability to deliver services autonomously across multiple sites with minimal supervision
  • Coaching & Mentorship: Demonstrated ability to mentor less experienced staff and model best practices
  • Technology Proficiency: Proficient with MS Office and CRM systems (Salesforce preferred); strong data entry and analysis skills
  • Cultural Competency: Proven ability to adapt services to diverse populations and demographics
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills; ability to troubleshoot service delivery challenges independently
  • Interpersonal Skills: Excellent communication, relationship-building, and conflict resolution abilities
  • Organizational Skills: Ability to manage complex workload across multiple sites; strong time management
  • Commitment to Equity: Demonstrated commitment to equity, inclusion, and resident-centered service delivery

Preferred Skills and Abilities

  • Knowledge of services available in local counties
  • Understanding of federal and state entitlement programs
  • Experience with permanent supportive housing and complex needs populations
  • Ability to speak a second language preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to establish trusting, confidential relationships
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work some evenings and weekends, as required

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

  • Must have access to reliable transportation to travel during the business day to Eden properties, training sites, and retail stores

title: Bioenergy Plant Operator (m/f/d)
description:
Join our new biomass power plant in Diepholz

HoSt Group is currently constructing a modern 25 MW thermal power plant in Diepholz, fuelled by waste wood. The plant will reliably generate electricity and process steam for an industrial customer while making an important contribution to reducing CO₂ emissions.

Commissioning is planned for March 2027. To operate the plant, we are building a small, specialised team that will be responsible for ensuring its safe, reliable and efficient day-to-day operation.

As a Bioenergy Plant Operator (m/f/d), you will be involved from the very beginning. Following comprehensive training and onboarding, you will take responsibility for the daily operation of the plant, monitor its processes and respond to technical deviations or malfunctions.

Do you enjoy hands-on technical work, taking responsibility and the opportunity to be involved in a new energy plant from the start? Then we would be happy to meet you.

Your responsibilities

As a Plant Operator, you and your colleagues will be responsible for the safe and reliable operation of the power plant.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Operating, controlling and monitoring the power plant and its associated technical systems;

  • Monitoring operating parameters and ensuring stable and efficient plant operation;

  • Carrying out regular plant rounds and inspections;

  • Identifying, analysing and resolving technical malfunctions during operation;

  • Performing minor maintenance and repair activities;

  • Supporting planned maintenance and repair activities;

  • Documenting relevant operating data, malfunctions and actions taken;

  • Working closely with internal and external specialists from Operations, Service, Engineering and Maintenance;

  • Ensuring compliance with all applicable health, safety and environmental regulations;

  • Participating in the rotating on-call duty of the operations team.

Your onboarding and training

As this is a new plant, we want to ensure that you are fully prepared for your future responsibilities before commissioning.

After joining HoSt, you will complete a structured onboarding and training programme. During this period, you will become familiar with the plant technology, processes, operational procedures and safety requirements.

This will ensure that you are fully prepared when the power plant becomes operational in March 2027.

What you bring

Above all, we are looking for people with strong technical understanding, a responsible mindset and experience working with industrial installations.

Ideally, you bring:

  • Professional experience as a Plant Operator, Power Plant Operator, Machine Operator, Process Operator or in a comparable technical position;

  • Experience operating energy, biomass, production or process installations;

  • Experience with steam boilers, steam systems or combustion systems is an advantage;

  • Good technical understanding and a practical, solution-oriented approach;

  • Willingness to take responsibility for safe and reliable plant operation;

  • Good German language skills and English at a minimum B1/B2 level;

  • Willingness to work day shifts;

  • Willingness to participate in a rotating on-call schedule in the event of malfunctions or emergencies;

  • Ideally, you live in Diepholz or the surrounding area, or are able to reach the plant within a short period of time when on call.

What we offer

  • A permanent employment contract with a 6-month probation period;

  • A 40-hour working week;

  • Attractive remuneration based on your qualifications and professional experience;

  • 30 days of annual leave per calendar year based on full-time employment;

  • 8% holiday allowance;

  • Overtime compensation at 125% for overtime exceeding 10% of the monthly working hours;

  • A company mobile phone and laptop, also available for private use;

  • Business travel expenses reimbursed in accordance with applicable German tax regulations;

  • Coverage under the German statutory social security system, including health, pension, long-term care, unemployment and accident insurance;

  • A comprehensive onboarding and training programme prior to the commissioning of the plant;

  • A secure and long-term position at a new, modern energy plant;

  • A responsible technical position within a small, specialized team;

  • A wide range of training and professional development opportunities within the international HoSt Group;

  • Direct communication channels and close cooperation with specialists from Operations, Engineering and Service.

About HoSt Group

HoSt Group is a Dutch family-owned company and an international technology provider in the renewable energy sector.

Since 1991, we have been developing and delivering innovative solutions for renewable gases, sustainable heat and power, hydrogen and CO₂ capture. Our technologies are used worldwide to help industrial companies reduce emissions and replace fossil fuels with more sustainable alternatives.

Biomass and Waste-to-Energy plants have been an important part of our technology portfolio and expertise for many years.

Interested?

Would you like to become part of our new operations team in Diepholz?

We look forward to receiving your application. For the first step, your CV is all we need.

We will contact you within 14 days after receiving your application.

Would you like to learn more about the plant or the position before applying?

Please contact Joost Fokkink (Manager Combustion Operations) or Natalia Wisniewska (Corporate Recruiter) at +31 88 460 90 80.

We look forward to meeting you!

title: SOC Analyst (Trainee)
description:
About Gruve

Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well-funded early-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.

Position summary:

Entry-level analyst on the 24×7 security monitoring rotation. First responder to alerts in the Exaforce AI SIEM, working strictly from runbooks under the guidance of the shift senior, and building toward independent triage within 6 months.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Monitor the Exaforce alert queue and acknowledge within SLA; perform first-level triage per documented runbooks.
  • Classify alerts (true/false positive) with evidence and record complete investigation notes in Linear tickets.
  • Escalate per the severity matrix to the shift senior / L2 with accurate context and timelines.
  • Run scheduled health checks on log sources, collectors and dashboards; raise ingestion-gap tickets.
  • Execute clean shift handovers and maintain the shift log.
  • Complete the structured training path (SIEM, cloud audit, identity, network flow fundamentals) and participate in shift drills.

Mandatory Qualifications:

  • BE/BTech (CS/IT/E&TC) or equivalent.
  • Fundamentals of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/TLS) and operating systems (Linux, Windows).
  • Core security concepts: common attack types, malware categories, authentication basics.
  • Clear written English for ticket and handover quality.
  • Committed to 24×7 rotational shifts including nights and weekends.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • CEH, CompTIA Security+, or Google Cybersecurity Certificate.
  • CTF / home-lab exposure; basic Python or shell scripting.
  • Cloud fundamentals, ideally GCP.

Why Gruve

At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Product Manager, Peer-to-Peer Events
description:
Highlights:

Location: Portugal

Language: Fluent in Russian and English (C1+)

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About Peer-to-Peer at Fundraise Up

Peer-to-Peer turns supporters into fundraisers. Instead of only donating, a supporter creates a fundraising page, invites others to give, joins a team, or participates in an event on behalf of a nonprofit.

We are building Peer-to-Peer as a new product line. The product starts with two connected directions:

  • P2P DIY: self-serve fundraising for birthdays, memorials, personal challenges, and other supporter-led campaigns.
  • P2P Events: structured, time-bound fundraising programs such as walks, runs, rides, climbs, workplace challenges, and recurring event series.

DIY creates the product foundation. Events extends it with registration, teams and captains, event operations, participant communication, attribution, reporting, and integrations. The two directions must work as one coherent product while serving different customer workflows and levels of complexity.

About the Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to own P2P Events within the broader Peer-to-Peer product line.

This is a hands-on software product role covering discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and iteration. You will turn an ambiguous product area into a focused solution grounded in customer, usage, and commercial evidence.

Events and DIY serve different sides of the same system: nonprofits need to run fundraising programs, while participants need effective tools to fundraise. You will work closely with the PM responsible for the broader P2P area so these experiences and their shared capabilities evolve together.

This is not an event-planning or project-coordination role.

What You’ll Own

Define the product direction

  • Turn customer research, market evidence, and business context into a clear product thesis and sequenced roadmap.
  • Choose a focused target segment and event scenario rather than trying to serve the entire category at once.
  • Decide which capabilities belong in the shared P2P foundation and which require an Events-specific model.
  • Keep assumptions, success metrics, scope, risks, and product decisions explicit.

Lead discovery and product definition

  • Work directly with nonprofit event teams, participants, design partners, and internal GTM teams.
  • Validate decisions through interviews, workflow mapping, prototypes, and live product usage.
  • Separate true adoption blockers from feature requests and incumbent-product expectations.
  • Shape problems such as registration, teams and captains, attribution and reporting, event operations, participant communication, and CRM integrations. These are examples—not a pre-committed feature checklist.

Shape and deliver the product

  • Own the product from problem definition through requirements, delivery, launch, and iteration.
  • Write clear requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and decision records.
  • Make day-to-day scope and trade-off decisions with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Research, and QA.
  • Ensure the product can evolve from simpler events to more advanced team structures, event series, and operational workflows without overbuilding the first release.
  • Keep delivery predictable by surfacing dependencies, risks, and unresolved decisions early.

Launch, learn, and drive outcomes

  • Launch and learn through EAPs with clear entry criteria, success measures, readiness requirements, and out-of-scope areas.
  • Understand whether organizations can run events successfully and whether participants activate, fundraise, and return.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, CSM, and Support on positioning, customer commitments, enablement, and competitive context.
  • Connect product evidence to adoption, expansion, pipeline, retention, and GPV.
  • Turn evidence into clear recommendations: iterate, expand, change direction, or stop.

Work AI-native

  • Use AI for research synthesis, prototyping, specification quality, data exploration, and operational automation.
  • Build testable artifacts quickly without outsourcing product judgment.

Requirements

  • 4–7 years of Product Management or Product Ownership experience in a software product company.
  • End-to-end ownership of a customer-facing product area with Engineering and Design.
  • Strong judgment in reducing a large problem space to a focused release and explaining the trade-offs.
  • Experience turning customer evidence and product data into decisions.
  • Clear written communication across requirements, edge cases, metrics, and decision records.
  • Ability to work with multi-actor workflows, permissions, states, and data relationships.
  • High ownership and independence, with fluent written and spoken English.

Strong plus

  • Experience with B2B SaaS, fundraising, payments, registration, events, community, or other multi-sided products.
  • Experience launching a new product area through beta or EAP.
  • Knowledge of CRM integrations, reporting, transaction attribution, analytics, or SQL.
  • Practical use of AI for research, prototyping, analysis, or product operations.

This Role May Not Be a Fit If

  • You are looking for an event-planning or internal project-management role rather than software product ownership.
  • You prefer to receive a fully defined roadmap and requirements instead of helping determine what should be built.
  • You want to work only on strategy and avoid specifications, QA, delivery details, or post-launch iteration.
  • You treat every customer request as a roadmap commitment.
  • You need stable scope and certainty before moving forward.
  • You measure progress mainly by features shipped rather than customer and business outcomes.

Why work with us

  • A strong, collaborative product team that owns what it builds
  • Clear product vision and access to real customer feedback from global nonprofit leaders
  • Flat structure: no politics, just great work with great people
  • Transparent company culture-we share how we’re growing, where revenue comes from, and what’s next
  • Long-term focus: we offer equity options and value sustained, meaningful contribution

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is €5,200 - €5,700 gross.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance for the employee and their family
  • 22 paid vacation days per year
  • Up to 14 paid public holidays per year
  • 5 company-paid sick leave days
  • English learning courses.
  • Relevant professional education.
  • Gym or swimming pool.
  • Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace.
  • Co-working.
  • Remote working.
  • €50 monthly allowance to cover internet and mobile phone expenses

**Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. Exercise caution and ensure the authenticity of emails claiming to be from our company.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.

title: Blasting and Seal
description:
Position Summary:

Wausau Tile is seeking a hardworking, energetic, and safety-conscious individual to join our Site Furnishings team as a Blasting and Seal. This position is responsible for preparing and operating media blasting equipment to finish concrete products. The ideal candidate is mechanically inclined, detail-oriented, and capable of working independently or collaboratively with minimal supervision.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Machine Set-Up

  • Prepare media blasting booth and related equipment for daily operations.

  • Perform start-up checks, calibrate equipment, and adjust air pressure as needed.

  • Ensure all support tools and safety equipment (forklifts, hoses, PPE, air monitoring) are ready for use.

2. Blasting

  • Operate a media blasting wand using stainless steel shot media to finish concrete products.

  • Adjust blasting technique (distance, timing, pressure) to achieve desired surface finish.

  • Wear full PPE including a blast helmet with supplied air.

3. Material Handling

  • Safely operate a forklift to load and unload products from the blasting area.

  • Use an air wand to remove blasting media from products and prepare for staging.

4. Machine Maintenance

  • Perform preventative maintenance including filter changes, hose inspections, equipment cleaning, and calibrations.

  • Complete daily, monthly, and quarterly maintenance logs accurately and on time.

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged standing, walking, bending, reaching, twisting, and lifting.

  • Ability to lift/move up to 50 lbs frequently.

  • Repetitive motion involving hands, wrists, shoulders, knees, back, and neck.

  • Must be able to safely climb stairs and ladders.

  • Must pass a FIT Test for use of required PPE.

If driving revenue, inspiring teams, and creating memorable experiences is your passion... keep reading.

You will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of the catering sales function, including prospecting, contracting, forecasting, team leadership, and collaboration with Operations, Culinary, Banquets, and Sales teams. Why You’ll Love It Here

Apply today and help us create experiences worth celebrating.

description:
Division 132 | Ashburn, VA

Design with purpose. Build with precision. Protect what matters.

Chesapeake Fire Protection is looking for an experienced Fire Sprinkler Designer to create accurate, code-compliant, and constructible fire sprinkler and suppression system designs. You’ll work closely with Project Managers, engineers, architects, and field teams to bring projects from concept to installation.

Every great fire protection system starts with a great design. Put your technical skills to work designing systems that protect people, property, and communities—and grow your career with Chesapeake Fire Protection.

Enterprise Leadership & Collaboration

CAPITAL

  • Research and develop planned enhancements for future mechanical and electrical equipment acquisitions and stay abreast with new technology and procedures. Assist all departments in executing plans and projects for improvements, as well as monitor building systems, correct defective and inefficient operations through remedial maintenance.
  • Coordinate and follow up on preventative maintenance on boilers, presses, furnaces, hammers, plumbing, electrical, overhead doors, PLC, and any other major systems.

REGULATORY COMPLIANCE – safety and environmental

  • Active member of the safety committee and emergency response team
  • Operate existing systems for fire detection and suppression, determine sources of troubles and correct them, and follow standard safety procedures in all work areas.
  • Handle hazardous materials, electrical circuits, solvents, refrigerants, cleaning supplies and chemicals in a manner that protects all personnel as well as properties in and around the facility

MAINTENANCE SYSTEMS AND PLANNING

  • Define requirements for internal and external preventive maintenance requirements in alignment with Total Productive Maintenance: operator inspection and verification, internal maintenance work orders, and vendor managed programs. Ensure all new equipment implementations are completed in alignment with TPM strategies.

TRAINING SKILLED TRADES

  • Conduct routine periodic performance audits of skilled trades personnel to confirm maintenance work orders are being completed in alignment with expectations
  • Develop and implement new hire checklists for millwrights, electricians, and combustion control technicians and conduct new maintenance program training initiatives in alignment with TPM strategies.
  • Develop standard for completing work orders, inspections, and equipment work instructions.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

This position carries no direct supervisory responsibilities. However, indirect, project and program management skills are essential to success. Indirect leadership of skilled trades is expected, with occasional direct leadership responsibilities in alignment with training and capital expense project management, or backup supervision of the maintenance group.

title: Principal Consultant - Data Scientist Lead
description:
Data Scientist Lead

Location: Hong Kong (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Data & Analytics | Type: Permanent

The Role

As a Data Scientist Lead at Capco, you’ll help clients optimise fraud models, machine learning platforms and supporting Google Cloud infrastructure, turning detailed analysis into practical, implementation-ready recommendations.

You’ll take a hands-on approach to improving model and platform performance, reliability and run-cost across GCP infrastructure and ML pipelines. Working closely with IT infrastructure teams, data scientists and fraud stakeholders, you’ll identify opportunities to reduce compute and inference costs while maintaining effective, resilient solutions.

You’ll provide configuration-level and code-level guidance, supported by clear estimates of implementation effort, expected savings and measurable outcomes. You’ll also use approved AI tools and AI-enabled workflows where appropriate to accelerate analysis, improve insight and support delivery, while maintaining human judgement, appropriate review and responsible AI guardrails.

What You’ll Do

  • GCP engineering: Lead hands-on design, diagnostics and optimisation across compute, storage and network services, implementing monitoring and observability to improve cost, performance and reliability.
  • Fraud ML modelling: Support the development, validation and deployment of fraud and ML models end-to-end, identifying measurable opportunities to reduce compute requirements, accelerate inference and improve automation.
  • ML and data pipelines: Optimise pipelines spanning ingest, transformation, feature creation and serving, training and inference, with a focus on cost efficiency, performance, resilience and responsible AI-enabled automation where appropriate.
  • Big data and distributed processing: Develop and tune large-scale batch and streaming workloads using Spark or similar technologies, improving efficiency, stability and production readiness.
  • Engineering excellence: Apply strong Python and SQL skills alongside CI/CD, automated testing, modular design and disciplined code review, using approved AI tools where appropriate to improve engineering productivity while ensuring outputs remain subject to human review and established controls.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong hands-on experience in data science, machine learning engineering or ML platform optimisation, including the ability to translate analysis into practical, implementation-ready recommendations.
  • Deep experience with Google Cloud Platform and the optimisation of cloud compute, storage, networking and ML workloads for performance, reliability and cost.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills, together with experience building, validating, deploying and optimising production ML models and data pipelines.
  • Experience with large-scale distributed data processing technologies such as Spark and applying sound software engineering practices including CI/CD, automated testing and code review.
  • An ability to collaborate effectively with infrastructure, data science and business stakeholders, with curiosity about approved AI tools and the judgement to apply AI-enabled workflows responsibly, including appropriate guardrails, review, escalation and auditability.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience supporting fraud detection, financial crime or other high-volume decisioning models within financial services.
  • Exposure to or implementation experience with Feedzai, including integration, performance tuning or operationalisation.
  • Experience demonstrating measurable cloud or ML cost savings, including reduced compute consumption, faster inference or improved automation.
  • Familiarity with production monitoring, model/platform observability and performance optimisation across complex ML environments.
  • Experience applying AI, including Generative AI or Agentic AI where appropriate, to engineering or data workflows within controlled and regulated environments.

Why Join Capco

  • Deliver high-impact technology solutions for Tier 1 financial institutions
  • Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture
  • Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications
  • Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services
  • Help shape the future of digital transformation across FS & Energy.

Inclusion at Capco

We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know – we’ll be happy to help. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

title: MEAL Officer
description:
Job Title: MEAL Officer
Location: Mbale
Reports to: MEAL Manager

Application Deadline: 10th September 2026

Project Background

The Sustaining Gains & Continuing Services for Smallholder Farmers (SGCF) Project is designed as a 12-month consolidation initiative that brings together selected results, relationships and delivery structures established under CG and BRIGHT into one focused project implemented by GOAL Uganda in partnership with Agriterra. The project will ensure continuity of support to smallholder farmers, FOs, cooperatives and other local actors across the 14 districts of Elgon, Rwenzori and Kigezi, while working closely with district local governments, private sector partners, financial service providers and implementing partners up to August 2027. The project will build on good practices, networks, community and household / farmer-led planning processes developed by CG and BRIGHT. The SGCF Project will focus on preserving gains already made, sustaining critical services, consolidating relationships with farmers and institutions, and generating practical learning for the next EKN programme design.

Job summary

The MEAL Officer will support field-level data collection, verification, monitoring visits, accountability mechanisms and learning documentation. Ensures timely collection of pathway-level results and supports implementing partners to apply agreed MEAL tools and reporting standards.

Job Functions

Data Collection and Management:
• Assist in designing and implementing data collection tools and methodologies for the BRIDGE Project.
• Conduct field visits to monitor the progress of implementation of project activities, collect primary data and feedback from the participants.
• Ensure accurate and timely data entry into the programme’s database.
• Maintain organized and secure data storage systems.

Data Analysis and Reporting:
• Analyse quantitative and qualitative data to assess project performance and impact for quarterly and annual reporting.
• Generate regular reports and dashboards to provide insights into project progress.
• Prepare data summaries, infographics, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders engagements.
• Ensure data quality and integrity through regular data quality assessments.

Monitoring and Evaluation:
• Monitor project activities to ensure they are on track and aligned with project goals.
• Support the development and tracking of performance indicators and targets.
• Carry out routine field data validation and quality checks.
• Support barrier analyses, baseline-, midline-, and end-line surveys.
• Provide feedback to project teams based on monitoring and evaluation findings.

Capacity Building:
• Train project staff and partners on data collection, management, and analysis techniques.
• Train and support selected youth, in particular young women, refugees and persons with disabilities to be involved in all steps of MEAL.
• Develop training materials and manuals to support capacity building efforts.
• Conduct workshops and training sessions to enhance the MEAL skills of project staff.

Learning and Adaptation:
• Facilitate learning sessions and workshops to share findings and best practices.
• Take responsibility to write stories from the field, and support the documentation and dissemination of success stories, case studies, and lessons learned.
• Promote adaptive management by integrating MEAL findings into project planning and decision-making.

Collaboration and Communication:
• Work closely with the MEAL Coordinator to ensure alignment of MEAL activities with project objectives.
• Collaborate with project teams to ensure data needs are met and support programmatic decision-making.
• Participate in regular team meetings and provide updates on MEAL activities and findings.

Job Level Specifications

Essential Criteria:
• Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Social Sciences, Development Studies or any related field.
• Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in monitoring, evaluation, research, and learning in the development sector.
• Proficiency in data analysis software (e.g., Excel, SPSS, STATA) and data visualization tools.
• Strong understanding of M&E methodologies and tools.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
• Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
• Ability to conduct training and capacity-building sessions.

Desired Criteria:
• Experience working in the development sector, either in agriculture/farming systems or market development approach (M4P / MSD).
• Knowledge of qualitative and participatory data collection methods.
• Experience in story writing.
• Proficiency in using online data collection platforms (e.g., CommCare, ODK, KoBoToolbox).
• Experience in producing high-quality reports and presentations.

General Terms and Conditions

At GOAL we welcome people of all abilities and want to ensure that our hiring and interview process meets the needs of all applicants. If you require a reasonable accommodation to make your application or interview experience a great one, please just contact our Recruitment Team at recruitment@ug.goal.ie

GOAL Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion:
GOAL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees. We foster an inclusive culture where all voices are heard and valued. We know that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.

All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling GOAL’s commitment to equal employment opportunity and equal treatment. GOAL does not discriminate against any employee on the basis of sex, race, color, ethnic background, tribe, birth, creed or religion or social or economic standing, political opinion, disability.

Code of Conduct and Accountability within GOAL

GOAL is an equal opportunities employer and has values and behaviours framework which defines our code of conduct. Any candidate offered a job with GOAL will be expected to adhere to the following key areas of accountability.

  • Comply with GOAL’s policies and procedures with respect to safeguarding, Code of Conduct, health and safety, data protection and confidentiality, do no harm principles and unacceptable behaviour protocols.
  • Report any concerns about the welfare of a child or vulnerable adult or any wrongdoings within our programming area.
  • Report any concerns about inappropriate behaviour of a GOAL staff or partner.

Safeguarding

Children and vulnerable adults a must be safeguarded to the maximum extent from deliberate or inadvertent actions and failings that place them at risk of abuse, sexual exploitation, injury, and any other harm. One of the ways that GOAL shows this on-going commitment to safeguarding is to include rigorous background and reference checks in the selection process for all candidates.

GOAL

Established in 1977, GOAL is an international humanitarian agency and works with the most vulnerable communities to help them respond to and overcome humanitarian crises, and to assist those facing poverty and exclusion achieve greater resilience and well-being. GOAL envisions a world beyond humanitarian crises where poverty no longer exists, where vulnerable communities exposed to shocks and stresses are resilient, where barriers to well-being are removed and where everyone has equal rights and opportunities.

General Description of the Country Programme

First operational in Uganda in 1979, the current GOAL Uganda country programme focuses on Health, (including WASH, Health Accountability and Nutrition); and a market-based systems approach to improving agricultural livelihoods and WASH. GOAL Uganda mainstreams gender, child protection, social behavior changes and resilience strategies across all programming. GOAL uses a mixture of direct implementation and partnerships with national and international civil society organizations, local government, the private sector and communities to give effect to our mission.

title: Public Services Assistant

title: Assertive Community Treatment (ACT) Supervisor (4299)
description:
About Us

Since 2003, we've been assisting children, families and adults across North Carolina with their behavioral health needs. Carolina Outreach is a group of highly trained behavioral health professionals dedicated to promoting the emotional and physical well-being of our community in a safe and respectful environment.
​
We provide a comprehensive and integrative array of behavioral health services and supports for people of all ages with varying levels of need utilizing an equitable and inclusive approach.
​
We focus on helping our clients tap into and develop their inherent strengths with the goal of supporting the highest quality of life possible for all we serve.

About the Role

Carolina Outreach is looking for a compassionate, driven, and clinically skilled ACT Team Lead to join our dedicated team in Smithfiled, NC. As part of the ncgCARE network, we’re committed to transforming lives through evidence-based behavioral health services — and we need a strong leader to help guide that mission on the ground.

In this full-time role, you'll lead a passionate multidisciplinary team delivering Assertive Community Treatment (ACT) services. You'll balance administrative oversight and direct client care (approximately 60/40), playing a key role in shaping team culture, maintaining clinical excellence, and ensuring every individual we serve receives the person-centered support they deserve.

You’ll step into a role that blends strategic leadership with hands-on care — offering supervision, consultation, and guidance to your team, while also working directly with clients to support their journey toward stability and independence. From crisis response to long-term planning, your work will touch every aspect of ACT service delivery.

This is more than a leadership position — it’s a chance to make a daily difference in the lives of individuals living with severe and persistent mental illness. You’ll also have the opportunity to influence service innovation, advocate in the community, and elevate standards of care in partnership with a values-driven organization.

  • Team Leadership and Supervision:

    • Provide clinical and administrative supervision for the ACT team, ensuring adherence to program standards.
    • Conduct individual clinical supervision and case consultations for team members.
    • Respond to crisis situations with staff and act as a back-up for client needs as required.

  • Direct Client Services:

    • Deliver services such as crisis assessment, symptom management, individual counseling, and psychotherapy.
    • Provide substance abuse treatment, daily living support, and social or leisure activity services to clients.
    • Coordinate education, support, and consultation for clients’ families and natural supports.

  • Program Oversight and Standards:

    • Ensure compliance with the latest National Program Standards for ACT Teams, as defined by the National Alliance for the Mentally Ill or the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services.
    • Oversee both internal and external services, advocate for clients in the community, and collaborate with families and natural supports.

  • Planning and Evaluation:

    • Lead the development and evaluation of person-centered plans in collaboration with the client and the team.
    • Monitor and ensure services are appropriate, effective, and aligned with client needs.

This description outlines the general scope and level of work for this role. It is not intended to include every duty or responsibility that may be required of employees in this position.

Compensation

This role is compensated on a salaried basis, providing consistent earnings aligned with the responsibilities and expectations of the position.

  • Compensation: $61,449 - $83,441

Placement within the range is based on licensure level, education, and experience.

What You Can Expect

  • Administrative and scheduling support
  • Supportive clinical and operational leadership
  • Opportunities to build your preferred clinical focus areas
  • Streamlined onboarding and credentialing support

Responsibilities

  • Maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation
  • Collaborate with care teams as needed
  • Maintain compliance with all clinical and regulatory standards
  • Participate in supervision (if applicable based on licensure level)

title: Service Coordinator
description:
The Service Coordinator is a critical role within our Commercial HVAC/R operation, responsible for coordinating service delivery from call intake through job closeout and invoicing. This position serves as the primary link between customers, technicians, service management, and accounting. Ensuring work is scheduled efficiently, documented accurately, and billed promptly. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, customer-focused, comfortable reviewing technical service documentation, and experienced in service billing within a commercial mechanical environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Schedule, dispatch, and coordinate commercial HVACR service calls, including reactive service, preventive maintenance, and minor project work
  • Monitor technician schedules and job progress throughout the day, adjusting assignments as needed to meet customer priorities, response-time commitments, and efficiency goals
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for commercial customers regarding service requests, scheduling, job status, and basic billing-related inquiries
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with customers, technicians, service management, and accounting to maintain alignment and expectations
  • Create, update, and maintain accurate service work orders in the service management system (e.g., ServiceTitan or equivalent)
  • Ensure labor hours, parts usage, service notes, photos, and required documentation are complete and accurate prior to job closeout
  • Enter, review, and validate technician timesheets, ensuring labor is coded correctly to the appropriate job, phase, and pay type in accordance with company policy and payroll requirements
  • Support field technicians by providing job details, service history, customer contacts, and site-specific requirements
  • Coordinate parts ordering, deliveries, rentals, subcontractor support, and warranty documentation as needed
  • Review completed service tickets for accuracy, completeness, and billability
  • Generate customer invoices in accordance with service agreements, time-and-material pricing, and contractual terms
  • Verify labor, materials, pricing, markups, and tax treatment before invoices are issued
  • Coordinate with Service Managers and Accounting to resolve billing discrepancies, credits, and adjustments
  • Assist with maintenance contract billing, recurring service invoicing, and job-related billing documentation requests
  • Respond to customer questions related to invoices and provide supporting documentation as required
  • Track service jobs through completion to ensure timely closeout and invoice release in support of cash flow objectives
  • Maintain organized service and billing records in compliance with company standards and customer requirements
  • Support service leadership with reporting related to workload, backlog, scheduling efficiency, and invoicing status
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to scheduling, documentation, service delivery, and billing accuracy
  • Adhere to all company safety, quality, and compliance standards

Job Qualifications:

The Service Coordinator should possess the following skills, characteristics, and abilities:

  • 5+ years of experience in service coordination, dispatch, and/or invoicing within commercial HVAC, mechanical contracting, or construction services
  • Working knowledge of commercial service billing practices, including time and material, contract, quoted, and not-to-exceed work
  • Experience with service management software (ServiceTitan preferred)
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Teams)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to review technical service documentation accurately
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively with customers, technicians, and internal teams

Physical Demands:

  • Stooping, walking, Standing, bending, reaching, pulling and pushing
  • Climbing stairs
  • Climbing Ladders
  • Dusty Environment
  • Navigate uneven terrain

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Health care benefits through United HealthCare, Delta Dental and Vision Service Plan

description:
