description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Counselors are responsible for delivering individual, group, and family counseling services to clients with substance use and co-occurring mental health disorders. Core responsibilities include completing required clinical documentation such as psychosocial assessments, Individual Treatment/Service Plans (ITP/ISP), progress notes, and monthly reviews. Counselors actively participate in interdisciplinary treatment team meetings, monitor client progress throughout care, and contribute to discharge planning to ensure continuity of services. They provide crisis assessment, intervention, and de-escalation to promote client and staff safety, while guiding peers to ensure consistent and appropriate responses to critical situations. Counselors develop and implement approved curricula to support group and individual counseling sessions, utilizing evidence-based practices tailored to client needs.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Provide individual, group, and family counseling to address substance use, co-occurring disorders, and mental health concerns.
  • Conduct thorough client screenings and assessments; develop, implement, and regularly update individualized treatment plans based on each client’s strengths, needs, abilities, and preferences.
  • Utilize evidence-based counseling and psychotherapy approaches to evaluate and treat emotional, behavioral, cognitive, and affective conditions.
  • Deliver services via secure distance-based platforms when appropriate, ensuring informed consent, confidentiality, and compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and professional standards.
  • Assess client needs and determine appropriate modalities of care, including crisis intervention, referrals, and coordination with ancillary services (e.g., family support groups, continuing care, medical services).
  • Conduct intake interviews and determine program eligibility and appropriateness for services or referral to external providers.
  • Provide crisis intervention, following WestCare policies and procedures, and take immediate action as needed to ensure client safety.
  • Report unusual incidents, safety concerns, or compliance issues to the Residential Clinical Coordinator, Program Director, Regional Vice President, or regulatory agency as appropriate.
  • Monitor, evaluate, and document client behavior, progress, and participation throughout treatment.
  • Maintain accurate, timely, and complete clinical documentation, including progress notes, assessments, and reports in accordance with agency and regulatory standards.
  • Follow all WestCare policies, procedures, and professional standards of practice.
  • Participate in interdisciplinary treatment team meetings, counselor meetings, and discharge planning discussions to support continuity of care.
  • Educate clients and families about recovery resources, relapse prevention, and coping strategies.
  • Support aftercare planning by assisting clients in identifying community resources and ongoing recovery supports.
  • Ensure regular and consistent attendance to maintain continuity of client care.

title: Install Technician
description:
Installation and Service Technician

Leonard’s Syrups is a family owned and operated business that employs over one hundred employees. We have been in business since 1964, starting with manufacturing Soda syrups and continuing to grow the company by adding services which are related to this core competency. These other companies include installing and Servicing bar equipment, servicing the soda systems, and supporting our customers with CO2 to use for their systems.

Job Overview

As an Installation and Service Technician specializing in soda, beer, CO2, and ice machines, nitro serve systems, etc. you will be responsible for installing, maintaining, and repairing beverage and ice equipment at client locations. You will ensure that installations are completed efficiently and that machines are operating effectively to meet client expectations. Additionally, you will provide ongoing servicing and troubleshooting to address any technical issues that arise.

Responsibilities

  • Install, set up, and configure soda dispensers, beer taps, CO2 systems, and ice machines at client locations.
  • Conduct on-site visits to assess installation requirements and plan equipment placement for optimal functionality.
  • Test and verify proper functionality of installed equipment, ensuring it meets quality standards and client specifications.
  • Provide training to clients and their staff on the use, cleaning, and maintenance of beverage and ice machines.
  • Respond promptly to service calls and requests for technical support, diagnosing and resolving equipment issues both remotely and on-site.
  • Perform routine maintenance tasks, such as cleaning, sanitizing, and adjusting equipment settings to ensure optimal performance.
  • Troubleshoot equipment malfunctions, identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions to minimize downtime.
  • Coordinate with vendors and suppliers to order replacement parts or schedule repairs as needed.
  • Maintain accurate records of service visits, equipment installations, and customer interactions.
  • Adhere to safety protocols and regulations while working with beverage and ice equipment, ensuring compliance with industry standards.

Technical Skills

  • Equipment Maintenance- Performing routine maintenance on equipment and determining when and what kind of maintenance is needed.
  • Equipment Selection- Determining the kind of tools and equipment needed to do a job.
  • Installation- Installing equipment, machines, wiring, or programs to meet specifications.
  • Operation and Control- Controlling operations of equipment or systems.
  • Operation Monitoring- Watching gauges, dials, or other indicators to make sure a machine is working properly.
  • Operations Analysis- Analyzing needs and product requirements to create a design.
  • Quality Control Analysis- Conducting tests and inspections of products, services, or processes to evaluate quality or performance.
  • Repairing- Repairing machines or systems using the needed tools.
  • Technology Design- Generating or adapting equipment and technology to serve user needs.
  • Troubleshooting- Determining causes of operating errors and deciding what to do about it.

title: Classification Specialist (52627)
description:
Join a company where excellence meets opportunity! At MIRACORP, we don’t just provide services to the federal government, we set the gold standard in quality and reliability. Position Summary

The Classification Specialist provides technical and administrative support for federal position classification activities. The Specialist performs position description (PD) reviews, classification analyses, job evaluations, and related advisory services.

title: Sr. Risk Specialist (Privacy Business)
description:
회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

팀 소개

Privacy Business 팀은 개인정보를 처리하는 쿠팡의 모든 개인정보 처리시스템을 식별하고 시스템 별 개인정보의 수집, 보관, 이용, 제공, 파기의 각 단계에서 처리 현황과 그 흐름을 분석하여, 쿠팡이 개인정보보호와 관련된 법 규정 및 인증 요구사항을 준수하여 안전하게 개인정보를 처리하기 위한 기틀을 마련하는 역할을 수행하고 있습니다.

업무 내용

  • 개인정보 처리시스템의 분류기준에 따라 모든 개인정보처리시스템을 식별하여 목록화 하고 최신성을 유지 관리 합니다.

  • 개인정보 수집, 보관, 이용, 제공, 파기 등 각 처리단계의 흐름을 실사기반으로 분석하고 흐름을 도식화하여 최신 상태로 유지 합니다.

  • 개인정보 흐름 분석을 통해 규정 미 준수 사항을 명확히 식별하고 비지니스팀 혹은 개발팀과 개선합니다.

자격 요건

  • 관련 분야의 학사 학위

  • 최소 5년 이상의 개인정보보호 관련 컴플라이언스 업무 경험, 특히 개인정보보호 관리 경험 우대

  • 개인정보 흐름분석 및 PI flow 기반 관리 경험

  • Database에 대한 기본적인 이해 및 Query 작성 경험

  • 개인정보보호 관련 컴플라이언스 문제를 식별하고 가이드를 제공할 수 있는 역량

  • 조직 내 이해관계자들과 효과적으로 협업을 수행하기 위한 뛰어난 의사소통 및 대인관계 능력

  • 주도적으로 업무를 수행하고, 문제를 해결하고자 하는 열정

우대 사항

  • 이커머스, IT 기업 등의 개인정보보호 프로그램에 대한 실무 경험

  • Cloud 기반 개인정보 처리환경에 대한 높은 수준의 경험과 이해

  • 개인정보보호 관련 국/내외 자격증 보유

  • 해외 담당자들과 회의가 가능한 수준의 영어 커뮤니케이션 능력

근무지: 쿠팡 서울 구의오피스 (재택병행)

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형 절차
    • 서류전형 - 화상면접 1차 - 화상면접 2차 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고 사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
    • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Aviation Accessory Technician III
description:

title: Finance & Strategy GTM, EMEA
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are seeking a Finance Business Partner to join our EMEA GTM Finance & Strategy team at Anthropic. In this role, you will be a key partner to our EMEA go-to-market teams, providing financial expertise and guidance to support strategic decision-making. As we continue to grow, you will play a crucial role in analyzing financial data, building models, and delivering insights to drive informed business decisions across revenue goals, sales capacity planning, deal desk and marketing spend returns. This role will work closely with cross-functional teams and collaborate with other members of the finance organization to align go-to-market strategies with broader financial considerations.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide expert guidance, recommendations, and influence to go-to-market stakeholders on financial strategies, investments, and resource allocation decisions, leveraging an in-depth understanding of the company's financials
  • Partner cross-functionally to drive analysis, build financial models, and recommend business decisions across a variety of areas, such as revenue goals, sales capacity planning and key strategic initiatives
  • Prepare and deliver clear, concise, and insightful financial reports, analyses, and forecasts, highlighting key trends, risks, and opportunities to facilitate informed decision-making to stakeholders and executives
  • Collaborate with other members of strategic finance, FP&A, and accounting counterparts, helping to align go-to-market with broader financial strategies and considerations

Requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience across strategic finance, FP&A, business partnering, consulting, investment banking, or related fields
  • Demonstrated experience supporting or building out finance functions in international or EMEA markets
  • Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex data into clear, actionable insights and develop robust financial models
  • Strong cross-functional communication skills and comfort presenting financial information to non-finance audiences, including senior leadership
  • Experience with budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning in a high-growth environment
  • Familiarity with multi-entity, multi-currency financial environments and EMEA regulatory or statutory considerations
  • A bias toward action, strong work ethic, and ability to drive outcomes under tight timelines
  • Passion for Anthropic's mission to build safe, transformative AI systems

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
£240,000—£240,000 GBP

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. title: Pathway Officers
description:
Job Title: Pathway Officers
Location: 01 Mbale, 01 Kapchorwa, 02Kabarole, 01 Kabale
Reports to: PIP & Community Engagement Coordinator; Private Sector Engagement, Markets & Finance Access Coordinators

Application Deadline: 10th September 2026

Project Background

The Sustaining Gains & Continuing Services for Smallholder Farmers (SGCF) Project is designed as a 12-month consolidation initiative that brings together selected results, relationships and delivery structures established under CG and BRIGHT into one focused project implemented by GOAL Uganda in partnership with Agriterra. The project will ensure continuity of support to smallholder farmers, FOs, cooperatives and other local actors across the 14 districts of Elgon, Rwenzori and Kigezi, while working closely with district local governments, private sector partners, financial service providers and implementing partners up to August 2027. The project will build on good practices, networks, community and household / farmer-led planning processes developed by CG and BRIGHT. The SGCF Project will focus on preserving gains already made, sustaining critical services, consolidating relationships with farmers and institutions, and generating practical learning for the next EKN programme design.

Job summary

The Pathway Officer will provide field-level coordination and implementation support for the SGCF Project within an assigned cluster. The role will support delivery across the three project pathways: PIP, Vision and Action Plans; Land Use, Farming Systems and Local Government Engagement; and Markets, Access to Finance and Farmer Organisations Strengthening. The Pathway Officer will work closely with GOAL technical staff, Agriterra staff, implementing partners, PIP communities, Learning Groups, FOs, VSLAs, SACCOs, cooperatives, private sector actors and district local governments to ensure timely implementation, follow-up, monitoring and consolidation of project gains from Common Ground and BRIGHT

Job Functions

  • Support field-level planning, coordination and implementation of SGCF activities within the assigned cluster, ensuring alignment with the approved workplan, targets and consolidation purpose.
  • Work with implementing partners to mobilise communities for PIP/CAP reviews, PIP harvesting workshops, seasonal reviews, technical trainings, Learning Group sessions, restoration activities and market/finance linkage activities.
  • Support follow-up of household PIPs, Community Visions and CAP priorities, ensuring that community priorities are documented, tracked and linked to relevant technical, market, finance or Farmer Organisation support.
  • Coordinate with district and lower local government structures to support implementation, technical backstopping, joint monitoring, reflection meetings and follow-up of community priorities.
  • Support Learning Groups, restoration site groups, farmer groups, VSLAs, Entrepreneurial Groups, and market-oriented groups (MoGs) to participate in relevant project activities and access available services.
  • Work with Agriterra and the Private Sector Engagement, Markets & Access to Finance Coordinator to support field-level follow-up of aggregation, input/output market linkages, finance linkages, private sector relationships and FO strengthening activities to that they benefit smallholder farmer groups.
  • Provide day-to-day support and supervision to implementing partners, including review of activity plans, field reports, attendance records, output documentation and follow-up actions.
  • Support the MEAL team to collect, verify and submit accurate field data, including participant records, activity reports, monitoring findings, feedback, lessons learnt and evidence of target achievement.
  • Promote safeguarding, gender equality, social inclusion and accountability in all field activities, ensuring that women, youth, persons with disabilities and vulnerable groups participate safely and meaningfully.
  • Identify implementation bottlenecks, emerging risks, community concerns and coordination issues, and escalate them to the relevant Coordinator, Specialist or Team Lead for timely action.
  • Document field-level lessons, good practices and challenges from implementation and contribute to monthly, quarterly and donor reporting.
  • Perform any other reasonable duties assigned by the line manager that are consistent with the purpose and scope of the role.

Job Level Specifications

Criteria

  • Bachelor’s degree in Agriculture, Agribusiness, Rural Development, Community Development, Development Studies, Agricultural Extension, or a related field.
  • At least 2-3 years of relevant experience in rural development, agricultural livelihoods, community mobilisation, farmer group support, market systems, financial inclusion or local government engagement
  • Experience working with smallholder farmers, community structures, FOs, cooperatives, VSLAs, SACCOs, Entrepreneurial Groups or market-oriented farmer groups.
  • Good understanding of participatory community planning approaches, including PIP, Community Action Plans or similar farmer-led planning processes.
  • Practical knowledge of sustainable land use, farming systems, farmer organisation support, market linkages or access to finance in rural contexts.
  • Experience coordinating with implementing partners, district local governments, private sector actors and community-based structures.
  • Strong facilitation, mobilisation, coaching, communication and relationship management skills.
  • Good documentation and reporting skills, including ability to prepare activity reports, field updates and basic monitoring records.
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate safeguarding, gender equality, social inclusion and accountability into community-level activities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and basic digital data collection tools.
  • High level of integrity, professionalism and respect for community members, partners and colleagues.
  • Knowledge of relevant local languages in the assigned project region is an added advantage.
  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently to rural and highland communities.
  • Valid motorcycle riding permit and riding experience is desirable.

General Terms and Conditions

At GOAL we welcome people of all abilities and want to ensure that our hiring and interview process meets the needs of all applicants. If you require a reasonable accommodation to make your application or interview experience a great one, please just contact our Recruitment Team at recruitment@ug.goal.ie

GOAL Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion:
GOAL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees. We foster an inclusive culture where all voices are heard and valued. We know that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.

All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling GOAL’s commitment to equal employment opportunity and equal treatment. GOAL does not discriminate against any employee on the basis of sex, race, color, ethnic background, tribe, birth, creed or religion or social or economic standing, political opinion, disability.

Code of Conduct and Accountability within GOAL

GOAL is an equal opportunities employer and has values and behaviours framework which defines our code of conduct. Any candidate offered a job with GOAL will be expected to adhere to the following key areas of accountability.

  • Comply with GOAL’s policies and procedures with respect to safeguarding, Code of Conduct, health and safety, data protection and confidentiality, do no harm principles and unacceptable behaviour protocols.
  • Report any concerns about the welfare of a child or vulnerable adult or any wrongdoings within our programming area.
  • Report any concerns about inappropriate behaviour of a GOAL staff or partner.

Safeguarding

Children and vulnerable adults a must be safeguarded to the maximum extent from deliberate or inadvertent actions and failings that place them at risk of abuse, sexual exploitation, injury, and any other harm. One of the ways that GOAL shows this on-going commitment to safeguarding is to include rigorous background and reference checks in the selection process for all candidates.

GOAL

Established in 1977, GOAL is an international humanitarian agency and works with the most vulnerable communities to help them respond to and overcome humanitarian crises, and to assist those facing poverty and exclusion achieve greater resilience and well-being. GOAL envisions a world beyond humanitarian crises where poverty no longer exists, where vulnerable communities exposed to shocks and stresses are resilient, where barriers to well-being are removed and where everyone has equal rights and opportunities.

General Description of the Country Programme

First operational in Uganda in 1979, the current GOAL Uganda country programme focuses on Health, (including WASH, Health Accountability and Nutrition); and a market-based systems approach to improving agricultural livelihoods and WASH. GOAL Uganda mainstreams gender, child protection, social behavior changes and resilience strategies across all programming. title: Technologist - Assay Development
description:
About Us

CSI Laboratories, a Fulgent Genetics Company, is a nationally recognized cancer testing and diagnostics laboratory experienced in helping pathologists and oncologists diagnose and treat cancer patients.

Founded in 2011, our parent entity, Fulgent Genetics, has evolved into a premier full-service genomic testing company built around a foundational technology platform.

Through our diverse testing menu, Fulgent is focused on transforming patient care in oncology, anatomic pathology, infectious and rare diseases, and reproductive health. We believe that by providing a wide range of effective, flexible testing options in conjunction with best-in-class service and support, we can redefine the way medicine is managed for patients and clinicians alike.

Since integrating with our therapeutic development business, Fulgent is also developing drug candidates for treating a broad range of cancers using a novel nanoencapsulation and targeted therapy platform. By merging our fields of expertise, we aim to become a fully integrated precision medicine company.

Summary of Position

The Assay Development Technologist is a cross-functional role comprised of assay development in collaboration with the Molecular Director, Senior Management, and the Molecular Department to drive decision-making and data-driven product development.

The Assay Development Technologist will initiate study projects, investigate the feasibility of potential projects, design and develop methods and assays, generate and interpret study results through the application of scientific principles and analytical techniques, and drive novel molecular biology assays from research to product proof-of-concept.

The Assay Development Technologist will be responsible for designing and developing fully automated, high-throughput genetic tests from concept through commercial launch. The assay development technologist strives to create a highly collaborative environment, with an emphasis on cross-functional projects. Continually assessing and integrating cutting-edge technology into our laboratory and development process, as well as will playing a key role in developing new tests as well as troubleshooting and maintaining existing assays in collaboration with the molecular department.

Key Job Elements

  • Demonstrate high attention to detail with a depth of knowledge in the principles of molecular biology and the use of instrumentation for genetic testing.
  • Work with Molecular Director and Senior Management to identify new assays with the potential to bring them in house
  • Lead research and development by designing new or optimizing existing molecular assays
  • Utilize molecular biology techniques and instrumentation for the successful validation and implementation of assays into established workflows.
  • Author all documents needed for assay development and implementation (i.e. validation plan, SOP, etc.)

  • Act as immediate supervisor for students while in the apprentice program
  • Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with organizational policies and applicable laws, in consultation with Field Leadership and Human Resources
  • Recruit and select candidates for the apprentice program
  • Manage performance; plan, assign, and direct work; appraise performance; reward and discipline employees; address complaints and resolve problems
  • Ensure student responsibilities, authorities, and accountabilities are defined and understood

Interim Salon Supervision

  • Act as interim supervisor for bathers and groomers in the absence of a Lead Groomer or Salon Manager
  • Provide coaching, lead work direction, technical skills building, and quality supervision
  • Train and support skill development for bathers, and maintain grooming and bathing quality standards across the team
  • Model safe dog handling techniques and customer experience excellence
  • Perform regular quality checks on groomers and bathers
  • Participate in performance meetings and support team performance improvement
  • As needed, manage performance, including rewarding and disciplining employees, addressing complaints, and resolving problems
  • Ensure employee responsibilities, authorities, and accountabilities are defined and understood
  • Address and resolve customer concerns, including making service corrections when needed

Grooming Services and Client Experience

  • Provide comprehensive grooming services in a salon environment
  • Greet customers and their dogs by name and communicate a best-estimate pick-up time
  • Perform a needs assessment for each assigned dog, evaluating the condition of eyes, ears, nails, teeth, coat, and skin
  • Suggest de-matting services, a short haircut, additional services, and products to customers based on that assessment, as appropriate
  • Describe benefits and options for all suggested add-ons, and communicate knowledgeably about all of Groombar's products and services, including nutrition, training, and dental cleaning
  • Obtain detailed instructions from customers regarding the haircut desired, take comprehensive notes, and record them in each customer's account for future reference
  • Clearly communicate fees associated with all services
  • Notify owners when service has been completed and ensure hourly contact occurs thereafter until the pet is picked up
  • Execute the GOTHEART strategy during every customer check-in, deliver exceptional customer service, and ensure a positive salon experience

Talent Selection

  • Partner with Human Resources to participate in the selection process for bather and groomer applicants

Operations and Performance

  • Maintain strong customer service standards and meet or exceed established goals
  • Adapt to changing priorities, including assisting and assigning walk-in grooming services
  • Communicate effectively and professionally with customers and team members

Salon Safety and Additional Duties

  • Ensure accuracy of release forms, kennel cards, and service documentation
  • Monitor pets for stress, health concerns, or behavioral changes and report as needed
  • Ensure kenneled pets are comfortable, safe, and have access to water
  • Check dogs hourly for any signs of stress
  • Communicate any health or safety concerns to management and pet owners
  • Ensure the salon environment is safe, clean, and free of hazards, and that equipment and tools are operating as intended
  • Respond appropriately to personnel or dog injuries, ensuring both employees and dogs receive prompt and appropriate medical care, and injuries are reported
  • Perform other salon-related duties as assigned by Field Leadership, as needed

Salon Maintenance and Compliance

  • Maintain a clean, safe, and organized grooming environment
  • Ensure completion of daily and weekly cleaning and sanitation lists
  • Respond appropriately to any pet or employee incidents, ensuring proper care and reporting

Compensation and Benefits

  • Bonus structure surrounding program performance and apprentice graduation outcomes
  • Ownership of a signature program with direct visibility to the VP of Services and Director of Grooming
  • Exclusive Professional Development Opportunity:

Work alongside a team of multi-award-winning international competition groomers with over 20 years of experience in advanced grooming techniques, salon leadership, and professional instruction, and help shape the standard every Groombar groomer is trained to.

Work Environment and Physical Requirements

  • Fast-paced grooming salon environment
  • Frequent interaction with dogs of all breeds, sizes, and temperaments
  • Approximate percent per 8-hour workday:
  • Constant visual stimulation, including close vision (up to 100%)
  • Constant standing (up to 100%)
  • Constant contact with water, shampoos and other bathing products, and hair (up to 100%)
  • Frequent squatting, bending, reaching, pulling, and twisting
  • Frequent lifting of dogs up to 30 pounds without assistance
  • Occasional walking around building

This is more than a grooming role; it is the opportunity to build the bench, set the standard, and leave a mark on the entire organization.

Benefits

  • 401(k)
  • Dental insurance
  • Employee discount
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Paid training
  • Vision insurance

title: DEPUTY CLERK
description:
General Summary

Under the supervision of a Command Officer, maintains financial records, calculates contract amounts, maintains the petty cash and evidence funds and inmate trust accounts, and performs a variety of other financial processing and maintenance tasks. Compiles and analyzes information in order to produce and assist with Department budget and grant reporting. Types reports and other documents, and performs a variety of support tasks.

Essential Functions

  1. Maintains inmate trust accounts and balances daily receipts which may include monies posted by Correctional officers to inmate accounts, commissary monies, money collected for copies of police reports, and various other fees. Deposits funds at bank and performs bank reconciliations.
  2. Calculates contract amounts for officers, including salary and fringe benefits; types up new contract and salary schedule for each Township; and prepares monthly invoicing of Townships and receipts payments.
  3. Maintains the petty cash account, includes coding bills and preparing vouchers for replenishing cash. Prepares vouchers for evidence funds account.
  4. Inventories and orders office supplies. Prepares purchase orders and requisitions for supplies, equipment, printing and other products and services.
  5. Processes records requests from insurance companies, FOIA requests, and investigations requests.
  6. Processes civil paperwork, verifying accuracy and completeness and referring to command officer for serving.
  7. Responsible for financial reporting relating grants, includes preparing salary schedules, preparing monthly and quarterly reports, final expense reports, and various other reports and forms.
  8. Verifies front counter receipt book and cash box balance. Posts receipts to proper accounts and transmits funds to County Treasurer.
  9. Receipts all monies and bond money posted. Releases funds per court orders.
  10. Enters MICR data into computer system for department activity reports. Reports MICR data to state for compilation of activity statistics.
  11. Performs various clerical and secretarial functions including typing, data entry, filing, copying, and various other duties. Assists with incoming phone calls and receives and processes mail. Provides back-up secretarial support to Sheriff and Undersheriff.
  12. Processes permits to purchase handguns, registrations of handguns, and applications to carry concealed weapons including running computer-generated background check. Provides information to the public on gun laws regarding permits to purchase handguns, concealed weapons and laws pertaining to handguns and explosives. Physically inspects weapons for correct serial numbers and to verify that weapons are safe and not stolen. Must be able to perform duties associated with the Automated Pistol Registration System. Maintains related reports.
  13. Performs fingerprinting and criminal history checks on applicants for employment with schools or liquor control and for car dealer licenses.
  14. Assists with jail duties including prisoner transfers. Provides back-up clerical support on other duties as assigned, including assisting with dispatch functions.
  15. Attends meetings or serves on committees at Sheriff’s request.
  16. Enters accident reports onto computer system and files associated reports.

Other Functions

17. Exercises arrest powers as necessary.

This list may not be inclusive of the total scope of job functions to be performed. Duties and responsibilities may be added, deleted or modified at any time.

title: Lid Raad van Toezicht met zorgprofiel
description:
Zet jouw zorginhoudelijke ervaring in voor een kleurrijk leven voor mensen met een verstandelijke beperking.

Pergamijn zoekt een maatschappelijk betrokken, toekomstgerichte en positief-kritische toezichthouder die actuele zorginhoudelijke kennis verbindt met een brede, strategische blik.

Waarom Pergamijn?

Bij Pergamijn kun je vanuit jouw rol als toezichthouder daadwerkelijk van betekenis zijn. Je draagt bij aan een organisatie die goede en veilige zorg biedt, blijft vernieuwen en zich voorbereidt op de toekomst.

Je kijkt niet alleen naar beleid, cijfers en resultaten, maar ook naar de ervaringen van cliënten, hun naasten en medewerkers. Zo lever je een waardevolle bijdrage aan de maatschappelijke opdracht van Pergamijn.

Over Pergamijn

Pergamijn ondersteunt mensen met een verstandelijke beperking in Midden-Limburg, de Westelijke Mijnstreek en Parkstad-Heuvelland. We bieden verschillende vormen van wonen, zorg, behandeling, dagbesteding en ambulante ondersteuning.

Onze cliënten voeren zoveel mogelijk zelf de regie over hun leven en nemen zo volwaardig mogelijk deel aan de samenleving. We werken vanuit de visie:

“Zo zelfstandig als mogelijk, zo beschermd als nodig.”

Samen met cliënten, hun naasten en bevlogen professionals bouwen we aan een kleurrijk leven dat past bij ieder individu. Onze vier kernwaarden geven daarbij richting: Passie voor de cliënt en ons werk, Partnerschap in de samenwerking, Professionaliteit in ons handelen en Positiviteit door te kijken naar wat wél kan. Ook van onze toezichthouders verwachten we dat zij deze waarden herkennen en uitdragen.

De Raad van Toezicht

De Raad van Toezicht bestaat uit zes leden en houdt integraal toezicht op het beleid van de Raad van Bestuur. De continuïteit en maatschappelijke doelstelling van Pergamijn staan daarbij centraal.

Het toezicht richt zich onder meer op de kwaliteit en veiligheid van de zorg, de kwaliteit van bestaan van cliënten, financiën en bedrijfsvoering, medezeggenschap, Governance, compliance, cultuur en maatschappelijke waardecreatie.

De raad werkt vanuit vertrouwen, open dialoog, kritische afstand en onafhankelijkheid. Daarbij betrekt de Raad van Toezicht verschillende perspectieven en signalen uit de organisatie en haar omgeving.

Jouw rol als toezichthouder

Als lid van de Raad van Toezicht lever je vanuit jouw zorginhoudelijke deskundigheid een bijdrage aan het integrale toezicht. Je kijkt verder dan je eigen expertisegebied en denkt mee over alle onderwerpen die binnen de raad aan de orde komen.

Je:

  • houdt toezicht op de kwaliteit en veiligheid van de zorg en hebt daarbij nadrukkelijk oog voor de kwaliteit van bestaan en een veilige woon- en leefomgeving van cliënten;

  • toont oprechte belangstelling voor de ervaringen van cliënten, hun verwanten en medewerkers;

  • onderschrijft het belang van inspraak en medezeggenschap en stimuleert dat de perspectieven van cliënten, verwanten en medewerkers worden betrokken bij beleid en besluitvorming;

  • verbindt prestaties en resultaten met signalen uit de dagelijkse praktijk;

  • houdt toezicht op strategische ontwikkelingen voor de lange termijn, zonder de dagelijkse praktijk en leefwereld van cliënten uit het oog te verliezen;

  • vertaalt relevante maatschappelijke, zorginhoudelijke en politieke ontwikkelingen naar de betekenis daarvan voor cliënten en Pergamijn;

  • denkt vanuit kansen, innovatie en de toekomstbestendigheid van Pergamijn;

  • stelt kritische vragen en durft een eigen standpunt in te nemen;

  • draagt bij aan een cultuur van openheid, leren en verbeteren;

  • werkt constructief samen met de andere toezichthouders en de bestuurder.

Wie zoeken wij?

We zoeken een toezichthouder met een stevig profiel, aantoonbare affiniteit met de gehandicaptenzorg en oprechte belangstelling voor de leefwereld van cliënten. Je onderschrijft de missie, visie en kernwaarden van Pergamijn.

Je:

  • bent op het moment van benoeming actief werkzaam in een reguliere functie in de zorgsector;

  • hebt aantoonbare ervaring als bestuurder en/of leidinggevende binnen een zorgorganisatie;

  • hebt aantoonbare kennis van en inzicht in het primaire proces van een zorgorganisatie;

  • hebt kennis van innovatieve concepten en technologische vernieuwing in de zorg;

  • kunt je een oordeel vormen over de kwaliteit, doelmatigheid en continuïteit van Pergamijn;

  • beschikt over strategisch inzicht en onafhankelijk oordeelsvermogen;

  • kunt complexe ontwikkelingen binnen de gehandicaptenzorg, maatschappij en politiek duiden;

  • handelt integer, transparant en vanuit sterke ethische normen;

  • bent reflectief, organisatiesensitief en samenwerkingsgericht;

  • functioneert effectief binnen een collegiaal toezichthoudend orgaan;

  • beschikt over een relevant netwerk;

  • hebt voldoende tijd en beschikbaarheid om de functie goed te vervullen.

Ervaring als toezichthouder is een pré. Jouw deskundigheid, achtergrond en persoonlijkheid zijn complementair aan die van de overige leden van de Raad van Toezicht.

Bezoldiging

De bezoldiging is vastgesteld binnen de kaders van de Wet normering topinkomens en de richtlijnen van de NVTZ. Reis- en onkosten worden volgens de geldende regeling vergoed.

Interesse en procedure

Wil jij vanuit jouw ervaring en maatschappelijke betrokkenheid bijdragen aan de toekomst van Pergamijn? Stuur dan je motivatiebrief en curriculum vitae uiterlijk donderdag 17 september om 12.00 uur naar raadvantoezicht@pergamijn.org.

De briefselectie is op woensdag 23 september en de selectiegesprekken worden gehouden op vrijdag 16 oktober tussen 13.00-18.00 uur in Sittard. De voorkeurskandidaten worden vervolgens uitgenodigd voor een tweede gesprek met de adviescommissie op donderdagmiddag 22 oktober tussen 15.00-17.00 uur, eveneens in Sittard.

We vragen kandidaten om bij hun sollicitatie alvast rekening te houden met deze data.

Voor meer informatie is Hans Hendrikx, voorzitter van de Raad van Toezicht, bereikbaar op 8, 10 en 15 september van 17.00-19.00 uur. Voor het maken van een afspraak kun je contact opnemen met het bestuurssecretariaat via raadvantoezicht@pergamijn.org

title: Scholarship Associate
description:
MEETING SACRIFICE WITH HOPE SINCE 2007.

It began with Lt Col Dan Rooney’s flight home from his second tour of duty in Iraq. An F-16 fighter pilot in the Oklahoma Air National Guard, he became painfully aware of the realities families face when a loved one in uniform is fallen or disabled.

As his flight landed, the pilot announced they carried the remains of Corporal Brock Bucklin on board. Lt Col Rooney watched as Corporal Bucklin’s twin brother walked somberly alongside the flag-covered casket to meet his family on the tarmac. Among them was the deceased Corporal’s young son, Jacob.

Since that night, Lt Col Rooney has committed his life to rallying patriotic Americans and meeting sacrifice with hope through the Folds of Honor. Since 2007, we’ve provided life-changing scholarships to the spouses and children of America’s fallen or disabled military. And now, our mission expands to the families of America’s first responders. On our watch, those who protect our freedoms and our families will know they are not forgotten.

Through education we meet sacrifice with hope. Each scholarship is a commitment to the families of those who bravely serve and protect our country and communities.

Folds of Honor Foundation

TITLE: Scholarship Associate

FLSA: Non-Exempt

REPORTS TO: Director of Scholarships

FUNCTION: Scholarships

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS: None

JOB FAMILY: Scholarships

PRIMARY JOB FUNCTION:

Supports the Folds of Honor by assisting in the administration and monitoring of programs, processes, and communications related to the Foundation’s scholarship programs. This position communicates with potential, current, and past recipients in addition to staff, donors, and other outside contacts providing the most accurate, appropriate information about the Foundation’s scholarship programs. Also responsible for maintaining applicant and scholar information; relaying information and resources to both internal and external customers; and providing administrative support to the department.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

Reasonable Accommodations Statement

To accomplish this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform, with or without reasonable accommodation, each essential function satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to help enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Manage and direct large amounts of incoming and outgoing calls and e-mails from scholarship applicants and recipients within 24 hours of receipt.
  • Serve as initial contact and provide information on programs, eligibility, application, and the awarding process for applicants, recipients, parents, schools, donors, and alumni.
  • Log incoming calls and/or inquiries within departmental systems, such as Elevate and/or Zengine.
  • Manage email correspondence in Scholarships email box to ensure all email communication is handled in an appropriate, timely manner.
  • Aid and follow up on various scholarship issues, including communication via email or phone with recipients, parents, and/or school personnel.
  • Support the application and awarding processes by receiving, processing, and managing all applicant and scholar documents, information and data and assisting with the evaluation of documentation and award payments.
  • Adhere to all scholarship deadlines.
  • Assist with ad hoc reporting as needed.
  • All other duties as assigned.

title: RECEIVER-2nd Shift (1:30 pm - 10:00 pm)
description:
The Receiver will accept all authorized incoming steel deliveries and associated shipping documents. This entails conducting thorough receiving inspections to ensure the quality and accuracy of the received materials.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Ensures the cleanliness and calibration of designated testing and measuring equipment at the commencement of each shift.
  • Obtains and reviews the schedule of inbound shipments at the onset of every shift.
  • Accepts all shipping documents and incoming steel for authorized inbound shipments.
  • Provides guidance and advice to associated support personnel as necessary.
  • Executes all assigned administrative functions efficiently and accurately.
  • Adheres to all safety protocols outlined in the plant safety handbook.
  • Demonstrates punctuality and adherence to attendance requirements as stipulated in the Attendance Policy.
  • Other duties as assigned.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION

  • High school diploma or equivalent (GED) is a prerequisite.
  • Possesses comprehensive proficiency in operating various measuring devices including tape measures, micrometers, and calipers.
  • Holds a valid forklift operator license, demonstrating the ability to operate forklifts within their specified capacities and conduct necessary inspections.
  • Successfully trained in and proficient at operating overhead cranes, including understanding capacities and performing required inspections.
  • Demonstrates adeptness in utilizing a wide array of lift devices such as ID lifters (skids), spreader bars, "C" hooks, sheet lifters, etc.
  • Capable of effectively identifying and locating loads for staging purposes.
  • Stratix Software experience a plus.
  • Exhibits strong interpersonal skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with team members and collaborate productively in a team-oriented environment.

PHYSICAL AND MENTAL REQUIREMENTS:

Employees are standing/walking 100% of the time; lifting up to 50 lbs. as needed; reading charts, tags, and written procedures; printing or writing legibly to complete all required paperwork; weighing and measuring material as required.

EQUIPMENT, AIDS, TOOLS:

Proper personal protective equipment (PPE) including gloves, safety glasses, and steel-toed boots. The ideal candidate will possess the capability to qualify for a hi-lo license, demonstrating proficiency in operating forklifts. This position requires the use of various measuring tools such as calipers, tape measures, micrometers, and hand tools. Additionally, competence in operating crimpers and plasma cutters is essential. Proficiency in conducting computer inquiries is also required. Furthermore, experience in operating overhead cranes is highly preferred.

WORKING CONDITIONS: The plant is on one level, accessible directly from the parking lot. The primary work environment is within a steel manufacturing facility, which includes:

  • Stairs in the rail pit and up to the slitter platforms.
  • Short ladders on the banding lines to climb from the floor to the conveyor.
  • Seasonal variations in temperatures from 60 to 95+ degrees;
  • Limited exposure to diesel fumes as trucks move through the plant
  • Exposure to moving machinery, heavy equipment, and sharp objects.
  • Work areas may be subject to fluctuating temperatures, including hot and cold conditions, dependent on the season.
  • Loud noise from machinery and equipment operation.
  • The presence of dust, debris, and airborne particles typical of an industrial setting.
  • Adherence to strict safety protocols to mitigate risks associated with the manufacturing process.

SUPERVISION AND CO-WORKERS/ATTENDANCE REQUIREMENTS:

Supervision and/or co-worker assistance are readily available. Attendance is closely monitored, as unscheduled absences may jeopardize meeting customer requirements due to insufficient staffing.

CONSEQUENCES IF ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS NOT PERFORMED

  • Failure to follow established safety rules and procedures may result in loss of position or termination of employment.
  • Failure to meet the requirements of the Attendance Policy will result in termination of employment.
  • Failure to observe safety procedures in material handling may result in serious injury up to fatality and/or damage and loss of material or property.
  • Failure to move material in a timely manner may result in production delays or customer delivery delays, which may in turn result in the loss of business.
  • Failure to complete appropriate paperwork may result in inventory shortage through loss of material or improper billing of the customer.
  • Improper storage of material may result in damage/loss of material.

Management retains the right to change this job description or add to the duties at any time.

title: Magazijnmedewerker Coördinerend
description:
Louwman Logistics zoekt een Magazijnmedewerker Coördinerend die het overzicht bewaart op de werkvloer, collega's ondersteunt en ervoor zorgt dat dagelijkse logistieke processen soepel verlopen. Jij bent het aanspreekpunt binnen het team, houdt de voortgang in de gaten en werkt zelf ook mee. Ben jij klaar voor de volgende stap in je logistieke carrière?

Wat ga je doen?

Als Magazijnmedewerker Coördinerend combineer je operationele magazijn werkzaamheden met een coördinerende rol binnen het team. Je houdt overzicht over de dagelijkse operatie, ondersteunt collega's en zorgt ervoor dat de werkzaamheden efficiënt en volgens planning verlopen. Samen met je collega's zorg je ervoor dat de dagelijkse doelstellingen en KPI's worden behaald.

Werkzaamheden waar jij je zoal mee bezig gaat houden:

  • Het opstellen van de dagelijkse werkplanning.

  • Het bewaken van KPI's en de voortgang van de werkzaamheden.

  • Het ontvangen, controleren en verwerken van inkomende goederen.

  • Het verzamelen, controleren, verpakken en verzendklaar maken van orders.

  • Het oplossen van operationele knelpunten, zoals mispicks en voorraadverschillen.

  • Het signaleren en begeleiden van ICT- en systeemgerelateerde problemen.

  • Het begeleiden en ondersteunen van collega's bij operationele vraagstukken.

  • Het inwerken van nieuwe medewerkers.

  • Het uitvoeren van verbeteractiviteiten volgens de Lean werkwijze.

Daarnaast ben je in staat om zelfstandig een dienst op te starten en af te sluiten en kun je werkzaamheden van de teamleider overnemen wanneer dat nodig is.

Wat vragen wij van jou?

Jij bent een ervaren logistiek medewerker die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt en collega's weet mee te nemen in de dagelijkse operatie. Je bent communicatief sterk, denkt in oplossingen en houdt het hoofd koel wanneer de druk toeneemt. Daarnaast ben je iemand die graag initiatief toont en flexibel is ingesteld.

Verder beschik je over:

  • MBO 4 werk- en denkniveau.

  • Relevante ervaring in een vergelijkbare logistieke magazijnfunctie.

  • Relevante ITM-certificaten.

  • Ervaring met WMS- en/of ERP-systemen.

  • Goede mondelinge en schriftelijke beheersing van de Nederlandse taal en een redelijke beheersing van de Engelse taal.

Wat kan je van ons verwachten?

  • Een salaris tussen de €3.000 en 3.300 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring.

  • Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen per jaar (op basis van een fulltime dienstverband) en hebt de mogelijkheid om tot twee extra werkweken bij te kopen. Zo kun je je vrije tijd flexibel invullen.

  • Je ontvangt 8% vakantiegeld bovenop je salaris, en dat wordt elke maand automatisch uitbetaald, wel zo overzichtelijk!

  • Je pensioen wordt geregeld via BPF Metaal & Techniek. Louwman betaalt 17,7% van de premie en jij draagt 10,28% bij. Zo bouwen we samen aan jouw toekomst.

  • Je ontvangt een netto reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,23 per kilometer. Kom je met de fiets? Dan profiteer je van extra gunstige voorwaarden: je ontvangt € 0,30 per kilometer. Goed voor je gezondheid én je portemonnee.

  • Je profiteert van aantrekkelijke personeelskorting op producten van Louwman Group, zoals auto’s, motoren, private lease, fietsen en watersportproducten.

  • De mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan collectieve verzekeringen waaronder een zorgverzekering en een (privé)autoverzekering met 20% korting.

  • Bij Louwman geloven we in groei. Je krijgt toegang tot een breed aanbod aan opleidingen en cursussen via onze digitale leeromgeving, zodat je je kunt blijven ontwikkelen op een manier die bij jou past.

  • Een tip-de-topper programma waarbij je tot en met € 1.250 euro netto kan verdienen bij het aandragen van een nieuwe medewerker voor Louwman Group.

Wie zijn wij?

title: Senior QA Automation Architect
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What is the role?

Roku is seeking a Senior QA Automation Architect to help evolve test automation capabilities from primarily AV-sync testing into broader audio quality coverage across Roku TVs, soundbars, and headphones. In this role, you will partner closely with the team lead to architect and advance the automation ecosystem, with a strong emphasis on AI-driven innovation through internal initiatives. You will design and implement test analysis systems that identify quality gaps, predict failure patterns, and optimize test effectiveness across products. This role requires a self-motivated, detail-oriented professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and is comfortable working through ambiguity while navigating evolving priorities. You will establish new methodologies for measuring and improving test quality beyond simple pass/fail metrics, focusing on regression prevention and production reliability. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in test architecture, embedded systems automation, and AI-powered quality assurance, and is excited to drive meaningful transformation in how Roku tests and delivers audio experiences.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.

We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

  • Design and implement test analysis systems that identify quality gaps, predict failure patterns, and optimise test effectiveness
  • Design systems that collect, analyse, and act on testing data to continuously improve quality processes
  • Leverage AI-powered tools to implement test automation, failure analysis, and root cause identification
  • Establish new methodologies for measuring and improving test quality beyond simple pass/fail metrics, focusing on regression prevention and production reliability
  • Define and implement architectural patterns that make testing more effective, maintainable, and aligned with business impact
  • Drive systematic regression tracking and implement processes to prevent regression reoccurrence
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align quality initiatives with broader engineering goals
  • Mentor engineers on best practices in test architecture, automation design, and AI-assisted quality assurance

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

  • Expertise in test architecture and automation systems design
  • Programming experience across multiple languages, with Python as a core requirement
  • Expertise in test automation with embedded systems in the loop
  • Proven track record driving test transformation initiatives that significantly improved test effectiveness and reduced production issues
  • Ability to design, implement, and optimize solutions leveraging AI tools and predictive analytics for quality assurance
  • Knowledge of continuous integration tools (Jenkins, GitLab, TeamCity, AWS) and their optimization for quality gates
  • Experience with test flakiness analysis, failure pattern recognition, and automated root cause identification
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence senior leadership and cross-functional teams on quality initiatives
  • Experience mentoring engineers and driving organisational change in testing practices
  • Experience as a project QA or development lead, or in a similar capacity
  • Certifications or training in AI/ML or AI-driven testing approaches
#LI-AM3

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit .

If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

title: Clinical Director (52651)
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Clinical Director provides clinical leadership, supervision, and oversight for the program to ensure the delivery of high-quality, evidence-based behavioral health services to individuals experiencing mental health and behavioral health crises. This position is responsible for maintaining appropriate clinical standards, supervising and supporting clinical staff, monitoring clinical documentation and service delivery, and ensuring compliance with applicable licensing, contractual, accreditation, regulatory, and organizational requirements.

The Clinical Director provides leadership in the development and implementation of trauma-informed, recovery-oriented, culturally responsive, and person-centered services. The position serves as a clinical resource for complex and high-risk cases and may provide direct clinical services as needed, including mental health assessments, crisis intervention, suicide and safety risk assessments, individual and and group counseling, treatment planning, and clinical consultation.

Essential Job Functions include those listed below.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Clinical Leadership and Oversight

  • Provides clinical leadership, direction, and oversight for behavioral health services delivered within the program.
  • Ensures clinical services are consistent with evidence-based practices, applicable standards of care, contractual requirements, and organizational policies and procedures.
  • Promotes trauma-informed, recovery-oriented, person-centered, and culturally responsive approaches throughout delivery service.
  • Provides clinical consultation and guidance regarding complex, high-risk, or challenging cases.
  • Supports the development, implementation, and evaluation of clinical programming, protocols, workflows, and service-delivery practices.
  • Participates in interdisciplinary treatment planning and case consultation as appropriate.
  • Collaborates with program leadership to identify clinical service needs, barriers, trends, and opportunities for program improvement.

Clinical Supervision and Staff Development

  • Provides clinical supervision, consultation, coaching, and support to assigned clinical staff in accordance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
  • Provides or coordinates clinical supervision for staff working toward independent licensure when permitted by applicable state requirements and the Clinical Director's licensure.
  • Supports clinical staff in developing competencies related to assessment, diagnosis, treatment planning, crisis intervention, suicide prevention, documentation, and evidence-based practices.
  • Participates in the recruitment, selection, orientation, training, and development of clinical staff.
  • Monitors clinical performance and provides timely feedback, coaching, and corrective guidance when appropriate.
  • Identifies training and professional development needs and assists in developing strategies to strengthen clinical practice.
  • Promotes effective communication, interdisciplinary collaboration, professional boundaries, and ethical clinical practice.

Crisis Intervention and Risk Management

  • Provides clinical leadership and consultation for individuals experiencing behavioral health crises.
  • Conducts or oversees suicide risk assessments, safety assessments, crisis evaluations, and other clinical assessments as appropriate.
  • Assists staff in determining appropriate interventions, safety planning, referrals, escalation, and levels of care for individuals presenting with elevated clinical risk.
  • Provides consultation regarding psychiatric emergencies, suicidal ideation, self-harm risk, behavioral escalation, and other complex clinical situations.
  • Ensures appropriate documentation, communication, follow-up, and reporting related to significant clinical events.
  • Collaborates with emergency services, hospitals, behavioral health providers, community partners, and other resources when necessary to support continuity and safety of care.

Direct Clinical Services

As program needs require, the Clinical Director may:

  • Conduct comprehensive mental health and behavioral health assessments.
  • Conduct suicide, self-harm, violence, and other safety risk assessments within the scope of professional practice.
  • Develop and review individualized treatment and service plans.
  • Provide crisis intervention, stabilization, and safety planning.
  • Provide individual, family, and group counseling or psychotherapy within the scope of licensure.
  • Provide clinical consultation for complex cases.
  • Facilitate referrals and coordination with appropriate behavioral health, medical, psychiatric, and community-based services.
  • Maintain an assigned clinical caseload when required by program needs.

Documentation, Compliance, and Quality Improvement

  • Ensures clinical documentation is accurate, timely, complete, clinically appropriate, and compliant with applicable standards.
  • Reviews clinical records, assessments, treatment plans, progress notes, discharge documentation, and other clinical records as required.
  • Conducts or participates in clinical chart reviews, audits, utilization reviews, and quality assurance activities.
  • Monitors clinical practices for compliance with applicable federal and state requirements, licensing standards, accreditation requirements, contractual obligations, and organizational policies.
  • Works collaboratively with Quality Assurance, Compliance, Human Resources, program leadership, and other departments to address identified concerns.
  • Develops and implements corrective actions and clinical improvement strategies when deficiencies are identified.
  • Participates in quality improvement initiatives and uses clinical and program data to identify trends and opportunities to improve service delivery and outcomes.
  • Assists with preparation for licensing, accreditation, contractual, and regulatory reviews as applicable.

Program Leadership and Collaboration

  • Works collaboratively with program leadership to support effective program operations and integration of clinical and administrative functions.
  • Participates in leadership meetings, clinical meetings, case conferences, quality improvement activities, and other program meetings as assigned.
  • Develops and maintains effective working relationships with community providers, hospitals, referral sources, regulatory agencies, and other stakeholders.
  • Supports continuity of care and coordination among behavioral health, medical, psychiatric, social service, and community-based providers.
  • Assists with developing and implementing policies, procedures, clinical protocols, and program standards.
  • Represents the program professionally in interactions with clients, employees, community partners, regulatory agencies, and other stakeholders.
  • Must Embrace and embody the mission, vision, guiding principles, clinical vision, and goals of WestCare Foundation; and
  • Perform all other duties as assigned.

title: DENTAL 3D PRINTING TECHNICIAN
description:
3D Dental Printing Technician

Company Overview

Founded in 2010 and with locations in Tempe and Tucson, JB Dental Lab is a state-of-the-art Full Service Dental Laboratory, specializing in digital Full-Arch Solutions. We take pride in utilizing advanced digital workflows to enhance efficiency and accuracy in dental restorations, reducing chair time and ensuring high-quality outcomes for patients.

Position Summary

Responsible for operating and maintaining 3D printing equipment to support efficient, high-quality production. This role performs routine printer operation, calibration, and preventive maintenance activities, including cleaning, lubrication, leveling, and consumable replacement, while accurately documenting maintenance and calibration results to support quality management system (QMS) requirements. The position also maintains a clean and organized production environment and ensures adequate supplies of resin, alcohol, and other consumables to sustain uninterrupted manufacturing operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate all 3D printers and associated equipment
  • Perform and log basic maintenance tasks on printers (cleaning, lubricating rails, leveling, film changes)
  • Perform and basic calibration tasks on printers and log results for QMS tracking (leveling, shrinkage calibration)
  • Clean production area & equipment as needed
  • Swap and replace production consumables as needed to ensure quality production (alcohol, resin, printer consumables)

Safely handle and dispose of resins and waste products associated with the production process according to SDS info and regulations:

  • Follow instructions on work tickets and Rx forms to ensure quality product
  • Track case production information by scanning cases and entering data into QMS logs
  • Operate CAM/slicing software to prepare jobs for printers
  • Understand relevant dental/down & upstream production tasks to aid production

Know how to support, arrange, hollow, orient, and otherwise manipulate STL models in CAM/slicing software to ensure optimal printing:

Inform the Printing Manager of supplies/equipment that need to be ordered

Safely take down print jobs and remove them from build plates without injuring the parts or yourself

Closely follow post-processing instructions for various resins to ensure parts are both cleaned and cured completely before sending the case out of the department:

  • Bring complicated/biocompatible cases to 3D Printing Manager for QC before or after production as appropriate
  • Bring completed cases to their next area of production
  • Stock common supplies in the printing production area as needed
  • Pick up case pans ready for 3D printing in a timely manner
  • Inform the 3D Printing Manager and front desk staff when cases will be delayed

Recognize common CAD issues and problems in STLs and work with CAD team/3D Printing manager to resolve:

  • Check STL files and print jobs for errors before starting production
  • Know how to use measuring equipment (digital calipers, micrometer) and record accurate results
  • Troubleshoot printing failures and reach out to the 3D Printing Manager for assistance as needed
  • Upload all print job log files to web service designated by the 3D Printing Manager as jobs are completed for tracking and accountability

Know how to post-process 3D-printed parts to remove surface blemishes and support spurs when needed:

  • Coordinate with other departments to complete cases/requests as needed
  • Assist the 3D Printing Manager with other relevant tasks at the Manager's discretion

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Pay with additional bonus potential
  • Benefits including Medical, dental, vision, Life
  • 401k with company match
  • Paid Time off (PTO) plus paid holidays
  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities

JB Dental Lab is an affiliate company of Catalis Dental Lab Partners. If you are interested in learning more about this opportunity and the other Brands under the Catalis Network, you can find us at catalislabs.com. At JB Dental Lab, you are not just joining a Team, you are joining a family, Let’s start building some smiles together.

JB Dental Lab is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Facilities Technician II
description:
🔧 FACILITIES TECHNICIAN II

HVAC & Building Systems | Big Bend Health

Your skills keep our mission moving.

Are you the person everyone calls when something isn't working—and you know how to figure it out?

Do you enjoy troubleshooting HVAC systems, repairing building components, tackling projects, and solving problems before they become bigger problems?

Big Bend Health is looking for a skilled, dependable Facilities Technician II to join our team.

This is an opportunity for an experienced facilities professional who wants more than a routine maintenance job. As a Facilities Technician II, you’ll play a key role in keeping our healthcare and hospice environments safe, comfortable, efficient, and operational across multiple Big Bend Health locations.

And with a primary focus on HVAC and building systems, your technical expertise will have a direct impact on the people and teams we serve.

🛠️ WHAT YOU'LL DO

You'll have a diverse day-to-day role that combines HVAC expertise, skilled building maintenance, troubleshooting, preventive maintenance, projects, and emergency response.

Your responsibilities will include:

❄️ HVAC & Building Systems

  • Inspect, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair HVAC and related building systems.

  • Diagnose mechanical, electrical, controls, airflow, temperature, humidity, and equipment issues.
  • Perform preventive maintenance according to manufacturer recommendations and organizational requirements.
  • Monitor equipment performance and identify aging, inefficient, or repeatedly failing equipment.
  • Recommend repairs, replacements, and opportunities for improved efficiency.
  • Maintain accurate HVAC, preventive-maintenance, service, and equipment records.
  • Coordinate qualified contractors when work exceeds your authorized scope.

🔨 Skilled Building Maintenance

Put your hands-on skills to work with:

  • Carpentry and building repairs
  • Drywall, painting, patching, caulking, flooring and trim
  • Doors, frames, hardware, cabinets, shelving, ceilings and fixtures
  • Minor construction, renovations, installations and facility-improvement projects
  • Safe operation of hand and power tools, ladders, lifts and other maintenance equipment

⚙️ Preventive Maintenance & Asset Management

You'll help us stay ahead of problems—not just react to them.

You'll perform and document preventive maintenance, manage work tickets, monitor recurring equipment issues, maintain asset inventories, and help identify replacement priorities and facility improvement opportunities.

🔧 Multi-Trade Maintenance

Your skills may also be called upon for:

  • Plumbing
  • Electrical and lighting
  • General facility repairs
  • Equipment maintenance
  • Grounds and exterior maintenance
  • Lawn and landscaping upkeep
  • Fleet and facility-support activities
  • Furniture and equipment moves
  • Facility and event setup

You'll work within your training, certifications, authorization, and applicable regulations—and know when it's time to bring in specialized expertise.

Healthcare facilities can't wait for problems to resolve themselves.

A failed HVAC system.
A plumbing emergency.
A power interruption.
Water intrusion.
A safety concern.
A building-system failure.

Your response matters.

As an essential employee, you'll participate in the Facilities Department's established on-call rotation and be prepared to respond to urgent and emergency facility needs during assigned evenings, weekends, holidays, and other non-business hours.

When an issue threatens patient care, life safety, security, utilities, or operations, you'll be part of the team that gets things moving again.

🌳 MORE THAN BUILDINGS

Our facilities don't stop at four walls.

You'll also help maintain grounds, landscaping, entrances, walkways, parking areas, and exterior spaces so our locations remain safe, accessible, and welcoming.

You'll travel between Big Bend Health locations as needed, making this an ideal position for someone who enjoys variety, independence, and solving different challenges throughout the day.
