We're looking for someone who is:

A Problem Solver
You don't just see what's broken—you want to understand why it broke and how to prevent it from happening again.

A Skilled Technician
You have hands-on experience and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty.

A Self-Starter
You can work independently, prioritize your workload, and recognize what needs attention.

A Team Player
You communicate well with coworkers, vendors, contractors, patients, families, and visitors.

Safety-Minded
You understand that healthcare environments require a higher level of attention to safety, infection control, fire/life safety, and regulatory requirements.

A Professional
You take pride in your work, your appearance, your communication, and the condition of the facilities you maintain.

The successful candidate will have working knowledge of facilities maintenance, HVAC/building systems, plumbing, electrical safety, carpentry, mechanical systems, grounds care, and equipment upkeep.

  • Continues professional development and training; keeps current with trends.

  • Assists other department staff as needed to promote a team effort.

  • Ability to manage multiple complex events and deadlines simultaneously while maintaining high service standards.

  • Strong data literacy and ability to use event data to evaluate effectiveness and recommend improvements.

From building water treatment systems for space exploration to keeping the world’s largest solar power stations running, our work matters, and so will yours!

What You’ll Do

  • Delivery: Safely operate company vehicles to deliver DI tanks to multiple customer sites.
  • Hands-On Work: Hook up DI tanks and light troubleshooting to ensure systems are operational.
  • Customer Interaction: Build relationships with customers, answer questions, and provide excellent service.
  • Documentation: Keep detailed logs of travel, maintenance, and deliveries.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Be Hands-on & Learn New Skills: Perfect for those who enjoy a great mix of driving, hauling and installing tanks, and customer interaction.
  • Freedom on the Road: You’re not stuck in an office; you’ll be out in the field, making things happen and home after each shift.
  • Hands-on learning: We support your growth with training in water treatment technology, equipment repair, and industry innovations.
  • Great team, great culture: Join a family-owned company where people genuinely care about each other.
  • Competitive pay & benefits: We take care of our team with competitive compensation, benefits, and opportunities to advance.

What You Bring

  • Valid Class C CDL (with a clean driving record).
  • Experience driving commercial vehicles.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and twist/pull up to 325 Ibs
  • Strong work ethic, attention to detail, and a commitment to safety.
  • Excellent communication skills and a customer-first mindset.

Your Work Environment

  • Full-time position with potential for overtime.
  • On-call rotation – because water emergencies don’t follow a 9-to-5 schedule!
  • Local travel with occasional overnight trips.

Ready to Join the Puretec Team?

If you’re looking for more than just a job, if you want a career with growth, hands-on work, and a company that truly cares, apply today and help us Make Water Better!

Take a look at what it’s like to work as a driver at Puretec by clicking the video link below!

You will also play an important role in integrating AI in a thoughtful and pragmatic way across our products and internal workflows.

title: Credit Controller (12m Fixed Term Contract)

Nice-to-Haves:

title: Persoonlijk Begeleider (Jong)Volwassenen LVB
description:
Jij hebt oprecht interesse in anderen. Je kijkt naar kansen en mogelijkheden om iedereen een zo zelfstandig mogelijk leven te bieden. Past dit bij jou? Solliciteer en wordt onderdeel van ons fijne team!

Hoe maak jij het verschil

Als persoonlijk begeleider bij Elsterveld ga je aan de slag met (jong)volwassenen met een licht verstandelijke beperking en bijkomende problematiek, zoals autisme of hechtingsproblematiek. Je bent goed in het bouwen en onderhouden van een fijne relatie met onze bewoners. Je stelt de zorgplannen op, stimuleert de bewoners om stapjes vooruit te zetten en begeleidt hen naar een zo zelfstandig mogelijk leven. Verder,

  • Werk je samen met familie, verwanten en andere betrokkenen om de ondersteuning zo goed mogelijk af te stemmen;

  • Coach en ondersteun je de begeleiders, in nauwe samenwerking met de teammanager en gedragskundige;

  • Draag je bij aan de regeltaken en teamdoelen en neem je verantwoordelijkheid voor gezamenlijke resultaten.

  • Zijn onregelmatige diensten, slaapdiensten en weekenddiensten onderdeel van je werkrooster.

Wat breng je mee

Jij ziet als persoonlijk begeleider talent waar anderen soms vooral een hulpvraag zien. Je bent positief en maakt makkelijk contact met anderen. Je staat stevig in je schoenen en durft knopen door te hakken. Je zet de bewoner in z’n kracht en herkent de vraag achter de vraag. Jouw voldoening haal je uit kleine successen en de fijne samenwerking met je collega’s. Feedback geven en ontvangen? Daar ben jij een kei in. Daarnaast:

  • Beschik je over een relevant mbo-4 diploma (bijv. MZ) of hbo Social Work;

  • Heb je affiniteit met onze doelgroep.

Hier kom je te werken

Elsterveld is een moderne 24-uurs woonvorm voor 26 bewoners, deels opgezet volgens het spettermodel. Een deel van de bewoners woont in een appartement in de wijk en een deel in de woonvoorziening. De ondersteuning die wordt geboden is gevarieerd en afgestemd op de vraag van onze bewoners en staat in relatie tot het werkrooster. Meer weten over Elsterveld? Klik hier.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Wij vinden het belangrijk dat jij met plezier, energie en vakmanschap je werk kunt doen. Daarom investeren we in jouw ontwikkeling en bieden we volop mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Daarnaast krijg je:

  • Een salaris van minimaal € 2.893 en maximaal € 3.902 bruto o.b.v. 36 uur per week (FWG-niveau 40, cao-ghz), met onregelmatigheidstoeslag, een periodieke salarisverhoging en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%;

  • Vakantietoeslag van 8%, 144 vakantie-uren en 57 uur balansverlof (bij een volledig dienstverband);

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding;

  • Een vaste aanstelling na een succesvolle proefperiode;

  • Een werkkostenregeling (waaronder een tablet- en fietsplan);

  • Toegang tot trainingen, cursussen en opleidingen, waaronder GoodHabitz.

Solliciteer!

Deze vacature staat open voor iedereen die zich hierin herkent. Interesse? Solliciteer direct. Twijfel je of je binnen ons team en in deze functie past? Neem dan gerust contact op met:

Judith Theunissen (teammanager),

📞 06-57 44 75 48 of

Luuk Lelivelt (persoonlijk begeleider),

📞 06-58 88 64 14

  • Er is geen sluitingsdatum;

  • De vacature sluit zodra wij de passende kandidaat hebben gevonden;

  • Interne kandidaten hebben bij gelijke geschiktheid voorrang op een externe kandidaat;

location: ATS Houston in Conroe, TX - TX
description:
Lightning Protection Technician – Houston, TX

Applied Technical Services, LLC (ATS) is a leading provider of critical testing, inspection, certification, and compliance services. Founded in 1967 and headquartered in Marietta, Georgia, ATS employs nearly 2,100 team members across more than 95 locations throughout the United States.

Our purpose is to create a safe and reliable world, and our mission is to deliver assurance through precise technical and professional services.

Position Summary

The ATS Houston office is seeking a hands-on Lightning Protection Technician to support our growing Lightning Protection group.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Role Summary

The Project Engineer is responsible for supporting SPR Flexible solutions projects, facility expansions, and engineering installations. This role works closely with architects, design engineering firms, OEMs, and contractors to ensure new equipment and infrastructure projects are delivered safely, on time, and to specification. The engineer will coordinate technical requirements, assist in layout development, manage site activities, support commissioning, and act as the technical liaison between internal teams and external partners.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Project Planning & Coordination
    1. Support facility layout development in collaboration with architects and design engineers.
    2. Assist in the planning and scheduling of CapEx projects, including equipment installations, utilities, and building modifications.
    3. Prepare project timelines, track progress, and escalate risks or delays.
    4. Review technical drawings, equipment specifications, and installation requirements
  2. OEM & Contractor Management
    1. Coordinate with OEMs on equipment delivery, site requirements, commissioning steps, and training plans.
    2. Work with contractors (electrical, mechanical, civil, HVAC, etc.) to ensure installations meet scope, safety, and performance standards.
    3. Conduct site readiness checks and verify mechanical/electrical utilities are prepared for equipment installation.
    4. Support on bidding processes and vendor evaluations as needed.
  3. Installation & Commissioning Support
    1. Participate directly in new equipment installation, alignment, start-up, and functional testing.
    2. Validate that equipment is performing to specification and document any deviations.
    3. Assist with troubleshooting during commissioning and handoff to operations.
    4. Develop or assist with work instructions, SOPs, and training materials for operators and maintenance teams.
  4. Technical Documentation & Compliance
    1. Maintain accurate project documentation: layouts, utility requirements, checklists, change orders, and commissioning reports.
    2. Ensure compliance with safety standards, building codes, and environmental requirements.
    3. Support internal audits and permitting activities when required.
  5. Cross-Functional Support
    1. Work closely with Production, Maintenance, Safety and Quality to ensure projects align with operational needs.
    2. Provide technical feedback during design reviews, feasibility evaluations, and equipment selection.

title: Product Manager, Peer-to-Peer Events
description:
Highlights:

Location: Poland

Language: Fluent in Russian and English (C1+)

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About Peer-to-Peer at Fundraise Up

Peer-to-Peer turns supporters into fundraisers. Instead of only donating, a supporter creates a fundraising page, invites others to give, joins a team, or participates in an event on behalf of a nonprofit.

We are building Peer-to-Peer as a new product line. The product starts with two connected directions:

  • P2P DIY: self-serve fundraising for birthdays, memorials, personal challenges, and other supporter-led campaigns.
  • P2P Events: structured, time-bound fundraising programs such as walks, runs, rides, climbs, workplace challenges, and recurring event series.

DIY creates the product foundation. Events extends it with registration, teams and captains, event operations, participant communication, attribution, reporting, and integrations. The two directions must work as one coherent product while serving different customer workflows and levels of complexity.

About the Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to own P2P Events within the broader Peer-to-Peer product line.

This is a hands-on software product role covering discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and iteration. You will turn an ambiguous product area into a focused solution grounded in customer, usage, and commercial evidence.

Events and DIY serve different sides of the same system: nonprofits need to run fundraising programs, while participants need effective tools to fundraise. You will work closely with the PM responsible for the broader P2P area so these experiences and their shared capabilities evolve together.

This is not an event-planning or project-coordination role.

What You’ll Own

Define the product direction

  • Turn customer research, market evidence, and business context into a clear product thesis and sequenced roadmap.
  • Choose a focused target segment and event scenario rather than trying to serve the entire category at once.
  • Decide which capabilities belong in the shared P2P foundation and which require an Events-specific model.
  • Keep assumptions, success metrics, scope, risks, and product decisions explicit.

Lead discovery and product definition

  • Work directly with nonprofit event teams, participants, design partners, and internal GTM teams.
  • Validate decisions through interviews, workflow mapping, prototypes, and live product usage.
  • Separate true adoption blockers from feature requests and incumbent-product expectations.
  • Shape problems such as registration, teams and captains, attribution and reporting, event operations, participant communication, and CRM integrations. These are examples—not a pre-committed feature checklist.

Shape and deliver the product

  • Own the product from problem definition through requirements, delivery, launch, and iteration.
  • Write clear requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and decision records.
  • Make day-to-day scope and trade-off decisions with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Research, and QA.
  • Ensure the product can evolve from simpler events to more advanced team structures, event series, and operational workflows without overbuilding the first release.
  • Keep delivery predictable by surfacing dependencies, risks, and unresolved decisions early.

Launch, learn, and drive outcomes

  • Launch and learn through EAPs with clear entry criteria, success measures, readiness requirements, and out-of-scope areas.
  • Understand whether organizations can run events successfully and whether participants activate, fundraise, and return.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, CSM, and Support on positioning, customer commitments, enablement, and competitive context.
  • Connect product evidence to adoption, expansion, pipeline, retention, and GPV.
  • Turn evidence into clear recommendations: iterate, expand, change direction, or stop.

Work AI-native

  • Use AI for research synthesis, prototyping, specification quality, data exploration, and operational automation.
  • Build testable artifacts quickly without outsourcing product judgment.

Requirements

  • 4–7 years of Product Management or Product Ownership experience in a software product company.
  • End-to-end ownership of a customer-facing product area with Engineering and Design.
  • Strong judgment in reducing a large problem space to a focused release and explaining the trade-offs.
  • Experience turning customer evidence and product data into decisions.
  • Clear written communication across requirements, edge cases, metrics, and decision records.
  • Ability to work with multi-actor workflows, permissions, states, and data relationships.
  • High ownership and independence, with fluent written and spoken English.

Strong plus

  • Experience with B2B SaaS, fundraising, payments, registration, events, community, or other multi-sided products.
  • Experience launching a new product area through beta or EAP.
  • Knowledge of CRM integrations, reporting, transaction attribution, analytics, or SQL.
  • Practical use of AI for research, prototyping, analysis, or product operations.

This Role May Not Be a Fit If

  • You are looking for an event-planning or internal project-management role rather than software product ownership.
  • You prefer to receive a fully defined roadmap and requirements instead of helping determine what should be built.
  • You want to work only on strategy and avoid specifications, QA, delivery details, or post-launch iteration.
  • You treat every customer request as a roadmap commitment.
  • You need stable scope and certainty before moving forward.
  • You measure progress mainly by features shipped rather than customer and business outcomes.

Why work with us

  • A strong, collaborative product team that owns what it builds
  • Clear product vision and access to real customer feedback from global nonprofit leaders
  • Flat structure: no politics, just great work with great people
  • Transparent company culture-we share how we’re growing, where revenue comes from, and what’s next
  • Long-term focus: we offer equity options and value sustained, meaningful contribution

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is €5,800 - €6,300 gross.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Benefits

  • 31 days off
  • 100% paid telemedicine plan
  • Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace.
  • English learning courses
  • Relevant professional education

  • Remote working

title: Head of Enterprise Success
description:
Location: Remote (East Coast US or European timezone preferred) | Reports to: Ben Tyrer, VP People and Operations

Laravel is the clean stack for Artisans and agents. Built on the world's most widely used PHP framework, with 80K+ GitHub stars and over 500 million package installs, Laravel Cloud is the fully managed platform purpose-built for Laravel applications, and the fastest growing part of our business. Cloud ARR is on pace to grow exponentially year on year, and our enterprise product, Private Cloud, is growing with it.

This is not a relationship management role dressed up in a management title. It is a build and scale role. You will join a small, effective team, inherit a book of 48 active enterprise customers, and be responsible for putting in place the people, processes, and instrumentation that make our Enterprise Success function systematic, data-driven, and genuinely excellent.

You will manage a team of two Enterprise Success Engineers, growing to three by March 2027 and four by Q3 2027. Each ESE carries a book of customers, deliberately sized to allow the depth of engagement our enterprise customers require, particularly as our platform expands to support multiple languages and frameworks beyond Laravel.

You will report to Ben Tyrer and work closely with James Brooks, Head of Enterprise Enablement, who owns the technical and product side of the enterprise function. Your ESEs surface what customers are doing, struggling with, and asking for. James translates that into the enterprise roadmap. That loop is not a nice to have. It is how we build the right product.

What you will own

The handoff from sales. Every new Private Cloud customer gets a named ESE assigned before or on their first day as a customer. You will formalise this process in partnership with our Head of Solutions Engineering.

Account health infrastructure. You will design and ship a customer health scoring model and a telemetry framework that gives the function meaningful, consistent visibility of how our customers are doing.

The ESE team. You will manage, develop, and grow a team of specialists who are technically fluent, relationship-led, and operationally disciplined.

The product feedback loop. A standing, formal cadence with James that ensures customer signal reaches the enterprise roadmap.

Expansion signal generation. You will build the discipline and logging practice that makes expansion moments visible, documented, and actionable for the sales team.

What you will achieve in your first 30, 60, and 90 days

In your first 30 days, you will not change much. You will spend this period learning the function properly: working alongside ESEs in accounts, sitting in on the sales handoff process end to end, reviewing our customer data, and forming your own clear view of what is working, what is fragile, and what needs to be built first. You will establish a standing cadence with James Brooks within the first two weeks.

By day 60, you will have shipped a working customer health score model. Consistent, agreed, and producing a score for every active Private Cloud customer. You will also have formalised the sales-to-success handoff protocol in writing and agreed it with the sales leadership team.

By day 90, the full telemetry framework is in place. You will have begun producing a regular account health summary for sales and leadership. The product feedback loop with James is running, documented, and evidenced.

Requirements

What we are looking for

  • Demonstrable track record of building and scaling a post-sales success function, not just running one
  • Experience managing deeply Technical Account Managers or Customer Success Engineers in a SaaS environment
  • Technical fluency: not an engineer, but able to earn credibility with ESEs and customers in conversations about infrastructure, deployment, and enterprise engineering problems
  • A process builder/ systemiser by instinct
  • Clear understanding of why structural separation between post-sales and revenue incentives is an advantage

What we are not looking for

  • Someone who has only run a function that was already built
  • A pre-sales or solutions engineering profile repurposed into a post-sales role
  • Someone who prioritises relationship coverage over operational discipline rather than treating them as the same thing
  • A purely commercial CS leader who measures success in renewals and expansion revenue

Benefits

  • Health care plan (Medical, Dental, Vision)
  • Retirement plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life insurance (Basic, Voluntary, AD&D)
  • Paid time off (Vacation, Sick, Public Holidays)
  • Family leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Short and long term disability
  • Work from home
  • Stock option plan

title: Produce Staff
location: Moscow Food Co-op Downtown - Moscow, ID 83843
description:
Join Our Produce Team!

The Moscow Food Co-op is looking for friendly, energetic, and dependable Produce Staff to join our team! If you enjoy working with fresh food, helping customers, staying active, and being part of a fast-paced team, this could be a great fit.

Produce Staff help create a welcoming shopping experience while keeping our Produce Department fresh, abundant, clean, well-stocked, and beautiful. This is a hands-on position that includes customer service, stocking, merchandising, receiving freight, maintaining product quality, and keeping the department clean and organized. The position supports department goals for quality, sales, margin, and service.

What You’ll Do

  • Provide friendly, helpful customer service and greet customers within 30 seconds.
  • Stay approachable and engaged, helping customers find products and answering questions.
  • Stock, rotate, face, trim, wash, and prepare fresh produce.
  • Keep displays full, abundant, attractive, and customer-ready.
  • Regularly check product quality and remove damaged or low-quality produce.
  • Receive and put away deliveries while checking products for quality and accuracy.
  • Maintain clean and organized displays, coolers, prep areas, and backstock.
  • Follow food safety, sanitation, rotation, and product-handling standards.
  • Work with a sense of urgency and take initiative to identify what needs to be done.
  • Support coworkers and other departments, including backup cashiering when needed.
  • Participate in department meetings, inventories, required training, and store-wide initiatives.

The core stocking, rotation, merchandising, receiving, quality, and cleaning responsibilities come directly from the Produce position description.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is:

  • Friendly and customer-focused — you enjoy helping people and creating a welcoming experience.
  • Positive and team-oriented — you communicate respectfully and work well with others.
  • Reliable and accountable — you show up on time, ready to work, and follow through on responsibilities.
  • Motivated and self-directed — you stay productive and look for the next thing that needs to be done.
  • Fast-paced but detail-oriented — you work with urgency without sacrificing quality or customer service.
  • Open to feedback and learning — you want to build your product knowledge and improve your skills.
  • Organized and adaptable — you can prioritize multiple tasks and adjust when department needs change.
  • Interested in fresh, local, seasonal, organic, and natural foods.

Retail, grocery, natural foods, or produce experience is preferred but not required.

What It’s Like to Work in Produce

Produce is an active, physical department. You’ll spend much of your shift on your feet, helping customers, stocking and rotating products, building displays, receiving freight, and keeping the department looking its best.

You must be able to lift and move up to 50 pounds, push or pull carts and racks up to 200 pounds, and frequently bend, reach, squat, kneel, and stoop. You’ll also work in coolers and varying temperatures.

Schedule & Availability

  • Full-time: 35–40 hours per week
  • Part-time: 20–29 hours per week
  • Flexible scheduling, including mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and university breaks
  • Must be able to stand for extended periods and lift up to 50 pounds

Why Work at the Co-op?

We're a community-oriented, values-driven workplace offering a supportive environment, living wages, and excellent benefits. In a recent employee survey, staff overwhelmingly said they're proud to work at the Moscow Food Co-op!

All employees receive:

  • 20% store discount
  • Employee Profit Sharing
  • 401(k) retirement plan participation

Full-time employees also receive:

  • Paid Time Off (PTO) Accrual
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Short-term disability coverage
  • Accidental & hospital insurance
  • Telemedicine & mental health support

Part-time employees working 20+ hours/week receive:

  • Dental insurance
  • Short-term disability, accidental & hospital insurance
  • Telemedicine & mental health support

Position Summary

Produce Staff are responsible for creating a welcoming customer experience while keeping the Produce Department fresh, abundant, clean, well-stocked, and visually appealing. This position stocks and rotates produce, maintains product quality, assists customers, receives freight, and supports the daily cleaning and operational needs of the department.

Produce Staff are expected to work with a sense of urgency, take ownership of their responsibilities, and contribute to department goals for customer service, productivity, quality, sales, margin, and waste reduction.

Customer Service Expectations

Customer service is the top priority at the Co-op. Staff are expected to create friendly, welcoming, and helpful experiences for every customer. Employees should proactively greet customers (30 second rule), remain approachable and engaged on the sales floor, and respond to questions with professionalism and care.

Staff should demonstrate:

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • A positive and solutions-oriented attitude.
  • Patience, professionalism, and respect for diverse customer needs and perspectives.
  • A willingness to learn about products and continuously improve product knowledge.
  • Consistent attention to detail and follow-through.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Customer Service & Community Engagement

Customer service is the top priority at the Moscow Food Co-op. Produce Staff are expected to:

  • Proactively greet and acknowledge customers within 30 seconds of entering the department or coming within the employee’s work area.
  • Remain approachable, attentive, and engaged while working on the sales floor.
  • Provide accurate product information, suggestions, samples, and preparation ideas when appropriate.
  • Help customers locate products and connect them with another employee when additional assistance is needed.
  • Handle questions, concerns, and complaints professionally and respectfully, involving a Lead, Manager, or MOD when appropriate.
  • Maintain knowledge of Produce products, seasonal offerings, local products, and Co-op programs and events.
  • Create a welcoming environment for all customers through patience, professionalism, and respect.

Stocking, Merchandising & Product Quality

  • Keep Produce displays full, abundant, faced, and customer-ready throughout the shift.
  • Stock with a sense of urgency while maintaining product quality and presentation standards.
  • Replenish and rotate displays using proper rotation procedures.
  • Cull displays regularly and promptly remove damaged, spoiled, dated, or low-quality products.
  • Trim, wash, bundle, and prepare produce according to department standards.
  • Accurately record shrink, waste, and discarded products.
  • Maintain accurate signs, pricing, labels, and product information.
  • Create attractive displays and support seasonal merchandising, promotions, resets, and department initiatives.
  • Monitor displays throughout the shift and take initiative to address holes, low inventory, quality issues, or presentation concerns without waiting to be directed.

Receiving & Department Operations

  • Receive freight and verify deliveries for quality, quantity, damage, and accuracy.
  • Report discrepancies and complete required receiving, invoice, and credit documentation.
  • Label, organize, rotate, and properly store incoming freight and backstock.
  • Maintain organized coolers, walk-ins, prep areas, storage areas, and backstock.
  • Monitor cooler temperatures and department equipment and promptly report problems.
  • Complete opening, closing, cleaning, stocking, and other assigned department tasks.
  • Work efficiently and prioritize tasks based on customer and department needs.
  • Support inventories, cycle counts, department meetings, and store-wide initiatives as required.

Cleanliness, Food Safety & Department Presentation

  • Maintain produce cases, wet racks, coolers, prep areas, storage areas, displays, floors, and work areas in a clean and orderly condition.
  • Completes assigned daily cleaning and scheduled deep-cleaning tasks.
  • Follow all food safety, sanitation, product-handling, and storage procedures.
  • Maintain a safe environment for customers and employees.
  • Obtain and maintain a current Idaho food safety card.
  • Immediately address or report spills, hazards, damaged equipment, temperature concerns, and other safety issues.

Co-op-Wide Employee Standards

Customer Service & Communication

  • Provide excellent customer service by creating friendly, welcoming, and helpful experience for every customer.
  • Remain approachable, attentive, and professional while assisting customers, coworkers, and vendors.
  • Communicate effectively with supervisors and team members regarding customer concerns, product issues, and operational needs.
  • Offer product suggestions and respond to questions with professionalism, patience, and respect for diverse customer needs and perspectives.
  • Maintain a positive, solutions-oriented attitude and continuously build product and operational knowledge.

Teamwork & Professionalism

  • Work cooperatively with all departments to support a respectful, inclusive, and team-oriented workplace culture.
  • Demonstrate flexibility by assisting in other areas of the store, including cashier backup and cross-department support as needed.
  • Follow the direction of the Manager on Duty (MOD) and contribute to department and store-wide initiatives.
  • Assist with staff training and participate in Co-op meetings, inventories, and required training.

Operations & Accountability

  • Maintain excellent attendance, punctuality, and scheduling flexibility, including arriving on time and following break and time-off policies.
  • Follow established opening, closing, safety, and operational procedures.
  • Maintain accurate use of scheduling and timekeeping systems and assist with shift coverage when needed.
  • Ensure a safe, organized, and professional environment for customers and staff through attention to detail and follow-through.

title: Afterschool Care Site Lead - Challenger Elementary School

description:

This position serves as the primary point person for the assigned afterschool site during program hours and works directly alongside staff in the daily care and supervision of participants. The Site Lead helps ensure that YMCA policies, program expectations, safety procedures, and youth development practices are consistently followed while building positive relationships with children, parents/guardians, school partners, and YMCA team members.

The ideal candidate is dependable, energetic, organized, and comfortable taking the lead while remaining actively engaged with children and staff.

Essential Functions

Site Leadership & Daily Operations

  • Provide on-site leadership for the assigned afterschool program and help ensure smooth daily operations.
  • Prepare the program space for participant arrival and ensure areas are clean, organized, safe, and ready for activities.
  • Coordinate the daily schedule, including arrival, snack, homework/quiet time, enrichment activities, physical activity, and dismissal.
  • Assign staff responsibilities and provide direction throughout the program day.
  • Work alongside program staff and actively participate in supervision and activities.

  • Create an environment where children feel safe, included, supported, and valued.
  • Lead and participate in age-appropriate recreational, educational, and enrichment activities.
  • Encourage positive behavior, teamwork, respect, responsibility, and healthy social interactions.
  • Use positive behavior-management techniques consistent with YMCA expectations.
  • Respond appropriately to behavioral concerns and communicate significant issues to parents/guardians and program leadership as appropriate.
  • Recognize individual participant needs and help staff provide appropriate support and engagement.

Staff Support & Leadership

  • Help orient and coach staff regarding daily procedures, participant supervision, safety expectations, and program standards.
  • Provide timely feedback and guidance to staff when expectations are not being met.

  • Provide appropriate updates regarding children's participation and program activities.
  • Respond to routine parent/guardian questions and refer significant concerns to program leadership when appropriate.
  • Maintain professional relationships with school personnel and other community partners at the assigned location.
  • Demonstrate excellent customer service and represent the YMCA positively in all interactions.

Safety & Risk Management

  • Maintain a safe environment and immediately address potential hazards or unsafe practices.
  • Follow all YMCA child protection, emergency response, incident reporting, and risk-management procedures.
  • Ensure participants are released only to authorized individuals in accordance with program procedures.
  • Maintain accurate participant counts and know the location of assigned children at all times.
  • Respond appropriately to injuries, emergencies, behavioral incidents, and other unexpected situations.
  • Complete required incident and accident documentation accurately and promptly.
  • Immediately report suspected abuse, neglect, inappropriate conduct, or other child-safety concerns in accordance with YMCA policy and applicable reporting requirements.
  • Maintain confidentiality regarding participants, families, employees, and organizational information.

title: Principal Full-Stack Developer – Full  Time -IST
description:
Principal Full-Stack Developer – Full Time -IST
Location: Hyderabad
Job Type: Full Time
About the Role
We are seeking a Principal Full-Stack Developer to lead the design and development of scalable, secure, and cloud-native software solutions.
The primary focus of this role is full-stack software development and architecture, with strong hands-on experience across backend and frontend technologies. The ideal candidate will also have practical knowledge of cloud infrastructure and database services (Azure, AWS, or OCI) and modern software delivery practices.
DevOps is a secondary responsibility. The candidate should understand how CI/CD pipelines, how to build automation, deployments, monitoring, and release processes work, but this is not primarily an infrastructure administration role.
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the architecture and development of full-stack applications.
  • Design scalable backend services, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems. Programming languages used may vary, though typically it is C#, Java, Python, or Node.
  • Build responsive and maintainable frontend applications. Technologies may vary, but React and Angular are commonly used by our clients as well as frameworks like Twitter Bootstrap, Material Design, or Tailwind.
  • Experience using AI Coding agents effectively is a plus, though we can also train you on the job to use these tools effectively (configuring AGENTS.md, skills, plan versus build modes, etc)
  • Make architectural decisions covering performance, security, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Develop and integrate applications using Azure, OCI, or AWS services.
  • Design database schemas and data-access strategies using SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Review code and establish engineering standards across projects.
  • Guide teams in software architecture, design patterns, testing, and delivery practices.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, cloud, security, and operations teams. Strong communication skills and ability to learn a customer’s business domain is a must.
  • Troubleshoot complex application, integration, performance, and production issues.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline design and deployment automation. Technologies can include simple bash scripting, kubernetes/containerization, Ansible, or terraform, though we do not expect you to be an expert in all of these.
  • Understand and improve build, release, rollback, and environment-promotion processes.
  • Support observability through logging, monitoring, alerting, and application diagnostics.
  • Mentor senior and junior engineers.
  • Adapt quickly across different client domains, technology stacks, and project requirements.
Required Skills and Experience
  • 9 + years of professional experience in software development, architecture, or related engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience developing full-stack applications.
  • Professional experience with at least one backend technology, such as:
    • .NET/C# (preferred)
    • Python (preferred)
    • Java (nice to have)
    • Node.js (nice to have)
  • Strong frontend experience with one or more modern frameworks:
    • React (preferred)
    • React Native (preferred)
    • Angular (nice to have)
    • Vue.js (nice to have)
  • Proven experience designing REST APIs, microservices, integrations, and distributed systems.
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle DB, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
  • Familiarity with NoSQL databases is beneficial.
  • Hands-on application development experience with Microsoft Azure, OCI, or AWS.
  • Understanding of cloud services such as compute, storage, databases, messaging, serverless, identity, networking, and monitoring.
  • Strong knowledge of software architecture principles, design patterns, clean code, and testing.
  • Experience with Git-based development workflows and code reviews.
  • Understanding of CI/CD concepts, including:
    • Build and release pipelines
    • Automated testing
    • Artifact management
    • Environment-specific configuration
    • Deployment approvals
    • Rollbacks
  • Working knowledge of Docker and containerized application deployment.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
DevOps and Cloud Knowledge
DevOps is a supporting responsibility. Candidates should have practical knowledge of:
  • Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar tools.
  • YAML or Classic CI/CD pipelines.
  • Infrastructure and application deployment workflows.
  • Docker and basic Kubernetes concepts is beneficial.
  • Environment management across development, QA, staging, and production.
  • Application logging, monitoring, and alerting.
  • Basic Terraform or Ansible knowledge is preferred.
  • Security practices for cloud-hosted applications.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Previous experience as a technical lead, software architect, or principal engineer.
  • Experience modernizing legacy applications and migrating workloads to Azure, OCI, or AWS.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging platforms.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes and cloud-native application patterns.
  • Experience with API gateways, authentication, authorization, OAuth2, and OpenID Connect.
  • Familiarity with Redis, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, or other NoSQL technologies.
  • Experience with observability tools such as Application Insights, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or Datadog.
  • Experience working with AI-assisted development or integrating AI services into business applications.
  • Consulting experience across multiple clients and technology stacks.


Why Join Us?
  • Lead the technical direction of modern full-stack applications.
  • Work on challenging projects across multiple industries and technology platforms.
  • Influence architecture and engineering practices across client engagements.
  • Work with Azure, AWS, OCI, modern frontend frameworks, APIs, microservices, and cloud-native technologies.
  • Mentor engineers and help build high-performing development teams.
  • Participate in innovative software and AI-driven projects.
  • Receive competitive compensation aligned with experience and technical expertise.

title: Medewerker Financiële Administratie
description:
Word jij onze nieuwe collega? Als Medewerker Financiële Administratie krijg je bij ons volop de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, zowel professioneel als persoonlijk. Jij draagt bij aan het succes van onze klanten, én aan je eigen groei binnen een professioneel en dynamisch team. Past dat bij jou? Kom dan werken bij Joanknecht in Eindhoven en maak samen met ons de toekomst!


Bij Joanknecht draait alles om samenwerking, innovatie en technologie. Vanuit ons moderne kantoor in Eindhoven werken we dagelijks met veel energie en plezier voor ondernemers in de Brainportregio. Wij zijn allesbehalve een traditioneel accountants- en advieskantoor: we staan voor vooruitgang en het verder helpen van onze klanten met slimme oplossingen.

Een dag als Medewerker Financiële Administratie

Je begint de dag met een kop koffie en een korte teammeeting. Samen met je collega’s bespreek je de prioriteiten van de dag: welke klanten hebben vragen, welke administraties moeten worden bijgewerkt, en welke btw-aangiftes staan op de planning? Na de meeting log je in op Exact Online, het platform waarmee we de financiële administratie uitvoeren. Je begint met het controleren en bijwerken van de administratie van een klant uit de retailsector. Je ziet dat er een vraag is binnengekomen over een factuurverwerking. Je pakt de telefoon, neemt contact op met de klant en legt op een heldere manier uit hoe het opgelost kan worden.

Rond lunchtijd ga je gezellig met de collega’s naar de business lounge en geniet je van een heerlijke huisgemaakte lunch en daarna nog een wandeling in het park vlak bij kantoor. De rest van de dag werk je aan de afronding van een kwartaalafsluiting. Tussendoor spar je nog even met een collega over een klantvraag. Voordat je afsluit, kijk je alvast naar de planning voor morgen en noteer je wat nog opgepakt moet worden.

  • Naast een marktconform salaris bieden we je 29 vakantiedagen (op fulltime basis), een goede pensioenregeling, dagelijks verse lunches, maandelijkse massages en iedere dag vers fruit op kantoor!

Kom gerust eens op de koffie om de Joanknecht sfeer echt te proeven! Wil je nu al meer weten hoe het is om bij Joanknecht te werken? Lees onze medewerkersverhalen.

Wat neem je mee?

Je bent enthousiast, accuraat en beschikt over sterke communicatieve vaardigheden. Proactief en met een grote interesse in informatiesystemen pak jij nieuwe uitdagingen met beide handen aan. title: Parts Processor | 2nd Shift (Four 10-Hour Shifts M-Th)
description:

title: Technician II (61249)
description:
**This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

Location:

Greensboro, NC

Overview:

The primary purpose of this position is to serve as an electronics technician responsible for installing, maintaining, and repairing high-end video teleconferencing, audio, and other telecommunications. Installer Level Tech 2 should be familiar with and know how to accomplish the following tasks through on-the-job training and formal certifications for the Technician level. This level employee will have the capability to perform site surveys, develop job plans, demonstrate and follow common safety practices, have the capability to supervise other technicians, and serve as a site superintendent.

Primary Responsibilities:

The Technician is responsible for the following duties.

  • Perform Site Surveys.
    • Use blueprints/floor plans to conduct visual site inspections.
    • Prepare site survey report to include local support facilities for parts, living and rental requirements.
  • Develop Job Plans.
    • Determine materials/delivery schedules in conjunction with the project manager.
    • Develop tool/equipment lists.
    • Review manpower requirements bid for the job and evaluate.
    • Calculate completion dates.
    • Be able to utilize Microsoft schedule software.
  • Build Closets.
    • Determine equipment layouts.
    • Mount/install backboards.
    • Mount/install cross-connects.
    • Mount/install racks/patch panels.
    • Install optical fiber panels/hardware.
    • Install entrance facility grounding infrastructure.
    • Perform grounding tests.
  • Install Grounding Infrastructure.
    • Know local and National Electrical Code basics.
    • Install grounding backbones and busbars.
    • Perform grounding tests.
  • Installation of Cable Support Systems.
    • Install cable support systems to include cable trays, ladder racks, j-hooks, and Bridle/D-rings.
  • Pulling Cable.
    • Pull Backbone cable- Bottom-up or top-down, along the path parallel to floor and ceiling.
    • Pull horizontal cable- in conduit, in the open ceiling, optical fiber cable in innerduct
  • Firestopping.
    • Core firewall, install sleeves, pull cable, firestop
  • Pretermination.
    • Organize, form, dress cables-determine length/slack-label cables
  • Termination.
    • Complete IDC terminations, UTP (Krone, BIX, 110, 66), ScTP, STP-A, Cross connect blocks, Patch Panels
  • Connectors.
    • Assemble and Install 8-pin modular connectors-coaxial connectors-fiber optic connectors, demonstrate connector color codes.
  • Splicing.
    • Splice copper cable and optical fiber (mechanical/fusion).
  • Testing.
    • Copper cable Category 5/5E/6 certification using handheld testers.
    • Optical fiber single-mode/multimode using light source/power meter and OTDR.
    • Use tone test set, volt-ohm meter- diagnose open, shorted crossed, and split pairs-active circuits
  • Troubleshooting.
    • Diagnose and correct copper and optical fiber problems.
    • Troubleshoot commonly installed AV and security systems.
  • Retrofits.
    • Identify active circuits and implement a cutover.
  • Local Area Networks.
    • Demonstrate knowledge of LAN topologies (Ethernet, token ring). LAN ANSI/TIA/EIA cabling standards. LAN components (Servers, hubs, routers, bridges)
  • Audio Visual/Security.
    • Demonstrate knowledge of multi-classification Audio Visual systems.
  • Administrative Tasks.
    • Document test results.
    • Document “as built’s”.
    • Complete daily reports.
    • Order/inventory materials.
  • Remain Current on Industry Practices.
    • Attend training/safety meetings.
    • Read industry journals/magazines.
    • Join professional trade organizations.
    • Keep up with standards and codes.
  • Safety.
    • Demonstrate common safety practices IAW, Unicom Government safety manual, and OSHA regulations.
  • Standard Codes.
    • Demonstrate knowledge of ANSI/TIA/EIA-568-A, 569-A, 606,607, and the National Electric Code.
  • Rigging.
    • Installation of overhead projection systems, speakers, microphones, and other functions as required to meet the needs of the project, following guidelines recommended by Avixa, formerly InfoComm International CTS practices, and other Federal, State, and Local requirements.
  • Other functions as required to meet the needs of the company.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

None

title: Resident Service Coordinator - La Resolana
description:
Who We Are

Redwood Communities, Inc. (“Redwood Communities”), an affiliate of Redwood Housing, is a multifamily property management organization that manages affordable housing communities throughout the country. To date, Redwood Communities has assembled a best-in-class team that currently manages a growing portfolio of properties and has built strong working relationships with government agencies and leading non-profit organizations to raise the standard of living for our communities.

Benefits

  • Exceptional medical benefits: We cover more than 90% of medical premiums, and employees have the option of a 100% employer-paid HSA medical plan.
  • 100% company paid dental and vision benefits for employee coverage.
  • Healthcare and dependent care flexible spending accounts.
  • Company paid life insurance, AD&D
  • Best-in-class voluntary insurance benefits.
  • Pre-tax and Roth 401(k) programs with a company match equal to 100% of the first 6% contributed by the employee.
  • Employee assistance program (EAP) with 24/7 counseling services.
  • 3 weeks of paid time off each year.
  • 12 paid holidays each year & 2 floating holidays.

About the Position

The Resident Service Coordinator (RSC) is responsible for assessing resident needs, identifying community resources, and developing supportive services to enhance the quality of life for residents living in HUD-assisted housing. The RSC works to promote housing stability, self-sufficiency, and resident well-being while ensuring compliance with HUD program requirements and fair housing laws.

Schedule: Monday-Friday 8am-5pm

Pay Details: $23-25hr

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Resident Support & Advocacy:

  • Serve as a liaison between residents, property management, and community agencies.
  • Assess resident needs through interviews, surveys, and case notes to determine appropriate support services.
  • Assist residents in accessing benefits such as SNAP, Medicaid, Medicare, Social Security, and energy assistance.
  • Provide crisis intervention and referrals for issues such as mental health, domestic violence, food insecurity, and substance use.
  • Maintain confidentiality and adhere to professional boundaries. Program Development & Coordination.
  • Develop and coordinate on-site programs that promote health, education, employment readiness, and community engagement.
  • Partner with local organizations to bring services on-site (e.g., health screenings, transportation assistance, financial literacy workshops).
  • Facilitate resident meetings, community-building events, and resource fairs.

Compliance & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate resident case files in accordance with HUD guidelines and company policy.
  • Track and report program outcomes to HUD, ownership, and management as required.
  • Ensure compliance with HUD’s Service Coordinator Program Handbook, including reporting in the HUD Multifamily Housing Service Coordinator Program Annual Report (HUD Form 92456).
  • Protect resident privacy in compliance with HUD, HIPAA, and Fair Housing regulations.

Collaboration

  • Work closely with property management to identify residents at risk of eviction and develop intervention strategies.
  • Attend staff meetings and collaborate with the management team to support community stability.
  • Build relationships with community agencies, service providers, and government organizations.

title: Finance Assistant (34817)
description:
Who We Are

At KLS Martin, we offer a unique opportunity to contribute to the success of a dynamic and thriving company whose products are used daily across the world to help surgical patients.

The KLS Martin Group is a worldwide leader in creating surgical solutions for the craniomaxillofacial and cardiothoracic fields. Surgical innovation is our passion, and we are constantly working with surgeons to improve surgical care for their patients. Our product portfolio includes titanium and resorbable implants for reconstruction, innovative distraction devices to stimulate bone lengthening, over 4,000 surgical instruments, and other surgical products designed specifically for CMF and cardiothoracic surgeons.

KLS Martin is an innovative leader in the treatment of CMF deformities and trauma cases. We use Individual Patient Solutions (IPS) by using our proprietary IPS products where CT scans are used to custom design implants that are created specifically for that individual patient. This technology allows our surgeons to provide the best-in-class treatment for their patients.

KLS Martin Guiding Principles

  • Established, Privately Held Business Group – Responsive to customers, not shareholders. KLS Martin has manufactured medical products since 1896, and we have sold our products in the United States under the KLS name since 1993. We have always been, and always will be, privately owned.

The Finance Assistant provides part-time administrative and accounting support to the Finance department while gaining practical experience in accounts payable, accounting operations, financial systems and business processes. title: Service Delivery Manager Secure
description:
Service Delivery Manager - Secure

(voor 4 of 5 dagen per week in Lijnden, Gouda en/of thuis)

Bouw mee aan het vertrouwen van onze Secure-klanten, met oog voor detail en een proactieve houding.

Als Service Delivery Manager bij Wortell ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze Secure-klanten. Je houdt overzicht op afspraken en SLA's, zorgt dat vragen en verzoeken snel de juiste weg vinden en leert stap voor stap hoe je onze IT-beveiligingsdienstverlening op koers houdt. Je werkt nauw samen met ervaren collega's, die je begeleiden in ITIL-processen en Microsoft-technologieën. Werk je graag in een dynamische omgeving waar je veel leert, veiligheid voorop staat en je stap voor stap doorgroeit in het vak? Dan is deze rol een mooie start.


Kerntaken

  • Aanspreekpunt Klanten

    Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze Secure-klanten en de vaste schakel tussen de klant en het interne team. Je kent de contractafspraken en SLA's goed en weet daardoor snel te beoordelen wat een vraag concreet betekent. Binnenkomende vragen pak je zorgvuldig op, je beantwoordt ze waar mogelijk zelf en schakelt anders snel door naar de juiste collega. Zo zorg je dat klanten altijd het gevoel hebben gehoord te worden en dat niets blijft liggen, ook niet wanneer het even druk is.

  • Dienstverleningsregie & dashboarding

    Je volgt de lopende serviceprocessen op de voet en houdt de standaardrapportages nauwkeurig bij, zodat er altijd een actueel beeld is van hoe de dienstverlening aan onze klanten verloopt. Opvallende patronen of afwijkingen signaleer je tijdig en bespreek je met je collega's, zodat er samen gekeken kan worden of er actie nodig is. Door dagelijks met deze data te werken, bouw je stap voor stap gevoel op voor wat normaal is binnen een klantomgeving en wat aandacht verdient.

  • Contracten en facturatie

    Je houdt overzicht op de lopende contracten van jouw klanten en weet welke afspraken daarin zijn vastgelegd. Elke maand ondersteun je bij het opstellen van de facturatie, waarbij je controleert of de gegevens kloppen en aansluiten bij de gemaakte afspraken. Simpele klantvragen over facturen of contractvoorwaarden beantwoord je zelfstandig, terwijl je bij complexere vraagstukken tijdig een ervaren collega betrekt. Zo draag je bij aan een transparante en betrouwbare relatie met de klant.

  • Risicomanagement

    Je hebt oog voor de securityrisico’s bij jouw klanten. Je signaleert proactief kwetsbaarheden, afwijkingen en ontwikkelingen die de digitale weerbaarheid kunnen beïnvloeden en brengt deze onder de aandacht van de klant. Samen met onze solution specialisten vertaal je deze signalen naar concrete risico’s en passende verbetermaatregelen. Zo help je klanten niet alleen om de dienstverlening goed te laten functioneren, maar ook om hun digitale veiligheid structureel te verbeteren.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je beschikt over een hbo werk- en denkniveau;

  • Je hebt bij voorkeur een eerste jaar werkervaring in een vergelijkbare rol, of je bent recent afgestudeerd met een relevante stage- of studieachtergrond;

  • Je hebt affiniteit met cybersecurity-oplossingen en IT-dienstverlening;

  • Basiskennis van ITIL-processen; een ITIL Foundation-certificering is een pré;

  • Eerste ervaring met SLA's en Managed Services-omgevingen is een pré;

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse & Engelse taal.

Sluiten niet alle functie-eisen aan maar heb je wel ambitie om te leren? Dan ontvangen we alsnog graag jouw sollicitatie!


Wat bieden wij?

Wat werken bij Wortell daarnaast extra aantrekkelijk maakt zijn de volgende arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Een salaris passend tussen de €3.800 en €5.650 bij jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • Auto of mobiliteitsvergoeding;

  • Flexibiliteit bij het indelen van je werktijden én werkplek;

  • Een devices budget welke je vrij kunt besteden aan laptop of mobiel naar wens;

  • 25 vakantiedagen en opbouw van extra loyaliteitsdagen, met de mogelijkheid bij te kopen of te verkopen of op te sparen voor sabbatical;

  • Interne coaches én carrière coaches die je kunnen begeleiden waar je dat nodig hebt;

  • Dagelijks goed verzorgde lunch;

  • En een verbetermeter! Kunnen wij iets beter doen, vertel het ons!


Waarom Wortell de juiste stap is voor jouw carrière?

Bij Wortell begrijpen we elkaar: we zetten mensen op de eerste plaats. Hier werk je samen met een team van experts, werk je elke dag met de laatste technieken, met als doel om onze klanten in hun kracht te zetten. Want dat is volgens ons waar technologie voor staat: we empower people, zodat in een wereld vol verandering het nog steeds de mensen zijn die het verschil kunnen maken.

title: Memory Care Med-Tech - PM Shift - $400 Hiring Bonus
description:
***$400 Hiring Bonus** $200 paid out at hire and $200 after 6 months of employment***

Pasadena Highlands is looking for dependable and caring individual to join our team as a Memory Care Med-Tech.
Salary: Starting at $19.00/hour

The Medication Technician is responsible for the safe administration of medications to residents as ordered by the attending physician, under the direction of the attending physician, and Health Services Director and in accordance with established nursing standards, the policies, procedures and practices of the property, and the requirements of the state. Responsible for maintaining a current accounting of all medications residents are taking and the documentation required for that process. Responsible to report all change in status of residents as it relates to assisting with medications. Reports to: Health Services Director or Journey Program Director, as assigned.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS, DUTIES AND RESPONSIBLITIES

The essential duties and responsibilities described below are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the basic functions of the position. While every effort has been made to identify the essential functions of the position, it in no way states or implies that these are the only duties you will be required to perform. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related or is an essential function of the position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

1. At the direction of the Health Services Director or Journey Program Director, coordinate medication services with resident, pharmacy and physician. Prior to resident’s arrival, inform the local pharmacy of the medication needs of new residents, verify medications and proper dosages with physician. Medication is not to be dispensed until verification with physician is complete.

2. Order additional medications as needed and directed by the Health Services Director or Journey Program Director.

3. Track all orders for medication changes and/or refills.

4. Report to the Health Services Director or Journey Program Director any changes in medication order for residents, residents requiring extra services on a continual basis, and any changes in resident physical or mental status.

5. Assist the Resident Services Director in maintaining and providing accurate and inclusive records on all residents. This may include the completion of Medication Administration Record (MAR) duplicate sheets for any changes in a particular resident’s medication, performing monthly audits/checks on all residents’ charts, assisting with the processing of a new resident’s paperwork, filing and maintaining resident files in a professional manner.

6. As requested, maintain an inventory of all department supplies. Notify the Health Services Director or Journey Program Director timely and/or place supply orders, with a supervisor’s approval, when supply levels reach a pre-designated threshold.

7. As directed, act as the main point of contact for physicians, family members and vendors in the absence of the Health Services Director or Journey Program Director.

8. At the direction of the Health Services Director or Journey Program Director, assist with department scheduling including covering call-offs, vacations and the elimination of overtime.

9. As required, update the Caregiver Monthly Assignment Journal, Medication Technician Med List and 24 Hour Communication Log.

10. Assists residents with their daily medications, treatments and resident care as assigned and within the scope of practice, policy and procedures and Title 22 Regulations.

11. Observe and verify that medication is ingested or applied as directed. Document any instance where prescribed medication is not administered, including reason(s) for refusal and notify supervisor and/or Executive Director.

12. Maintain accurate, complete and confidential resident medication and care records according to established procedure and state law.

13. Keep medicine carts and areas orderly, clean and appropriately stocked and locked. Maintain upkeep and cleanliness of medicine carts and medication rooms.

14. Assist medication aides and caregivers in the performance of their job and assume caregiver activities when needed.

15. Participate in and complete narcotic count at beginning and end of each shift. Report any and all discrepancies to Health Services Director or Journey Program Director immediately.

16. Prepare medication for distribution to residents as per the OMG Medication Policy.

17. Carry a radio and/or pager as directed by supervisor to ensure prompt response to resident issues.

18. Be familiar with the meaning and usage of common medical abbreviations, symbols and terms relative to the administration of medications as used by the residence, pharmacists and physicians.

19. Demonstrate knowledge of infection control, i.e., adequate hand-washing, blood borne pathogens procedures, universal precautions, etc.

20. Maintain all required licenses/certifications as required by state law.

21. Report occupational exposure to blood, body fluids, infectious materials, and hazardous chemicals in accordance with the property’s policies and procedures governing accidents and incidents.

22. Provide support to community’s marketing efforts through positive/friendly interaction during all property tours and telephone contact with the public, and as directed by a supervisor.

23. Maintain a safe and secure environment for all staff, residents and guests, following established safety standards.

24. Encourage teamwork through cooperative interactions with co-workers and other departments.

25. Support a positive and professional image through actions and dress.

26. Performs other duties consistent with the position as assigned by the Health Services Director or Journey Director.

title: Senior Associate, Banking Alliances
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

The Role
We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Senior Analyst to join the KAM Operations (Ops) team within Razorpay Engage's Loyalty business. This role sits at the center of our client and merchant operations, working closely with Account Managers, Partnerships, Finance, and Client Support to ensure every operational workflow runs accurately and on time.

Key Responsibilities

• Offer & Reward Uploads – Manage end-to-end upload of offers, gift cards, and rewards for internal and client requests.
• Invoicing Requests – Own the invoicing lifecycle from Proforma Invoice request through to final Tax Invoice and payment tracking.
• Reporting incl. Ad Hoc Reports – Support report setup at program launch and fulfil ad hoc client reporting requests.
• Offer Testing – Own the ongoing testing cadence for live offers and coordinate merchant outreach for issues found.
• Merchant Payouts & Reconciliation – Collect and reconcile merchant MIS/invoices and drive the corresponding client invoicing process.
• Inventory Management – Monitor and plan reward code inventory to prevent stock-outs across live programs.
• Vendor / Client Onboarding – Collect KYC documentation and coordinate vendor/client onboarding on the Razorpay SAP system.
• Cross-functional Coordination – Act as the primary Ops point of contact for Account Managers, Finance, and Partnerships teams.

Mandatory Qualifications

• At least 2 years of experience in operations, client operations, or process-heavy coordination roles.
• Comfortable managing high-volume, ticket-based workflows across Slack and email with strict TATs.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs).
• Proficiency with AI tools (e.g., Claude) for automating workflows, report generation, and process documentation is a strong plus.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence coordinating across internal and external stakeholders.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to validate documentation completeness before processing.
• Ability to manage multiple concurrent requests and prioritize effectively based on urgency and criticality.
• Basic understanding of invoicing/finance workflows (POs, Proforma Invoices, Tax Invoices) is a plus.
• Experience with reconciliation or vendor/merchant onboarding processes is a plus.
• Highly organized, able to work independently while coordinating across multiple internal teams.

Location: Bangalore

title: Key Business Developer DACH - Collectables
description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

  • Taking ownership and driving impact
  • Being open to change and feedback
  • Being passionate about our mission and our customers.

About the role

We are looking for a Key Business Developer to build a strong pipeline of high-potential sellers across the DACH region (Germany, Austria and Switzerland) for our Collectables business unit.

You will identify and engage prospective sellers, encouraging them to offer high-quality objects across categories such as Books, Coins, Toys and Trading Cards. You will guide new sellers through a smooth onboarding experience and help them build momentum on our platform.

Your focus will be on creating sustainable revenue growth by turning new sellers into engaged, fast-growing sellers who are ready to transition to our Account Management teams.

What you’ll do

  • Identify, qualify and develop leads through call, email, field visit, fair visit and experts collaboration
    • Identify and reactivate high potential dormant sellers and organic sign-ups
    • Qualify inbound leads by working with data and sales tooling
    • Facilitate a frictionless pre and post-sales experience for new sellers
  • Build and nurture strong relationships with new sellers to expand Collectables seller network
    • In cooperation with experts, quickly learn the important characteristics of categories
  • Select and grow high-potential new sellers, and hand-over the best ones to Account Management teams
    • Move in sync with Account Managers to develop growth plan for onboarded sellers

What you’ll bring

  • Strong sales mindset with a proven track record of achieving/exceeding sales targets
  • Successful and active networker with the ability to establish and nurture relationships with sellers, manufacturers and distributors
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills
  • Proactive problem solver with a data driven approach to decision making
  • Genuine passion in the online marketplace or collecting space, ideally with personal experience as a collector so you can naturally understand and connect with our sellers
  • Open to travel on a regular base within Germany and Austria to meet prospective and existing sellers
  • Familiar with G Suite tools (Google sheet, Google Slides, and Gemini)
  • Experience working with a sales CRM (Hubspot or any equivalent) is a plus
  • Fluent in German and English

Where you’ll be

The role is preferably based in Germany with a work-from-home arrangement. It can also be based in the Netherlands with regular field visits to Germany and Austria.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

  • Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
  • Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
  • A culture of connection defines us. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
  • Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion”. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Our Offices and Way of Working

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

Interested?

Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
