title: Career Navigator & Industry Engagement Specialist (Solar & Roofing)
location: Center for Sustainable Careers - Baltimore, MD
description:
Organization Summary

Civic Works strengthens Baltimore’s communities through education, skills development, and community service. Our Center for Sustainable Careers (CSC) department expands access to family-sustaining careers through hands-on learning, on-the-job training and job quality initiatives. We have sector-based career tracks in solar installation, roofing and utility infrastructure. Our program model has proven powerfully successful, with over 1,000 CSC graduates since 2003, an impressive average job placement rate of 85% and starting wages of over $20 per hour. Our innovative work has been highlighted by the White House, the National Fund for Workforce Solutions, Green for All, The Baltimore Sun, The Washington Post, and the US Conference of Mayors. Join us in creating a more just and equitable green economy. For more information, please visit http://sustainablecareers.civicworks.com/

Position Summary

The Career Navigator & Industry Engagement Specialist plays a critical role on the Career Services team, guiding solar and roofing trainees toward family-sustaining careers through hands-on career coaching, high-quality employment readiness instruction, and relationships with industry employers. This role combines a dedicated coaching caseload with delivery of the program's employment readiness curriculum and employer outreach and engagement – conducting initial outreach to prospective solar and roofing partners and supporting ongoing engagement to open and sustain hiring opportunities. The Navigator coaches participants throughout their entire career development journey, from initial skills building through job placement and beyond, including graduate retention and advancement support. In coordination with employer engagement staff, the Navigator identifies participants for industry openings and facilitates and tracks applications, interviews, job offers, and related milestones. Through coaching, curriculum delivery, employer connections, and industry insight, the Navigator delivers career outcomes that last well beyond placement. This role advances Civic Works' commitment to expanding career access for residents excluded from quality employment, including people impacted by the criminal justice system, housing instability, and other systems, and reflects our belief in the capacity of every participant to build a lasting career.

Primary Responsibilities:

I. Support participants in building their professional development skills

  1. Achieve and maintain fidelity in the motivational interviewing framework, applying evidence-based coaching techniques to support participant motivation, self-direction, and progress.
  2. Provide individualized, strength-based coaching that builds participants' workplace communication, interview, networking, and strategic career planning skills.
  3. Sustain participant engagement and momentum across the full career development journey, from early skill-building through placement.

II. Coordinate participants' progress toward job placement

  1. Conduct comprehensive assessments and provide targeted coaching to evaluate participants' strengths, identify development areas, and support their ongoing professional growth.
  2. Partner with the Job Readiness Manager to evaluate participant readiness for employment transition and coordinate seamless handoffs between program phases.
  3. Facilitate strategic job matching and placement support by connecting participants with suitable employment opportunities and providing guidance through all stages of the application, interview, and hiring process.
  4. Maintain comprehensive documentation in Salesforce including participant engagement metrics, application and interview progress tracking, job placement outcomes, and other critical placement and retention milestone data to ensure program accountability and continuous improvement.
  5. Transport participants to interviews and appointments as needed.

III. Conduct employer outreach and industry engagement

  1. Conduct initial outreach to prospective solar, roofing, and related construction/green-energy employers to introduce the program and build a pipeline of hiring opportunities.
  2. Support ongoing engagement with industry partners, maintaining regular communication and a positive partner experience that drives repeat hiring.
  3. In coordination with employer engagement staff, understand employer talent needs, role requirements, and hiring cycles to align participant preparation and referrals.
  4. Conduct labor market analysis and industry mapping for the solar and roofing sectors to identify in-demand roles, growth areas, and emerging employers, using that insight to guide participants and inform outreach.
  5. Attend industry events, trade association meetings, job fairs, and networking functions to build program visibility and develop new employer relationships.
  6. Plan and execute employer engagement events, such as open houses, employer showcases, and site visits, that connect industry partners directly with participants and program staff.

IV. Support high quality graduate employment outcomes

  1. Provide ongoing retention and career advancement support to program graduates through continued coaching, professional development resources, and strategic career planning assistance.
  2. Deliver targeted job search assistance to unemployed graduates, including updated resume review, interview preparation, and connections to new employment opportunities.
  3. Track and analyze graduate employment data including wages, work hours, job retention rates, and career advancement metrics to measure program effectiveness and inform continuous improvement.
  4. Expand placement support beyond target industries by providing specialized guidance and resources to participants seeking employment in alternative career paths and sectors.

V. Peer Support & Team Development

  1. Provide informal guidance and peer support to Career Services staff on career coaching practices, participant assessment, curriculum delivery, and facilitation techniques.
  2. Share knowledge of curriculum content, coaching approaches, and program context to support onboarding and task continuity during transitions.
  3. Model effective coaching and facilitation standards and serve as an internal resource for best practices in curriculum design and training delivery.
  4. Support team cohesion by collaborating across the Career Services and Career Pathways teams on shared curriculum and participant success goals.

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
Location Details: Gurgaon, India

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time; others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.​

This is a hybrid position. You’ll divide your time between working remotely from your home and an office, so you should live within commuting distance. Hybrid teams may work in-office as much as a few times a week or as little as once a month or quarter, as decided by leadership. Join Our Team

GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing all of the help and tools to succeed online. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights and the people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success.

Our Identity team is looking for a Software Engineer to join us in building and maintaining GoDaddy's customer identity platform. As a software engineer on our team, you will work in an Agile scrum environment, contributing to the development and maintenance of mission-critical services that serve as the authoritative source of truth for all GoDaddy customer profiles, identity verification, and consent management. You'll be working with modern cloud-native architectures, handling billions of requests, and ensuring the highest standards of security and compliance for customer data.

What you'll get to do...

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot for GoDaddy's customer profile and identity platform
  • Build scalable, event-driven microservices on AWS (DynamoDB, Kinesis, Lambda, ECS/Fargate, S3, OpenSearch), including real-time integrations with internal systems and third-party vendors
  • Deliver secure, GDPR-compliant solutions by implementing identity verification, consent management, encryption, audit trails, and API security controls including WAF
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code; participate in code reviews, troubleshoot production issues, support on-call operations, and contribute to CI/CD and infrastructure automation
  • Take ownership of features from design through deployment, collaborate across engineering and product teams, solve problems independently, and leverage AI tools to improve productivity

Your experience should include...

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend services, APIs, and distributed applications
  • Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot, with solid understanding of RESTful API design and microservices architecture
  • Experience with relational or NoSQL databases, cloud-native development, Git, testing frameworks, and CI/CD practices
  • Understanding of data structures, algorithms, software design patterns, security fundamentals (authentication, authorization, encryption), and API security concepts
  • Strong problem-solving, debugging, communication, and ownership skills, with the ability to independently drive features from design to delivery

You might also have...

  • Experience with AWS technologies including DynamoDB, Kinesis, Lambda, ECS/Fargate, OpenSearch, CloudFormation, and WAFv2
  • Knowledge of event-driven architectures, message streaming platforms (Kinesis, Kafka, SQS/SNS), API gateways, GraphQL, and OpenAPI/Swagger
  • Familiarity with security and compliance best practices, including encryption, KMS, PII protection, GDPR, and audit trail requirements
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, observability tools (CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk), and additional backend languages such as Go or Python
  • Experience in Agile environments, passion for engineering excellence, continuous learning, and effective use of AI-powered development tools

We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.

We've got your back... We offer a range of total rewards that may include paid time off, retirement savings (e.g., 401k, pension schemes), bonus/incentive eligibility, equity grants, participation in our employee stock purchase plan, competitive health benefits, and other family-friendly benefits including parental leave. Project Background

The Sustaining Gains & Continuing Services for Smallholder Farmers (SGCF) Project is designed as a 12-month consolidation initiative that brings together selected results, relationships and delivery structures established under CG and BRIGHT into one focused project implemented by GOAL Uganda in partnership with Agriterra. The project will ensure continuity of support to smallholder farmers, FOs, cooperatives and other local actors across the 14 districts of Elgon, Rwenzori and Kigezi, while working closely with district local governments, private sector partners, financial service providers and implementing partners up to August 2027. The project will build on good practices, networks, community and household / farmer-led planning processes developed by CG and BRIGHT. At GOAL we welcome people of all abilities and want to ensure that our hiring and interview process meets the needs of all applicants. If you require a reasonable accommodation to make your application or interview experience a great one, please just contact our Recruitment Team at recruitment@ug.goal.ie

GOAL Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion:
GOAL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees. We foster an inclusive culture where all voices are heard and valued. We know that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.

title: HR Adviseur
description:
Ben jij op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging als HR adviseur en werk je graag dicht op de operatie? Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Den Bosch is op zoek naar een HR adviseur die het verschil maakt in de dagelijkse praktijk. Iemand die overzicht creëert, regie pakt en leidinggevenden écht adviseert, begeleidt en ontzorgt. Heb jij affiniteit met de bouw? Dan zijn we nieuwsgierig naar jou.

Dit wordt jouw baan

Als HR adviseur ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het soepel laten verlopen van de dagelijkse HR praktijk binnen onze organisatie. De focus in deze rol ligt op operationeel en tactisch niveau: jij zorgt voor structuur, overzicht en opvolging en pakt HR vraagstukken op, denk aan onder andere in-, door- en uitstroom, preventie en verzuim, en de opleiding en ontwikkeling van medewerkers.

Je werkt nauw samen met de HR-manager en corporate recruiter en fungeert als een verlengstuk in de organisatie. Je pakt HR-dossiers en vraagstukken op en zorgt voor regie en opvolging, zodat zaken niet blijven liggen en leidinggevenden en de HR-manager daarop kunnen vertrouwen. Je weet goed te prioriteren, hebt een sterke organisatiesensitiviteit en werkt gestructureerd en doelgericht.

Je bent zichtbaar en actief aanwezig in de organisatie, beweegt je moeiteloos tussen collega’s op kantoor en op de bouwplaats en signaleert wat er speelt. Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor leidinggevenden en adviseert hen over uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken, van verzuim en teamontwikkeling tot strategische personeelsplanning. Ook werk je samen met de HR-manager aan HR verbeteringen en projecten.

Meer over Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Hier zit je op je plek

Als Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Den Bosch zijn we een zelfstandige werkmaatschappij binnen een groter geheel. Een organisatie van 150 medewerkers die jou, als nieuwe collega. graag wil opnemen binnen de familie! Samen realiseren we gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling, woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, renovatie en transformatie - van nieuwbouw tot het verbeteren en vernieuwen van bestaand vastgoed in de regio Noord-Brabant en Limburg.

Als medewerker van Dura Vermeer ben je onderdeel van een club van ontwikkelaars, bouwers, doeners en waarmakers. Duurzame samenwerking staat daarbij voorop: samen plannen maken, samen kennis en successen delen en samen innoveren.

Wat breng je mee?
We zoeken een HR-professional met minimaal 2 jaar ervaring binnen HR, die het leuk vindt om samen met ons te werken aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de organisatie en onze collega’s. Je bent energiek, een echte doener en weet precies hoe je de juiste keuzes maakt en prioriteiten stelt voor zowel de organisatie als onze collega’s. Ook ben je in staat om stevig in je schoenen te staan als gesprekspartner en streef je naar kwaliteit.

title: Chief Wealth Management Officer
location: Ho Chi Minh, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
description:
Chief Wealth Management Officer

Location: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

Workplace Type: On-site


About the Role

ACB is embarking on a transformative journey to establish a next-generation Wealth Management business in Vietnam. This ambitious program aims to deliver holistic financial solutions, personalized advisory services, and digitally enabled customer experiences for affluent, high-net-worth, and emerging wealth clients. As a leading private bank in Vietnam, ACB is making significant investments in capabilities, technology, talent, partnerships, and operating models to build a market-leading Wealth Management franchise, drawing inspiration from regional best practices. We are seeking a visionary and execution-focused leader to spearhead this initiative and shape the future of Wealth Management at ACB.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the long-term Wealth Management vision, strategy, and business roadmap, positioning ACB as a leading wealth and advisory institution in Vietnam.
  • Drive sustainable growth across Assets Under Management (AUM), fee income, client acquisition, and customer lifetime value by establishing a scalable and differentiated Wealth Management model.
  • Develop and implement customer segmentation strategies and compelling value propositions tailored to Affluent, Priority, High-Net-Worth Individual (HNWI), and Business Owner segments, covering wealth accumulation, growth, preservation, retirement planning, and legacy planning.
  • Lead the development of a comprehensive suite of wealth solutions, including investments, mutual funds, bonds, structured products, insurance, cash management, and global wealth opportunities, fostering an advisory-led approach.
  • Build strategic relationships with asset managers, insurers, securities firms, fintech companies, and global financial institutions to develop an open architecture model and partnership-led solutions.
  • Provide leadership and governance for key strategic initiatives across Wealth Platforms & Technology, Data & Analytics, Risk Management, Customer Experience, Product & Advisory, and Operating Model Design.
  • Design and implement a modern Wealth Advisory model with differentiated capabilities in Financial Planning, Investment Advisory, Portfolio Advisory, and Wealth Relationship Management.
  • Drive the deployment of digital wealth platforms and AI-enabled advisory capabilities, leveraging data and analytics for personalized recommendations and digital engagement.
  • Design the target operating model and organizational structure for ACB Wealth Management, developing talent, capability-building, and succession strategies to foster a performance-driven culture.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in Wealth Management, Private Banking, Asset Management, Investment Advisory, Affluent Banking, or related financial services sectors.
  • Proven leadership experience at Managing Director, Division Head, Business Head, or equivalent executive level.
  • Strong track record of building, scaling, or transforming Wealth Management businesses.
  • Experience leading large-scale business transformation and cross-functional programs.
  • Strategic vision and commercial acumen, with strong transformation and change leadership capabilities.
  • Ability to operate effectively at Board and Executive Committee level, with outstanding stakeholder management and influencing skills.
  • Deep understanding of client-centric wealth models and the ability to bridge business, technology, data, risk, and operations.
  • Passion for building high-performance teams and future capabilities.
  • Regional exposure within Asia-Pacific markets is highly desirable.
  • Experience with organizations such as DBS, UOB, OCBC, HSBC, Standard Chartered, Citi, UBS, Julius Baer, Bank of Singapore, or comparable institutions would be advantageous.


Additional Information

This is a unique opportunity to create one of Vietnam's most ambitious Wealth Management platforms from the ground up, with strong executive sponsorship, significant investment, and a long-term commitment to transformation. The successful candidate will play a defining role in shaping the future of Wealth Management at ACB and setting a new benchmark for client-centric wealth services in the Vietnamese market. Success will be measured by key outcomes including Assets Under Management (AUM), Net New Money, Fee-Based Revenue Growth, Wealth Client Acquisition and Retention, Advisor Productivity, Customer Satisfaction and Engagement, Digital Wealth Adoption, and Strategic Initiative Delivery.

title: Director of Residential Services
location: 611 N Rampart Street - New Orleans, LA 70112
description:
GENERAL SUMMARY

The Director of Residential Services provides leadership and strategic oversight for residential services at Covenant House New Orleans CHNO. This role ensures that services are delivered with dignity, respect, and a commitment to CHNO youth and staff well being while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, and accountability. The Director directly supervises the Care Center Manager and Transitional Housing Manager. The Director leads through visible presence, traumainformed decision making, and cross department collaboration, ensuring alignment with CHNOs Mission, Principles, and Core Value to provide safety, consistency, growth, and opportunity to youth experiencing homelessness.

The Director of Residential Services will be part of our Senior Leadership Team and help drive service standards, quality assurance and customer satisfaction across all CHNOs Residential Programming Services. This role involves developing, implementing, and maintaining quality assurance protocols and service standards and will be responsible for developing and overseeing quality assurance, monitoring, and improvement processes to ensure services are compliant and meet regulatory and agency standards while leading on initiatives for continuous improvement in quality and service delivery of services. The position requires strong leadership in a fast paced environment and the ability to support staff managing complex youth needs including mental health, trauma, substance use, and housing instability.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Culture, Values, and Leadership

Model accountability by setting clear expectations, honoring commitments, and ensuring decisions prioritize the physical and emotional safety of youth and staff.
Use accurate operational, financial, and safety data to inform decisions, promote transparency, and respect the lived experiences of residents and staff.
Lead with presence through visible engagement on campus, calm leadership during crises, and respectful communication at all levels.
Promote a culture of dignity and respect, ensuring all interactions recognize the inherent worth of each individual.
Collaborate across departments to align operations with program goals and resident experience.

Residential Program Oversight

Oversee 24 7 shelter including respite and emergency overnight and Transitional Housing, including onsite Rights of Passage ROP and offsite Maternal Pathways.
Ensure a safe, healthy sanctuary for all youth in CHNO programming.
Support implementation of case management, safety planning, housing support, and lifeskills programming.
Provide leadership, training, and support so services meet all relevant regulatory standards and respond effectively to challenges.
Ensure youth receive timely orientation, accurate information, and, where applicable, assignment to a Case Success Manager who coordinates with Social Workers and Clinical Services.
Conduct monthly case review meetings with Care Center and Transitional Housing Managers, Team Leaders, and Case Success Managers, and provide appropriate reports to Senior Leadership.
Develop and embed a quality assurance program across services, monitoring adherence to Covenant House service standards.
Oversee completion and approval of incident reports, including critical incidents, in line with Child Protection Policy and Procedures.
Ensure timely escalation of cases to the Department of Family and Childrens Services, Senior Leadership, and or the Site Child Protection Officer SCPO, as required.
Respond to and support the team during crises, modeling expected crisismanagement practices.
Ensure youth medication logs are consistently and accurately maintained in compliance with applicable policies and procedures.
Complete and submit all required daily, biweekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reports as scheduled.
Engage regularly with youth forums such as Youth Advisory Council, meetings, programming to gather feedback on operations and services.
Plan and execute youth engagement activities and support groups.
Monitor and ensure accurate data entry and reporting in required systems, including Efforts to Outcomes, HMIS, and other city state federal systems.
Develop and maintain positive, strategic relationships with internal and external partners and stakeholders.

Strategic Planning and Program Development

Contribute to organizational strategic planning related to youth homelessness services.
Identify service gaps and support new initiatives or program enhancements.
Use data and outcomes to drive program improvements.
Support program evaluation requirements.
Maintain professional and technical knowledge through trainings, publications, and participation in policy and procedure development.

Grant Compliance and Reporting

Oversee compliance of all grantfunded programs, ensuring adherence to requirements, timelines, and regulations.
Participate in grant audits and site visits, providing documentation and responding to inquiries.
Maintain a clear understanding of grant terms, conditions, and deliverables to align services with funder expectations.
Partner with leadership to ensure grant activities are executed as planned and within approved budgets.
Collaborate with staff to ensure grant goals and objectives are met and accurately reported.
Monitor and track program expenditures in alignment with grant budgets.
Work with finance and leadership on budget forecasting and adjustments.
Prepare personal work expense reports to ensure efficient use of funds for CHNO operations.
Provide quarterly reconciliation between financial and physical inventories.

Program Model Training and Management

Ensure staff understand and are proficient in CHNOs Program Model and traumainformed, holistic, youthcentered care.
Facilitate or support training on core program components, including case management, youth empowerment, conflict resolution, and engagement techniques.
Support consistent integration of the program model into daily practice and ensure staff confidence in applying it.

New Hire Onboarding and Staff Development

In partnership with People and Culture, conduct interviewing, hiring, supervision, and performance reviews for direct reports.
Lead onboarding and training for new hires, ensuring readiness to implement the program model and traumainformed care.
Provide ongoing training on best practices with youth experiencing homelessness, including housingfirst principles, case management, deescalation, and crisis intervention.
Foster a culture of professional growth through development opportunities and regular performance feedback.

Collaboration and Accountability

Actively contribute to departmental, crossdepartmental, leadership, and allstaff meetings to ensure clear communication and followthrough on priorities.
Collaborate with all CHNO teams to align operational systems.
Prepare and deliver clear, datainformed presentations on facilities, capital projects, safety, and operational performance.
Engage constructively with community partners, vendors, contractors, public agencies, and neighborhood stakeholders.
Promote a culture of mutual respect and teamwork among staff.

Security and Safety Management

Coordinate staff training on safety protocols in collaboration with the Sr. Director of Facilities and Operations.
Participate in quarterly safety audits and organizational emergency preparedness activities.

title: Finishing Inspector
description:

The Finishing Inspector is responsible for meeting customer requirements while conforming to company standards for quality and job parameters.

Essential Functions:

  • Inspects printed products to assess and evaluate quality conformance to specifications.
  • Discards or rejects defective product that does not conform to requirements for print quality or product functionality.
  • Operates finishing equipment at required speed to ensure proper slitting, alignment, and roll profile.
  • Examines job orders to determine details such as finished quantities, production times, packaging specifications, and shipping requirements.
  • Notifies supervisors and other personnel of production problems, and assist in identifying and correcting these problems.
  • Loads, positions, and adjusts master press rolls on holding fixtures or in equipment loading and feeding mechanisms.
  • Moves printed materials using lifts and transports them to storage or finishing areas.
  • Pushes buttons or moves controls and levers to start and control finishing equipment.
  • Monitors finishing equipment in order to maintain specified operating levels and to detect malfunctions; make any necessary adjustments.
  • Maintains, or adjusts equipment using proper preventive maintenance techniques.
  • Records finishing data specific to product quantities, copy position, packaging, and shipping requirements using the appropriate quality control forms.
  • Responsible for verifying critical quality conformance to proper line clearance and product segregation processes.
  • Ensures the work conducted within the production area is performed in a safe and efficient manner. Any unsafe work conditions are addressed immediately.
  • Ensures adherence to all quality control processes and procedures and actively supports the company’s internal audit program.
  • Maintains daily time and materials usage reports by entering information into the computer print management system.

Skills and Experience Required:

  • Individual must be able to monitor processes, materials and equipment.
  • Individual must be able to work independently with minimal guidance required. This implies good time management, planning/organization, and decision-making skills.
  • Individual must be able to interact effectively with a wide variety of people, maintaining flexibility, objectivity and a capacity to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Participation and support of 5S initiatives and activities.
  • 1-2 years relevant experience in finishing or inspection preferred.
  • High school diploma / GED / or equivalent preferred.
  • Individual should possess math and computer skills.
  • English language required.

Physical and Other Requirements:
This job is performed indoors in a temperature and humidity controlled environment. Job tasks are performed in close proximity to other people and include exposure to strobe lights, sounds and noise levels that could be distracting. The employee is occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, bend or crouch. The employee must frequently stand, walk, talk, and occasionally lift, push, pull and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Specific hearing abilities required by this job include ability to hear alarms and other sensors in a factory environment. Requires use of hands to handle, control or feel objects and operate tools and controls.

They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and/or skills required of all personnel. The above duties are subject to change and shall not be construed as a promise or contract of employment or of any specific duties.

title: HR Intern - Munich

title: Employee Benefits Consultant I - South Region
description:

While the ideal candidate would reside within this region, all qualified applicants will be considered. Please note that relocation assistance or reassignment to another region is not available at this time. The role requires frequent travel up to 80% of the time.

Position Overview

Responsible for consulting with members of the Texas Association of Counties (TAC) Health and Employee Benefits Pool (Pool), the Texas Association of Counties Unemployment Compensation Group Account Fund (Fund) and other eligible local governmental entities regarding employee benefits programs offered by the Pool and the Fund. Responsible for account management activities associated with servicing the fully pooled and self-insured Pool members in an assigned territory. Assist in developing strategies as necessary to deliver employee benefit programs to Pool and Fund members. Market the Pool and Fund services to current and prospective members in an assigned territory. Position requires extensive travel, up to 80% overnight in the state of Texas. Residence is Texas is required, and residence in assigned territory is preferred.

Essential Job Functions

  1. Responsible for consulting with Pool and Fund members and other eligible local governmental entities regarding employee benefits programs offered by the Pool and the Fund and communicating the value of the Pool and the Fund.
  2. Develop and maintain understanding of current Pool coverages and programs, health care contracts, financial reports and laws applicable to the Pool’s coverages, including COBRA, PPACA, HIPAA and Medicare.
  3. Responsible for account management activities associated with servicing the fully insured and self-insured Pool and Fund members in assigned territory, including marketing new products, identifying prospective Pool and Fund members and marketing employee benefits programs to them.
  4. Required to regularly visit current and prospective Pool and Fund members and to develop relationships with their governing body and other significant contacts responsible for approval or management of employee benefit programs.
  5. Provide information to the Financial Analyst and Business Systems team for inclusion in responses to Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and Requests for Quotes (RFQs).
  6. Conduct semi-annual and annual financial performance reviews, as appropriate, with the governing body of each member in the assigned territory.
  7. Develop and deliver presentations related to employee benefit proposals and programs to current Pool and Fund members, at TAC-sponsored and TAC-affiliate member organization conferences and at other venues, including staffing the TAC and HBS booths at conferences.

  9. Coordinate with HBS Employee Benefits Specialists (EBSs), Wellness Consultants (WCs) and other TAC staff to provide Pool and Fund member services and assist with renewals as requested.
  10. Develop and maintain expertise in employee benefits funding and delivery, including point of service, HMO network arrangements, EPO network arrangements, network operations, pooling, and partially self-funded administrative services only plans.

description:
Organization Overview, Mission, Vision, and Values

Our mission is to improve the health of people in the communities we serve through compassionate, high-quality care, prevention, and wellness education. Hunt Transport Services Neuroscience Institute; Washington Regional Walker Heart Institute; Washington Regional Women and Infants Center; Washington Regional Total Joint Center; and Washington Regional Pat Walker Center for Seniors.

Position Summary

The Non-Registered Polysomnographic Tech assists with sleep disorder evaluations and treatments under the Sleep Lab Manager. This role assists with in-center polysomnography and home sleep apnea testing, helps ensure accurate data acquisition and documentation, and provides direct patient education and high-quality, compassionate care in accordance with facility protocols and applicable standards.

Essential Position Responsibilities

  • Prepare, calibrate, and troubleshoot equipment to ensure accurate recordings and safe operation
  • Complete patient intake and orientation, including assessment, education, consent verification as applicable, and accurate documentation
  • Apply and secure sensors/electrodes and complete patient hook-up in accordance with AASM standards and facility protocols
  • Monitor patients throughout testing, recognize and respond to events/artifacts, and intervene appropriately to support patient comfort and data quality
  • Review, score, and annotate studies following data acquisition, ensuring complete and accurate records for provider interpretation
  • Support onboarding and training of new staff and participate in ongoing in-services, competency maintenance, and process improvement

Qualifications

  • Education: High school diploma or GED, required. Completion of A-STEP educational modules administered through the AASM.
  • Licensure and Certifications: BLS, required. National sleep credential preferred: RST (Registered Sleep Technologist), RPSGT (Registered Polysomnographic Technologist), SDS (Sleep Disorders Specialist), or CPSGT (Certified Polysomnographic Technician).
  • Experience: Previous experience in a sleep lab, preferred (including in-center PSG and/or HSAT). Experience with patient education, PAP titration support, and accurate study scoring/documentation is preferred.
  • Professional Development: Successful completion of department training and competency validation required. Eligibility for, and progress toward, professional credentialing in sleep (e.g., RST, RPSGT, or CPSGT) is preferred and may be required within an established timeframe based on department policy.

Work Environment: This position will spend 60% of the time walking and/or standing while pushing, pulling, lifting, and/or carrying up to 50 lbs. This position will spend 40% of the time sitting while performing work in a standard office environment. This position may be exposed to communicable disease and bodily fluids. This position will serve a culturally and linguistically diverse patient population.

The job description is not designed or intended to cover or set forth a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Washington Regional reserves the right in its absolute discretion to change duties, responsibilities or activities or assign new duties, responsibilities, or activities at any time with or without notice. Employees may be directed to perform job-related tasks other than those specifically presented in this description.

title: HIGHLY SKILLED 1st Shift - CNC Mill Setup Operator (6A-2:30P)
description:
Incentives:

401K: 100% Matching 6%

Tuition Reimbursement: 100% of In-State Accredited Approved Program

Health, Dental, and Vision: Extremely affordable and market leading health benefits.

ESPP (Employee Stock Purchase Plan): 15% discount on purchased stock at the lowest price of the quarter.

Job Summary:

The CNC Mill Setup/Operator is responsible for the setup, operation, and maintenance of CNC milling machines. The role involves reading and interpreting blueprints, programming CNC machines, setting tooling, and inspecting machined parts to ensure they meet specifications. This individual plays a crucial role in ensuring production runs smoothly and efficiently while maintaining a high standard of quality.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • 3 years experience performing complex Milling setups for Aerospace/Medical industries

  • +/- .0001 (one tenth) tolerance experience required

  • Proficient in using precision measuring instruments (calipers, micrometers, height gauges, etc.).

  • Basic knowledge of CNC programming (G-code, M-code).

  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, schematics, and mechanical drawings.

  • Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team.

Duties/Responsibilities:

Machine Setup:

  • Prepare CNC mills for production runs by loading tools, securing workpieces, and setting machine parameters.

  • Read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and engineering documentation to understand the required specifications.

  • Install, align, and secure fixtures, tooling, and workpieces using precision measuring instruments.

  • Conduct initial machine setups and make necessary adjustments to ensure correct machine operation.

Operation and Monitoring:

  • Operate CNC milling machines to machine parts according to specifications.

  • Monitor machine operations to detect malfunctions or out-of-tolerance machining and adjust machines as necessary.

  • Perform basic troubleshooting of equipment issues and collaborate with maintenance staff for repairs.

  • Operate various other machines or manual tools as needed during production.

Quality Control:

  • Inspect finished parts using precision measuring tools (e.g., calipers, micrometers, and gauges) to ensure accuracy and conformance to specifications.

  • Perform first-article inspections and in-process inspections during production.

  • Ensure that machined parts meet tolerances, surface finish, and dimensional requirements specified in the blueprints.

Program Adjustments:

  • Input or modify CNC programs for specific part production.

  • Adjust machine offsets and tool paths as required for optimal performance and precision.

  • Collaborate with engineers or programmers to optimize CNC programming and improve production efficiency.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Maintain accurate records of production, machine settings, and adjustments made during the machining process.

  • Log completed work and any discrepancies or defects found during production.

  • Follow established safety protocols and maintain a clean and organized workspace.

Education and Experience:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • Technical certifications or vocational training in CNC machining or manufacturing preferred.

  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience as a CNC Setup Operator.

  • Familiarity with G-code programming and interpreting technical drawings/blueprints.

Physical Requirements:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands and fingers, feel/reach with hands/arms, talk, and hear.

The employee frequently is required to sit and walk. The employee is occasionally required to bend and stop, push and pull, reach above shoulder level, kneel, squat, or crouch. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 70 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job to include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is exposed to moving mechanical parts and fumes or airborne particles. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

title: Right of Way Appraiser

description:

title: SVP, Technology, Data & Digital Strategy
description:
GENERAL SUMMARY

The Senior Vice President of Technology, Data & Digital Strategy is the Company's senior leader responsible for technology operations, enterprise data, cybersecurity, and digital innovation.

This role uses secure, reliable technology and trusted data to support and advance business strategy, strengthen operations, improve decision making, and enhance long-term shareholder value.

The position provides senior leadership for the Company's technology, cybersecurity, governance, compliance, disaster recovery, business continuity, and enterprise data programs, ensuring the security, integrity, availability, and appropriate use of information and technology assets while maintaining a strong control environment and supporting regulatory and audit requirements.

The successful candidate is a strategic, people-first leader who fosters accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement while developing high-performing teams and translating business objectives into practical technology solutions that deliver measurable value.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

Technology Operations & Security

  • Provide leadership and oversight for the Company's technology infrastructure, applications, business systems, cybersecurity, and technology operations.
  • Ensure reliable, secure, and scalable technology platforms that support business objectives.
  • Establish and maintain enterprise cybersecurity, governance, compliance, disaster recovery, and business continuity programs.
  • Lead IT general controls (ITGCs), application controls, SOX IT compliance activities, and technology risk management initiatives.
  • Manage technology budgets, vendor relationships, contracts, and investments to align priorities with business objectives and deliver secure, cost-effective, and high-quality services.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing technology organization focused on customer service, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Enterprise Data & Governance

  • Develop and implement the Company's enterprise data strategy in support of long-term business plans.
  • Lead modernization of enterprise data architecture, data platforms, and analytics capabilities.
  • Oversee the development and maintenance of enterprise data models that support trusted reporting, advanced analytics, and future AI capabilities.
  • Ensure the Company's data, analytics, and information assets are effectively governed, accessible, and leveraged to support decision making and operational excellence.
  • Establish and maintain enterprise data governance and stewardship frameworks that ensure accountability, data quality, security, accessibility, and regulatory compliance.

Digital Transformation & AI

  • Establish and execute the Company's enterprise AI strategy to enable the secure and effective adoption of artificial intelligence at scale.
  • Identify opportunities and lead enterprise-wide digital transformation initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, improve scalability, and increase employee effectiveness.

Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and maintain a multi-year technology, data, and digital transformation roadmap aligned with corporate strategy, operational priorities, and risk management objectives.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, sound risk management, and responsible technology adoption throughout the organization.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on technology, cybersecurity, data governance, and emerging technology opportunities and risks.

CORE COMPETENCIES

  • Strategic Leadership - Leads organizational transformation and drives successful adoption of new technologies and work processes through effective stakeholder engagement, communication, training, and change readiness activities.
  • Talent Development - Builds high-performing teams through coaching, mentorship, succession planning, and clear expectations.
  • Risk Management & Governance - Establishes and maintains effective cybersecurity, compliance, data governance, business continuity, and risk management frameworks that protect organizational assets and support business objectives.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This job does have supervisory responsibilities.

title: Torenkraanmachinist
description:
Ben jij dé torenkraanmachinist die veiligheid hoog in het vaandel heeft staan? Jij bent het onmisbare middelpunt van onze bouwprojecten. Zoek je een uitdagende baan als torenkraanmachinist, houd je je hoofd koel in elke situatie en ben je op zoek naar lange(re) termijn projecten? Bij Dura Vermeer bieden we jou precies dat én meer. Onze bouwprojecten bevinden zich door heel Nederland, maar we proberen altijd een project dicht bij jouw woonplaats te vinden.

Dit wordt jouw baan
Als ervaren torenkraanmachinist ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het veilig en nauwkeurig bedienen van onze Liebherr torenkranen. Jij bent het onmisbare middelpunt van onze bouwprojecten. Jij bedient de kraan met precisie en overzicht, waardoor alles op de juiste plek terechtkomt. Je werkt op uitdagende projecten die variëren van een half jaar tot wel twee jaar, waarbij jouw vaardigheden het verschil maken. Of je nu op grote hoogtes werkt of samen met collega’s op de grond een planning doorneemt, jij houdt altijd het overzicht en zorgt voor een veilige werkomgeving.

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Hier zit je op je plek
Je werkt aan indrukwekkende projecten, zoals Leidsche Rijn E5 Utrecht met 2 torenkranen, in een dynamisch en veilig team. Onze projecten zijn verspreid door heel Nederland, maar we plannen je het liefst in op een locatie dicht bij je thuis. Met lange(re) termijn projecten krijg je de kans om écht betrokken te zijn en met trots terug te kijken op wat je hebt bereikt. Bovendien zorgen we ervoor dat je werk niet alleen uitdagend, maar ook leuk blijft, met volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Wij begrijpen hoe belangrijk werkplezier en balans zijn, daarom zorgen wij voor goede arbeidsomstandigheden én fijne extra’s.

Dit breng jij mee

  • Een geldig TCVT-certificaat als torenkraanmachinist.

  • Bij voorkeur een geldig VCA-certificaat.

  • Een flexibele instelling en een focus op veiligheid.

  • Jij zegt waar het op staat (maar je houdt het wel tactisch 😉)

  • Woonplaats regio Amersfoort.

Conform Cao Bouw & Infra kan een medische keuring onderdeel zijn van de sollicitatieprocedure. Voor deze functie is de keuring verplicht wanneer je voor het eerst in de bouw en infra gaat werken, of in de afgelopen 3 jaar niet als werknemer in de bouw en infra hebt gewerkt èn voor dezelfde of vergelijkbare functie waarvoor gesolliciteerd wordt nog niet eerder een intredekeuring heeft plaatsgevonden.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Direct een vast contract! Omdat we vertrouwen hebben in jou en samen willen bouwen aan de toekomst.

  • Een goed salaris dat meegroeit met jouw ontwikkeling conform CAO Bouw, in loongroep E, eventueel met prestatietoeslag, op basis van jouw ervaring.

  • 48 verlofdagen, waarvan 18 in het tijdspaarfonds worden gestort (inclusief kort verzuim).

  • Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico’s, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap.

  • Een tablet en een smartphone.

  • Een elektrische leaseauto.

  • Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar bijvoorbeeld ook op het gebied van vitaliteit.

  • Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland.

  • Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de eerste 5 wettelijke verlofdagen én het 5 weken aanvullend ouderschapsverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%.

Wil jij ook meer uit je werk halen?
Dan zijn wij nieuwsgierig naar jou! Solliciteren kan direct via onze website middels de solliciteerbutton onder de vacature.

Meer weten?
Neem contact op met onze recruiter Sharon Kuling!
T: 0618508282
M: s.kuling@duravermeer.nl

title: Fire Sprinkler Foreman
description:
Division 136 | Ashburn, VA

Lead the crew. Own the job. Protect what matters.

Chesapeake Fire Protection is looking for an experienced Fire Sprinkler Foreman to lead field crews and oversee the installation of fire sprinkler systems. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who knows the trade, takes ownership, and can keep a project moving safely and efficiently.

  • Strong fire sprinkler installation knowledge and leadership skills.
  • Basic computer and email skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with crews, designers, project managers, and customers.
  • Clean MVR required.
  • Successful completion of a pre-employment drug screen.
  • Ability to work overtime when needed.

🚀 Why This Role Matters

As a Foreman, you’re the leader in the field. Your experience, communication, and attention to detail keep the crew moving and ensure every system is installed right—the first time. Lead the team. Build with purpose. Protect what matters.

title: Billing and Data Analyst
description:
ABOUT US:

Villa Sport offers exciting and fulfilling career opportunities for those who thrive in a fast-paced, energizing environment. Our portfolio includes clubs across multiple states, including California, Texas, Colorado, Idaho, and Oregon. Our resort-style clubs are more than just gyms; they are communities where fitness, family, and fun come together. We are on a mission to create energizing environments where you can thrive and grow with us.

If you're a high-performing, outgoing, service-oriented superstar looking for a chance to make a difference, you've found your home. At Villa Sport, we offer a fantastic work environment, competitive wages, and a 401(k) plan with a company match of up to 4% of your compensation. Ready to join a team that’s going places? Your journey starts here!

POSITION SUMMARY:

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Billing & Data Analyst to support the integrity of billing operations, financial reporting, business analytics, and data governance across Villa Sport locations. This role will be responsible for analyzing billing and membership data, identifying trends and variances, validating system reporting, supporting data migrations and system implementations, and providing actionable insights to Finance and Operations leadership. The ideal candidate possesses strong analytical skills, advanced Excel capabilities, and the ability to translate complex data into meaningful business recommendations.

This is a hybrid position located at our Cypress, TX athletic club Monday through Thursday with the opportunity to work remote Fridays, weekly.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS INCLUDE:

  • Annually, based on relevant experience to the role. Full-time hours.
  • PTO.
  • Full benefits package.
  • 401K with dollar for dollar match up to 4%.
  • Complimentary club membership.
  • Discounts on club products and services.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Analyze billing, membership, collections, revenue, and operational data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and process improvements.
  • Develop and maintain recurring billing, revenue, collections, and membership analytics reports for management review.
  • Perform detailed reconciliation of billing activity, collections, ACH transactions, and membership data across multiple systems.
  • Investigate data anomalies and variances, identify root causes, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Monitor data quality and integrity across billing and financial systems, ensuring accuracy and consistency of reporting.
  • Support system implementations, data conversions, testing, and validation activities to ensure accurate migration of member and financial data.
  • Create and maintain dashboards, KPIs, and performance metrics for Billing.
  • Prepare business analysis and management presentations summarizing trends, risks, and recommendations.
  • Perform ad hoc financial, operational, and membership analyses to support strategic initiatives and business decisions.
  • Review and validate system-generated reports and communicate findings, discrepancies, and recommendations to management.
  • Assist with month-end close processes, account reconciliations, audit requests, and compliance reporting.
  • Identify opportunities to automate reporting and improve efficiency through data analytics and process redesign.
  • Document business processes, reporting methodologies, and data governance standards.
  • Mentor and assist in training team members on reporting tools, analytics, and best practices.
  • Other duties as assigned by management.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or related fields.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial analysis, billing analytics, business analytics, accounting, or reporting.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Power Query, XLOOKUP, Index Match, and complex formulas.
  • Experience working with large datasets and multiple source systems.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends and root causes.
  • Experience creating reports, dashboards, and executive-level presentations.
  • Knowledge of financial reporting, reconciliations, and internal controls.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with SQL, Co-Pilot or other business intelligence tools preferred.
  • Experience supporting accounting system implementations and data migrations preferred.
  • Experience with membership billing systems, fitness clubs, hospitality, or subscription-based businesses preferred.
  • Experience with Power Query, Power Automate, or other reporting automation tools preferred.
  • Understanding of revenue recognition, collections, membership analytics, and financial controls preferred.

PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Occasional bending, kneeling, and lifting up to 30 lbs
  • Frequent sitting and occasional standing, walking, reaching
  • Noise level may be moderate to high at times

For more information about Villa Sport, please visit our website at .

title: Career Readiness Navigator (45913)
description:

Mission Contribution:

To prepare participants for employment and/or self-sufficiency by providing career readiness, life skills or basic skills instruction people seeking assistance including those with disabilities, justice involved youth, at-risk youth, and others with barriers to employment or needing assistance to be successful.

  13. Assists visitors to the Opportunity Center with needs such as Medical equipment loans, resource and referral information and job search activities.
  14. Ensures confidentiality of participant records and private information, keeping in compliance with organization’s guidelines, policies and CARF regulations.
  15. Identifies opportunities for expansion of services through grant opportunities and/or collaboration with other agencies or businesses.
  16. Maintains accountability of inventory of supplies, materials and equipment essential to the operation of the program and follows proper procedures for new acquisitions and purchases.

title: Senior Associate, Design - Life Sciences
description:
At Unispace, we create spaces that empower people and businesses to thrive. We are a global design-build partner delivering workplace and life sciences projects for some of the world’s most innovative brands.

With over 500 people across four continents, we bring together strategy, design, project management, and delivery into one seamless experience. Our integrated approach enables us to move with agility, solve complex challenges, and deliver meaningful outcomes for our clients.

Our people are at the centre of everything we do. We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture that values curiosity, accountability, creativity, and continuous improvement. We believe diverse perspectives strengthen our teams and help us create better experiences for our clients and each other.

At Unispace, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to impactful projects, work alongside talented global teams, and grow your career in an environment that encourages innovation and new ideas.

Why you’re here

You’re an experienced and confident Life Sciences designer ready to take the next step—owning key design packages, contributing to client relationships, and helping shape high-quality, technically complex environments.

You bring strong lab planning expertise, thrive in integrated teams, and are passionate about delivering innovative, functional design solutions that meet both client and regulatory requirements.

What you’re responsible for

  • Lead and deliver design packages across projects of varying scale, supporting end-to-end project execution
  • Plan and develop laboratory environments, including programming, layouts and technical coordination
  • Collaborate closely with clients to understand requirements and translate them into effective design solutions
  • Work in partnership with Design Principals and multidisciplinary teams to deliver Unispace’s integrated methodology
  • Produce and coordinate technical design documentation, ensuring alignment with building codes and regulatory standards
  • Support construction administration, ensuring design intent is maintained through delivery
  • Apply QA/QC processes to ensure accuracy, consistency and quality across all design outputs
  • Coordinate with consultants, engineers and delivery teams to resolve technical challenges and drive project outcomes
  • Develop and present design concepts clearly and confidently to clients and stakeholders
  • Contribute to a culture of creativity, collaboration and continuous improvement

How we’ll measure it

  • Delivery of high-quality, compliant and innovative design solutions
  • Accuracy and coordination of construction documentation
  • Effective collaboration across design, planning and delivery teams
  • Positive client feedback and contribution to strong client relationships
  • Ability to independently manage design scopes and support project delivery
  • Consistent application of QA/QC standards
  • Contribution to team culture, knowledge sharing and design excellence

Your experience & skills

  • 5–8 years of experience in Life Sciences, laboratory or technical design environments
  • Strong understanding of laboratory planning, programming and design principles
  • Knowledge of technical and regulatory requirements for lab and workplace environments
  • Experience producing and coordinating construction documentation
  • Proficiency in Revit and other design tools (CAD, Adobe Suite, Excel)
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary, integrated teams
  • Experience contributing to client presentations and design storytelling
  • Exposure to corporate or campus-scale projects is beneficial

What We Will Offer
You’ll gain exposure to the design and construction industry in an agile and collaborative global firm. This is a great opportunity to work within a friendly, design-oriented, and creative culture while growing your career.
Sound like you? Don’t wait, send us your resume and portfolio !

Inclusion & Diversity

At Unispace, we believe diverse perspectives strengthen our teams, our culture, and the work we deliver for our clients. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with respect and has the opportunity to thrive.

Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

title: IT Director
description:
Knight Automotive Group is a family-owned and family-centric company built on integrity, accountability, and care for one another. For over 17 years, we’ve proudly served our communities by providing end-to-end automotive solutions — from sales and service to fleet and upfitting — all under one roof. Our success starts with our people. We believe in creating an environment where team members feel supported, valued, and empowered to grow.

At Knight Automotive Group, we live by our Core Values: being accountable and taking great care of each other, always doing the right thing, focusing on our guests with empathy and helpfulness, staying respectful, genuine, and fun (“the sun, not the salt”), and never being satisfied — always striving for improvement and excellence. Together, we’re building a culture that wins through teamwork, continuous growth, and a shared commitment to doing things the right way.

The IT Director is responsible for leading the technology infrastructure, cybersecurity, and IT strategy across Knight Automotive Group’s dealerships and divisions. This role will take ownership of the company’s higher-level technology needs while building a strong internal IT function and reducing reliance on outsourced IT providers. The ideal candidate is a hands-on, solutions-oriented leader with strong technical expertise who can manage complex IT systems while developing a secure, reliable, and scalable technology environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage IT infrastructure across multiple dealership locations, including networks, servers, firewalls, wireless systems, phone systems, and cloud environments.
  • Oversee cybersecurity, including endpoint protection, email security, identity and access management, MFA, vulnerability management, backups, and disaster recovery.
  • Manage Microsoft 365, Active Directory/Entra ID, user permissions, security policies, and other company-wide technology platforms.
  • Oversee dealership management systems, CRM tools, OEM integrations, and other dealership-specific technology.
  • Design, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network infrastructure, including firewalls, switches, VPNs, VLANs, and internet connectivity.
  • Lead technology projects, upgrades, system implementations, and infrastructure needs for new dealerships, acquisitions, and facility expansions.
  • Manage technology vendors, software providers, telecommunications companies, licensing, and IT-related contracts and expenses.
  • Develop and maintain IT policies, procedures, security standards, system documentation, and business continuity plans.
  • Lead and support internal IT staff responsible for day-to-day employee support, workstation setup, hardware, software, and other routine technology needs.
  • Partner with company leadership to identify technology solutions that improve productivity, reduce costs, strengthen security, and support future growth.
  • Uphold Knight Automotive Group’s Core Values — accountability, integrity, teamwork, and continuous improvement — in all work and decision-making.

What We Offer

  • Competitive and performance-driven pay structure
  • Health, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Paid time off (PTO), holidays, bereavement, maternity/paternity leave
  • Employee discounts on vehicles, parts, and service
  • Paid online and offsite hands-on training for continued professional development
  • Opportunities for career advancement within a growing, family-owned automotive group
  • A supportive, family-oriented culture built on teamwork, integrity, and continuous improvement

title: Vestigingsdirecteur
description:
Heb jij al ruime ervaring in de automotive in een commerciële of een aftersales rol? Ben jij klaar voor de volgende stap? Lijkt het jou leuk om onze vestiging naar een nog hoger niveau te tillen? Lees dan snel verder, want dan is deze baan als vestigingsdirecteur echt iets voor jou!


Wat ga je doen?
Voor onze Van Mossel Renault, Dacia en Nissan vestiging in Vlaardingen zijn wij op zoek naar een vestigingsdirecteur. In deze rol ben jij het gezicht van de vestiging. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van het team bestaande uit 22 collega’s en werkt met hen mee op de werkvloer indien nodig. Samen met jouw team zorg jij ervoor dat de vestiging zich blijft onderscheiden in de branche. Jij ziet het als jouw doel om iedere dag de klant een nog betere ervaring te geven dan hij of zij verwacht en zo de positie van jouw vestiging in de markt nog verder te verstevigen. Door jouw kritische en analytische blik verbeter je processen en vergroot je de efficiëntie op de vestiging. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor het resultaat van de vestiging en hebt de vrijheid om te ondernemen maar kan terugvallen op andere collega’s binnen Van Mossel. Je staat er dus nooit alleen voor! De volgende taken en verantwoordelijkheden behoren tot jouw functie:

  • De dagelijkse aansturing van het team, met daarbij HR gerelateerde zaken;

  • Verantwoordelijk voor het uitdragen van het gastheerschap en het verhogen van de klanttevredenheid;

  • Verbeteren van processen om rendement te verbeteren;

  • Vaststellen van kwaliteitsdoelen en de kwaliteitsvisie.

Wie ben jij?
Natuurlijk is het fijn als je al ervaring hebt als vestigingsdirecteur, maar wanneer jij werkzaam bent in de automotive als verkoopleider of in een leidinggevende aftersales rol, kan dit ook jouw vervolgstap zijn. Met jouw bevlogenheid en passie wil jij de vestiging naar een nog hoger niveau tillen. Commerciële kansen laat jij niet onbenut. Jij weet als geen ander hoe je met klanten omgaat en daarmee inspireer en motiveer je jouw team. Je voelt je het meeste thuis in een resultaatgerichte en dynamische organisatie. Het is fijn als je al een netwerk hebt in de omgeving van Vlaardingen, wanneer dit niet zo is weet jij deze in no-time op te zetten. Daarnaast beschik jij over:

  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een leidinggevende functie binnen de automotive;

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau;

  • Fulltime beschikbaar.


Wat bieden wij jou?
In ruim 75 jaar tijd is de Van Mossel Automotive Group uitgegroeid tot het grootste en leukste autobedrijf van de Benelux. Wij zijn ambitieus, groeien hard en willen blijven groeien. Ondanks dat wij een groot bedrijf zijn, blijven wij een familiebedrijf. Het familiare gevoel overheerst dan ook binnen ons bedrijf, zo ook op onze gezellige Van Mossel Renault, Dacia en Nissan vestiging in Vlaardingen. In totaal werken wij hier met 22 collega’s. Wij zijn een ambitieus team dat er alles aan doet om onze klanten te ontzorgen. Onze doelen willen we graag behalen maar dat doen we wel als team samen. Hier werken we dan ook hard voor. Naast hard werken vinden wij een goede werksfeer belangrijk. We hebben regelmatig een gezellige BBQ en iedere week sluiten we op vrijdag af met een gezellige borrel. Daarnaast bieden wij jou een zelfstandige en verantwoordelijke baan waarbij er veel doorgroeimogelijkheden zijn. Je krijgt de vrijheid om te ondernemen binnen een groot bedrijf. Verder kun je rekenen op:

  • Een goed salaris passend bij jouw ervaring;

  • Uiteraard krijg je van ons een telefoon van de zaak;

  • Personeelskorting op een auto, onderdelen en verzekeringen voor het hele gezin;

  • Regie over je eigen carrière pad;

  • Het vrijblijvend volgen van trainingen, cursussen en workshops naar keuze;

  • Onbeperkt gebruik maken van de Van Mossel Academy;

  • En natuurlijk een leuke baan binnen een snel groeiende organisatie!


Ben jij na het lezen van de vacature enthousiast geworden? Solliciteren kan eenvoudig via de website. We maken graag kennis met je!

title: Director of Public Services
description:
Classification: Director

Job Grade: 22 ($85,300 - $127,900)

Job Category: A – Full-Time

FSLA Status: Exempt

Direct Reports: Yes

Reports to: Executive Director

Application deadline: September 25; applications reviewed as received.

SUMMARY

The Director of Public Services is a senior operational leader responsible for the strategic direction, administration, and continuous improvement of public-facing library services across a multi-branch library system. Working in close partnership with the Executive Director and administrative leadership team, this position ensures the effective delivery of high-quality and responsive service delivery to meet community needs. This role provides direct leadership to department heads and oversees system-wide public service functions including circulation, reference, youth services, programming, and customer experience. The Director serves as a key liaison between senior leadership and operational teams, ensuring alignment in priorities, policies, and service delivery.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Organization-Wide Expectations

  • Follows and enforces established library operational and workforce policies, procedures, and work standards
  • Attends work regularly, on-time, and as scheduled
  • Demonstrates inclusive, welcoming, and customer-focused service to patrons, staff, and community partners
  • Maintains confidentiality of sensitive information and exercises sound judgment
  • Actively participates in professional development, conferences, and community engagement
  • Promotes a safe, secure, and accessible environment across all facilities
  • Regularly reviews and utilizes internal communication platforms

Job-Specific Accountability

Leadership and Strategic Direction

  • Provides system-wide leadership for all public service departments across multiple locations, ensuring consistent, high-quality service delivery
  • Serves as a key member of the senior leadership team, contributing to strategic planning, organizational priorities, and policy development
  • Serves as an acting administrator in the absence of the Executive Director, as delegated

Service Delivery and Operations

  • Ensures effective, customer-focused execution of services across circulation, reference, youth services, programming, and related areas
  • Oversees the development, implementation, and evaluation of public programs and services across the library system
  • Evaluates trends in library services, technology, and related library area of expertise to guide innovation and service delivery
  • Promotes a culture of service excellence and continuous improvement
  • Addresses escalated patron matters and interprets policy to resolve complex service issues
  • Develops, reviews, and refines operational policies and procedures related to public service delivery
  • Makes data-informed decisions regarding programs, service models, staffing, and resource allocation to maximize community impact
  • Performs administrative, customer service, or operational support duties as needed to ensure continuity of service

Financial Oversight and People Leadership

  • Oversees departmental budgets, including materials, programing, and operational expenditures while ensuring fiscal responsibility
  • Ensures effective development, coaching, and engagement of public service staff, including recruitment and retention
  • Promotes cross-functional teamwork and system-wide consistency

Community Engagement and Collaborative Partnerships

  • Represents the library in the community, building relationships with schools, government, nonprofits, and other organizations, as applicable to role scope
  • Identifies and develops collaborative opportunities that enhance library services to expand community impact
  • Serves as a visible ambassador for the library and its mission
  • Facilitates communication and collaboration with other divisions (e.g. branches, technical services, marketing, etc.) to ensure alignment of services and messaging
