  • Flexibility, teamwork, and a willingness to support various program areas are essential.

title: Staff Engineering Project Manager
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril is fielding the next generation of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles, delivering an ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth platform alongside a manufacturing architecture that scales from large to extra-large vehicle sizes. The Dive-XL programme is designed, built and tested in Australia and is executing against live contracts. The XL Vehicle System team owns the vehicle end to end – systems, software, mechanical, electrical, and integration and test.

ABOUT THE JOB

You will own programme execution across the XL vehicle system as it moves from development into production, reporting to the Director of Platforms. The role requires both programme management rigour and genuine technical depth: you will be expected to engage substantively on system architecture, interfaces and verification approach alongside the engineering discipline leads.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own programme planning end to end for the vehicle system: scoping, sequencing, dependency mapping, risk identification, and driving decisions when requirements, timelines or resourcing conflict.
  • Stand up and run the scaled agile cadence across the vehicle programme — coordinating planning increments, cross-team dependency mapping, and integration points across up to ~100 engineers spanning multiple agile teams. Own the rhythm: PI planning, backlog alignment, system demos and inspect-and-adapt events, ensuring the cadence actually drives decisions rather than just generating ceremony.
  • Implement and maintain robust project management methodologies and best practices across the programme, driving predictability and accountability.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate programme risks and challenges, developing mitigation plans alongside the engineers who will execute them.
  • Engage with the technical substance of the programme – architecture, requirements baselines, interfaces and verification approach – well enough to catch problems early rather than simply track status.
  • Partner with discipline leads as a technical peer, pressure-testing estimates and identifying missing scope before a schedule or resourcing decision is made.
  • Translate system-level requirements and subsystem dependencies into a sequenced plan that reflects how the vehicle is actually integrated and tested.
  • Manage interfaces and dependencies across production, supply chain and test, driving resolution where subsystem plans conflict.
  • Lead re-planning as priorities shift, and communicate the change and its technical consequences clearly.
  • Own the technical narrative in design review gates, milestone reviews and executive updates.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Demonstrated systems engineering capability – requirements decomposition, interface management and ICDs, subsystem trade studies, verification and validation, and requirements traceability across a complex system
  • Technical depth sufficient to engage as a peer with engineers rather than only track their status – able to follow an architecture discussion, question an estimate, and understand the downstream effect of a design decision
  • Delivery experience across both hardware and software – you have owned the plan for a complex product where mechanical, electrical and software work had to converge, and have shipped software as part of that scope
  • Hands-on experience running scaled agile delivery across a programme of multiple agile teams — including standing up planning increments, managing cross-team dependencies in Jira, and facilitating the events (planning, sync, demo, retrospective) that keep teams aligned. Not just familiarity: you've been the person making the system work.
  • Prior experience as a practising engineer is strongly preferred, ideally in systems, mechanical, electrical or software engineering before moving into programme leadership
  • 8+ years driving delivery of complex engineering programmes, including time in a technically accountable role
  • Strong programme management fundamentals: scoping, dependency mapping, risk management, and execution across multiple teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to manage stakeholders across engineering, production and leadership and to push back on unrealistic asks
  • Degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an Australian Government security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience on subsea, maritime, aerospace, automotive or another complex vehicle platform
  • Background in robotics or autonomous systems
  • Familiarity with model-based systems engineering, configuration management, or formal requirements tooling
  • Defence industry experience, including milestone review structures such as SRR, PDR and CDR
  • Experience in a rapidly iterating test environment with close hardware and software integration

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

title: CHARTER SCREENER (PART-TIME)
description:

Huntleigh USA Corporation

Seattle-Tacoma International Airport (SEA)

About the Role

Huntleigh USA Corporation is seeking dependable, professional, and detail-oriented individuals to join our aviation security team as Charter Screeners at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport.

As a Charter Screener, you will help provide a safe and secure travel environment by conducting passenger and baggage screening for charter flight operations. This is a part-time, on-call position, with hours based on charter flight schedules and operational needs.

  • Educate passengers regarding applicable security and travel requirements while providing professional customer service.

  • Maintain constant communication with supervisors regarding security concerns and operational issues.

  • Follow all safety, security, and compliance procedures.

  • Maintain focus and professionalism while working in a fast-paced environment with time constraints, distractions, noise, and large numbers of people.

  • Must be 18 years of age or older.

  • High school diploma or GED required.

  • Must have reliable transportation.

  • Must have a reliable telephone number and active email account.

  • Must be able to read, write, speak, and follow verbal and written instructions in English.

  • Must be able to successfully complete all required background and security screening, including fingerprinting and employment history verification.

  • Must be able to pass required DOT/FAA drug and alcohol testing, including pre-employment and random testing.

  • Must be able to work a flexible, on-call schedule based on charter flight operations.

  • Must be dependable, punctual, and able to respond quickly when called in for a shift.

  • Must be able to stand and walk for prolonged periods.

  • Must be able to lift, carry, and/or hold 50 pounds or more and perform activities including lifting, squatting, stooping, pushing, and bending.

  • Must maintain a neat, well-groomed, and professional appearance.

  • Must be willing to work indoors and outdoors as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous aviation, airport, security, passenger screening, or customer service experience is a plus.

  • Previous screening experience is helpful but not required. Training will be provided.

Why Join Huntleigh USA?

At Huntleigh USA, our employees play an important role in supporting safe, secure, and efficient aviation operations. This position offers an opportunity to work in a dynamic airport environment while gaining valuable experience in aviation security and passenger screening.

Apply today to join the Huntleigh USA team!

Associate Technical Specialist

Als Associate Technical Specialist maak je deel uit van ons MSAT Technical Support-team en speel je een sleutelrol in het waarborgen van robuuste, conforme en efficiënte CAR-T productieprocessen. Deze functie werkt binnen een shiftmodel en biedt directe ondersteuning aan de productieactiviteiten op de werkvloer, inclusief een wachtdienstregeling.

Wat mag je verwachten?

Dit is wat je zal doen:

  • Technical Support & Troubleshooting (Shop Floor Firefighting)
    • Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor procesgerelateerde problemen tijdens productieactiviteiten.
    • Je herprioriteert tijdelijk je werkzaamheden om dringende issues op de productievloer te ondersteunen, via een ticketingsysteem of ad-hoc verzoeken.

    • Je leidt of neemt deel aan escalatiecalls wanneer problemen niet onmiddellijk opgelost kunnen worden, in nauwe samenwerking met MSAT-leidinggevenden, Operations, Quality en technische experts.
  • Brugfunctie tussen MSAT & Operations en Procesverantwoordelijkheid
    • Je bent zichtbaar aanwezig op de werkvloer door actieve betrokkenheid, waaronder GEMBA-walks in Grade B- en Grade C-omgevingen.
    • Je fungeert als wetenschappelijke brug tussen MSAT en Operations en ontwikkelt een diepgaand inzicht in hoe processen op de werkvloer worden uitgevoerd.
    • Je bouwt sterke relaties op met interne stakeholders.
    • Je treedt op als end-to-end proceseigenaar met een grondig begrip van procesrobuustheid, aanvaardbare afwijkingen en optimalisatiemogelijkheden.
    • Je past een wetenschappelijke benadering toe om een correcte behandeling van cellen te garanderen en productieprocessen continu te verbeteren.
  • Project- & Continuous Improvement Support
    • Je ondersteunt initiatieven rond procesverbetering en optimalisatie, met focus op praktische en impactvolle verbeteringen.
    • Je draagt bij aan documentatie-updates, onderzoeken, CAPA's en change controls.
    • Je ondersteunt grotere projecten.
    • Je helpt bij dataverzameling en trendanalyses om onderbouwde beslissingen mogelijk te maken.

Naar wie zijn we op zoek?

Opleiding

  • Je beschikt minimaal over een bachelor diploma in een life sciences-gerelateerd vakgebied of gelijkwaardige ervaring

Ervaring

  • Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar professionele ervaring, waarvan minstens 2 jaar binnen een cGMP biotech- of biofarmaceutische omgeving.
  • Ervaring binnen Cell & Gene Therapy manufacturing is een sterke troef.

Talen

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vlot Engels

Sterktes

  • Je voelt je comfortabel in een operationeel kritische omgeving met ploegensysteem.
  • Je bent een sterke communicator die complexe onderwerpen kan vertalen naar verschillende niveaus binnen de organisatie.
  • Je bent flexibel, proactief en houdt van troubleshooting en snel schakelen.
  • Je bent een teamspeler, empathisch en in staat vertrouwen op te bouwen op de werkvloer

Expertise

  • Je bent sterk in het oplossen van complexe wetenschappelijke en technische problemen met beperkte begeleiding.
  • Je hebt een grondige kennis van cGMP-documentatie, waaronder deviations, CAPA's en change controls.
  • Je beschikt over een analytische, gestructureerde en resultaatgerichte mindset.
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, kwaliteitsgericht en volgens geldende procedures en standaarden.

Wat wij jou bieden?

  • Een betekenisvolle functie met een uitstekende work-life balance. Je werkt 4 dagen gevolgd door 4 dagen vrij (gemiddelde arbeidsduur van 35 uur per week). Je bent bereid te werken in verschillende shifts tussen 06:00 uur en 02:00 uur.
  • Een ondersteunende en innovatieve werkomgeving.

  • Veel leuke en informele evenementen met collega's!

Over Legend Biotech

Legend Biotech is een wereldwijd biotechnologiebedrijf dat zicht toelegt op het ontwikkelen, produceren en commercialiseren van innovatieve en levensreddende celtherapieën, waaronder behandelingen voor hardnekkige ziekten zoals kanker.

Sinds onze oprichting in 2014 in Somerset, New Jersey, zijn we uitgegroeid tot een bedrijf met meer dan 2400 medewerkers in zes productie-eenheden wereldwijd.

In Gent richten we ons op de productie van onze geavanceerde CAR-T-therapie voor de behandeling van multipel myeloom, in samenwerking met Johnson & Johnson.

Perricone Juices has joined forces with the esteemed Natalie’s Orchid Island Juice Company, combining two leaders in the premium citrus juice industry. This strategic acquisition forms a dynamic and growth-oriented company, blending Perricone’s expertise in craft citrus juices with Natalie’s reputation for fresh, high-quality products. Acquisition enhances the company’s market presence and strengthens its position within the industry, opening doors to exciting opportunities for innovation and expansion.

Perricone Juices is currently seeking a Sanitation Supervisor for our Fort Pierce facility, to help lead and advance our operations. This position offers long-term stability and a comprehensive benefits package, including health, vision, dental, life insurance, and a 401(k) plan.

Position Summary:

The Quality Assurance Supervisor leads the day-to-day activities of the QA department to ensure all products meet food safety, quality, and regulatory requirements. This role directs a team of QA technicians and inspectors, oversees in-process and finished product testing, sanitation verification, and hold/release decisions, and ensures compliance with SQF, GMP, FDA 21 CFR Parts 117 and 120, and applicable customer audit standards (including Costco COC/SCS). This role works in close coordination with the HACCP/Document Control Coordinator, who owns the facility's HACCP plan, CCP monitoring program, and document control system; the QA Supervisor ensures the QA team executes CCP monitoring, verification activities, and documentation practices on the production floor in accordance with that program. This is an exempt, supervisory role whose primary duty is the management of the QA department and its employees.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities:

The following duties are representative of the position; other duties may be assigned as business needs require.

  • Supervise, schedule, and direct the daily work of QA technicians and inspectors across assigned shifts, ensuring adequate coverage for all production lines.
  • Interview, select, train, coach, and evaluate QA staff; recommend hiring, discipline, promotion, and termination decisions.
  • Oversee in-process quality checks, finished product testing, and pre-operational and sanitation verification (SSOP) activities.
  • Review and approve hold, release, and rework/disposition decisions on non-conforming product; escalate significant quality deviations to the QA Manager.
  • Ensure compliance with SQF, GMP, FDA 21 CFR Parts 117 and 120, and OSHA; lead or support internal and third-party audits and customer audits (including Costco COC/SCS).
  • Coordinate with the HACCP/Document Control Coordinator to ensure QA staff properly execute CCP monitoring, verification activities, and food safety plan requirements on the production floor; escalate CCP deviations per the food safety plan.
  • Investigate quality complaints, deviations, and non-conformances; lead root cause analysis and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) development and follow-up, looping in the HACCP/Document Control Coordinator on issues tied to CCPs or controlled documents.
  • Maintain accurate and audit-ready QA records, including batch/lot documentation, testing logs, and calibration logs, in accordance with the document control system maintained by the HACCP/Document Control Coordinator.
  • Partner with Production, Maintenance, and Food Safety leadership to resolve quality issues and minimize disruption to the production schedule.
  • Verify calibration and proper use of QA testing equipment and instrumentation; coordinate calibration schedules with outside vendors as needed.
  • Support new product trials, specification changes, and label/claim verification in coordination with R&D and regulatory.
  • Coach and reinforce GMP, allergen control, foreign material control, and food defense practices among production and QA staff.
  • Manage QA supply and testing material needs and coordinate with Purchasing as required.
  • Respond to and direct urgent quality holds or potential recall situations, including off-hours and on-call support as needed.
  • Review the quality of ingredient, COA, and compliance documents of incoming ingredient in coordination with purchasing Team. Sample the bulk ingredient for quality evaluation and USDA Release.
  • Perform daily/weekly shift walk-thru for GMP, Safety, and Sanitation Inspection and audit.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the QA Manager

Supervisory Responsibility:

This position has direct supervisory authority over QA technicians, inspectors, and related quality department staff. The QA Supervisor customarily and regularly directs the work of two or more full-time employees (or their equivalent) and has the authority to hire, fire, promote, and discipline, or whose recommendations on these actions are given particular weight, consistent with the FLSA executive exemption. The HACCP/Document Control Coordinator is a separate exempt position and does not report to the QA Supervisor; the two roles coordinate closely, with the QA Supervisor responsible for day-to-day QA staff supervision and the HACCP/Document Control Coordinator responsible for the food safety plan and document control system.

title: IT Specialist II
description:
Who We Are

We have the fundamental belief that we, as an organization, can and will improve lives. Rooted in the centuries-old credit union philosophy of people helping people, we maintain a simple premise. Those we interact with will receive equal and just treatment, devoid of intolerance, false judgment, racism, or discrimination of any kind. We must not accept less if we are to fulfill our mission, "We Improve Lives." This mission empowers us to serve the greater good and to make a difference in our world. Our cooperative structure creates a cycle of mutual assistance towards the common goal of the financial well-being of members.

At Black Hills Federal Credit Union (BHFCU), we’re committed to improving the lives of our members every day, and we look for people who share that passion. Don’t have a ton of financial industry experience? No problem. Our onboarding includes an orientation program with ongoing training to help staff further their career at BHFCU by building on their existing strengths.

General Purpose:

Responsible for assisting the IT Services Manager in maintaining the in-house computer system and Credit Union's network of personal computers. Responsible for the execution of standardized programs and completing assigned procedures

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Provide coverage and technical support for Corporate and Branch users as directed by IT Services Manager.
  • Develop and maintain scripts and programs that automate repetitive tasks and data transfer in the IT Department.
  • Perform system administrator functions on credit union servers .
  • Responsible for identifying, resolving and documenting all computer-related problems that may occur during the operator's operational shift.
  • Perform daily, weekly, and monthly housekeeping and equipment maintenance as needed or scheduled by the IT Services Manager.
  • Configure, install, troubleshoot, and maintain PCs, network printers, multi-function devices, and other computer peripheral equipment.
  • Remain current on present and new technologies as well as research, recommend, and apply new technologies as they emerge.
  • Provide guidance and training to technicians as directed.

Other Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for performing preventive maintenance procedures for computers as instructed. Prepare standardized reports as directed.
  • Assist supporting employees in the use of personal computers and software, in a timely manner and with little assistance.
  • Assist in the installation of computer program patches, releases, and fixes as directed/scheduled by the IT Services Manager
  • Assist Credit Union staff in using the computer system.
  • Assist the I.T. staff in the installation of PCs/peripherals.
  • Serve as primary maintainer of one major Credit Union computer systems.
  • Research, plan, and oversee implementation on three IT projects, as lead IT member.
  • Perform other duties as may be assigned by IT Services Manager.

Job Knowledge:

  • Working knowledge of Credit Union's in-house computer system.
  • Working knowledge of organization's policies/procedures and Credit Union's service philosophy.
  • Working knowledge of Credit Union's personal computers, networks, and accompanying software.
  • Working knowledge of MS Office software products.

Job Qualifications (Skills):

BHFCU is committed to working with its employees to reasonably accommodate them with the physical aspects of the position. The following list outlines the physical considerations that are normally encountered in this job.

  • Vision: A sighted person to effectively run programs and detect errors.
  • Speech/Hearing: Ability to communicate verbally and in writing with staff and vendors.
  • Manual Dexterity: Ability to perform necessary computer-related input and associated hardware maintenance.
  • Physical Mobility: Some mobility required. Ability to work flexible hours.

Job Qualifications (Ability):

  • Ability to understand and follow complex written and oral instructions.
  • Ability to comprehend complex functions and procedures and to be able to disseminate that knowledge in a clear and understandable format to others.
  • Ability to express oneself, clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.
  • Ability to prepare and maintain confidential records and reports.
  • Ability to gather, assemble, correlate, and analyze facts and develop solutions.
  • Ability to install/maintain computer equipment and associated equipment.
  • Ability to create and manage Active Directory accounts.
  • Ability to configure/manage servers in VMware or other virtualization technology.

Job Qualifications (Education/Experience/Essential Duties/Responsibilities/Ability) - Job Levels:

IT Specialist I

  • Job requires a two-year college level of language, math, and reasoning skills. One to three years of experience in a related field with equal responsibilities is acceptable. Formal training should be supplemented with continuing education.
  • Thorough knowledge and understanding of personal computer software, MS Windows operating systems.

IT Specialist II

  • Meets all requirements for an IT Specialist I.
  • Three to five years’ experience in a related field with equal responsibilities is acceptable, preferably in the help desk environment. Formal training should be supplemented with continuing education.

Senior IT Specialist

  • Meets all requirements for an IT Specialist II.
  • Five or more years of experience in a related field with equal responsibilities is acceptable. CompTIA A+ Certification or equivalent certification is preferred. Formal training should be supplemented with continuing education.
  • Time Management: Ability to independently meet and set deadlines.
  • Demonstrated ability to take initiative and use appropriate authority.
  • Research skills: ability to research and determine root causes of complex issues.

Working Conditions:

Material and Equipment Involved

  • In-House Computer System / Internet
  • VMWare Virtual Environment
  • LANS and WANs
  • Telecommunication equipment
  • Computer Networks
  • Slack
  • Webex
  • Various Software Applications

Work Environment/Physical Activities

Occasional travel to one of BHFCU’s branch locations or attendance at community events may be required.

Physical Requirements

Perform primarily sedentary work with limited physical exertion and occasional lifting of up to 20 lbs. Must be capable of climbing / descending stairs in emergency situation. Must be able to operate routine office equipment including telephone, copier, facsimile, and calculator. Must be able to routinely perform work on computer for an average of 6-8 hours per day, when necessary. Must be able to work extended hours whenever required or requested by management. Must be capable of travel by automobile (as driver and passenger), commercial airlines, rental vehicles and public transportation and be able to lodge in public facilities. Must be capable of regular, reliable and timely attendance.

Working Conditions

Must be able to routinely perform work indoors in climate-controlled private office with minimal noise.

Mental and/or Emotional Requirements

Must be able to perform job functions independently and work effectively either on own or as part of a team. Must be able to plan and direct the work activities of self and others. Must be able to read and carry out various written instructions and follow oral instructions. Must be able to speak clearly and deliver information in a logical and understandable sequence. Must be able to perform complex mathematical calculations with extreme accuracy. Must be capable of dealing calmly and professionally with numerous different personalities from diverse cultures at various levels within and outside of the organization and demonstrate highest levels of customer service and discretion when dealing with the public. Must be able to perform responsibilities with composure under the stress of deadlines / requirements for extreme accuracy and quality and/or fast pace. Must be able to effectively handle multiple, simultaneous, and changing priorities. Must be capable of exercising highest level of discretion on both internal and external confidential matters.

Notice: This job description is not intended to be, nor should it be construed as, a contract or guarantee of employment. Black Hills Federal Credit Union adheres to all federal and state labor laws regarding termination and probationary periods. This position is also subject to all the personnel policies of Black Hills Federal Credit Union. Changes may be made to this job description at any time by the President. Black Hills Federal Credit Union is an equal opportunity employer.

Black Hills Federal Credit Union is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to age, race, color, sex, sexual orientation, genetic information, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status or condition protected by state or federal law. BHFCU will provide reasonable accommodation to qualified persons with a disability but who are otherwise able to perform the essential functions of the job.

  • Vision
  • Life Insurance

Job Summary:

The Mill Cutoff Operator Group 2 assists the mill operator with mill changeovers, monitors tube quality, performs equipment adjustments and maintenance, and supports inspection, documentation, and training activities to ensure consistent product quality. This role requires adherence to safety and quality systems while performing physically demanding tasks in a manufacturing environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Assist mill operator in changeover of mill.

Constantly monitors quality of tube for surface condition, measures for I.D. flash, O.D. size, gauge, length, end condition and checks for tube straightness

Makes adjustments to or replaces cutoff tooling as needed

Lubricates cutoff, greases bearings, oils gear boxes as time permits

Assist in eddy current setup and maintains painting unit

Helps mill loader when possible

Keeps heat numbers separate

Documents weld mill final inspection sheet as needed

Aids in training of new employees

Cleans all areas of the plant when not directed to do anything else

Performs miscellaneous duties as directed.

The incumbent is expected to understand that all employees have a shared responsibility for the quality of products and related services provided to our customers. Duties and responsibilities are to be carried out in accordance with the PTC Quality Management System and its policies, procedures, and work instructions as applicable to the job or function being performed.

title: Program Delivery Specialist - Occasional Part-Time  (Ponca City)
description:
Public Strategies Overview

Public Strategies is a dynamic professional services firm with more than 35 years of experience delivering innovative communications, consulting, technology, events, and project management solutions. Our collaborative team of problem solvers, creatives, technologists, trainers, communicators, and change agents is committed to doing good well.

Serving private sector, government, and nonprofit clients nationwide, Public Strategies delivers award winning products and experiences. Public Strategies has also pioneered nationally respected human services programs supporting low income and other vulnerable populations. Through our integrated initiatives (including One Set Studio, our cutting edge virtual production space, and NextThought, our eLearning initiative) we elevate storytelling, training, videos, and immersive experiences for leading national brands.


Position Summary

Program Delivery Specialists play a key role in delivering Public Strategies’ curriculum based programs. They lead engaging learning experiences that help individuals and families build knowledge, strengthen skills, and achieve meaningful personal goals. Program Delivery Specialists implement evidence informed curricula with fidelity, create inclusive learning environments, and support participants throughout their learning journey.

This occasional part time position is part of the Knowledge Development and Deployment Team within the Knowledge and Practice Division and reports to the Manager of Facilitation Practice and Quality. Program Delivery Specialists select their preferred availability, and assignments are scheduled based on program needs and individual availability. Required training, preparation, and periodic professional development are scheduled as needed to support successful program delivery.

Essential Job Functions

Program Delivery & Facilitation

  • Deliver assigned community based programs using established curricula, materials, and delivery standards.
  • Facilitate interactive learning experiences that encourage discussion, reflection, and practical skill building.
  • Adapt facilitation techniques to meet participant needs while maintaining fidelity to program content.
  • Coordinate with co facilitators and program staff to ensure consistent, high quality program delivery.

Participant Engagement & Support

  • Build positive and trusting relationships with participants to support engagement and continued participation.
  • Reinforce program concepts and help participants apply new knowledge and skills.
  • Assist participants in goal setting, activities, identifying resources, and navigating barriers.
  • Maintain awareness of community resources and provide referrals when appropriate.

Program Operations & Participant Experience

  • Assist with preparing program materials, technology, supplies, and learning spaces before each session as needed.
  • Welcome participants, support check in processes, and help create an inclusive environment.
  • Monitor participant needs during sessions and address routine on site issues.
  • Assist with restoring and organizing the learning environment after program activities.
  • Represent Public Strategies professionally with participants, partners, host sites, and community stakeholders.

Program Quality & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate and timely attendance records, participant documentation, and required program forms.
  • Provide feedback on participant engagement, curriculum implementation, and operational needs.
  • Participate in quality assurance activities to support consistent program standards.
  • Other duties as assigned and accepted.

Professional Expectations

  • Program Delivery Specialists must complete all required onboarding, program specific training, certification activities (when applicable), and ongoing professional development to maintain proficiency and delivery quality.

title: Technical Lead (.NET/AWS) - Manchester
description:
CreateFuture is an AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what's not working and helping them to build the future.

We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel, and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference while always putting people first. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.

About the role and team
We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Technical Lead with a strong background in .NET, AWS, event-driven architecture, and continuous delivery to join a team delivering and modernising a broad range of business-critical applications and services. This is very much a lead engineer role: you'll spend the majority of your time writing code, setting technical direction by example, and working closely with engineering teams and client stakeholders.

The successful candidate will work across a broad technology landscape including .NET, Next,js and AWS. You will play a key role in building scalable, event-driven, cloud-native solutions, improving existing systems, and setting the technical bar for delivery.

This role requires someone comfortable operating within challenging technical environments, able to work closely with engineering teams and stakeholders to simplify, improve, and evolve existing services. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills are essential, as many existing platforms and services have significant operational and organisational investment behind them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a hands-on Tech Lead, writing production code as the majority of your day-to-day activity while setting technical direction for the team.

  • Design, develop, and maintain applications and services using .NET technologies and AWS cloud platforms.

  • Work hands-on across a broad technology landscape including .NET, Next.js and AWS

  • Drive continuous delivery practices, improving build, test, and release pipelines to enable frequent, low-risk deployments.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify, rationalise, and improve existing systems and services.

  • Design and implement Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform.

  • Support cloud-native engineering practices and platform improvements across AWS environments.

  • Contribute to frontend application development using Next.js or similar modern JavaScript frameworks.

  • Engage directly and confidently with business stakeholders, translating technical trade-offs into terms that support good decision-making.

  • Promote best practices in software engineering, maintainability, scalability, and operational excellence.

  • Support teams through technical challenges and modernisation initiatives.

Required Experience
  • Strong, hands-on experience as a Tech Lead or Lead Engineer working within .NET environments.
  • Good experience across both modern .NET and legacy .NET Framework applications.
  • Strong experience with AWS cloud technologies.
  • Strong experience designing and implementing event-driven architecture.
  • Strong experience with continuous delivery, including CI/CD pipeline design and delivery automation.
  • Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
  • Experience working within complex or evolving technical environments.
  • Frontend development experience using Next.js or similar JavaScript frameworks.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence engaging directly with business stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working hands-on within challenging technical environments, spending the majority of time writing code rather than managing people.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across engineering and business teams.
Nice to Have
  • Experience modernising legacy enterprise applications and services.
  • Exposure to WCF, WPF, and broader legacy Microsoft technology stacks.
  • Experience supporting platform consolidation or transformation initiatives.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tooling and harness engineering concepts.

    Note: this role requires onsite time in the office in Manchester 2-3 days per week.

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

  • Call with our Talent Acquisition Team
  • Role specific capability interview

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

We look forward to your application!

title: Senior Product Manager — Rwanda Portfolio
description:
Who We Are!

🌍 Africa has the world’s youngest and fastest-growing population. By 2035, the continent is poised to contribute more young people to the global workforce each year than the rest of the world combined.

At Educate! we're obsessed with impact. We leverage iterative learning to build highly scalable youth employment solutions aimed at unlocking the potential of the world’s youngest continent.

Educate! prepares youth in Africa to learn, earn and thrive in today’s economy by:

  1. Introducing an employment-focused school subject into secondary and
  2. Delivering livelihood boot camps for out-of-school youth, with a focus on marginalized rural girls and young women.

To date, more than 500,000 youth have been meaningfully impacted across Uganda, Rwanda, Kenya, and Tanzania, and along the way, Educate! has become the largest youth employment and skills provider in East Africa.

Educate! is a team of over 300 largely African staff and 300 volunteer youth mentors. We prioritize building an engaging, fulfilling and growth oriented work environment. 50% of our top 30 leaders have been with us for over 5 years, 10+ alumni have started their own organizations, and 6 current or former team members were Acumen Fund East Africa fellows.

We have been backed by top foundations such as Imaginable Futures, Livelihood Impact Fund, Jack Dorsey’s #startsmall, CIFF and Echidna Giving. Educate! won a 2018 Klaus J. Jacobs Prize and a 2015 WISE Award, and has been highlighted by the World Bank’s S4YE's Impact Portfolio, an Al Jazeera documentary, BBC, The Brookings Institution as one of 14 case studies on scaling education, and the Gates Foundation as a Goalkeepers Accelerator. In 2022, we received a catalytic investment from philanthropist Mackenzie Scott to scale our systems change work.

Educate!'s long-term vision is to design solutions that measurably impact millions of youth across Africa each year.

Good to note: To Our Awesome Applicants! 🚀💫

We know that incredible candidates sometimes hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every requirement. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply!

We’re looking for passionate individuals who believe in our mission and can bring unique perspectives to our team—not just those who check every box. We value diversity and strongly encourage women and individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Position Overview

At Educate!, we build learning experiences that change what youth employment looks like across Africa — products reaching hundreds of thousands of young people in Uganda, Kenya, Rwanda, and Tanzania. As Senior Product Manager — Rwanda Portfolio, you will own the translation of the broader strategy to quarterly strategy aligned to the learning experience (LX) strategy and agreed roadmap set for Rwanda for the PBA Sustainability Phase and the AI for Systems Change Product Suite. This is not a programme management role. It is a product role with real strategic authority over what gets built, how it gets tested, and whether it scales.

Rwanda’s team is small. There is no dedicated designer on the ground. As a result, this role carries a dual mandate: product strategy and learning experience (LX) design. You will own both — from defining what gets built and why, leveraging the wider design team for support, to making sure the materials, tools, and experiences that reach students, teachers, and district officials are grounded in evidence and fit for context.

You will work closely with the Global Director, ESS & Tech Products, who sets the broader strategy. Your job is to translate that strategic direction into executed, evidence-backed products at speed — and over time to take on increasing ownership of investment decisions, government engagement, and strategic oversight.

If you are a hands-on operator who also thinks strategically, can hold ambiguity without losing momentum, and want to work at the front edge of AI in education, this is the role for you.

What you will be accountable for in the first 12 months

  • PBA Year 2 is running in line with the strategy set
  • Coach Fabs prototype is tested with a student cluster and teacher cohort with insights and learning documented to inform scale.
  • CPD digital monitoring framework is designed with REB

What You’ll Do🌟

Rwanda Portfolio Strategy

Strategic commitment: Operationalize the product strategy for the PBA Sustainability Phase and AI for Systems Change — within the strategic direction set by the Global Director — making deliberate trade-offs, surfacing risks proactively, and building toward full ownership of next-stage decisions over time.

  • Design and iteratively test a project bank of student projects, coordinating teacher designers through rubric development, testing, proofreading, and deployment in collaboration with NESA.
  • Design and test the Coach Fabs virtual coaching model for students and teachers across delivery formats (hybrid and fully online; synchronous and asynchronous), structuring sessions around measurable behavioural change.
  • Own and maintain Rwanda's core strategy artefacts: value proposition, theory of change, lean canvas for AI products, user personas, and product risk register — kept live and decision-relevant.
  • Contribute to Tanzania Phase 2 Business Studies Fund design, drawing on Rwanda's proof of concept and lessons from experimentation with the DDE fund.

Learning Experience Design & Product Quality

Strategic commitment: Own LX design for Rwanda's full product suite — PBA materials, Coach Fabs session guides, dashboard training, and CPD tools — ensuring every touchpoint is grounded in evidence and fit for Rwanda's context.

  • Own the full suite of product builds: project bank materials, rubrics, student and teacher session guides, assessment tools, and workshop materials — from brief to final deployment.
  • Own LX strategy and user journeys across both PBA and AI products — set quality standards, establish review mechanisms, and hold any external designers or consultants accountable to them.
  • Lead the design of Coach Fabs' Kinyarwanda-localised AI coaching experience — working with the tech team and local language leads to validate tone, vocabulary, and pedagogical approach.
  • Design the CPD tracking interface requirements for the digital monitoring tool — translating district workflow realities into a product brief for the infrastructure partner, liaising with REB on the prototype.

Product Development & Experimentation

Strategic commitment: Run structured, evidence-generating experiments that answer Rwanda's highest-stakes product questions — and translate findings into clear decisions, not just reports.

  • Own the full learning and experiments agenda for Rwanda's AI products — defining what must be learned at each stage, how evidence will be generated, and how findings feed into the investment cases.
  • Own Coach Fabs' measurement framework for students and teachers — defining business action indicators (problem identified, customers spoken to, first sale) and designing data collection to attribute impact above the PBA baseline; and for teachers, defining indicators that capture whether 'assign, feedback, and present' are being supported through the digital tool.
  • Scope and manage the student coaching platform for Rwanda — working with the tech team to adapt LLM infrastructure for Kinyarwanda-language delivery.
  • Contribute to the CPD evaluation plan — baseline data collection, indicator definition, and digital monitoring pilot design in partnership with REB.

Government & Stakeholder Engagement

Strategic commitment: Maintain and deepen Educate!'s partnership with NESA, REB, and district officials — ensuring government co-ownership of Rwanda's PBA and AI agenda, and progressively taking on more of the external relationship work currently shared with the Global Director.

  • Lead district and national workshop facilitation on PBA projects and competitions — driving active government collaboration and institutional buy-in.
  • Coordinate with NESA on PBA national exam integration, delivery logistics, and quality assurance; coordinate with DDEs and DEOs on SEI accountability and school competition delivery.
  • Lead NESA, REB, and DDE/DEO engagement independently — handling strategic conversations and surfacing product risks without Global leadership in the room.
  • Own the CPD and partner infrastructure relationships — coordinating roles, avoiding duplication, and aligning the CPD monitoring tool with existing reporting chains and teacher management structures.

Documentation, Systems Building & Knowledge Management

Strategic commitment: Convert Rwanda's experimental work into structured, institutionalised systems that reduce dependence on individuals, enable the team to operate without central support, and build institutional memory that allows Rwanda to scale.

  • Create and maintain SOPs for PBA design, selection, training, and deployment processes; document all experiment findings systematically in Confluence — not just what happened, but the rationale and what it means for next decisions.
  • Build and maintain Rwanda's product performance dashboard — tracking PBA and AI metrics and using it actively in strategic decisions, not just for reporting.
  • Lead budget variance (BvA) reviews for Rwanda's product budgets — identifying variances, flagging cost risks, and making financial trade-off recommendations to the Global Director.
  • Create institutional memory that allows government stakeholders and internal teams to operate independently — reducing single points of failure at every level of the programme.

Who You Are 🦸‍♀️🦸‍♂️

  • Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into executed products — you have shipped something, measured it, and used the evidence to make the next call.
  • Experience managing government or institutional stakeholders in a low-resource, high-stakes context — and a track record of building trust without relying on seniority to open doors.
  • Comfort holding ambiguity — you can move fast when the brief is incomplete and know when to ask and when to decide.
  • Learning experience or instructional design instinct — you think about how information lands, not just what it says.
  • Strong written and analytical communication — you can write a concise synthesis that moves a decision, not just a status report.
  • Kinyarwanda fluency and familiarity with Rwanda's education system, government structures, and political landscape is strongly preferred.
  • Fits our Five Culture Tenets (see What is Educate! About? below); Learn more by looking at Educate!’s culture deck here

What We Offer

  • A vibrant, mission-driven environment with a supportive and fun team.
  • Competitive salary based on experience.
  • Learning & growth opportunities

Application Process: Rolling basis, interviews happening soon!

Terms

  • Location is Kigali, Rwanda

Our Culture & Tenets(Values) 🌱

We’re ambitious. Are you? Educate! is growing fast, so new opportunities are opening up and expanding all the time. We’re inspired by people with drive, and we love to help them reach their full potential. We expect everyone at Educate! to contribute above and beyond their job description, grow their skills, and advance their careers, and we are committed to supporting our staff members on that journey of their careers, and we are committed to supporting our staff members on that journey.

  1. We put Youth First, Impact-Obsessed - We are purpose-driven, focused on impact, and prioritize what truly matters. We listen to youth, design our efforts around their needs, and ensure every dollar creates transformative experiences they value.
  2. We Exceed Expectations - We take pride in going above and beyond to achieve the best results—proactively identifying problems and seeking solutions without waiting or stopping at what's requested.
  3. We Are Always Learning - We are committed to seeking and applying new knowledge and ideas. We stay open-minded and continuously try new things, experiment, grow, and improve. We invest in learning for ourselves and our teams.
  4. We are One Team, Many Views - We value all individuals, believe diverse ideas and open dialogue drive excellence, foster a supportive and respectful environment where everyone can freely express themselves. We work as one team and prioritize the organization's mission over personal or team interests.
  5. We have the Startup Mindset - We innovate relentlessly to grow our impact, we never think “we have arrived” or “we’re done.”We constantly challenge the status quo, embrace change, and move quickly toward our vision. Unafraid of failure, we question anything that hinders progress.

Every person at Educate! — from interns to the executive director — is evaluated by how they live up to these five cultural tenets. They are at the core of how we achieve our mission and why we work as well as we do. Educate is committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for all who interact in our community. In creating this environment, we encourage people from a variety of cultures, backgrounds and life experiences to join our diverse team.

We’re committed to ensuring all candidates are screened for child and youth safety. As part of the process, candidates must successfully complete our standard background verification and safeguarding review in accordance with local legal standards. Educate! reserves the right to withdraw an offer of employment if any screening results indicate potential risks to youth.

title: Supervisor of Clinical Services (58506)

description:
SUMMARY

Are you ready to join a dynamic team of dedicated values-based leaders and professionals who are committed to creating a healthy, addiction-free world?

As a Clinical Supervisor at Phoenix House, you will provide direct clinical services, review and approve all facets of discharge planning and provide routine supervision to clinical staff.

If this sounds like you, we invite you to apply. Be part of something bigger — help us build a healthier, addiction-free future together.

***Phoenix House of NY is proudly offering 100% employer-paid medical insurance for all eligible employees and their dependents!***

About Us

Phoenix House of New York | Long Island is a nonprofit organization dedicated to helping individuals and families overcome substance use disorders and achieve lasting recovery. We provide treatment, housing, and support services for our clients and their families. Our core values— Integrity, Compassion, Appreciation, Respect, Excellence, and Forward Thinking —guide our approach, ensuring each person receives evidence-based care that promotes dignity and wellness. By upholding these values, we empower people to rebuild their lives with hope, accountability, and support.

What We Offer

At Phoenix House, we recognize that in today’s economic climate, stability and support matter more than ever. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to care for you as a whole person—supporting your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance. Here are some of our perks:

  • (10) Paid Holidays

  • Paid vacation, sick time, personal and wellness time

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance for those who are scheduled to work at least 30 hours per week

  • Pet insurance, legal support, and other supplemental insurance

  • A generous tuition reimbursement program

  • 403(b) retirement plan

  • Competitive wages and more...

You will have responsibilities including but not limited to:

• Provides direct clinical services (i.e., crisis intervention/de-escalation, assessment, counseling, family therapy, referrals, and discharge planning) to patients as needed

• Assists clinical staff in the development of treatment/recovery plans, ensuring that such plans address all facets of a patient's treatment -- mental health, substance abuse, education, and vocational rehabilitation

• Review and approve all facets of discharge planning

• Ensures that treatment operations meet clinical regulations

• Ensures that treatment operations comply with Medicaid and other reimbursement standards

• Designates staff to perform tasks required under regulations (i.e., evaluation of patients’ needs, development and implementation of treatment/recovery plans, etc.)

• Conducts regular interdisciplinary case conferences.

• Leads workshops and individual or group therapy sessions, as needed, in conjunction with other clinical staff.

• Works with counselors in all areas of their job functions and facilitates open, consistent, skill focused clinical supervision and staff development, documenting as needed.

• Reviews clinical documentation of staff; participates in or leads the clinical case review process; supports, monitors, and implements clinical and recovery support programming for all phases of treatment.

title: Transportation Driver
description:
The Transportation Driver is responsible for providing safe, timely, courteous, and dependable transportation for residents across all levels of care at Sunshine Meadows Retirement Community (SMRC). The Transportation Driver supports residents in accessing medical appointments, services, activities, and other approved destinations while maintaining resident safety, dignity, privacy, and comfort.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Safely transport residents while protecting their health, dignity, privacy, and comfort.
  • Promptly report missed or cancelled appointments, wrong destinations, delays, resident refusals, or other issues to the supervisor or nursing staff.
  • Secure residents and mobility devices using approved safety equipment before moving the vehicle.
  • Assist residents safely during vehicle entry and exit, avoiding unsafe discharge locations.
  • Follow SMRC protocols for accidents, medical emergencies, missing residents, condition changes, bad weather, or breakdowns.
  • Immediately report accidents, injuries, resident incidents, unusual resident behaviors, or changes in condition to the appropriate SMRC team member and complete required documentation.
  • Maintain effective communication with nursing, scheduling, providers, residents, families, and other departments as appropriate to transportation responsibilities.
  • Must maintain resident confidentiality and comply with HIPAA, SMRC policies, and applicable state and federal requirements.
  • When transportation responsibilities have been completed, assist with other appropriate duties within the facility as assigned.
  • Attend required orientation, safety education, resident-rights training, emergency preparedness training, and other assigned in-services.
  • Maintain vehicles and report mechanical or safety issues promptly, avoiding unsafe vehicles.
  • Verify wheelchair lifts, ramps, securements, and emergency equipment before transport.
  • Report damage, accidents, warning lights, or equipment failures immediately.
  • Obey traffic laws and SMRC safe-driving rules, avoiding distracted driving and unauthorized phone use.

GENERAL EXPLANATION

  • All listed duties are essential unless noted; additional tasks may be assigned.
  • Qualifications represent minimum requirements for the role.
  • Transportation must align with care plans, safety rules, assessed needs, and nursing instructions.
  • Immediately report any threats to resident safety, health, care continuity, or appointments.
  • Reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities are provided under applicable law.
  • The Transportation Driver must comply with the SMRC Code of Conduct, Corporate Compliance Program, resident rights, HIPAA, SMRC policies, and applicable laws

title: LEASING ASSOCIATE
description:

It is you who will be the first contact for our prospective residents and it is you who will be the driving force in helping them find the best place to call home. title: Hardware Associate - Part-time
description:
Hardware Associate

Why You’ll Love This Role

  • Help customers find exactly what they need to complete their projects and keep their homes or jobs moving.
  • Build relationships with a diverse range of retail customers while representing our store.
  • Enjoy a hands-on, active role that combines store upkeep, inventory management, and customer interaction.
  • Work for a values-driven company that puts people first and values ownership, honesty, and continuous improvement.
  • Join a team committed to safety, service, and supporting our local community.

title: Software Engineer - Developer Surface
description:

It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. title: Adult Care Specialist
description:
Adult Care Specialist

Full-Time 3rd Shift - Sat, Sun, Mon, Tues - 11pm-7am

Part-Time 2nd Shift - Sat & Sun - 3pm-11pm

Be the mentor. Be the coach. Be the steady presence. Help young people build what comes next.

Are you the kind of person who can turn a tough day into a fresh start? Do you believe young people have incredible potential—and that sometimes they just need someone in their corner to help them see it?

We’re looking for an Adult Care Specialist who is compassionate, energetic, patient, and ready to make a real difference in the lives of young adults.

This isn’t a desk job. You’ll be a mentor, coach, problem-solver, activity leader, role model, and trusted support for youth as they build life skills, work toward their goals, and prepare for greater independence.

Every day brings something different—and every day is an opportunity to help someone take another step forward.

What You’ll Do

🌟 Help Youth Find Their Strengths

  • Engage, inspire, and connect with youth in meaningful ways.
  • Help young adults identify, explore, and work toward their own goals.
  • Use a strengths-based, youth-centered approach to help residents build confidence and independence.
  • Get to know each young person’s unique circumstances, preferences, strengths, and goals—and incorporate those into daily activities and support.
  • Be a mentor, coach, encourager, and positive role model.

🧭 Help Them Build Real-Life Skills

You’ll help young adults develop the skills they need to thrive, including:

  • Self-care and hygiene
  • Daily living skills
  • Community resources
  • Problem-solving
  • Social skills and inclusion
  • Independent living skills
  • Goal setting and personal development

You’ll provide both one-on-one and group skill-building support and help create structured activities that are meaningful, engaging, and—yes—even fun.

🛡️ Create a Safe & Supportive Environment

  • Supervise youth and maintain a safe, productive environment.
  • Be aware of residents’ activities and whereabouts.
  • Use trauma-informed language and strength-based approaches, especially during difficult moments.
  • Support youth during crisis situations and help them regain a sense of control.
  • Facilitate problem-solving rather than simply solving problems for them.
  • Provide therapeutic interventions when required and directed by individualized service plans.

📝 Keep Things on Track

Great support also means great follow-through. You’ll:

  • Complete required documentation in the electronic health record (EHR).
  • Maintain accurate records, reports, evaluations, and other documentation.
  • Follow individualized service plans.
  • Communicate important resident concerns and program needs to incoming shifts.
  • Follow agency, federal, and state policies, procedures, and regulations.

🤝 Be Part of the Team

You won’t do this work alone. You’ll:

  • Participate in staff meetings, supervision, and agency/department meetings.
  • Attend trainings, seminars, and professional development opportunities.
  • Stay current on safeguarding, health and safety, and relevant policies.
  • Communicate and collaborate with coworkers to keep the program running smoothly.

🍳 And Yes… There’s a Little Bit of Everything

Depending on the day, you might:

  • Organize a group activity.
  • Help someone navigate a community resource.
  • Coach a resident through a difficult conversation.
  • Drive clients to a program activity.
  • Prepare a meal.
  • Celebrate a resident reaching a personal goal.
  • Help someone work through a problem.
  • Be the calm, steady person someone needs that day.

No two days are exactly alike—and that’s part of the fun.

You’ll Be Great in This Role If You Are…

  • Trauma-informed and able to meet people where they are.
  • Empathetic, patient, and genuinely interested in helping young adults succeed.
  • Comfortable working with diverse populations and committed to LGBTQ+ inclusion and racial equity.
  • A strong communicator who knows how to engage and facilitate meaningful conversations and activities.
  • Someone who can set boundaries while still building trusting relationships.
  • Safety-minded and comfortable supervising residents in a residential setting.
  • A natural mentor, coach, encourager, and role model.
  • Flexible and adaptable when plans inevitably change.
  • A creative problem-solver who can stay calm under pressure.
  • Comfortable using Microsoft Office Suite and electronic documentation systems.
  • A team player who understands that communication and consistency matter.

Role Summary:

The Brand Content Strategist is Gesa’s lead copywriter and brand voice steward. This role creates clear, compelling, and distinctly Gesa content that helps members understand products, act, and see the difference their membership makes in the communities they call home. This position is responsible for hands on copywriting and editing across Gesa’s marketing channels, including brand campaigns, web, email, product marketing, advertising, direct mail, social media, branch materials, video and audio scripts, member communications, and community storytelling. This role establishes the standards, ownership, workflows, and planning practices that make Gesa content more connected, consistent, timely, and useful. The Brand Content Strategist also helps evolve how Marketing uses emerging content tools, including AI, to improve ideation, research, content development, quality, and workflow efficiency while maintaining Gesa’s brand standards, accuracy, and human judgment.

What You Will Be Doing:

  1. Serve as Gesa’s lead copywriter, creating and editing high-quality content across brand campaigns, web pages, emails, advertising, direct mail, product marketing, social media, branch materials, video and audio scripts, member communications, and community storytelling
  2. Lead content strategy, editorial planning, and copy development for major brand campaigns, community initiatives, member education, product marketing efforts, newsletters, community partnerships, giveback programs, and brand storytelling
  3. Coordinate input from subject matter experts and internal partners to translate complex information, including financial products and member benefits, into clear, useful, and meaningful member communications
  4. Serve as the internal authority on Gesa’s brand voice, ensuring content reflects its responsible, generous, human, optimistic, and playful personality while providing clear direction, thoughtful editing, and practical feedback across channels
  5. Lead the responsible adoption of AI and emerging content tools within Marketing by identifying useful applications, establishing practical workflows and standards, and helping teams improve ideation, research, content development, quality, and efficiency while maintaining Gesa’s brand standards, accuracy, and human judgment
  6. Develop and execute content strategies that strengthen member engagement, reinforce Gesa’s brand, and create a unified, recognizable story across digital, print, branch, and community channels
  7. Develop, maintain, and govern the tools and standards that guide Gesa content, including messaging frameworks, voice and tone guidance, editorial standards, product copy foundations, templates, approved language, content ownership expectations, AI supported content tools and resources, and examples of strong Gesa communications
  8. Own Gesa’s content governance practices, including content intake, briefing, review, approval, publishing, ownership, version control, review timing, lifecycle management, and clear decision rights
  9. Establish and maintain a content planning rhythm and editorial calendar that connects brand, campaign, product, web, community, social, email, and newsroom priorities
  10. Partner with the appropriate teams to improve website content, navigation language, search visibility, answer engine optimization, accessibility, calls to action, and ongoing content maintenance
  11. Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, duplicate, unclear, missing, or underperforming content. Maintain a prioritized plan to update, consolidate, archive, or retire content as needed
  12. Use content performance, website behavior, search data, and member feedback to inform content priorities and improve future work
  13. Coach internal contributors on Gesa’s voice, writing standards, content tools, and best practices to strengthen content quality across the organization

About You:

  1. Exceptional writing, editing, proofreading, and storytelling skills, with the ability to create clear, accurate, engaging, and distinctly on brand content for a range of audiences, channels, and business priorities
  2. Strong understanding of brand voice, messaging strategy, editorial planning, content governance, and content lifecycle management
  3. Ability to translate complex information into useful, easy to understand member communications
  4. Strong strategic thinking skills with the ability to connect organizational priorities, audience needs, community impact, and brand goals
  5. Ability to develop practical content standards, workflows, tools, and templates that improve consistency, efficiency, and quality
  6. Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines
  7. Collaborative and confident working style, with the ability to build strong relationships, influence decisions, and provide constructive feedback across teams
  8. Working knowledge of search engine optimization, answer engine optimization, web content best practices, accessibility, analytics, and performance measurement
  9. Ability to evaluate and -responsibly apply AI enabled content and workflow tools while maintaining strong editorial judgment, accuracy, brand standards, and human oversight
  10. Detail oriented with strong judgment, consistency, and follow through
  11. Proficiency with content management systems, project management tools, and common digital marketing platforms preferred

title: Social Clipping Editor (7596)
description:

Creative Direction and Quality Control

In This Role, You Bring

title: Parking Supervisor - THE POLAR EXPRESS Train Ride, Whippany, NJ
description:
Job Title: Parking Supervisor - THE POLAR EXPRESS™ Train Ride

Division/Department: Rail Events Productions/Front of House

Reports To: Rail Events Inc. (REI) Business Manager FOH

Type of position: Non-exempt/Hourly

Employee Classification: Seasonal

Compensation: $23.00/hourly

Job Summary:

The Parking Supervisor is responsible for creating the first impression of the event, so efficiency and friendliness are required. The position is responsible for creating and leading efficient parking experience, warmly greeting customers, confirming parking reservations, and directing patrons as needed. The Parking Supervisor manages responsibilities with a balance of patience and a sense of urgency, works well under pressure, has strong multi-tasking skills, and most importantly has a pleasant demeanor.

Being part of the Front of House team is an excellent opportunity to learn about the business side of production and be the first interaction our guests experience. The high-energy logistics of moving folks through parking, the box office, waiting areas and onto their departure on time with all the amenities needed for the production is extremely rewarding, knowing guests are on their way to making lasting memories with loved ones. The Front of House team is also an integral part of providing customer service to our guests and support to cast and crew on the ground.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Act as an example to, and assist in leading, the entire Parking Attendant team
  • Act as a liaison between the Parking Attendants and the FOH & Business Manager
  • Create efficient parking experience
  • Welcome customers and assist the team with any service needs for efficient parking experience
  • Handle customer parking inquiries and ensure a pleasant customer experience
  • Confirm parking reservations, ensuring passengers have arrived at the appropriate date and time
  • Direct customer to the ticketing area if ticket updates and/ or more information is required
  • Assist in general care, maintenance and safety of parking area including keeping a clean and orderly space
  • Communicate any safety or maintenance concerns to FOH Manager
  • Maintain a safe, welcoming, positive, and inclusive working environment and advises other management with related concerns
  • Communicate the importance of parking safety and implement practices with parking attendant team
  • Other duties as assigned

Education, Skill & Work Experience Requirements:

  • Ability to learn the Etix Ticketing platform with efficiency and competency.
  • Strong leadership and communication skills
  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Basic computer skills
  • Ability to work weekends and evenings
  • Possess a well-spoken manner in personal communications
  • Front desk, reservation, customer service experience preferred
  • Self-motivation and attention to details
  • Alert and aware of surroundings
  • Must be 18 or over

Work Environment:

  • Majority of time is spent in an outdoor setting
  • Able to work in cold, snowy, or otherwise inclement winter weather
  • Varied schedule requiring evenings, weekends, and overtime
  • Able to stand for prolonged periods of time

  • Time spent in and around active railroad yard(s)

Working on THE POLAR EXPRESS™ Train Ride is unlike anything you will ever do. This immersive experience is entirely unique to Rail Events Productions. The challenge of producing a full-length production on a moving train is one of the most rewarding experiences as an artist or technician. With a total cast, crew and front-of-house employees of 60-75 people onsite every day and the possibility of over 2,000 guests, our days can be chaotic. With such a fast-paced environment, the team at Rail Events Productions takes care to properly support and teach everyone the best ways to accomplish their jobs. We strive to build a space where employees are safe and encouraged to grow throughout their time with the company.

Rail Events Productions, an American Heritage Railways subsidiary, is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Data Architect (Consultant)
description:
OREDATA is a Digital Transformation & IT Consulting firm with 10+ years of proven expertise and hundreds of successfully implemented projects across the EMEA region. Apply and be part of our exciting journey!

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Architect to lead the assessment and modernization of our client's existing data environment and help shape the future architecture of their enterprise data platform. (Cargo Industry)

The current environment includes a complex Data Warehouse ecosystem, MsSQL and SSIS-based ETL processes, multiple reporting environments, and legacy systems.   • Provide architectural and technical guidance to teams throughout the transformation.

Requirements

  • Experience with or strong knowledge of Data Governance, including data quality, metadata management, data lineage, and data ownership.
  • Strong ability to communicate and collaborate with different teams on both technical and business matters
  • Based in Istanbul or able to work regularly from Istanbul, as the role may require on-site customer visits and face-to-face meetings.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and architectural decision-making skills.
  • Proactive and self-driven, with the ability to take ownership and provide technical direction.
  • Strong English communication skills (professional working proficiency), both written and verbal

Why Oredata?

  • Learning & Development opportunities for both personal and professional growth
