Position Summary

The Quality Assurance Technician is responsible to ensure compliance of products and processes to defined requirements. QA Technician determines compliance using testing of product properties, auditing of processes providing compliance documentation. QA Technicians are also responsible to initiating the nonconforming product process, providing all defect details, participating in correction teams as requested, and determining the next steps to achieve disposition.

Essential Job Duties/Responsibilities

  • Conducts all audits and testing to requirements per published documentation.
  • Conduct acceptance testing on incoming raw materials, intermediate/first pass products and finished goods per pre-defined schedule or upon request.
    • Prepare test samples and conduct testing per requirements to reduce sample to sample and person to person variation.
  • Disposition finished goods based on test results compared to provided specifications and product trends/history within appropriate databases and ERP.
    • Monitor inventory in QA and “out of flow” statuses, coordinating with necessary personnel to disposition material in a timely manner.
  • Document all auditing/testing results in defined databases, and file & maintain all physical samples kept as “retains” per requirements. Review data and samples to ensure accuracy to requirements.
  • Complete special requirements for customer/products as defined:
    • After review for accuracy, generate finished good Certificate of Analysis (COA) for each completed lot/product. Send to customer as required, upon shipment of product/lot to the customer.
    • Produce, properly label, and provide to Shipping customer chips to be included with initial shipment to customer.
  • Review incoming raw materials Certificates of Analysis (COA) to raw material requirements and provide appropriate disposition in ERP. Maintain records as required.
  • Initiate and facilitate the nonconforming product process.
    • Conduct and document confirmation, containment, and correction testing.
    • Perform communication of nonconforming condition to affected teams.
    • Participate in correction (color and other) and/or root cause investigations to reduce occurrences of the nonconforming condition.

title: Product Manager, Peer-to-Peer Events
description:
Highlights:

Location: Georgia

Language: Fluent in Russian and English (C1+)

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About Peer-to-Peer at Fundraise Up

Peer-to-Peer turns supporters into fundraisers. Instead of only donating, a supporter creates a fundraising page, invites others to give, joins a team, or participates in an event on behalf of a nonprofit.

We are building Peer-to-Peer as a new product line. The product starts with two connected directions:

  • P2P DIY: self-serve fundraising for birthdays, memorials, personal challenges, and other supporter-led campaigns.
  • P2P Events: structured, time-bound fundraising programs such as walks, runs, rides, climbs, workplace challenges, and recurring event series.

DIY creates the product foundation. Events extends it with registration, teams and captains, event operations, participant communication, attribution, reporting, and integrations. The two directions must work as one coherent product while serving different customer workflows and levels of complexity.

About the Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to own P2P Events within the broader Peer-to-Peer product line.

This is a hands-on software product role covering discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and iteration. You will turn an ambiguous product area into a focused solution grounded in customer, usage, and commercial evidence.

Events and DIY serve different sides of the same system: nonprofits need to run fundraising programs, while participants need effective tools to fundraise. You will work closely with the PM responsible for the broader P2P area so these experiences and their shared capabilities evolve together.

This is not an event-planning or project-coordination role.

What You’ll Own

Define the product direction

  • Turn customer research, market evidence, and business context into a clear product thesis and sequenced roadmap.
  • Choose a focused target segment and event scenario rather than trying to serve the entire category at once.
  • Decide which capabilities belong in the shared P2P foundation and which require an Events-specific model.
  • Keep assumptions, success metrics, scope, risks, and product decisions explicit.

Lead discovery and product definition

  • Work directly with nonprofit event teams, participants, design partners, and internal GTM teams.
  • Validate decisions through interviews, workflow mapping, prototypes, and live product usage.
  • Separate true adoption blockers from feature requests and incumbent-product expectations.
  • Shape problems such as registration, teams and captains, attribution and reporting, event operations, participant communication, and CRM integrations. These are examples—not a pre-committed feature checklist.

Shape and deliver the product

  • Own the product from problem definition through requirements, delivery, launch, and iteration.
  • Write clear requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and decision records.
  • Make day-to-day scope and trade-off decisions with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Research, and QA.
  • Ensure the product can evolve from simpler events to more advanced team structures, event series, and operational workflows without overbuilding the first release.
  • Keep delivery predictable by surfacing dependencies, risks, and unresolved decisions early.

Launch, learn, and drive outcomes

  • Launch and learn through EAPs with clear entry criteria, success measures, readiness requirements, and out-of-scope areas.
  • Understand whether organizations can run events successfully and whether participants activate, fundraise, and return.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, CSM, and Support on positioning, customer commitments, enablement, and competitive context.
  • Connect product evidence to adoption, expansion, pipeline, retention, and GPV.
  • Turn evidence into clear recommendations: iterate, expand, change direction, or stop.

Work AI-native

  • Use AI for research synthesis, prototyping, specification quality, data exploration, and operational automation.
  • Build testable artifacts quickly without outsourcing product judgment.

Requirements

  • 4–7 years of Product Management or Product Ownership experience in a software product company.
  • End-to-end ownership of a customer-facing product area with Engineering and Design.
  • Strong judgment in reducing a large problem space to a focused release and explaining the trade-offs.
  • Experience turning customer evidence and product data into decisions.
  • Clear written communication across requirements, edge cases, metrics, and decision records.
  • Ability to work with multi-actor workflows, permissions, states, and data relationships.
  • High ownership and independence, with fluent written and spoken English.

Strong plus

  • Experience with B2B SaaS, fundraising, payments, registration, events, community, or other multi-sided products.
  • Experience launching a new product area through beta or EAP.
  • Knowledge of CRM integrations, reporting, transaction attribution, analytics, or SQL.
  • Practical use of AI for research, prototyping, analysis, or product operations.

This Role May Not Be a Fit If

  • You are looking for an event-planning or internal project-management role rather than software product ownership.
  • You prefer to receive a fully defined roadmap and requirements instead of helping determine what should be built.
  • You want to work only on strategy and avoid specifications, QA, delivery details, or post-launch iteration.
  • You treat every customer request as a roadmap commitment.
  • You need stable scope and certainty before moving forward.
  • You measure progress mainly by features shipped rather than customer and business outcomes.

Why work with us

  • A strong, collaborative product team that owns what it builds
  • Clear product vision and access to real customer feedback from global nonprofit leaders
  • Flat structure: no politics, just great work with great people
  • Transparent company culture-we share how we’re growing, where revenue comes from, and what’s next
  • Long-term focus: we offer equity options and value sustained, meaningful contribution

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is GEL12,650 - GEL13,500 gross.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance for the employee and their family
  • 24 paid vacation days per year
  • 18 paid public holidays per year
  • English learning courses.
  • Relevant professional education.
  • Gym or swimming pool.
  • Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace.
  • Co-working.
  • Remote working.

**Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. Exercise caution and ensure the authenticity of emails claiming to be from our company.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.

title: Merchant Account Supervisor
description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

At Wave, excellent client relationships are our top priority. If you are a result-driven person with a passion for providing exceptional client service, then this opportunity is for you!

We’re looking for a Merchant Account Supervisor to join our dynamic Merchant Success team. You'll be responsible for managing the roll-out of corporate merchant products and supervising corporate merchant activities to ensure effective deployment, branding, training, compliance, data, and transaction rates across a specific merchant portfolio, within our merchant network.

In this role, you'll;

Corporate Merchant Deployment and Account Management

  • Support the deployment and management of corporate merchants across Côte d’Ivoire.

  • Ensure merchants understand our products and how to use our product, operational processes, and best practices.
  • Monitor merchant activation, performance, and ongoing engagement throughout the partnership lifecycle.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure merchants are fully operational and supported.

Partner Portfolio Management

  • Manage and develop the portfolio of partners (All product and specially API) by monitoring transaction volumes, alert on pick in volumes, performance, and growth opportunities.
  • Define and execute growth strategies in collaboration with partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Organize regular business and performance review meetings (every cycle/bi-cycle) with partners.
  • Identify risks, performance gaps, and opportunities to improve partner engagement and transaction growth.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key partner stakeholders.

API/Aggregator Management

  • Manage relationships and operational follow-up with aggregators.
  • Monitor the creation and activation of aggregated merchants.
  • Monitor the database with aggregator network KYB documents and activities prez;
  • Ensure the timely follow-up and resolution of Monday tickets related to aggregated merchant creation.
  • Coordinate with relevant internal teams to address onboarding, technical, or operational issues affecting aggregated merchants.
  • Collect and report market information (improvement, competition, opportunities, customer/corporate feedback, etc) .

Volume Monitoring and Performance Management

  • Monitor transaction volumes and key performance indicators across the partner portfolio.
  • Identify significant volume increases, decreases, or unusual transaction patterns and raise relevant alerts.
  • Contact and visit merchants regularly, especially when their volume of activity drops.
  • Conduct initial investigations into unexpected volume variations through partner outreach, internal data review, online research, and other relevant sources.
  • Provide timely insights and recommendations to support business growth and risk mitigation
  • Report detected bugs to engineers and be the support for relay with partners.
  • Coordinate with the marketing team on the implementation of promotions, events, communication and BTL activities for merchants, etc.

Compliance

  • Conduct regular compliance reviews and monitor partner activities for potential risks or suspicious patterns.
  • Identify and document potential compliance concerns.
  • Raise relevant issue cases and escalate suspicious activities to the Internal Control team in line with established procedures.
  • Support the implementation and follow-up of corrective actions when required.
  • Conduct regular field visits to ensure smooth operations, compliance with API policy and restrictions, and gather feedback from users and clients about their needs and suggestions.

Key details

  • Location: You'll work from our office in Abidjan.
  • You must have work authorization in Côte d’Ivoire.
  • This is a permanent assignment.
  • Our salaries are competitive and calculated using a transparent formula.
  • We offer generous health insurance for yourself and your dependents.
  • We support working parents - we offer (26 weeks for mothers and 4 weeks for fathers) and subsidized child care when you return to work.
  • We help you live your fullest life now- we subsidize gym memberships and fitness classes.
  • Airtime reimbursement.
  • Free food and a beautiful office space.

Requirements

  • Bachelor degree in Business Administration, Law, Management, Sales or a similar field.
  • 5+ years experience in a similar position.
  • Fluent in French and in English
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Previous experience conducting field-related merchant activities, including acquiring and onboarding merchants and ensuring they meet Wave criteria.
  • Experience supporting customers & corporate.

You might be a good fit if you

  • Have a good knowledge of the merchant and especially aggregator/fintech ecosystem.
  • Have strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build rapport with clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Have a good knowledge of data analysis and technical;
  • Demonstrate tenacity and a willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Have a proven track record of successfully managing client relationships.
  • Are comfortable defaulting to over-communication and overreaching when it comes to coordination.
  • Are excessively detail-oriented and seek to achieve excellence in everything you do.
  • Are client-oriented and have strong organizational and interpersonal skills.
  • Are a diplomatic speaker.
  • Have a teamwork spirit.
  • Are self-motivating with a focus on self-improvement.

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: VP, Pharmacovigilance & Safety
description:
Position

The Vice-President, Pharmacovigilance & Drug Safety serves as Ocugen’s head of pharmacovigilance and lead safety physician across the company’s clinical-stage portfolio of ocular gene therapies, including OCU400 (retinitis pigmentosa), OCU410 (geographic atrophy), and OCU410ST (Stargardt disease). The incumbent provides medical leadership and operational accountability for the global PV system—ICSR management, signal detection, benefit–risk evaluation, aggregate safety reporting, vendor oversight, and inspection readiness—with particular focus on the distinct safety considerations of subretinal and intravitreal administration, AAV-related immunogenicity, and long-term follow-up under FDA CBER guidance.

As a leader within a publicly traded biotechnology company, this role also supports timely and accurate safety input to executive leadership, the Board of Vice-Presidents, and external disclosures. The position partners closely with Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Medical Affairs, Quality Assurance, Legal, and external CROs and PV vendors.

Responsibilities

Medical Safety Leadership (Safety Physician)

  • Serve as the lead safety physician for assigned programs; provide medical judgment on causality, expectedness, seriousness, and clinical significance of all adverse

events.

  • Author and medically review clinical narratives for SAEs, SUSARs, and adverse events of special interest (AESI).
  • Lead benefit–risk assessments and ongoing product safety evaluations throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Provide safety input to clinical protocols, informed consent forms, Investigator Brochures, clinical study reports, and integrated safety summaries (ISS).
  • Serve as medical author and reviewer of aggregate safety reports, including DSURs, PSURs/PBRERs, IND annual reports, IB safety updates, and health authority responses.
  • Define and maintain program-level lists of AESIs, Targeted Medical Events (TMEs), and pre-specified safety endpoints.

Gene Therapy and Ophthalmology-Specific Safety

  • Develop and maintain program-specific safety surveillance strategies addressing the unique risk profile of ocular gene therapy, including intraocular inflammation (uveitis, vitritis, retinitis, endophthalmitis), chorioretinal atrophy, RPE changes, and

procedure-related events from subretinal or suprachoroidal delivery.

  • Provide medical oversight of AAV-related immunogenicity monitoring (pre-existing

and treatment-emergent neutralizing antibodies, T-cell responses), vector shedding analyses, and replication-competent AAV (rcAAV) considerations.

  • Adjudicate procedure-related versus product-related adverse events, including bilateral and contralateral-eye safety considerations.
  • Apply and maintain ophthalmic AE grading standards (e.g., SUN criteria for uveitis, CTCAE Ophthalmology, NEI conventions).
  • Oversee long-term safety follow-up (LTFU) studies and registry programs consistent with FDA CBER 5–15 year gene therapy follow-up guidance and applicable ICH expectations.

Pharmacovigilance Operations and Compliance

  • Provide strategic and operational leadership for the global PV system across clinical development and (as programs advance) post-marketing activities.
  • Ensure compliant intake, processing, medical review, and expedited and periodic reporting of AEs, SAEs, SUSARs, pregnancies, special situations, and product complaints in accordance with FDA, EMA, and other applicable authorities.
  • Own the Pharmacovigilance System Master File (PSMF), Safety Management Plans, Safety Data Exchange Agreements (SDEAs), and PV SOPs; ensure they remain current and inspection-ready.
  • Monitor PV compliance metrics (case timeliness, late-case rate, reconciliation status, query turnaround); investigate and remediate quality or regulatory risks.
  • Ensure integrity, accuracy, and completeness of the safety database; oversee MedDRA coding quality and consistency.

Signal Detection, Risk Management, and DSMB Support

  • Lead routine and ad hoc signal detection activities; convene and chair internal safety review meetings.
  • Drive Risk Management Plan (RMP) and, where applicable, REMS development as programs advance toward BLA.
  • Serve as the company safety interface with Data Safety Monitoring Boards (DSMB/IDMC); develop charters, prepare data review packages, and operationalize DSMB recommendations.
  • Provide medical safety support for clinical hold responses, FDA Type B/C meetings, and other health authority interactions.

Vendor Oversight and Inspection Readiness

  • Provide sponsor oversight of PV CROs, case processing vendors, and safety service providers; manage SLAs, KPIs, governance forums, and quality oversight.
  • Lead PV inspection readiness; serve as subject matter expert for FDA BIMO, EMA, MHRA, and PMDA inspections.
  • Oversee PV-related CAPAs, deviations, and audit responses; partner with Quality Assurance on continuous improvement.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership and Public Company Support

  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Quality, Legal, and Investor Relations to ensure safety information is appropriately integrated into regulatory submissions, study communications, and external disclosures.
  • Provide safety input to material event assessments, risk factor disclosures in periodic SEC filings, and safety briefings to executive leadership and the Audit Committee or full Board as requested.
  • Deliver safety training to internal teams, investigators, and vendors on protocol-specific reporting obligations and PV procedures.
  • Monitor evolving global PV regulations (FDA 21 CFR 312/314/600/1271, EU GVP, ICH E2A–E2F, FDA CBER gene therapy guidance) and implement updates to systems and processes.

description:

  • 사내 공모 정책: [Link]

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

카탈로그 오퍼레이션 조직은 서울, 연길, 대만의 400명 이상 규모 인력을 기반으로 감사 프레임워크(Audit Framework) 설계, 카탈로그 품질 프로그램, 인력 스케일링, 거버넌스 관리 등 최우선 순위(P0) 프로젝트들을 운영합니다. 조직이 성장함에 따라 이 핵심 포지션들을 전담하여 이끌어갈 책임자(Single-threaded owner)가 필요합니다. 본 역할은 최우선 프로그램들이 차질 없이 추적·관리되고, 높은 품질 기준을 충족하며 완수되도록 총괄합니다.

Senior Operations Program Manager는 P0 이니셔티브 포트폴리오 전체를 엔드투엔드(End-to-End)로 관리합니다. 조직 전체의 방향성을 맞추는 운영 체계를 설계·운영하고, 특정 팀에 속하지 않는 영역의 실행을 이끌며, 리더십의 의사결정이 명확한 실행 과제로 이어지도록 만듭니다. 서울, 연길, 대만의 오피스 리더십과 긴밀히 협력하며 조직의 이니셔티브 전달을 책임지는 고임팩트·실행 중심의 리더 역할입니다.

업무 내용

  • P0 포트폴리오 관리 (P0 Portfolio Management)
    • 모든 P0 이니셔티브의통합 현황을 관리하고 프로젝트 계획, 의존성, 리스크, 이스컬레이션 경로를 운영합니다.
    • 일정이 지연되는 지점을 조기에 파악하여 리더십에 갑작스러운 이슈로 보고되기 전에 선제적으로 해결합니다.
  • 운영 체계 및 프로세스 구축 (Operating Cadence and Mechanisms)
    • 주간 비즈니스 리뷰(WBR), 월간 딥다이브(MBR), 분기별 기획(QBR) 등 조직의 전체적인 운영 리듬을 설계하고 이끕니다.
    • 회의 아젠다의 질, 사전 읽기 자료(Pre-read)의 표준, 그리고 액션 아이템 관리(Action item register)를 철저히 관리합니다.
    • 회의에서 결정된 사항은 담당자와 기한이 명확한 실행 과제로 할당하며, 모든 항목에 대해 완료까지 추적합니다.
  • 크로스 사이트 및 크로스 펑셔널 실행 (Cross-Site and Cross-Functional Execution)
    • 여러 국가에 걸쳐 있거나 오퍼레이션, 엔지니어링, 품질(QA) 등 다수 부서에 걸쳐 있는 프로젝트를 총괄 관리합니다.
    • 담당 팀이 모호하고 리더십 공백의 위험이 높은 이니셔티브(예: 감사 프레임워크 도입, 거버넌스 개편, 카탈로그 목표 달성을 위한 거점별 확장 프로그램 등)를 주도합니다.
  • 임원진 보고 및 서사 작성 (Executive Reporting and Narrative)
    • 비즈니스 리뷰 문서, 리더십 업데이트, 기획 보고서 등 상부 보고용 문서를 작성합니다.
    • 복잡한 오퍼레이션 상세 현황을 VP급 이상 임원진의 의사결정에 도움이 되는 명확하고 간결한 서사(Narrative) 문서로 변환합니다. 카탈로그 결함 조사 및 해결 (Catalog Defect Investigation and Resolution) 카탈로그 결함의 근본 원인 분석(RCA)을 전담하는 소규모 조사 팀을 이끕니다. 명확한 마일스톤과 담당자가 포함된 문제 해결 문서(Correction of Error, CoE)를 작성합니다. 타 부서 담당자들과 협력하여 결함 해결 방안이 실제 적용될 때까지의 전 과정을 총괄 관리합니다. 팀 리더로서 조사 프로세스의 품질 기준을 설정하고, 팀의 분석 역량을 강화하며, 조직의 요구 수준에 맞춰 결함 처리 속도를 유지합니다. 전략적 이니셔티브 수행 (Strategic Initiatives) 특정 팀의 관할에 속하지 않지만 시급하고 중요한 문제들을 발굴하고 해결합니다. 모호한 문제의 범위를 정의하고, 이해관계자들의 의견을 조율하며, 최종 결과물을 이끌어냅니다.

자격 요건

  • 오퍼레이션, 프로그램 매니지먼트 또는 경영 컨설팅 경력 8년 이상 (대규모 오퍼레이션 환경에서 다중 워크스트림 프로그램을 관리해 본 경력 3년 이상 포함)
  • 직접 관리하지 않는 부서 및 조직에 대해 영향력(Influence)을 발휘하여 성과를 만들어낸 경험
  • 뛰어난 서면 소통 능력: 여러 부서의 복잡한 진행 상황을 임원진이 바로 의사결정할 수 있는 간결한 문서로 요약할 수 있는 역량
  • 운영 프로세스(비즈니스 리뷰, 기획 주기, 이스컬레이션 프로세스 등)를 직접 설계하고 운영해 본 경험
  • 오퍼레이션 데이터에 대한 이해도: 각 팀이 보고하는 데이터를 검증할 수 있을 정도의 샘플링 개념, 품질 지표, 캐파(Capacity) 모델 활용 능력
  • 소규모 오퍼레이션 또는 프로그램 팀을 리드하거나 멘토링해 본 경험 (실무자 역할과 피플 매니저 역할을 모두 원활히 수행할 수 있는 분)

우대 사항

  • 이커머스, 마켓플레이스 오퍼레이션, 카탈로그, 콘텐츠, Trust & Safety 등 품질 중심 오퍼레이션 영역에서의 근무 경험
  • 여러 거점에 분산된 다국적 조직에서 C-Level/임원급 리더를 지원해 본 경험
  • 비즈니스급 영어 회화 및 작성 능력과 함께 한국어 또는 중국어 활용이 가능하신 분
  • 대규모 조직 환경에서 Jira 기반으로 프로그램 및 프로젝트를 추적해 본 경험

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

반드시 첨부된 ‘사내공모지원서 양식’을 작성 후 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.

Please complete the attached Internal Transfer Request Form and submit.

반드시 쿠팡 이메일 계정으로 지원해 주시기 바랍니다.

Please make sure to apply with your Coupang e-mail address.

title: ASSOCIATE, INVESTMENT SOLUTIONS PRODUCT MANAGEMENT
description:
About Cresset

Cresset is a firm built by clients, for clients. As an independent, award-winning multi-family office and private investment firm, we are reimagining the way wealth is experienced. Our purpose is to help ensure that both wealth and life are fully optimized—integrated, intentional, and aligned with each client’s vision of success.

We provide access to the caliber of talent, ideas, and investment opportunities typically available to the largest single-family offices and institutions. Our approach is personalized, entrepreneurial, and client-first.

Proudly owned by our clients and employees, Cresset was built to endure. We are creating a 100+ year firm—one focused on delivering an exceptional experience, not only for the families we serve but for the team that serves them. Recognized by Barron’s and Forbes among the nation’s top RIA firms, and as one of the industry’s best places to work,* Cresset is guided by long-term relationships, shared success, and a belief that wealth should serve a life well lived.

Job Description

We are seeking an associate level Product Manager to join our Investment Solutions team. This role will sit at the intersection of investment management, technology, and business operations, helping build and enhance the technology platforms that support our investment process and advisor experience.

This role will be primarily responsible for the ongoing development and advancement of MSCI Wealth Manager, working closely with investment teams, advisors, operations, technology partners, and other stakeholders to translate business needs into effective platform capabilities.

Beyond MSCI Wealth Manager, this individual will contribute to the broader Investment Solutions technology ecosystem, including applications and workflows supporting investment research, portfolio construction, portfolio rebalancing, and investment implementation.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone with financial technology experience who enjoys solving complex problems, working across teams, and taking ownership of products from requirements through implementation.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership & Platform Development

  • Serve as a key product owner for MSCI Wealth Manager, developing a deep understanding of the platform, its capabilities, and its role within the firm's investment and advisory workflows.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to identify opportunities to improve functionality, workflows, usability, and adoption.
  • Translate business and investment requirements into clear functional requirements, user stories, workflows, and development priorities.
  • Manage and prioritize product enhancements in partnership with internal technology teams and external vendors.
  • Coordinate testing, implementation, documentation, and rollout of new functionality.
  • Monitor platform performance and user feedback and proactively identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Investment Solutions Technology

  • Support product strategy and development across the firm's broader Investment Solutions technology ecosystem.
  • Contribute to applications and workflows supporting:
  • Investment research and research management
  • Portfolio construction and analysis
  • Portfolio rebalancing
  • Investment implementation and related advisor workflows
  • Develop an understanding of how these systems interact and identify opportunities to improve integration, data quality, efficiency, and the overall user experience.
  • Help evaluate new technologies and capabilities that could enhance the firm's investment platform.

Stakeholder & Requirements Management

  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders across Investments, Wealth Management, Technology, Operations, and other functions.
  • Lead or participate in requirements-gathering sessions to understand business problems and translate them into actionable product requirements.
  • Communicate effectively between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Maintain clear documentation of requirements, decisions, workflows, testing results, and product enhancements.
  • Manage multiple initiatives simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail and follow-through.

title: Health Information Supervisor
description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The purpose of this position is to support the business with an emphasis in Health Information functions and the Health Information Exchange (HIE) while assuring adherence to Federal HIPAA Guidelines and provide a communication point person for providers, staff, and external entities. This job will primary be remote work with occasional in-person meetings and events.


CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Provides work direction.
2. Coordinates staff schedules.
3. Oversee staff training, including creating and updating training guides.
4. Problem solves and trouble shoots department issues.
5. Conducts performance reviews.
6. Assists in recruitment and facilitates new hire training.
7. Creates reports and performs analysis.
8. Collaborates with other departments, providers and outside facilities.
9. Other duties as assigned by Manager.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Maintains patient confidentiality and abide by HIPAA laws and regulations.
2. Oversees health information functions: importing and abstracting of patient records, release of records and the patient portal.
3. Assists the EMR Manager to create, revise, train and/or implement workflow for
the Health Information Exchange (HIE) and/or Oracle Cerner Direct correspondence.
4. Manages and tracks insurance payer audits to ensure timely completion.
5. Performs analysis to monitor staff production and provide feedback to staff as a group and individually.
6. Demonstrates exceptional customer service skills with patients, providers, staff and partnering medical facilities.
7. Works independently, multi-tasks and provides mentorship to the HIS Team Lead and staff.
8. Leads department meetings and staff connections.

SUPPLEMENTAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Assists Business Services Supervisor colleagues with staff related responsibilities for the Insurance and Accounts Receivable Departments, as needed.
2. Investigates and addresses HIPAA violations within the team. Notifies affected patients of breach in accordance with organizations policies and applicable laws.
3. Provides phone support and assist with in-house duties, as needed for coverage.
4. Works effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
5. Remains flexible, adapt to change, and effectively prioritize changing workload.
6. Possess strong analytical, grammatical, spelling and communication skills.

WORKING CONDITIONS:
1. Is subject to interruptions, imposed deadlines and frequent problem-solving activities.
2. May be subject to hostile and emotionally upset patients, staff, and personnel from other agencies.
3. Standard Office Environment.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:
1. Abide by ergonomic recommendations of the position.
2. Must possess sight/hearing senses, or use prosthetic devices that will enable these senses to function adequately.
3. Sit for several hours.
4. Subject to lifting and carrying supplies averaging 25 lbs. (i.e., cartons of paper, medical supplies, office supplies, etc.).
5. Repetitive motions involving use of phone and keyboard.

title: Floor Technician
description:
*** Please note this position requires Saturday availability.

Job Purpose

The Floor Technician is position in which work may consist of primary dock duties such as: unloading and loading trucks, wrapping furniture, disposing of cardboard and other dock functions that keep employee in the dock area for the majority of their hours. This position is the same as Floor Technician II but on a limited basis as directed by the Floor Design Manager.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Gallery Setup.
  • Pickup furniture from the Distribution Center for placing on showroom floors.
    • Requires DOT medical card and a valid Class B or C license (CDL not required).
  • Unbox and inspect all furniture before placing items on the floor.
  • Keep all inventory scanned into proper locations.
  • Lift, carry, and/or push furniture with a minimum weight of 100 lbs. in such a way to avoid injury.
  • Move furniture by freight elevator.
  • Pull sold merchandise off the Mart, Showroom and Clearance Center floors.
  • Prepare furniture for shipment to Distribution Center.
  • Work rotating Friday nights and Saturdays.
  • Assist Manager or his/her delegate in special projects or tasks as he/she may assign. This may include work in conjunction with or on behalf of other departments.
  • Arrive punctually and consistently for work for normally scheduled eight-hour days, five days a week. Additional hours may be required as needed.
  • Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.
  • Perform various related duties as required or assigned by supervisor.

The job duties are not limited to the items as described above, duties can be added or changed at any given time. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Working Conditions

This job is an onsite position that operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as laptop computers, photocopiers and smartphones.

Physical Requirements

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and ability to adjust focus. This would require the ability to lift files, open filing cabinets and bend or stand on a stool as necessary.

title: Laundry - Double Weekend
location: Northwest Nursing Center - Oklahoma City, OK 73112
description:
The Laundry Aide is responsible for providing clean and sanitary linens, clothing, and other laundry items for residents and the facility. This position ensures proper handling, washing, drying, folding, and distribution of laundry while maintaining infection control standards and safety procedures in a nursing environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collect soiled linens, towels, and resident clothing from designated areas.

  • Sort laundry according to type, color, and washing requirements.

  • Operate commercial washers and dryers according to facility procedures.

  • Fold, stack, and distribute clean laundry to resident rooms and facility departments.

  • Ensure proper labeling and return of resident personal clothing.

  • Follow infection control procedures when handling contaminated laundry.

At Big Bend Health, facilities aren't simply buildings—they are the environments where patients receive care, families find support, and our teams do meaningful work.

Your work helps make sure:

Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

$80,200—$118,000 USD

title: Software Engineer, Runtime
description:
About IonQ:

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Location: Oxford, UK
Job ID: 1831

The Role:

We are looking for a Systems Software Engineer to join our Runtime Software team at Oxford Ionics / IonQ. In this role, you will be responsible for working directly with the experimental scientists to implement the real-time control system behaviours and provide abstractions they require for their experiments, contributing to the team’s mission of enabling our science teams to experiment and improve the primitive operations which allow compute, and building towards fault tolerant computation.

You’ll play an important part in shaping the core, Rust, libraries and the execution environment which take our system from a collection of hardware to a quantum computer, and support our work in building the world’s most advanced quantum systems.

Responsibilities:

In this position, you will work on developing abstractions over real-time control hardware, supporting the effective delivery of a control system capable of repeatedly and reproducibly driving our ions with nano-second level precision, with abstractions which are conducive to both fast iteration and system scaling.

You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate the science core to the development of our systems, and contribute to the core execution model of our quantum computers, contributing directly to the success of building utility-scale quantum computers.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Collaborating with scientists to understand their requirements.
  • Interfacing with system orchestration, non-realtime control and compiler teams to ensure our work integrates seamlessly with the wider software architecture.
  • Implementing drivers for various real-time devices.
  • Producing tooling to enable users of our code to iterate rapidly and fearlessly.
  • Developing the execution environment for the user programs which run on our systems.
  • Continually improving the APIs used by our internal users.

Requirements:

To be successful, you will need expert programming skills in a systems programming language and a desire to produce high quality code appropriate to a real-time environment. We’re looking for someone who can quickly iterate on low-level code in a collaborative, cross-disciplinary, environment and contribute effectively within a fast moving, highly technical team.

You’d be a great fit if you:

  • Have strong programming skills in one or more mainstream programming languages
  • Have experience with a systems programming programming
  • Have an interest in or experience with Rust
  • Have developed excellent communication skills both within the context of software and across disciplines
  • Are comfortable working with rapidly evolving requirements
  • Are used to maintaining and producing high quality code reviews and appropriate testing
  • Have a desire to maximize impact through quick iteration and short cycles of learning and improvement
  • Are eager to learn and develop your skills

title: Solutions Sales Engineer
description:
Superlinear is building Holon, an Enterprise Orchestration Platform for the physical economy.

Large companies that move or make goods run every part of their operation on its own system. One decides what stock is needed, another plans the warehouse, another plans the trucks. Each system optimises its own KPI, so a decision that looks right to logistics quietly costs margin in commercial. Companies leave two to four percentage points of EBITDA on the table this way. Not because their departments are inefficient, but because no tool optimises the end-to-end chain. We call it the Orchestration Gap.

That’s where Enterprise Orchestration comes in. Not another tool for one of your departments, but the first system that optimises departments jointly against one objective: net contribution.

Backed by a €6M Series A, we intend to unlock a 1% increase in EU GDP. Profitable enterprises are the engine that funds our society, so every point of efficiency we unlock in the physical economy is a resource Europe gets back. That is the shift we’re after: from a world of scarcity to a world of possibility.

As a Solutions Sales Engineer at Superlinear, you are focused on market penetration. Deals are large and complex: multi-stakeholder, COO or CEO as buyer, IT and Finance as gatekeepers, sales cycles measured in months. Every deal starts by earning the right to reframe a problem they think is already covered.

The role

You get to open a market. Europe's largest retailers know margin is leaking between their departments; nobody has ever shown them where, or what it is worth. You are the person who does, and you own that from the first cold conversation to a signed deal.

That means building it yourself. You create the conversations: outreach to retailers, expert and partner calls, until you are in front of someone who runs the operation. Then the discovery, working out where margin is actually leaking between departments, putting a number on it, and showing what it would take to recover it. Progressing pipeline in collaboration with Account Executives, deal by deal, until the business case is theirs rather than ours.

Done well, you are the trusted advisor rather than "the technical person on the call": the one who understands their operation better than they expected, and is therefore believed when they say what is possible.

What you'll do

  • Create the conversations. Outreach and prospecting, plus expert and partner conversations, to open doors at Europe's largest retailers and gather market input as you go.

  • Understand the prospect deeply. Map how their value chain actually works, find where departments optimise locally at the expense of the whole, and quantify what that costs them.

  • Build the business case. Turn their challenges into a defensible financial case a CFO will sign off on.

  • Own technical trust. IT and Finance are our gatekeepers. Integration, data readiness, governance, auditability, security. You answer these credibly rather than deferring them to a follow-up call.

  • Prove it on their operation. Run demos and workshops that show Holon against real retailer problems, not a generic dataset.

  • Progress the pipeline. Work deals forward with our Account Executives and founders, then hand over cleanly to deployment once one is signed.

  • Feed the loop. Bring market insights back into positioning, product and marketing so the next conversation is easier than the last.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in pre-sales, solution consulting, or top-tier consulting in supply chain, operations or planning. You've been the person a client trusts in the room.

  • An expert at discovery. This matters more than anything else on this list. You get to the real problem because you know how to ask, not because someone briefed you.

  • You know 80% is in the preparation. You do the homework on the company and the operation before the call, so the time in the room is spent on what you couldn't have known.

  • Agile in conversation. You listen, and you tailor your questions and your pitch to the person in front of you rather than running a script.

  • You can build a business case a CFO believes. Comfortable with P&L logic, cost-to-serve, margin mechanics, and defending assumptions under pressure.

  • Diagnostic before prescriptive. You listen and map before you present. You've walked away from deals you knew wouldn't work.

  • Technically deep, commercially fluent. Comfortable discussing optimisation and data models with engineers, and margin with a COO, in the same afternoon.

  • A fast learner. Our market, our product and our story are all still moving. You pick things up quickly and don't wait to be trained.

  • Happy to travel. Our prospects are across Europe and the important conversations happen on their site.

  • English is our working language. Dutch or French is a strong plus given our first markets.

Bonus: optimisation or OR background · experience selling a category that didn't exist yet · retail or grocery operations experience.

What we offer

  • Competitive base, plus shareholder participation through our ESOP

  • Health and group insurance, meal and eco vouchers, mobility budget, net allowances, group and personal bonuses

  • High impact role in high growth environment

  • Hybrid working from our Brussels office

title: Associate Technical Specialist
description:
Associate Technical specialist

As an Associate Technical Specialist, you will join our MSAT Technical Support team and play a key role in ensuring robust, compliant, and efficient CAR‑T manufacturing operations. Acting as a subject matter expert (SME), you will provide hands‑on scientific and technical support on the shop floor while contributing to continuous improvement and operational excellence.

This role operates in a shift‑based model, providing direct shop floor and on‑call support to manufacturing operations.

What can you expect?

Here's what you'll do

  • Technical Support & Troubleshooting (Shop Floor Firefighting)
    • Act as the first point of contact for process‑related issues during manufacturing
    • Temporarily reprioritize work to support urgent shop floor issues, working via a ticketing system or ad‑hoc requests
    • Troubleshoot process and equipment‑related problems (e.g. equipment errors, process deviations, validation or technical constraints)
    • Lead or participate in escalation calls when issues cannot be immediately resolved, in close collaboration with MSAT leadership, Operations, Quality, and technical experts
  • MSAT – Operations Bridge & Process Ownership
    • Maintain strong on‑the‑floor presence through active engagement, including GEMBA walks in Grade B and Grade C environments
    • Act as a scientific bridge between MSAT and Operations, ensuring deep understanding of how processes are executed on the shop floor
    • Build strong relationships with stakeholders
    • Act as an end‑to‑end process owner, with a solid understanding of process robustness, acceptable deviations, and optimization opportunities
    • Apply a science‑driven perspective to ensure correct handling of cells and continuous improvement of manufacturing practices
  • Project & Continuous Improvement Support
    • Support process improvement and optimization initiatives, focusing on practical, impactful improvements.
    • Contribute to documentation updates, investigations, CAPAs, and change controls
    • Support larger projects
    • Contribute to data collection and trend analysis to support informed decision‑making

Who are we looking for?

Education

  • A minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences oriented field is required, or equivalent by experience

Experience

  • Minimum 3 years in total, of which 2 years in a cGMP biotech or biopharma environment
  • Experience in Cell and/or Gene Therapy manufacturing is a strong asset

Languages

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken

Strengths

  • Comfortable working in a shift‑based, operationally critical environment
  • Strong communicator able to translate complex topics across all organizational levels
  • Flexible, proactive, and accustomed to firefighting and rapid problem solving
  • Team‑oriented, empathetic, and able to build trust on the shop floor

Expertise

  • Troubleshooting complex scientific and technical issues with limited oversight
  • Strong knowledge of cGMP documentation (deviations, CAPAs, change controls)
  • Analytical, structured, and result‑driven mindset
  • Precise, quality‑focused, and compliant with procedures and standards

What do we offer you?

  • A meaningful job with an excellent work-life balance. You will work 4 days, followed by 4 days off (average working time 35 hours). Please be prepared to work across various shifts in the range starting from 6AM and ending by 2AM.
  • A supportive and innovative work environment. We value and encourage learning and personal development.
  • The opportunity to work with people from all over the world.
  • A contract of indefinite duration and an attractive salary package complemented by many fringe benefits, such as extra-legal holidays, meal vouchers, company laptop, net allowance, group and hospitalization insurance, double vacation pay, an end-of-year bonus, performance bonus and the possibility to participate in our bicycle lease plan.
  • Many fun and informal events.

About Legend Biotech

Legend Biotech is a global biotechnology company dedicated to developing, manufacturing, and commercializing innovative and life-saving cell therapies for the treatment of chronic and life-threatening diseases, such as cancer.

The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Somerset, New Jersey. Legend Biotech now employs over 2,400 people across six global manufacturing sites. Two of these sites are in Ghent: Obelisc (Technology Park Zwijnaarde) and Tech Lane (Eilandje Zwijnaarde).

In Ghent, Legend Biotech focuses on the production of advanced CAR-T cell therapies for the treatment of multiple myeloma, in close collaboration with Johnson & Johnson.

Legend Biotech is a proud equal opportunity/affirmative action employer committed to attracting, retaining, and maximizing the performance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is Legend’s policy to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, national origin, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, genetic information, citizenship status, uniformed service member or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Legend Biotech maintains a drug-free workplace.

title: QUALITY ENGINEER - SVP
description:
Quality Engineer

Injection Molding | Automotive & Aerospace Manufacturing

Location: El Paso, Texas
Industry: Plastic Injection Molding Manufacturing

Southwest Venture Plastics is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Quality Engineer to join our growing team. This position is ideal for a quality professional who combines strong quality engineering fundamentals with hands-on metrology expertise and a passion for continuous improvement.

The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting automotive and aerospace manufacturing programs, leading quality initiatives, driving corrective actions, supporting customer requirements, and ensuring compliance with IATF 16949 and AS9100 quality management systems.

This is a high-impact position that works closely with customers, manufacturing, engineering, suppliers, and production teams to ensure products consistently meet or exceed quality requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead quality planning activities including APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, Process Flow Diagrams, MSA, and SPC.
  • Develop, coordinate, and submit PPAP packages and customer-required documentation for new product launches, engineering changes, and annual validations.
  • Conduct root cause investigations using methodologies such as 8D, 5-Why, Fishbone, DMAIC, and other structured problem-solving techniques.
  • Lead customer complaint investigations and corrective action activities from containment through permanent corrective action implementation.
  • Support manufacturing teams in reducing scrap, rework, and operational costs through data-driven quality improvement initiatives.
  • Perform process capability studies and statistical analysis utilizing Minitab and other quality tools.
  • Develop and maintain inspection plans, quality documentation, and product acceptance criteria.
  • Perform internal audits, process audits, layered audits, and product audits to ensure compliance with customer and industry requirements.
  • Support and participate in IATF 16949 and AS9100 certification, surveillance, and customer audits.
  • Ensure compliance with aerospace and automotive customer requirements and applicable industry standards.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Tooling, Manufacturing, and Operations teams during product launches and process validations.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to quality technicians, inspectors, and production personnel.
  • Analyze quality trends and present quality metrics to management.

Metrology & Measurement Responsibilities

  • Program, operate, and troubleshoot Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMMs) and Micro-Vu vision systems.
  • Develop and optimize CMM programs using Calypso or equivalent metrology software.
  • Perform dimensional layouts, first article inspections, annual validations, and capability studies.

  • Support calibration systems and ensure measurement equipment compliance.
  • Provide metrology expertise and training to internal teams.

title: Fire Alarm Designer

title: Senior Software Engineer, Aiven Context
description:
We’re a global team of over 400 people, working together to push the boundaries of open-source technology and multi-cloud solutions. Our vision is to help developers, builders, and creators bring their ideas to life with speed and simplicity, by providing a cloud data platform that makes open-source databases, search, streaming, and application infrastructure easily accessible to everyone.

The Role:

The team's mission is to build the definitive AI-Native Open Source Data Platform. They are integrating best-of-breed open-source technologies - starting with data governance and discovery (DataHub) and moving into unified federated querying - to deliver a seamless data experience in minutes, not months.

They aren't a typical corporate team. They operate like an early-stage startup inside Aiven: they move fast, iterate rapidly, and default to extreme ownership. Senior Software Engineers don't just own a product surface from ideation to production - they shape how the team builds, help resolve the hardest technical problems, and raise the bar for everyone around them.

The AI-First Mindset

They aren't just building for an AI-first future; they live in it. They expect candidates to be AI-First Engineers. This means actively using LLMs and agentic workflows to supercharge daily coding, automate mundane tasks, and optimize deployment pipelines. Senior engineers are also expected to bring this mindset to the team - identifying where AI-driven workflows can multiply the team's output and helping others adopt them.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the Stack (Backend to Console): Act as a true full-stack engineer across backend services written in Python and the user-facing web flows within the React-based Aiven Console, taking on the most architecturally significant and ambiguous parts of the system.
  • Drive Technical Direction: Work on complex, open-ended problems where the right approach isn't obvious - evaluate variable factors, choose methods and techniques, and define the patterns and standards the rest of the team builds on.
  • Launch & Maintain Managed OSS Products: Lead the technical design and delivery of new managed services like DataHub on Aiven, and help build out the context layer offering as it matures.
  • Mentor and Raise the Bar: Review designs and code, advise other engineers on complex technical matters, and help less experienced team members grow.
  • Contribute Back to the Community: Give back to the ecosystem by upstreaming bug fixes, optimizations, and feature enhancements to original open-source projects whenever possible.
  • Build AI-First Workflows: Design and productionize AI context workflows, including synthetic metadata generation, reducing hallucinations, and automated data discovery workflows.
  • Construct the Aiven Context Layer: Create integrations, features, and workflows that turn fragmented technologies into a seamless platform experience.
  • Partner Beyond the Team: Network with contacts outside the immediate team - product, design, other engineering groups - and adapt how you communicate technical tradeoffs to a broader business audience.

What You'll Bring:

  • Senior software engineering experience, with a track record of resolving complex problems that require in-depth evaluation of variable factors and ambiguous requirements.
  • Diverse Programming Skills: Deep proficiency in Python, with the judgment to select, adapt, and evaluate techniques for new or unfamiliar problems (Java, etc. as needed).
  • Frontend Capabilities: Solid experience with React and TypeScript, plus enough product intuition to make UI decisions that hold up without close direction.
  • Sound Technical Judgment: Comfortable determining your own methods and procedures on new assignments, with work reviewed on completion rather than step by step.
  • An AI-First Workflow: You've already integrated AI tools deeply into your development process, and you look for automation opportunities for yourself and your team.
  • A Startup Soul: You thrive in ambiguous environments, don't wait for permission or perfect documentation, and are comfortable being the person who figures things out first.
  • Data Systems Literacy: Familiarity with the foundational building blocks of modern data stacks (e.g., PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Kafka).

Nice to Have:

  • Prior experience as an early startup hire.
  • Active contributions to open-source software (OSS) projects.
  • Background or strong interest in agentic context, data catalogs, or ontologies.
  • Experience building or experimenting with Agentic workflows, Text-to-SQL, or Graph RAG.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical initiatives that span multiple engineers or teams.

Amazing! What’s next:

If you think Aiven is the place for you and that our Values align with yours, send us your resume and we’ll get in touch!

Global Benefits:

Our global benefits are designed to help you thrive and grow, personally and professionally:

  • Participate in Aiven’s equity plan.
  • Balance work and life with our hybrid work policy.
  • Choose the equipment you need to set yourself up for success.
  • Use your Professional Development Plan budget for learning opportunities.
  • Receive holistic wellbeing support through our global Employee Assistance Program.
  • Inquire about our Global Time Off Commitment (Parental and Sick Leave, as well as Personal Time)
  • Enjoy country-specific benefits for our global cast.

How to Recognize and Avoid Employment Scams:

There has been a rise in fake job postings used by scammers to get personal information. At Aiven, all of our emails relating to recruitment come from an @aiven.io, @greenhouse.io or @eu.greenhouse.io domain and all of our interviews are conducted by video call or in person. title: INFORMATION SYSTEMS SPEC II
description:
Information Systems Specialist II

Located at Central Maine Community College

The Maine Community College System (MCCS) is seeking a full-time Information Systems Specialist II. Under limited supervision and a high level of judgment required, this technical services position provide management and troubleshooting of all classroom audio visual and computing equipment. This position provides tier 1 support for enterprise applications, and the infrastructure divisions, including, where appropriate, research and proactive maintenance at the assigned colleges. The position will perform tier 1 technical support and administrative functions across the complete range of technologies supported by MCCS IT Shared Services, requiring a vast knowledge of multiple user and server hardware, software and Software as a Service environment. This position is also responsible for installing, configuring, and maintaining campus specific software and services based on their college assignment. The position is required to keep up to date on current computer technology in order to perform their duties and contribute to recommendations regarding policy development and improvements. They may also provide input for the development of information technology plans for the college, working collaboratively with College employees including the Helpdesk Manager and MCCS Deputy Chief Information Officer. This position is located at Central Maine Community College and the work hours during the academic year, are Monday – Thursday from 10:00AM - 6:30PM, and Friday 8:00AM - 4:30PM. During the off academic year work hours are Monday – Friday from 8:00AM - 4:30PM.

The Information Systems Specialist II position is classified within the MSEA Support Services Unit range 19. The position expects to pay in the vicinity of $25.35 per hour dependent on experience and qualifications. MCCS offers a full suite of employee benefits including health, dental, vision and life insurance, retirement savings, flexible savings accounts, employee assistance program, tuition waivers, 529 education plan MCCS matching grant and paid holidays, vacation, and sick time.

The required minimum qualifications include an associate’s degree in information technology or related field and four years of experience in information technology or related discipline. Years of relevant training and experience may be considered in lieu of minimum education requirements on a year-for-year basis.

The required knowledge, skills, and abilities include, but not limited to, the following:

  • Knowledge of complex design, image creation, implementation, upgrades, management, and troubleshooting of computers and labs on all CMCC campuses, as well as project management concerning computer/lab replacement cycles.
  • Ability to coordinate and or perform installations, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of desktop and laptop computers at CMCC, requiring analysis and resolution.
  • Ability to keep up to date on current computer technology in order to make informed recommendations regarding policy improvements and future needs in the computer labs, in working with faculty, and shared services staff.

  • Skilled in providing support in the research, development, and maintenance of desktop documentation (how labs are configured).

To apply, please upload your cover letter, current resume/CV, including names and contact information for three professional references, and official transcripts when you complete the online application. Search will remain open until the position is filled.

title: Application Analyst - Epic Hospital Billing (Salaried, Full time)
location: Washington Regional Med. Ctr. - Fayetteville, AR 72703
description:
Organization Overview, Mission, Vision, and Values

Our mission is to improve the health of people in the communities we serve through compassionate, high-quality care, prevention, and wellness education. Washington Regional Medical System is a community-owned, locally governed, non-profit health care system located in Northwest Arkansas in the heart of Fayetteville, which is consistently ranked among the Best Places to live in the country. Our 425-bed medical center has been named the #1 hospital in Arkansas for five consecutive years by U.S. News & World Report. We employ 3,200+ team members and serve the region with over 40 clinic locations, the region’s only Level II trauma center, and five Centers of Excellence - the Washington Regional J.B. Hunt Transport Services Neuroscience Institute; Washington Regional Walker Heart Institute; Washington Regional Women and Infants Center; Washington Regional Total Joint Center; and Washington Regional Pat Walker Center for Seniors.

Position Summary

The Application Analyst - Epic Hospital Billing reports to the Manager of Business Applications and is responsible for the build, support, optimization, testing, and ongoing maintenance of Epic Resolute Hospital Billing functionality, with a primary focus on Charge Router and Hospital Billing charging workflows. This position partners closely with Revenue Cycle, Revenue Integrity, clinical operations, Information Services, vendors, and Epic support resources to ensure accurate charge capture, charge routing, account posting, workqueue performance, issue resolution, and system reliability. The analyst serves as a subject matter resource for Epic Hospital Billing charging configuration, troubleshooting, upgrades, enhancements, and operational adoption.

Essential Position Responsibilities

  • Build, maintain, test, and optimize Epic Resolute Hospital Billing functionality with emphasis on Charge Router, Hospital Billing charging administration, charge capture, charge review, and related revenue cycle workflows.
  • Configure and support charging rules, routing logic, workqueues, charge review processes, and related system build to promote accurate, timely, and compliant charge generation and posting.
  • Partner with Revenue Cycle, Revenue Integrity, Finance, clinical departments, and operational leaders to evaluate charging workflows, resolve charging issues, and implement system improvements that support organizational revenue cycle performance.
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve application issues, including failed charges, workqueue errors, routing concerns, configuration defects, and end-user support tickets.
  • Lead or participate in application testing, including unit testing, integrated testing, regression testing, upgrade testing, charge testing, and validation of new or modified functionality.
  • Document system build, workflow decisions, testing outcomes, issue resolution steps, and operational impacts in accordance with Information Services standards and change control processes.
  • Collaborate with application analysts across clinical, access, professional billing, claims, coding, interfaces, reporting, and data teams to support integrated charging workflows and downstream billing processes.
  • Monitor application performance, ticket trends, charging errors, workqueue activity, and system outcomes to identify opportunities for optimization, standardization, and process improvement.
  • Support Epic upgrades, special updates, Nova notes, break/fix activities, optimization requests, and project work related to Hospital Billing and Charge Router functionality.
  • Serve as a liaison between Information Services and operational stakeholders to translate business needs into effective system design, workflow configuration, and sustainable support processes.
  • Provide guidance, communication, and support to end users, super users, revenue cycle leaders, and application teams regarding system functionality, charging workflow changes, and issue resolution.
  • Maintain active engagement with Epic support resources, vendor tools, knowledge repositories, and application governance processes to support reliable and compliant system operations.
  • Participate in incident response, downtime planning, issue escalation, and post-implementation support activities as needed.
  • Ensure assigned applications and workflows support applicable regulatory, compliance, privacy, security, and organizational standards, including the safeguarding of protected health information.
  • Prepare and maintain project plans, status updates, issue lists, testing documentation, and other materials necessary to support application governance and operational readiness.
  • Support knowledge transfer, cross-training, and mentoring of team members to promote continuity of application support and long-term team effectiveness.

Qualifications

  • Education: High school diploma or GED, required.
  • Licensure and Certifications: Epic certification in Charge Router and Epic certification in Hospital Billing Charging Administration, required. Additional Epic Resolute Hospital Billing certification or proficiency, preferred.
  • Experience: Four years of business applications, revenue cycle, information systems, or related healthcare technology experience, required. Experience supporting Epic Hospital Billing, Charge Router, charge capture, revenue integrity, billing workflows, workqueues, testing, troubleshooting, and application build, preferred.

Work Environment: This position will spend 90% of time sitting while performing work in a standard office environment and 10% of time standing and/or walking while pushing, pulling, lifting, and/or carrying up to 50 lbs. This is role is considered a remote position with onsite presence as needed.

Notice: This job description is designed to provide an overview of the essential and principal duties and responsibilities of the position. The job description is not designed or intended to cover or set forth a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Washington Regional reserves the right in its absolute discretion to change duties, responsibilities or activities or assign new duties, responsibilities, or activities at any time with or without notice. Employees may be directed to perform job-related tasks other than those specifically presented in this description.

title: Quality Inspector
description:
Quality Inspector
Mason, Ohio
Reports to: Quality Manager

🔐 U.S. Citizen, U.S. Person, or Immigration Status Requirements:

Candidate must be a US citizen to meet the eligibility criteria for this position

🌐 Who We Are?

RH Aero Systems is setting the standard for aviation support equipment and services. Through our industry-leading businesses – Rhinestahl and HYDRO Systems – we deliver capability across custom-designed Ground Support Equipment, OEM-licensed engine and airframe tooling, 26 global service centers and innovative engineered solutions for OEMs, MROs and Operators worldwide. RH Aero Systems’ global headquarters are in Mason, Ohio, USA, and Biberach, Germany. For further details visit RHAero.com.

🚀 Why Join Us?

Join our Quality team in a hands-on role where your attention to detail directly supports aerospace quality, customer requirements, and continuous improvement. As a Quality Inspector, you will inspect, test, sample, and sort products against customer specifications, technical requirements, and marking standards while partnering closely with the Quality Manager and Quality Engineer. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving quality challenges, supporting strong supplier and internal performance, and growing toward broader Quality Engineering responsibilities.

As Quality Inspector, you will:

  • Inspect, test, sample, and sort products to ensure they meet customer specifications, technical requirements, and quality standards.
  • Use gages, coordinate measuring tools, point verification methods, and optical comparator equipment to confirm product compliance.
  • Review protocols, qualifications, validation procedures, inspection reports, and findings to support accurate documentation and corrective action.
  • Audit and monitor quality requirements by performing detailed inspections of machined goods in line with company quality policies and customer specifications.
  • Investigate nonconforming materials, support issue resolution, and help ensure final inspection clearance.
  • Verify that goods comply with internal requirements, customer requirements, and applicable federally regulated protocols.

As Trainee Quality Engineer, you will:
